However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

</details>


### [158] [Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23484)
*Naman Garg,Sarika Jain,George Fazekas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Team Semiintelligencn在ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛中的解决方案，采用三阶段流水线实现对话式音乐推荐，包括多模态检索（七种稠密嵌入空间加权融合）、轻量级重排序和基于GPT-4o-mini的个性化回复生成，最终在Blind B上取得0.3213的综合得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决对话式音乐推荐中多模态信息融合与个性化生成的挑战，参与ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛，探索如何在有限的资源约束下构建高性能的对话式推荐系统。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 多模态检索，在七个稠密嵌入空间（CF-BPR的track/user级、Qwen3的元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP音频、SigLIP视觉）构建衰减加权质心，结合BM25词法检索与艺术家子串匹配信号，通过加权RRF融合（权重用差分进化在500会话开发集上优化）；(2) 轻量级重排序，包括历史过滤、流行度平滑和目录多样性惩罚；(3) 使用GPT-4o-mini生成个性化回复。此外探索了LLM引导的艺术家注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART和GPT-4.1提示等未部署组件。

Result: 差分进化优化RRF权重使MRR提升19.5%；在Blind A上发现无约束的LLM引导注入（54个会话）导致nDCG下降18.9%，而保守注入（9个会话）取得最佳Blind A nDCG；提交系统在Blind B上取得0.3213的综合得分。

Conclusion: 多模态加权融合检索与轻量级重排序构成有效的对话式音乐推荐方案，但LLM引导注入的部署需要谨慎权衡收益与风险，部分开发实验组件因成本和复杂度限制未部署到最终提交。

Abstract: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

</details>


### [159] [SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23493)
*Jialong Liu,Yuling Shi,Ning Yang,Xiaodong Gu,Zuchao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO)框架，让LLM通过自我反思将稀疏的终局反馈转化为密集的token级训练信号，无需外部批评器、奖励模型或更大规模的教师模型。在数学推理和长程智能体基准上取得SOTA性能，显著提升数据效率（AIME'24达73.3%，仅需SFT的8%训练FLOPs）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我反思是人类学习中强大的信用分配机制，能将稀疏结果反馈转化为可操作的指导，但这一能力在LLM训练后阶段尚未被充分探索。现有的训练范式缺乏将稀疏监督信号转化为密集学习信号的有效手段。

Method: SRPO让LLM分析自己完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的"反思片段"（reflection patches），并使用反思作为条件的教师评分，作用于学生的on-policy rollout，从而产生密集的token级训练信号。整个过程无需外部批评器、独立奖励模型或更大规模的教师模型。

Result: 在数学推理和长程智能体基准上达到SOTA性能。基于Qwen3-8B，AIME'24准确率达73.3%，仅使用sSFT所需训练FLOPs的8%（0.08x）；WebShop成功率64.7%、ALFWorld 76.8%、SWE-Bench-Lite 31.2%，均有显著提升。

Conclusion: SRPO成功将稀疏的终局监督转化为密集的token级学习信号，实现了卓越的数据效率与性能，证明了自我反思机制在LLM策略优化中的巨大潜力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

</details>


### [160] [Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23497)
*Yipeng Zhao,Qishun Yang,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"推理诱导的错位"(RIM)问题：在不含任何有害内容（如数学、代码、链式思考推理）的数据上进行微调，也会诱发LLM的有害行为。作者通过表示空间分析发现推理能力与安全行为编码在两个耦合的方向上，并提出训练时修复方法——安全方向惩罚(SDP)，在Qwen2.5-3B/7B上恢复安全性同时保持推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理数据微调（即使完全无害）也会诱发LLM有害行为（RIM），这一现象对推理模型安全性构成严重挑战。已有工作将其归因于神经元层面的纠缠，但未识别底层表示空间的几何结构，也未提出训练时的修复方案。

Method: 本文首先在激活空间中提取两个方向，一个编码推理能力、另一个编码安全行为，并通过跨架构/跨规模/跨数据集验证RIM并非普遍出现。使用CKA距离比率和探针定位安全决策层。基于方向耦合性设计Safety-Direction Penalty(SDP)，在推理微调过程中惩罚沿安全方向的位移；若初始惩罚范围（层）不足导致补偿性位移超出惩罚层，则通过诊断指标迭代扩展范围。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B和7B模型上，SDP在恢复安全性的同时保持了基准推理性能。方向耦合分析表明：提升推理的微调会使安全表示发生偏移，偏移越大的提示词安全退化越严重。

Conclusion: RIM源于表示空间中推理方向与安全方向的耦合，SDP通过惩罚安全方向位移并在必要时迭代扩展惩罚层范围，可在不牺牲推理能力的前提下修复安全性，为推理模型的安全微调提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

</details>


### [161] [EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23525)
*Zhiqing Cui,Xinxiang Yin,Yihong Tang,Xinglang Zhang,Yuanzhe Hu,Siru Zhong,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Liang,Weijia Li,Ming Jin,Shirui Pan,Yuhao Kang,Dingyi Zhuang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EarthVerse 是一个评估科学智能体在地球系统分析中可靠性的基准测试，包含 405 个可复现任务、199 个事件和 19 个灾害类别。在 25 个模型和智能体系统上，最佳平均答案单元准确率为 84.65%，但最高的 Strict@95 仅为 34.81%，表明现有智能体在端到端证据链条一致性上存在显著短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统分析需要从来源、尺度、时序和模态各异的观测中重构变化中的物理过程。自然灾害使这项工作具有重大意义，因为不完整的证据会改变对严重程度、暴露度和机制的估计。现有系统缺乏一个能够系统评估科学智能体在包级（package-scoped）研究调查中综合能力（证据访问、工具选择、推理、计算与溯源）的标准化基准。

Method: 作者引入 EarthVerse 基准，包含 405 个可复现任务，基于 199 个已记录事件和 19 个灾害家族。智能体需要检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异并在最终答案中保留溯源信息。基准提供可执行的真实标注（将每个任务分解为细粒度答案单元）以及任务特定评分标准（rubrics），允许多条有效路径。评估了 25 个模型和智能体系统，在受控工具使用协议下进行，并通过受控研究定位证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行等环节的失败点。

Result: 最佳平均答案单元准确率为 84.65%，但最高 Strict@95 仅为 34.81%。两者之间的差距表明，当前智能体经常完成单个步骤，却无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释之间保持一致的研究链。

Conclusion: EarthVerse 为测量动态地球系统中端到端科学可靠性提供了可复现的基础，揭示了现有科学智能体在完整证据链一致性上的核心瓶颈，为后续系统改进指明了方向。

Abstract: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

</details>


### [162] [Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23526)
*Richard Bao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现一个冻结的DreamerV3仅从摆锤视频预测时，其潜在转移中隐含一个近似守恒的能量标量。标签无关搜索在独立训练的多保守模型中恢复出相同的能量不变量，而阻尼模型中无此不变量。自主滚动时该量漂移，将潜在状态投影回初始水平集能降低所有保守模型的滚动误差，随机约束则通常增加误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型擅长预测视频帧，但可能并未真正学习或可靠保持视频背后的物理动态约束（如守恒定律）。作者希望检验：一个只从视频训练的世界模型是否在其潜在状态转移中内隐地学习到真实的物理不变量，以及该不变量能否在想象（rollout）过程中被可靠保持。

Method: 使用冻结的DreamerV3仅在摆锤视频上训练，通过标签无关的搜索方法寻找一个标量，使其在模型的潜在转移近似守恒。在多个独立训练的保守（无阻尼）模型中重复该搜索验证一致性，并在匹配的阻尼模型上作为对照。随后在自主rollout中测量该量的漂移，并通过将潜在状态投影回初始水平集（level set）来测试其对滚动误差的影响，与随机约束做对比。

Result: 标签无关搜索在所有独立训练的保守模型中恢复了相同的能量类不变量，而阻尼模型中未发现该不变量。自主rollout中该量发生漂移。将潜在状态投影回初始水平集会降低全部三个保守模型的滚动误差，而匹配的随机约束通常增加误差。

Conclusion: 该工作区分了"动态上有意义的不变量"与"仅可解码的相关量"，揭示了一个具体的失败模式：世界模型能从像素中学习物理约束，但在前向想象（rollout）时却可能违反这一约束。这说明模型掌握了物理定律的表征，却没有在生成过程中可靠地遵守它。

Abstract: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

</details>


### [163] [How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23543)
*Shang Wu,Catarina G Belem,Shuyuan Fu,Mark Steyvers,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过控制性逻辑谜题实验研究AI协助对人类技能长期发展的影响。研究发现低成本的AI协助会导致更频繁的使用，但使用AI协助的参与者在AI被移除后表现更差，且其后续无协助表现会被高估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI协助虽能短期提升任务表现，但可能长期削弱技能发展。现有研究多关注短期收益，缺乏对技能长期影响的系统性考察。作者旨在通过控制实验揭示AI协助与技能发展之间的张力关系。

Method: 采用控制性逻辑谜题实验，参与者在AI可用前、中、后三个阶段完成任务。通过实验操纵AI请求成本（cost）来改变AI使用频率。使用贝叶斯潜在能力模型分离初始能力、AI后能力及参与者特定技能变化，并估计AI阶段独立推理与技能发展的关系。

Result: 低成本的AI协助导致更频繁的AI使用；在AI阶段请求协助的参与者在AI移除后任务表现更差；从早期AI协助表现预测的无协助表现被高估；独立推理投入与潜在能力增长正相关，AI协助替代独立推理时技能发展更弱。

Conclusion: AI协助替代独立推理会削弱技能发展；独立推理的努力程度与潜在能力提升正相关，支持了"AI替代即时推理阻碍长期能力培养"的解释。

Abstract: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

</details>


### [164] [Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23552)
*Seth Karten,Alex L. Zhang,Kevin Thomas,Sebastian Müller,Elie Bakouch,Daniel Auras,Mika Senghaas,Fares Obeid,Konstantin Dunas,Johannes Hagemann,Sami Jaghouar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prime Agent是一个开源的长时程智能体评估与编码工作流工具，通过持久化IPython REPL、持续化历史记忆存储、递归子代理机制和人类可视化监控界面，为标准化的执行、恢复、验证和资源核算提供低摩擦的"膜"层，将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升至95.5%，并在多项长上下文编码任务上匹配或超越现有方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型本质上是顺序处理器，但长时程智能体任务需要超越模型权重和活跃上下文的外部信息与计算。现有方法缺乏持久化的外部状态管理和标准化的执行管线，导致harness失败与模型失败混淆，无法准确评估模型的真实上限能力。

Method: Prime Agent提出：(1) 持久化IPython REPL基于Recursive Language Model抽象实现程序化上下文处理和测试时计算；(2) Continual Harness跨轨迹保存历史、记忆、技能、提示词和子代理规格；(3) 递归子代理通过直接代理间通信协作；(4) Agents View允许人类检查和管理daemon后台会话；(5) 标准化执行、恢复、验证和资源核算，同时将策略构建完全留给模型。

Result: 在ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1上从30%提升至95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器构建和自主nanoGPT speedrun等任务上匹配或超越原生及主流harness；在Factorio任务中发现refinement机制支持连续技术推进，专用子代理支持并行化工作。

Conclusion: Prime Agent作为低摩擦、富有表达力的中间层，能够防止harness失败演变为模型失败，将评估结果更准确地推向模型真实的最大底层能力，为长时程智能体评估和编码工作流提供了一个开放的基础设施。

Abstract: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

</details>


### [165] [ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23565)
*Zhifei Chen,Luozhou Wang,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Shuai Yang,Tianshuo Xu,Yihua Du,Wei Wang,Tianyi Gui,Lianghua Huang,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ReWorld，一种交互式世界模型，通过训练时将控制与记忆分离、推理时用有界预算约束二者的方式，解决"控制需短视界、记忆需无限视界"的结构性矛盾。采用混合逐头注意力窗口（局部头+全局头+随机路由）、随机块丢弃、位姿索引地标库支持的固定预算KV缓存，以及多源度量尺度对齐的数据引擎与LoRA分布匹配蒸馏，实现704x1280实时流式视频生成，在动作跟随、长时记忆召回与视频质量三项上超越六个现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需要同时满足三个要求：跟随用户动作（需要短视界以快速响应）、记住已展示的场景（需要无界视界）、实时流式生成。这三者存在结构性张力——控制需要短视界，记忆需要无界视界，现有方法无法同时兼顾。

Method: 1) 训练阶段将控制与记忆分离：采用混合逐头注意力窗口，大部分头只关注近期过去，少数全局头关注整个历史，并通过随机头路由防止特定能力绑定到固定头；随机块丢弃使稀疏历史进入训练分布。2) 推理阶段将有界预算施加于全部过去：固定块数的KV缓存，其背后由位姿索引地标库支持，模型检索当前位姿最近的地标。3) 构建度量尺度对齐的数据引擎：将八种数据源（Unreal渲染飞行、游戏漫游、真实世界视频）统一到同一物理动作刻度，保证相同按键在所有源移动相同距离；回文轨迹提供重访证据供记忆训练。4) 用限于LoRA适配器的分布匹配蒸馏将采样压缩到四步，单一骨干同时服务高保真多步模式与实时交互模式。

Result: 在三轴评测协议（动作跟随、长时记忆召回、视频质量）下，对比六个近期交互式世界模型，ReWorld取得最佳控制保真度（旋转误差11.95°，最佳相机运动一致性）和最佳生成质量；在64秒、384个latent的分钟级往返轨迹推演中，其固定12块缓存仍能重建起始视图，而此时滑动窗口早已驱逐了相关证据、全KV注意力已内存不足。

Conclusion: ReWorld通过训练/推理分离设计——训练时让控制与记忆各司其职，推理时用有界预算约束所有历史——有效化解了交互式世界模型中控制视界与记忆视界的结构性冲突，在长时记忆召回下仍保持实时流式质量与高保真控制，验证了"有界预算+地标检索+尺度对齐数据+四步蒸馏"这一组合方案的有效性。

Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

</details>


<div id='cs.CV'></div>

### [166] [Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21422)
*Leon Dahlmeier,Sara Kališnik,Albert Mehl,Bastian Rieck*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于持久同调（持续同调）与支持向量机相结合的方法，用于CBCT（锥束计算机断层扫描）图像中的牙齿分类与诊断任务，在牙齿标注和诊断上分别达到97.67%和96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于在同一数据上训练的CNN（分别仅70.27%和86.67%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBCT扫描为牙科诊断和治疗规划提供精细的三维图像，但其分析和记录过程劳动密集。现有的自动化方法（如CNN）在该任务上准确率有限，需要更有效的技术来自动完成牙齿分类、类型识别及病理诊断，以减少人工负担并提升准确性。

Method: 该方法利用拓扑数据分析中的持久同调框架，通过跨多个尺度识别数据中的连通分量、空洞和空隙等拓扑特征来研究牙齿形状，并将这些持久同调特征与支持向量机（SVM）相结合，用于CBCT扫描中的牙齿分类与诊断。牙齿断层数据被编码为基于持续同调的特征表示，输入SVM分类器完成标签预测。

Result: 该方法在牙齿标注任务上达到97.67%的平均准确率，在诊断任务上达到96.77%的平均准确率，均优于在同一数据集上训练的CNN（分别仅70.27%和86.67%）。

Conclusion: 基于持久同调与SVM的组合方法在CBCT牙齿分类和诊断任务上展现出明显优于CNN的性能，验证了拓扑数据分析在医学图像自动化分析中的有效性，为该领域提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans provide detailed three-dimensional images, widely used in dentistry for diagnostic and treatment planning tasks. While invaluable, analyzing and documenting these scans is labor-intensive, prompting efforts to automate key steps like the classification and segmentation of anatomical structures to identify tooth types and associated pathologies. In this article, we propose an approach to automation that leverages persistent homology, a framework from topological data analysis that studies the shape of data by identifying features like connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Persistent homology, together with a support vector machine, allows us to classify teeth in a CBCT scan and to perform diagnostics. Our method advances the state of the art, reaching average accuracy scores of 97.67% for tooth-labeling and 96.77% for diagnostic tasks, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracy of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.

</details>


### [167] [EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21424)
*Yuqian Zhou,Zhenghong Zhou,Zongze Wu,Cameron Smith,Richard Zhang,Jiebo Luo,Eli Shechtman,Zhe Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditStream 是一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架，基于单个 DiT 模型，通过灵活的任务特定条件支持文本到视频、图像到视频、视频到视频、编辑传播、参考引导视频编辑和相机姿态变化等多类任务。通过两阶段蒸馏（VMM 速度矩匹配 + 自回归展开）将模型转化为快速少步自回归模型，解决了常见的过饱和、运动退化、时间不稳定和训练复杂等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频生成与编辑在创意设计中日益重要，但现有方法通常需要为不同任务分别训练模型，且扩散模型推理速度慢，难以满足交互式应用的实时性需求。需要一个统一的、快速且可扩展的框架来桥接高质量扩散视频模型与交互式创作工作流。

Method: 将多个视频创建和操作任务统一到一个基于 DiT 的模型中，通过灵活的任务特定条件实现统一控制。进一步将该模型转换为快速少步自回归模型，采用两阶段蒸馏方法：第一阶段使用 Velocity Moment Matching（VMM）在学生对中间状态进行条件速度矩匹配，以保持生成质量与运动；第二阶段结合自回归展开，使学生在训练时接触自身的自回归预测以提高时间稳定性。

Result: EditStream 在单一系统内实现了六类视频任务（T2V、I2V、V2V、编辑传播、参考引导视频编辑、相机姿态变化）的统一支持，并通过 VMM 与自回归展开的联合蒸馏有效缓解了少步自回归视频生成中的关键挑战（过饱和、运动退化、时间不稳定、训练复杂），实现了高质量且快速的交互式视频生成。

Conclusion: EditStream 提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，弥合了高质量扩散视频模型与交互式创作工作流之间的鸿沟，证明了统一框架结合两阶段蒸馏的有效性，为交互式视频生成与编辑领域提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Interactive video generation and editing are becoming increasingly important for creative design. In this report, we introduce EditStream: a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing. EditStream unifies multiple video creation and manipulation tasks within a single DiT-based model through flexible task-specific conditioning, and further transforms it into a fast, few-step autoregressive model for efficient streaming. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change, enabling flexible control over video generation, transformation, and editing within one system. To make the unified model practical for interactive use, we develop a two-stage distillation approach that combines Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling. VMM matches conditional velocity moments at student-reached intermediate states to preserve generation quality and motion, while unrolling exposes the student to its own autoregressive predictions to improve temporal stability. Together, they alleviate common challenges in few-step autoregressive video generation, including over-saturation, degraded motion, temporal instability, and complex training. EditStream provides a practical and scalable solution that bridges high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

</details>


### [168] [Aligning Human Sense: Calibrated Distributional Reward Learning for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21425)
*Nai-Xin Zhai,Weihua Cheng,Dexu Yu,Yikai Gu,Hanwen Du,Junchen Fu,Chenxi Huang,Yingwei Song,Liyuan Lillian Ma,Yang Ran,Youhua Li,Yongxin Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的偏好感知学习框架用于视频生成对齐。框架包含三个核心组件：精英引导过滤（elite-guided filtering）用于校准偏好数据、多维奖励分布建模配合Wasserstein距离对齐人类偏好分布、以及基于Wasserstein的分布局对齐集成到GRPO中进行策略优化。实验表明该方法提高了奖励信号的可靠性和生成视频的感知一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成虽取得显著进展，但将生成视频与人类偏好对齐仍面临三大挑战：1）人类偏好数据受主观噪声和偏差影响，导致奖励信号可靠性不足；2）标量奖励模型将多维度人类偏好压缩为单一值，丢失了跨维度的动态权衡信息；3）策略优化中广泛使用的KL散度主要施加局部约束，无法捕捉人类偏好的全局结构。

Method: 提出统一偏好感知学习框架，包含三部分：1）精英引导过滤（elite-guided filtering）校准偏好数据并构建可靠的监督信号用于奖励模型训练；2）将视频质量建模为多维奖励分布，使用Wasserstein距离将学习的奖励分布与经验人类偏好分布对齐；3）将基于Wasserstein的分布局对齐引入GRPO，指导策略优化更好地匹配人类偏好的全局结构。

Result: 在奖励建模和视频生成任务上的实验表明，该方法提高了奖励信号的可靠性以及生成视频的感知一致性。

Conclusion: 通过数据校准、分布级奖励建模和Wasserstein距离对齐，该框架有效解决了人类偏好对齐中的噪声、维度坍缩和局部约束问题，为视频生成对齐提供了统一的解决方案。

Abstract: Video generation is central to AI-powered content creation. Aligning generated videos with human preferences is a key criterion for evaluating generation quality. Despite significant progress in visual quality, three key challenges remain. First, the reliability of reward signals is constrained by the quality of human preference data, which is often affected by subjective noise and bias. Second, standard scalar reward models collapse multi-aspect human preferences into a single value, leading to the loss of dynamic trade-offs across multiple preference dimensions. Third, in policy optimization, the widely adopted KL divergence imposes primarily local constraints and may fail to capture the global structure of human preferences. To address these challenges, we propose a unified preference-aware learning framework for video generation. First, we introduce elite-guided filtering to calibrate preference data and construct reliable supervision for reward model training. We then model video quality as a multidimensional reward distribution to capture the uncertainty inherent in human preferences, and use the Wasserstein distance to align the learned reward distribution with the empirical human preference distribution. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein-based distributional alignment into GRPO, guiding policy optimization to better match the global structure of human preferences over videos. Experiments on reward modeling and video generation demonstrate that our approach improves the reliability of reward signals and the perceptual consistency of generated videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/alignhs26/ahs.

</details>


### [169] [AI Visual Inspection for Garment Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21426)
*Ray Wai Man Kong,Ding Ning,Theodore Ho Tin Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文开发和验证了一种基于CNN的AI视觉检测系统，用于服装缝纫线质量检测。系统最初用黑色面料和黑色缝线样本训练，在黑色、红色和深绿色材料上成功检测到跳线缺陷，但在浅蓝、银色和荧光黄等视觉特征差异较大的面料以及断线缺陷上表现受限，表明模型精度受训练数据多样性和跨颜色泛化能力的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服装制造业面临提升产品质量、降低成本及向工业4.0数字化转型的压力。缝纫线检测（如跳线、断线缺陷）是质量控制中最具挑战性的环节之一，人工检测容易受疲劳、主观判断和表现不一致的影响，导致缺陷漏检、返工和生产率下降，迫切需要自动化的视觉检测系统。

Method: 开发基于AI的视觉检测系统，采用卷积神经网络（CNN）检测缝纫缺陷。系统初始阶段使用黑色面料和黑色缝线样本进行训练，随后在黑色、红色、深绿色、浅蓝、银色和荧光黄六种颜色面料上进行实验测试。

Result: 系统在黑色、红色和深绿色面料上成功检测到跳线缝纫缺陷，但在断线缺陷以及浅蓝、银色和荧光黄等视觉特性差异显著的面料上表现受限。研究揭示模型精度强烈受限于训练数据多样性及模型在不同面料和缝线颜色上的泛化能力。

Conclusion: AI视觉检测系统在特定颜色组合下可有效检测缝纫缺陷，但模型准确度受训练数据多样性和泛化能力制约。未来需要通过扩展训练数据集的颜色和缺陷类型多样性，以提升系统在不同生产场景下的鲁棒性和实用性。

Abstract: The garment manufacturing industry is under increasing pressure to improve product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate digital transformation toward Industry 4.0. One of the most challenging quality-control activities is sewing-line inspection, where defects such as broken stitches and skipped stitches are difficult to detect consistently through manual inspection. Human-based inspection is often affected by fatigue, subjective judgement, and inconsistent performance, resulting in defect leakage, rework, and reduced production efficiency.
  This study presents the development and validation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based visual inspection system for garment sewing-line quality control. The system utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect sewing defects and was initially trained using black fabric and black sewing thread samples. Experimental testing was conducted on black, red, dark green, light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow fabrics. The results demonstrated successful detection of jump sewing-line defects on black, red, and dark green materials, while performance limitations were observed for broken sewing-line defects and fabrics with significantly different visual characteristics, including light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow colours. These findings indicate that model accuracy is strongly influenced by the diversity of training data and the ability to generalize across different fabric and thread colours.

</details>


### [170] [Few-Shot Cross-Dataset Adaptation for Tuberculosis Detection Using DenseNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21427)
*Bidhan Biswas,Shahadat Hossain Sohag,Nabil Ashab,Soumit Kumar Kundu,Saif Mahmud Parvez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了胸部X光片中肺结核检测的跨数据集域偏移问题。以TBX11K为源域、Mendeley TB数据集为目标域，通过少量样本（few-shot）扩展实验，比较了冻结骨干适应、全量微调源预训练DenseNet121模型以及从头训练三种训练范式。结果表明，即使每类仅用75个标注样本，模型也能达到98.36%的准确率，证实全量微调预训练模型是缓解域偏移的高效实用策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺结核每年在全球造成大量死亡，尽管深度学习模型在胸部X光片上能较准确检测TB，但不同数据集之间的域偏移（如成像协议、患者人口统计、设备差异）严重影响了模型的泛化能力。在真实世界中，模型在一个数据集上表现良好，换到另一个数据集时性能会显著下降。因此需要研究如何通过域自适应策略（尤其是数据有限的Few-shot场景）来缓解这一问题。

Method: 本文采用受控的跨数据集评估框架：以TBX11K作为源域、Mendeley TB数据集作为目标域。通过变化目标域样本数量，在三种训练范式中进行少量样本（few-shot）扩展研究：（1）冻结骨干网络的自适应（frozen backbone adaptation）；（2）对源域预训练的DenseNet121模型进行全量微调（full fine-tuning）；（3）从头训练（training from scratch）。系统记录不同目标样本数量下的模型性能，并绘制自适应曲线。

Result: 模型即使在有限数据下也能表现良好：每类仅用75个标注样本即可达到98.36%的准确率。自适应曲线表明微调能有效缓解域偏移带来的性能下降。

Conclusion: 全量微调预训练模型被证明是缓解低资源临床部署场景下域偏移的高效且实用的策略，为实际医疗应用中应对跨数据集泛化问题提供了有力依据。

Abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) is one of the most common and dangerous bacterial ailments. Every year, it causes a large number of deaths worldwide. Although many deep learning models can detect tuberculosis from chest X-rays quite accurately, severe domain shift across datasets makes the task challenging. Different imaging protocols, patient demographics, and equipment across domains make the task of generalization difficult. In real-world settings, a model may perform well on one dataset but show a noticeable drop in performance when tested on another. In this work, we address this domain adaptation challenge through a few-shot scaling study. A controlled cross-dataset evaluation is presented in this paper using TBX11K as the source domain and the Mendeley TB dataset as the target domain. It is investigated how varying the number of target samples affects model performance under three training regimes: frozen backbone adaptation, full fine-tuning of a source-pretrained DenseNet121 model, and training from scratch. The results indicate that the model can perform well even with limited data and can achieve 98.36\% accuracy with just 75 labeled samples per class. The adaptation curves demonstrate how fine-tuning effectively mitigates domain shift. These findings establish full fine-tuning of pretrained models as a highly effective and practical strategy for mitigating domain shift in low-resource clinical deployment scenarios.

</details>


### [171] [Improved denoising diffusion probabilistic models with efficient non-diagonal covariance modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21972)
*Rui Xia,Ayan Das,Artem Artemev,Andi Zhang,Guillaume Hennequin,Alberto Bernacchia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的Kronecker-DCT（K-DCT）协方差模型，用于加速DDPM（去噪扩散概率模型）的采样过程。该模型通过Kronecker分解处理颜色通道间的协方差，并在DCT频域中建模空间协方差，将计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性。在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上的实验表明，该方法在FID和似然度方面均优于现有最先进的去噪采样器，尤其在少数去噪步数的场景下表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DDPM采样可以通过利用去噪后验协方差的二阶信息来加速，使得在更少但更大的采样步长下生成可接受质量的样本。然而，先前的方法仅使用简化的（如对角）协方差近似，未能捕捉自然图像独特的统计结构——像素和颜色通道间存在强非对角相关性，以及频谱具有慢衰减的幂律特性。

Method: 提出K-DCT协方差模型：(1) 使用Kronecker分解分解颜色通道间协方差与空间协方差；(2) 空间协方差在频域中通过离散余弦变换（DCT）建模；(3) DCT将计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性，使每步去噪的计算和内存开销可忽略；(4) 使用预训练分数模型在多个数据集上学习K-DCT结构的去噪后验协方差摊销。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、Celeb-A、ImageNet和LSUN数据集上，K-DCT方法在FID和似然度两个指标上均优于先前最先进的去噪采样器，尤其在少数去噪步数的场景下改进最为显著。

Conclusion: K-DCT协方差模型能够有效捕捉自然图像的统计结构（跨通道相关性和频域特性），在保持极低计算开销的同时实现更高质量的快速采样，为DDPM的高效采样提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: The sampling process of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) can be accelerated by leveraging second-order information in the form of approximations to the denoising posterior covariance -- allowing samples of acceptable quality to be produced in fewer but larger sampling steps. Previous attempts at using such information have used drastic (e.g.\ diagonal) simplifications of the covariance. These do not do justice to the peculiar statistical structure of natural images, which exhibit strong non-diagonal correlations between pixels and color channels, and a slow-decaying power-law frequency spectrum. Here, we develop a novel covariance model that captures these features. Our Kronecker-DCT (K-DCT) model uses a Kronecker-factored decomposition of inter-color covariances and spatial covariances modeled in the frequency domain using the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT). The use of the DCT reduces the computational complexity from quadratic to log-linear, resulting in negligible computational and memory overhead in each denoising step. By learning K-DCT-structured amortizations of the denoising posterior covariance using pre-trained score models on CIFAR-10, Celeb-A, ImageNet and LSUN datasets, we show improved performance compared to previous SOTA denoising samplers, both in terms of FID and likelihoods, especially in the regime of few denoising steps.

</details>


### [172] [Measuring Gender Representation in Animated Films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21429)
*David Bamman,Allison Cooper,Ruby Alvarez Rubio,Reina Kushihashi,Madison Mar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究开发了一套计算管道用于识别动画电影中的角色，并在224部流行动画电影语料库中测试了关于性别表征的多个假设。研究发现女性角色在动画电影中的整体占比与真人电影大致相当（1980-2025），但人类角色与非人类角色之间存在显著差异（人类角色中女性占比更高，非人类角色以男性为主）。与以往迪士尼研究不同，该研究未发现动画电影中女性反派的减少趋势，且女性角色更倾向于共享银幕时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动画电影是重要的文化教化载体，但以往关于性别表征的大规模实证研究主要统计角色数量构成，缺乏更精细的度量手段（如评估角色在总银幕时间中的可见性）。本研究旨在填补这一空白，开发更细粒度的分析工具。

Method: 开发了一个计算管道用于自动识别动画电影中的角色，并在224部流行动画电影语料库上检验关于性别表征的多个假设。区别于传统的性别构成计数方法，该研究通过银幕时间评估角色的可见性，并区分人类角色与非人类角色进行分析。

Result: 1) 动画电影中女性角色的整体表征水平与真人电影（1980-2025）大致持平；2) 人类角色中女性表征显著更高，而非人类角色以男性为主，呈现鲜明对比；3) 与以往迪士尼研究相反，未观察到女性角色在反派角色中比例下降的趋势；4) 动画电影中的女性角色比真人电影中的同期角色更倾向于共处同一场景。

Conclusion: 动画电影中的性别表征呈现复杂且分化明显的格局：整体趋势与真人电影趋同，但人类/非人类角色的性别分布存在显著差异。该研究推翻了以往关于迪士尼动画中女性反派减少的结论，并揭示了动画电影中女性角色聚集效应这一独特现象，为媒体性别研究的量化方法提供了新范式。

Abstract: Animated films--often developed with an audience of children in mind--are an important vector for enculturation, and empirical work that has examined the representation of gender at scale in these films has largely focused on counting the gender composition of the cast rather than deploying a more fine-grained instrument (such as assessing the visibility of those characters in overall screentime). In this work, we develop a computational pipeline for recognizing animated characters in these films, and use it to test several hypotheses about gender representation in a corpus of 224 popular animated movies. We find that while the overall representation of female characters in animated films largely tracks with those of live-action films (over the period 1980-2025), we see stark differences between the representation of human characters (much greater representation among women and girls) and non-humans (largely male). Contrary to past work on Disney, we do not see female characters declining in antagonist roles in animated films, and characters who are women and girls are much more likely to share scenes together than their live action contemporaneous counterparts.

</details>


### [173] [Boosting Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering with Structured Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21431)
*Qiyou Liu,Yong Zhang,Jianjie Luo,Zhenguo Yang,Yi Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCoRe框架，通过上下文获取、选择与压缩三阶段，将异构的视觉描述和检索知识转化为显式实体-关系三元组的形式化结构化提示，用于知识型视觉问答，在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法直接将异构的视觉描述和检索知识拼接为长且非结构化的提示，导致推理性能下降，原因在于包含过多无关上下文且缺乏显式的关系结构。

Method: SCoRe包含三个阶段：(1) 上下文获取：生成多样化视觉笔记，并通过高效的两阶段多模态检索策略获取显式知识；(2) 上下文选择：利用LLM引导的选择机制过滤相关的视觉、显式和隐式知识；(3) 上下文压缩：通过关系逻辑蒸馏(RLD)将原始文本转化为显式实体-关系三元组，作为最终答案预测的简洁结构化提示。

Result: 在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SCoRe一致性地优于最先进的方法。

Conclusion: 通过将非结构化的多模态上下文压缩为结构化关系三元组，能够显著提升知识型VQA中LLM的推理性能，验证了结构化上下文推理的有效性。

Abstract: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering aims to answer questions about an image by integrating external knowledge with visual and textual information. Recent approaches often rely on in-context learning to prompt Large Language Models (LLMs) with multimodal context in a zero-shot or few-shot manner. However, we observe that directly concatenating heterogeneous visual descriptions and retrieved knowledge into long, unstructured prompts often degrades reasoning performance, due to both excessive irrelevant context and the lack of explicit relational structure. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based Structured Context Reasoning (SCoRe) framework that infers both explicit and implicit relationships for prediction. SCoRe consists of three stages: Context Acquisition, which generates diverse visual notes and retrieves explicit knowledge via an efficient two-stage multimodal retrieval strategy; Context Selection, which filters relevant visual, explicit, and implicit knowledge using LLM-guided selection; and Context Compression, which performs Relational Logic Distillation (RLD) to transform raw text into explicit entity-relation triplets. These relational triplets serve as a concise and structured prompt for final answer prediction. Extensive experiments on the OK-VQA and A-OKVQA benchmarks demonstrate that SCoRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [174] [DesignAgent3D: Interactive 3D Scene Editing via Designer-like Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21438)
*Xiujin Liu,Tianyu Yang,Yilun Zhao,Xiangliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DesignAgent3D是一个交互式多模态智能体框架，将3D场景编辑重构为"规划-感知-行动"的设计师式范式，通过用户交互澄清语义模糊的编辑意图，精确空间定位目标物体/区域，并执行保持场景一致性的受控视觉修改，在NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting骨干上均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本的3D场景编辑方法通常将任务简化为单一提示的一次性条件生成，未能解决：1）自然语言请求在语义上常常是不明确的（underspecified），需要与用户交互来澄清意图；2）在杂乱3D场景中难以实现精确的空间定位（object localization drift）；3）遮挡下的目标跟踪失败；4）多视角不一致的"贴纸效应"。这些问题源于缺乏对模糊用户意图的解析能力和对3D场景的精确空间感知。

Method: 提出DesignAgent3D，一个交互式多模态智能体框架，将3D场景编辑形式化为设计师式的Plan-Perceive-Act三阶段范式：（1）Plan阶段：通过与用户交互澄清不明确的编辑设计目标；（2）Perceive阶段：将编辑意图精准锚定到3D场景中的特定物体或区域；（3）Act阶段：应用受控的视觉修改并保持场景一致性。最终的编辑结果被集成到底层3D表示中，支持持久化、多视角一致的场景渲染。

Result: 在NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting两种骨干表示上进行了广泛实验，DesignAgent3D显著优于现有最先进基线，在语义意图对齐、空间定位准确性和多视角一致性方面均取得了先进性表现。

Conclusion: 通过将3D场景编辑从被动的一次性条件生成转变为主动的交互式智能体范式，DesignAgent3D证明了澄清用户意图和精确空间定位是解决现有3D编辑方法核心瓶颈的关键，为语义级3D场景编辑提供了更可靠和一致的解决方案。

Abstract: Text guided 3D scene editing provides an intuitive interface for modifying reconstructed environments, but remains difficult because natural language design requests are often semantically underspecified and must be grounded in cluttered 3D scenes. Existing methods typically formulate the task as one-shot conditional generation from a single prompt, failing to resolve ambiguous user intents or achieve precise spatial grounding. Consequently, they suffer from severe object localization drift, tracking failure under occlusions, and the notorious multi-view "sticker effect." To overcome these limitations, we present DesignAgent3D, an interactive multimodal agentic framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a designer-like Plan-Perceive-Act paradigm. The agent first plans by interacting with the user to clarify underspecified design goals, then perceives by grounding the intended edit to specific objects or regions in the 3D scene, and finally acts by applying controlled visual modifications while preserving scene consistency. The edits are further integrated into the underlying 3D representation, supporting persistent and multi-view consistent novel-view rendering. Extensive experiments across both NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting backbones demonstrate that DesignAgent3D significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, delivering superior semantic intent alignment, impeccable spatial localization accuracy, and high-fidelity multi-view consistency.

</details>


### [175] [WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21439)
*Zhiyang Deng,Boran Zhang,Danze Chen,Yeying Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldMind 是首个将游戏世界模型中的 NPC 行为解耦为显式状态感知决策框架的工作。它将交互式世界建模分为理解层、决策层、控制层和生成层四层，通过闭环交互将 NPC 行为锚定在动态游戏状态上，并配套发布了 BOSS-140K 数据集及自动化采集代理，实验显示其在紧凑状态重建和机制导向规划上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏世界模型中的 NPC 行为要么与视频生成隐式纠缠，要么通过外部控制信号显式预设，缺乏状态锚定的显式交互接口，导致模型需同时理解状态、规划反应并渲染结果，难以产生响应式和状态感知的 NPC 行为。

Method: 提出四层解耦架构：理解层从生成帧中构建紧凑状态；决策层基于紧凑状态推理以规划 NPC 下一步动作；控制层将动作转化为时间对齐的条件；生成层合成视觉效果。四层以闭环交互回路相连，使 NPC 行为扎根于演进的游戏状态。同时构建 BOSS-140K 数据集（游戏视频与丰富内部状态配对），并设计自动化采集代理支持大规模数据收集。

Result: 在 BOSS-140K 上验证了可靠的紧凑状态重建与机制导向规划能力；在约 70% 的成对比较中，WorldMind 相比基线因其更具战术合理性和连贯性的 NPC 行为而被优先选择。

Conclusion: WorldMind 证明了将 NPC 决策从世界模型生成中显式解耦的有效性，为游戏世界模型中的状态感知 NPC 行为提供了新的范式与配套数据基础设施。

Abstract: Game world models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in generating visually coherent and action-controllable gameplay videos. However, non-player character (NPC) behavior in existing models is either implicitly entangled with video generation or explicitly prescribed through external control signals. Consequently, a game world model has to jointly understand the state, plan the NPC's response and render its visual outcome, limiting its ability to produce responsive and state-aware NPC behavior. The challenge lies in the lack of an explicit interface for state-grounded decision-making. To this end, we introduce WorldMind, to our knowledge the first decoupled framework for state-aware NPC behavior in game world models. WorldMind separates interactive world modeling into four layers: an Understanding Layer that constructs a compact state from generated frames; a Decision Layer that reasons over the compact state to plan the NPC's next action; a Control Layer that translates the actions into temporally aligned conditions; and a Generation Layer that synthesizes their visual outcomes. By reconnecting layers in a closed interaction loop, WorldMind grounds NPC behavior in the evolving game state. We further introduce BOSS-140K, a dataset of gameplay videos paired with rich internal game states, together with an agent that automates the collection at scale. Experiments on BOSS-140K demonstrate reliable compact state reconstruction and mechanics-grounded planning, with WorldMind preferred over the baselines in approximately 70% of pairwise comparisons for its more tactically appropriate and coherent NPC behavior. Project page: https://teawhite.cn/worldmind_projectpage/

</details>


### [176] [Text-Guided Visual Dependency Graph Learning with Cross-Modal Attention Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21443)
*Fei Wang,Yutong Zhang,Yang Ye,Jinxian Chen,Wang Wenshuai,Xiong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CM-GLasso（跨模态图形套索）框架，将视觉-语言表示学习与稀疏高斯图模型相结合，通过文本可视化、跨模态注意力蒸馏和联合ADMM优化三个关键组件，在统一框架中估计可解释的跨模态条件依赖结构，并在八个基准上取得竞争性或更优的分类与分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从多模态视觉-语言特征中估计可解释的条件依赖结构目前尚未被充分探索，现有方法通常先估计再分解各别类别图，缺乏统一的端到端框架。

Method: CM-GLasso包含三个核心组件：(i)文本可视化策略，将类别属性描述渲染为图像，通过同一SigLIP-2视觉编码器处理，生成原型索引的patch级注意力足迹；(ii)跨注意力蒸馏机制，将高维patch压缩为少量语义图节点，利用注意力足迹相似度生成跨模态结构先验用于非均匀L1惩罚；(iii)联合ADMM公式，在单一凸目标中估计共享与类别特定的精度矩阵组件。学习到的稀疏图拓扑直接支持无参数的精度基分类规则和轻量级拓扑感知分割头。

Result: 在八个基准上的广泛实验表明，CM-GLasso相比强特征基和任务特定基线实现了竞争性或更优性能。在受控协议下，平均分类准确率最高达91.97%，在VOC上分割mIoU达74.75%、ADE20K上达64.01%，为所有受控基线最高，同时产生具有共享-特定分解的显式稀疏条件依赖图。

Conclusion: CM-GLasso成功将图模型结构先验引入跨模态学习，在分类和分割任务上均取得优越性能，并提供可解释的稀疏条件依赖图，验证了图拓扑学习与多模态表示联合优化的有效性与普适性。

Abstract: Estimating interpretable conditional-dependence structures from multimodal visual-linguistic features remains largely unexplored. We propose CM-GLasso (Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso), a framework that bridges vision-language representation learning and sparse Gaussian Graphical Models. CM-GLasso introduces three key components: (i) a text visualization strategy that renders class-attribute descriptions as images and processes them through the same SigLIP-2 vision encoder as natural images, yielding prototype-indexed patch-level attention footprints in a shared feature coordinate system; (ii) a cross-attention distillation mechanism that condenses high-dimensional patches into a small set of semantic graph nodes, whose attention-footprint similarities yield cross-modal structural priors for non-uniform L1 penalization; (iii) a joint ADMM formulation that estimates shared and class-specific precision components within a single convex objective, avoiding the need to first estimate and then decompose separate class-wise graphs. The learned sparse graph topologies directly support a parameter-free, precision-based classification rule and a lightweight topology-aware segmentation head. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CM-GLasso achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong feature-based and task-specific baselines. Under the matched controlled protocol, it attains the highest average classification accuracy (91.97%) and the highest segmentation mIoU among the controlled baselines on VOC (74.75%) and ADE20K (64.01%), while also yielding explicit sparse conditional-dependence graphs with common-specific decomposition.

</details>


### [177] [ViTexSZ: Heterogeneous Vision-Text Knowledge Distillation for EEG Seizure Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21445)
*Chenxi Liu,Mingzhao Li,Yicong Liu,Hao Miao,Hongyuan Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Gaofeng Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViTexSZ是一个异构视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架，用于EEG癫痫检测。它通过将EEG记录转换为结构化波形图像，利用基于查询的多通道对齐模块统一异构特征，并借助多模态大语言模型将临床语义与癫痫证据关联，最后通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征转移到轻量学生模型。在四个EEG癫痫数据集上均取得最高准确率，相对第二最佳基线提升最高达12.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于时间序列的EEG癫痫检测方法通常假设固定的通道配置，难以适用于通道布局不规则的异构EEG记录。虽然视觉和语言建模提供了替代方案，但将异构EEG表征与临床语义对齐仍具挑战性。尤其是亚临床癫痫发作仅表现出细微的脑电变化，需要更有效的自动检测方法。

Method: ViTexSZ框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 将EEG记录转换为结构化波形图像；(2) 基于查询的多通道对齐模块，将源依赖的视觉特征映射到统一的token空间；(3) 异构教师网络，通过多模态大语言模型将对齐的EEG表征与临床提示词集成，从而关联高层临床语义与癫痫发作相关证据。最后通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征转移到轻量学生模型用于检测。

Result: 在四个EEG癫痫数据集上的实验验证了ViTexSZ在亚临床癫痫和一般癫痫检测场景中的泛化能力，在所有数据集上均取得最高准确率，相对第二最佳基线实现了最高12.9%的改进。

Conclusion: ViTexSZ通过异构视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架有效解决了EEG癫痫检测中异构通道配置和临床语义对齐的挑战，展示了在不同类型癫痫检测场景中的出色泛化性和有效性。

Abstract: Automated seizure detection from electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for continuous neurological monitoring, particularly for subclinical epileptic seizures that may exhibit only subtle electrographic changes. Existing time-series methods are often designed for fixed EEG channel configurations, thereby limiting their applicability to heterogeneous EEG recordings with irregular channel layouts. Although visual and language modeling offer promising alternatives, aligning heterogeneous EEG representations with clinical semantics remains challenging. We introduce ViTexSZ, a heterogeneous Vision-Text knowledge distillation framework for EEG seizure detection. ViTexSZ converts EEG recordings into structured waveform images and introduces a query-based multi-channel alignment module that maps source-dependent visual features into a unified token space. A heterogeneous teacher further integrates the aligned EEG representations with clinical prompts through a multimodal large language model, associating high-level clinical semantics with seizure-related evidence. Vision-text knowledge distillation then transfers the teacher representations to a lightweight student during detection. Experiments on four EEG seizure datasets demonstrate the generalizability of ViTexSZ across both subclinical and general seizure detection scenarios, achieving the highest accuracy on all datasets and relative improvements of up to 12.9% over the second-best baselines, showing its effectiveness.

</details>


### [178] [BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21447)
*Prakash Kondibhau Naikade,Thomas B. Moeslund,Andreas Møgelmose*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BIMScript 将结构化语言模型扩展到建筑信息建模（BIM）场景，通过单一语法同时回答场景由什么构成、生成速度多快、元素具体位置三个问题。其核心贡献包括：引入材料与状态属性的扩展布局语言（基于10万合成场景构建VLM材料护照语料库，覆盖190万伪标签元素）；提出输出精确的CUDA图解码器（1.9 vs 6.4 ms/step，加速3.4倍）和语法并行、容差验证的草稿-验证方案消除自回归解码开销；通过训练无关的几何吸附和混合离散-连续解码头解决5cm分词网格粒度问题。最终在Revit插件与IFC4导出的端到端验证中证明了直接摄入BIM工具的可行性，同时其程序语言形式支持LLM驱动的可持续性推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化语言模型（如SceneScript）以参数化命令程序的形式重建场景，具有天然可编辑和语义明确的优势。但若要应用于最具吸引力的场景——将现有建筑自动摄入BIM工具——仍存在三个关键问题悬而未决：(1) 场景由什么材料构成（语义属性缺失）；(2) 程序生成能有多快（解码开销过大）；(3) 每个元素的位置精确度如何（受限于分词网格粒度）。作者旨在用一个统一语法同时解决这三个维度的问题。

Method: BIMScript 在其语法中集成三方面解决方案：(1) 语义扩展：为每个元素增加材料(material)和状态(condition)属性，构建基于VLM的"材料护照"语料库（10万合成场景、190万伪标签元素），并通过升维特征点编码器(lifted-feature point encoder)将图像外观映射到材料词元；(2) 加速解码：分析表明自回归解码瓶颈并非计算而是内核启动与主机同步开销，因此设计输出精确的CUDA图解码器（3.4倍加速）以及利用确定性实体模式的语法并行、容差验证的草稿-验证(draft-and-verify)方案；(3) 精度提升：针对5cm分词网格粒度，提出训练无关的几何吸附(geometric snapping)和混合离散-连续解码头（回归亚bin偏移）两种方法，并测量各自恢复的残差误差。

Result: BIMScript 在合成扫描场景上取得了三方面成果：解码速度从6.4 ms/step降至1.9 ms/step，实现3.4倍加速；材料与状态属性通过VLM语料库监督实现稳定预测；几何吸附与混合离散-连续解码头共同降低定位误差。端到端验证通过实际Revit加载项及IFC4导出完成，证明每个命令可一对一映射到原生Revit对象，实现直接摄入BIM创作工具。

Conclusion: BIMScript 证明了结构化语言模型可以通过统一语法同时解决"内容、速度、位置"三个关键问题，使合成场景的自动BIM摄入成为可行。这一方法不仅打通了从语言模型输出到Revit原生对象的一对一映射，还因其程序语言形式天然支持LLM驱动的可持续性推理，为建筑资产生命周期管理提供了新的可能性。

Abstract: Structured-language models such as SceneScript reconstruct a scene as a short program of parametric commands, an inherently editable and semantically explicit representation. We ask three questions that stand between such models and their most compelling application, automated ingestion of existing buildings into BIM tools, studied here on synthetic scans: \emph{what} is the scene made of, \emph{how fast} can it be produced, and \emph{exactly where} is each element. BIMScript answers all three within one grammar. First, we extend the layout language with per-element \emph{material} and \emph{condition} attributes, supervised by a vision-language-model material-passport corpus we build over 100k synthetic scenes (1.9M pseudo-labeled elements), and route image appearance to the material tokens through a lifted-feature point encoder. Second, we show that autoregressive decoding of these programs is dominated not by compute but by kernel-launch and host-synchronization overhead, and remove it with an output-exact CUDA-graph decoder (1.9 vs 6.4\,ms/step, $3.4\times$) plus a grammar-parallel, tolerance-verified draft-and-verify scheme that exploits the deterministic entity schema. Third, we address the model's 5cm token-grid granularity with training-free geometric snapping and a hybrid discrete--continuous decoder head that regresses a sub-bin offset, and measure how much of the residual error each recovers. Because each command maps one-to-one onto a native Revit object, we validate direct ingestion into a BIM authoring tool end to end with a working add-in and its IFC4 export, and the same program's language form is designed to support LLM-driven, sustainability-aware reasoning over the built asset.

</details>


### [179] [Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21450)
*Hangrui Xu,Zhengxian Wu,Yunyao Yu,Zhuohong Chen,Rui Cong,Xiangwen Deng,Zhifang Liu,Peng Jiao,Haoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KBMR是首个面向KB-VQA的基于多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的嵌入检索器，通过将图像映射到保留概念同一性的语义空间，并引入基于MLLM的语义判别器生成连续的实体一致性权重来指导连续语义蒸馏目标，解决传统CLIP双编码器只注重表面视觉相似性而忽视实体级语义对齐的问题，在检索Recall@1上提升达14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KB-VQA检索管线普遍采用CLIP风格的双编码器，只关注表面视觉相似性而非实体级语义对齐，导致在语义相同但视觉差异大或视觉相似但实体不同的情况下检索失败，无法满足长尾实体查询对精确知识检索的需求。

Method: 提出KBMR，利用MLLM的自回归能力将图像嵌入到能更好保留概念同一性的语义空间；设计MLLM-based语义判别器生成连续的实体一致性权重，配合连续语义蒸馏目标实现有效的困难负样本采样和软监督，替代刚性的二元标签监督。

Result: 在Wikipedia规模检索任务中KBMR显著超越CLIP基线，检索Recall@1提升最高14.7%，端到端VQA准确率提升9.4%，并开源代码。

Conclusion: KBMR验证了MLLM作为嵌入检索器在KB-VQA中的有效性，证明了利用MLLM语义理解能力结合连续软监督机制，可以显著改善实体级检索精度并推动下游VQA性能提升。

Abstract: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) relies on retrieving external information to answer queries involving long-tail entities. However, existing retrieval pipelines predominantly employ CLIP-style dual encoders, which prioritize surface-level visual similarity over entity-level semantic alignment. This paradigm often fails when semantically identical concepts exhibit large visual variations or when distinct entities appear visually similar. To address this, we propose KBMR, the first MLLM-based embedding retriever tailored for KB-VQA. Leveraging the robust autoregressive capabilities of MLLMs, KBMR maps images into a semantic space that better preserves concept identity. To tackle the challenge of noisy supervision in Wikipedia-scale retrieval, we introduce an MLLM-based semantic discriminator that generates continuous entity-consistency weights. These weights guide a novel continuous semantic distillation objective, enabling effective hard negative sampling and soft supervision beyond rigid binary labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KBMR significantly outperforms CLIP baselines, yielding up to a 14.7% improvement in retrieval Recall@1 and a 9.4% gain in end-to-end VQA accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/realHarryX/KBMR.

</details>


### [180] [Multi-Scale Fruit Capsules: Dilated Convolutions and Dynamic Routing for In-the-Wild Explainable Fruit Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21454)
*Subhankar Chattoraj,Sawon Pratiher,Samiran Das,Hubert Konik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FruitCapsNet胶囊网络，用膨胀卷积替代标准卷积前端，使每个胶囊在动态路由前编码多尺度上下文，通过贝叶斯优化选择超参数（包括膨胀因子）。在三个公开数据集和新构建的19类10639张图像的PD-19野生数据集上，以三分之一的深度超越十个微调迁移学习骨干，在最难数据集上领先最近竞争对手2.7%。Grad-CAM显著性分析表明改进源于对整体果实区域的归因而非边缘特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野生环境下的水果分类（AFCW）面临巨大挑战：同一水果可能以成串、未剥皮、袋装、切片等多种形态出现，导致类内差异大、类间差异小。传统卷积网络通过池化丢弃了感兴趣区域的姿态和位置信息，在不同展现形式下泛化能力差。

Method: FruitCapsNet采用胶囊网络架构，核心创新是用膨胀卷积替代标准卷积前端——感受野以恒定参数成本指数级增长，使每个胶囊在动态路由解决部分-整体空间一致性之前就能编码多尺度上下文。超参数（包括膨胀因子）通过贝叶斯优化而非网格搜索选择。

Result: 在三个公开数据集（SMP、FruitsGB、Fruits-360）和新构建的PD-19数据集上，FruitCapsNet以三分之一的深度超越十个微调迁移学习骨干网络，在最具挑战性的数据集上相对最近竞争对手取得最大+2.7%的准确率提升。Grad-CAM显著性传播显示改进源于将决策归因于完整果实区域而非物体边缘。

Conclusion: 胶囊网络结合膨胀卷积能有效处理野生环境下水果分类中的大类内差异和小类间差异问题；Grad-CAM的后验证据表明性能提升不是数据集伪影，而是因为模型学到了更具语义一致性的整体果实特征表征。

Abstract: The same fruit appears in a bunch, unpicked, peeled, bagged in plastic, or sliced on a dish, so automated fruit classification in the wild (AFCW) must absorb wide intra- class and narrow inter-class variability in shape, size, colour and texture. Convolutional networks route information through pooling, which discards the pose and location of the region of interest and therefore generalises poorly across these presentations. We propose FruitCapsNet, a capsule network whose Fruit Capsules replace the standard convolutional front end with dilated convolutions: the receptive field grows exponentially at constant parameter cost, so each capsule encodes multi-scale context before dynamic routing resolves part whole spatial agreement. Hyper-parameters, including the dilation factor, are selected by Bayesian optimisation rather than grid search. On three public datasets (SMP, FruitsGB, Fruits-360) and a new 19-class, 10,639-image in-the-wild dataset (PD-19), FruitCapsNet exceeds ten fine-tuned transfer-learning backbones at one-third the depth, with the largest margin (+2.7% over the nearest competitor) on the hardest set. Grad-CAM saliency propagated from the DigitCaps layer shows that the improvement comes from attributing decisions to whole-fruit regions rather than to object edges, giving post-hoc evidence that the gain is not a dataset artefact.

</details>


### [181] [Tomatoes, Potatoes, and Onions: Questioning the Need for Faces in Face Presentation Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21455)
*Guray Ozgur,Fadi Boutros,Naser Damer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TPO数据集，使用番茄、土豆和洋葱等非人脸对象进行演示攻击检测（PAD）训练，证明可迁移的PAD表征可以脱离人脸内容学习，在跨数据集人脸PAD基准上达到92.70%的AUC，且与人脸数据联合训练可提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人脸PAD被视为人脸特有任务，但打印、重放和翻拍引入的视觉伪影本质上与人脸外观无关。作者质疑PAD表征是否必须依赖人脸数据，并探索使用无脸数据训练可迁移的PAD表征的可能性，以推动隐私保护和身份无关的PAD开发。

Method: 作者构建了TPO数据集（番茄、土豆、洋葱在受控协议下的真实/打印/重放录制），采用基于基础模型的PAD架构，在TPO上训练检测器并迁移到四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准进行评估；同时进行反向迁移（人脸数据集训练→TPO测试）以及将TPO并入人脸PAD训练的联合训练实验，并辅以表征和频率分析。

Result: TPO训练的检测器在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上平均AUC达92.70%，优于合成人脸训练，与人脸数据集训练的模型竞争力相当；人脸PAD训练的模型迁移到TPO也持续高于随机水平；将TPO并入传统人脸PAD训练在固定优化预算下一致提升跨数据集性能。

Conclusion: 可迁移的PAD表征可以独立于人脸内容学习，且不能以单一光谱伪影解释，而是编码了跨对象类别共享的更丰富演示线索。这为隐私保护和身份无关的PAD开发开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) is traditionally formulated as a face-specific problem, although many of the visual artifacts introduced by print, replay, and recapture processes are not inherently tied to facial appearance. In this work, we investigate whether transferable PAD representations can be learned without using faces during downstream PAD training. To this end, we introduce TPO, a controlled face-free presentation attack dataset consisting of bona fide, print, and replay recordings of, almost randomly chosen, tomatoes, potatoes, and onions acquired under protocols that closely mirror conventional face PAD datasets. Using a foundation-model-based PAD architecture, we demonstrate that a detector trained on TPO achieves an average AUC of 92.70% across four standard cross-dataset face PAD benchmarks, outperforming training on synthetic faces and remaining competitive with models trained on real face datasets. Conversely, models trained on face PAD datasets transfer consistently above chance to TPO, suggesting that the learned representations capture characteristics of the presentation process rather than object semantics. Furthermore, incorporating TPO into conventional face PAD training consistently improves cross-dataset performance under fixed optimization budgets, indicating that face-free data provides complementary information rather than simply additional training samples. Finally, representation and frequency analyses provide further evidence that transferable PAD representations cannot be explained by a single spectral artifact but instead encode richer presentation cues shared across object categories. Together, these results provide empirical evidence that transferable presentation attack representations can be learned independently of facial content, opening new opportunities for privacy-preserving and identity-independent PAD development.

</details>


### [182] [CLSC DETR: Reliable Candidate Ranking via Cross Layer Geometric Support for UAV Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21457)
*Junyan Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLSC DETR，通过跨层局部支持模块聚合互补几何证据以更可靠地估计定位质量，并通过分类与定位一致性校准模块自适应调整分类分数来改善候选排序，在VisDrone和UAVDT数据集上取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机场景中的小目标检测面临空间范围小、分布密集和频繁遮挡等挑战，导致候选排序困难。现有基于DETR的方法通过单个query估计定位质量并将其融入分类分数，但单个query对边界线索弱的小目标缺乏足够的几何证据，导致质量估计不可靠、排序不稳定。

Method: 提出CLSC DETR框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 跨层局部支持模块（Cross Layer Local Support），在最终层query与中间层候选之间建立对应关系，聚合互补的几何证据以获得更可靠的定位质量估计；(2) 分类与定位一致性校准模块（Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration），根据定位质量和分类可靠性自适应调整分类分数，以改善候选排序。

Result: 在VisDrone数据集上，CLSC DETR相比基线在AP上提升1.5%，在AP_75上提升2.0%，并在UAVDT数据集上取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过跨层信息聚合和分类-定位一致性校准，CLSC DETR有效解决了小目标检测中单query几何证据不足导致的质量估计不可靠问题，提升了无人机视角下小目标检测的候选排序能力。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object detection is critical for applications such as target search, where accurate detection of small objects in complex aerial scenes remains challenging. The limited spatial extent, dense distribution, and frequent occlusion of small objects make reliable candidate ranking particularly difficult. Existing Detection Transformer (DETR) based methods improve ranking by estimating localization quality from individual queries and incorporating it into classification scores. However, a single query often lacks sufficient geometric evidence for small objects with weak boundary cues, resulting in unreliable quality estimation and unstable ranking. To address this limitation, we propose Cross Layer Local Support and Consistency Calibration for DETR, termed CLSC DETR. Specifically, the Cross Layer Local Support module establishes correspondences between final layer queries and intermediate layer candidates to aggregate complementary geometric evidence for more reliable localization quality estimation, while the Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration module adaptively adjusts classification scores according to localization quality and classification reliability to improve candidate ranking. Experiments show that CLSC DETR improves AP and AP$_{75}$ over the baseline by 1.5\% and 2.0\% on VisDrone, respectively, while achieving consistent improvements on UAVDT.

</details>


### [183] [FigmaTrace: Capturing Creative Nuances in Human Figma Design Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21460)
*Darshan Deshpande,Yoshinari Fujinuma,Martyna Markiewicz,Devanshu Bansal,Shivani Jain,Nicholas Saban,Chirag Maheshwari,Anand Kannappan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FigmaTrace数据集，包含200多小时人类设计视频转换的3469条设计轨迹，用于训练视觉语言模型，使其在主观创意设计任务上达到与前沿闭源模型（如Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6-Sol）相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在可验证的客观领域（如目标检测）表现良好，但在主观和创意设计任务上持续欠佳。主要原因是缺乏捕捉人类专家多样化偏好和决策的高质量工作流程数据。

Method: 1) 定义专家策划的设计技能与最佳实践分类体系；2) 扩展为126个开放式、主观、长期任务；3) 构建FigmaTrace数据集，通过新颖的设计阶段（design phase-based）方法将200多小时人类录屏视频转换为3469条设计轨迹；4) 基于此数据集训练四个模型；5) 进行消融实验对比设计阶段法与长度法的轨迹转换效果。

Result: 训练于FigmaTrace的模型在四个分布外代理GUI环境中性能提升，与Claude-Opus-5和GPT-5.6-Sol等前沿闭源模型相当。消融实验证明设计阶段法优于先前的长度法轨迹转换。最佳模型Qwen3.8-27B的定性分析进一步解释了性能提升与FigmaTrace趋势的相关性。

Conclusion: FigmaTrace数据集及其最佳模型已开源，该工作验证了基于专家工作流程的高质量轨迹数据能有效提升VLM在主观设计任务上的表现，缩小与闭源前沿模型的差距。

Abstract: Vision Language Models have recently shown improvements in several objective and verifiable domains such as object detection but continue to underperform on subjective and creative design tasks. A major contributor to this performance gap is the lack of high quality human workflow data that captures a diverse set of preferences and decisions that make human experts good at design tasks. In this work, we first define a unique, expert curated taxonomy of design skills and best practices which we further expand into a set of 126 open ended, subjective, long horizon tasks. Built on top of this and expert solutions, our dataset FigmaTrace contains over 200 hours of human captured video data converted into 3469 design trajectories using a novel design phase-based method. We use our dataset to train four models and show that training on FigmaTrace leads to a performance improvement comparable to frontier closed models such as \textsc{Claude-Opus-5} and \textsc{GPT-5.6-Sol} on four out of distribution agentic GUI environments. We further perform a useful ablation to attribute these performance improvements to a design phase-based video to trajectory conversion which outperforms prior length-based conversion approaches. Finally, we perform a qualitative analysis on the best performing \textsc{Qwen3.8-27B} outputs to better correlate performance improvements to FigmaTrace's trends. We open source our dataset and the best model for the community.

</details>


### [184] [Complexity Induction: Compositional Generalization via Structured Label Distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21464)
*Aleksandr Abramov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文证明，通过结构化扭曲训练数据（称为"复杂度归纳"）可以在不改动CNN架构的情况下诱导组合泛化能力。基于Jaccard字符串相似度的两种失真方法（混合标签和扩展数据集）都能使网络预测未见过的类别组合，且作用于不同层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究组合泛化能否通过训练数据的结构化扭曲而非架构修改来实现，并理解其背后的机制，进而揭示自然语言在认知发展中可能扮演的角色。

Method: 使用合成彩色几何图形图片，将类别编码为扁平字符串标签（如"red-circle"），从训练中完全排除某些颜色-形状组合。设计了两种基于Jaccard字符串相似度的失真方法：(1) 混合标签——软目标分布编码类间重叠；(2) 扩展数据集——添加带有结构化错误标签的假训练样本。此外设置随机非结构化错误标签作为对照组。

Result: 两种方法均能诱导网络预测未见过的类别组合，但作用机制不同：混合标签通过利用CNN的自然嵌入结构激活分类器对未见过组合的响应；扩展训练则改善嵌入分解本身。随机（非结构化）错误标签对照实验证实效果依赖失真的结构而非噪声本身。

Conclusion: 训练信号的结构化复杂化既能影响学习到的表征内部组织，也能影响其组合解释——这一原则可能构成自然语言在认知发展中作用的底层机制。

Abstract: We demonstrate that structured distortion of training data - which we term complexity induction - can induce compositional generalization in a standard CNN classifier without architectural modification. Using synthetic images of colored geometric shapes, we encode classes as flat string labels (e.g., "red-circle") with no explicit attribute decomposition, and exclude certain color-shape combinations from training entirely. We apply two distortion methods derived from Jaccard string similarity between class names: mixed labels (soft target distributions encoding inter-class overlap) and expanded dataset (false training samples with structurally motivated incorrect labels). Both methods induce the ability to predict unseen class combinations, and act at different levels: mixed labels activate the classifier for unseen combinations by exploiting the CNN's natural embedding structure, while expanded training improves the embedding factorization itself. A control with random (unstructured) false labels confirms that the effect depends on the structure of the distortion, not on noise per se. These results suggest that structured complication of training signals can influence both the internal organization of learned representations and their compositional interpretation - a principle that may underlie the role of natural language in cognitive development.

</details>


### [185] [3D Point Cloud from Close-Range Photogrammetry for Defect Characterisation of Rubberised Concrete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21468)
*Jiacheng Liu,Mohammed Alnahhal,Ailar Hajimohammadi,Sara Gonizzi Barsanti,Jinling Wang,Mohsen Kalantari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究将近景摄影测量（SfM-MVS）工作流适配于橡胶混凝土（RuC）的细观尺度表面缺陷检测与变形监测，对比了Canon DSLR与iPhone 16两种采集设备，验证了DSLR重建可达亚毫米级分辨率，并开发了RGB引导的裂缝提取方法及前后试验变形分析方法，证明该工作流是LiDAR在实验室环境下表面检测的灵活高分辨率替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维点云虽在土木工程中广泛应用，但主流LiDAR系统（如TLS）受限于实验室环境，其激光光斑尺寸超过微裂缝宽度，光束会桥接空隙，无法用于细尺度缺陷分析。因此需要探索近景摄影测量（SfM-MVS）在细尺度高韧性材料（如橡胶混凝土）缺陷检测中的适用性。

Method: （1）针对橡胶混凝土调整摄影测量工作流；（2）使用Canon DSLR和iPhone 16采集高分辨率图像集生成密集三维模型；（3）对比两种设备的重建精度；（4）开发RGB引导的裂缝提取方法以增强表面缺陷识别；（5）进行试验前后（Pre and Post-Test）变形分析以量化表面位移。

Result: DSLR-based重建实现亚毫米级分辨率，性能优于iPhone 16；RGB引导的裂缝提取方法能清晰分离裂缝区域并生成结构良好的缺陷几何形态表示；前后试验变形分析成功量化了各测试阶段的表面位移。

Conclusion: 近景摄影测量工作流是实验室环境下LiDAR用于表面检测与变形监测的灵活、高分辨率替代方案，并建立了稳健的几何基线，为未来自动化三维特征表征与材料性能评估奠定基础。

Abstract: While three-dimensional (3D) point clouds are widely used in civil engineering, mainstream LiDAR systems such as Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) are physically constrained to laboratory environments. Since their laser spot size typically exceeds the width of microcracks, the beam physically bridges over voids, rendering TLS unsuitable for fine-scale defect analysis. Alternatively, close-range photogrammetry utilising Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) algorithms offers a solution for testing highly tortuous materials, and its utility at fine-scale remains underexplored. This study adapts photogrammetric workflows specifically for rubberised concrete (RuC), a sustainable composite exhibiting high ductility and complex fracture morphologies. High-resolution image sets were captured using a Canon DSLR and an iPhone 16 to generate dense 3D models. Comparisons revealed that the DSLR-based reconstruction achieved sub-millimetre resolution, demonstrating superior performance for fine-scale surface monitoring. An RGB-guided crack extraction method was developed to enhance the identification of surface defects and isolate potential crack areas from the background. The extracted crack regions were visually distinguishable and provided a well-structured geometrical representation of defect morphology. Furthermore, a Pre and Post-Test deformation analysis was conducted to quantify surface displacement across testing stages. The results confirm that this close-range photogrammetry workflow is a flexible, high-resolution alternative to LiDAR for surface inspection and deformation monitoring of specimens in laboratory settings. Ultimately, this approach establishes a robust geometric baseline for future automated 3D feature characterisation and material performance evaluation.

</details>


### [186] [EXPL-FR: Explaining Face Recognition Models via Vision-Language Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21486)
*Guray Ozgur,Mustafa Efe Tamyapar,Naser Damer,Fadi Boutros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EXPL-FR 是一种面向深度人脸识别（FR）模型的可解释性方法，通过轻量适配器将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的图像编码器对齐到冻结的 FR 嵌入空间，仅用面部图像训练（无需文本），将可扩展的 978 个属性提示词（22 个类别）转化为 FR 空间中的锚点，从而在不访问架构的情况下提供身份级、图像级和差分级解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度人脸识别模型准确率已接近饱和，但模型仍不透明，使用者无法获知相似度评分依赖于哪些语义属性。现有可解释性方法缺乏在 FR 模型自身嵌入空间中提供语义级解释的能力。

Method: 关键设计包括：(1) 轻量适配器将 VLM 图像编码器对齐到冻结的 FR 嵌入空间，仅用面部图像训练；(2) 同一适配器复用于文本编码器（因 VLM 编码器共享同一空间），将属性提示词转换为 FR 空间锚点；(3) 提出人脸验证协议与消融实验验证对齐的有效性；(4) 提出无标签的可检测性度量（对比概念在 FR 空间与 VLM 空间中的可分性），筛选出 100 个最可检测概念构成模型语义签名；(5) 实现身份级、逐图像和差分级三种解释模式；(6) 支持三种监督设置下的属性级审计（人工标签、VLM 伪标签、纯提示驱动）。

Result: 覆盖四个人脸识别骨干网络和两个 VLM 编码器。语义签名在区分身份方面优于完整词汇表。无标签的提示驱动审计能够按实测的种族 RFW 错误对四个 FR 模型进行排序，并在受控属性变化下按其真实验证成本排序。该框架无需架构访问权限，适配成本极低。

Conclusion: 并非所有概念在 FR 空间中都能存活，因为 FR 模型通过丢弃其为跨因素验证身份所需的因子来获得不变性；可检测性度量能识别出哪些语义概念得以保留。EXPL-FR 提供了一种无需标签、无需架构访问的可扩展方法来审计和解释人脸识别模型。

Abstract: Deep face recognition (FR) models reach near-saturated accuracy but remain opaque: a practitioner cannot ask which semantic attributes a similarity score relied upon. EXPL-FR answers this inside the FR model's own embedding space. A lightweight adapter aligns a vision-language model's (VLM) image encoder with the frozen FR space, trained on face images alone and never on text. Because the VLM's encoders share one space, the same adapter applies to the text encoder, turning 978 attribute prompts in 22 categories, also extendable, into FR-space anchors at no extra cost. We do not assume this transfer works: a face-verification protocol measures it, and an ablation changing only the adapter isolates its contribution. Not every concept survives, because an FR model earns its invariances by discarding the factors it must verify identities across. A label-free detectability measure compares each concept's separability in FR space against the VLM space, and the 100 most detectable form the model's readable semantic signature, which separates identities better than the full vocabulary. We cover four FR backbones and two VLM encoders, EXPL-FR needs no architecture access, and supports identity-level, per-image, and differential explanations. We benchmark attribute-level auditing under three supervision settings, human labels (current practice), VLM pseudo-labels, and our fully prompt-driven audit, against real verification behavior. With no labels, the prompt-driven audit ranks four FR models by their measured per-ethnicity RFW errors and ranks controlled attribute changes by their true verification cost.

</details>


### [187] [TASSO: TAsk-Specific Subspace Optimization for Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21487)
*Chang Sun,Francesco Barbato,Matteo Caligiuri,Pietro Zanuttigh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TASSO范式，通过子空间学习和几何感知知识蒸馏两种互补技术，高效保持潜空间几何结构的同时确保网络可塑性，在CLIP视觉语言模型的持续学习中显著缓解灾难性遗忘和零样本性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在持续学习过程中面临两个关键问题：灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化，两者都会严重损害模型在连续任务中的整体性能。现有方法未能同时有效解决这两个问题。

Method: TASSO采用两种互补技术：(1) 子空间学习——学习一系列任务特定的低秩投影器，将潜表示投影后再优化交叉熵损失，避免沿完整嵌入维度进行不必要的参数更新；(2) 几何感知知识蒸馏——使用基于测地线距离的损失函数，从先前任务模型中蒸馏知识，同时有效保持潜空间几何结构，聚焦于任务特定流形。

Result: 在CLIP视觉语言模型的多域任务增量学习和类增量学习基准上，TASSO在缓解遗忘和保持零样本能力方面均优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 子空间学习和几何感知蒸馏的设计选择既能避免全维度参数更新的浪费，又能通过任务特定流形关注提升学习效果；几何感知蒸馏提供强正则化，显著降低了持续学习序列中的灾难性遗忘和零样本退化。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot capabilities, making them an attractive solution for continual learning across diverse tasks. However, during continual adaptation, both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation occur, severely degrading performance. In this paper, we introduce TASSO, a new paradigm that efficiently preserves the latent space geometry while ensuring network plasticity. We achieve this with two complementary techniques: subspace learning and geometry-aware knowledge distillation. Specifically, we first learn a sequence of task-specific low-rank projectors, which we use to project the latent representations before optimizing cross-entropy. Secondly, we employ a geodesic-distance-based loss that distills knowledge from the previous-task model while effectively preserving the latent space geometry. These design choices not only avoid unnecessary parameter updates along the full embedding dimensions but also improve learning by focusing on task-specific manifolds. Moreover, the geometry-aware distillation provides strong regularization and significantly reduces both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation throughout the continual learning sequence. Experimental results with the CLIP vision language model in the multi-domain task incremental and class incremental learning benchmarks demonstrate clear improvements over state-of-the-art methods in mitigating forgetting and preserving zero-shot capabilities.

</details>


### [188] [DamageScope: Vision-Language Retrieval at Scale for Disaster Damage Assessment from Satellite Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21529)
*Ravi K. Rajendran,Biplob Debnath,Murugan Sankaradas,Srimat T. Chakradhar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DamageScope是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）框架的自动化财产损失评估系统，它将卫星图像与视觉语言模型（VLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）相结合，支持自然语言交互式灾害损失评估。该系统通过创新的多向量嵌入聚类算法将索引时间缩短14倍，并通过双存储数据架构将LLM API调用成本及响应延迟降低约3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统灾害后现场勘测评估财产损失耗时、昂贵且存在安全风险。虽然卫星图像和视觉语言模型的发展使大规模远程灾害评估成为可能，但将VLMs集成到大规模地球观测管线中面临着计算效率、数据组织和信息检索等方面的挑战。

Method: DamageScope基于检索增强生成（RAG）框架，从卫星图像中提取结构化视觉表征以支持交互式自然语言查询。为应对可扩展性问题，提出了一种新颖的多向量嵌入聚类算法，优于传统单向量嵌入方法；同时采用双存储数据架构来最小化LLM API调用次数，降低运营成本和响应延迟。

Result: 多向量嵌入聚类算法将索引时间减少高达14倍；双存储数据架构将运营成本和响应延迟降低约3倍。

Conclusion: DamageScope通过有效平衡可扩展性与运营效率，为真实世界灾害损失评估任务提供了稳健且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Timely and accurate assessment of property damage is critical following natural disasters. Traditional on-site inspections are labor-intensive, costly, and often pose safety risks. Advances in satellite imagery and vision-language models (VLMs) enable scalable remote damage assessment; however, integrating VLMs into large-scale Earth observation pipelines presents challenges in computational efficiency, data organization, and information retrieval. To address these challenges, we present DamageScope, a retrieval-augmented framework that combines satellite imagery with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate property damage analysis. Built on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, DamageScope extracts structured visual representations from satellite imagery to support interactive natural language queries for damage assessment. To address scalability, we introduce a novel multi-vector embedding-based clustering algorithm that outperforms traditional single-vector embedding approaches while reducing indexing time by up to 14x. Furthermore, a dual-store data architecture minimizes LLM API calls, reducing both operational cost and response latency by up to approximately 3x. By effectively balancing scalability and operational efficiency, DamageScope provides a robust and practical solution for real-world damage assessment tasks.

</details>


### [189] [presto: Efficient, Training-free, and Open-world Object Placement via Imaginary Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21543)
*Weixuan Ding,Shang Liu,Hanyu Pei,Zeyan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出presto，一个零样本、免训练的开放世界物体放置框架，将物体放置重构为基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理引导的启发式搜索任务。框架通过从粗到细的搜索策略在想象动作空间中迭代优化物体的位置和尺度，并评估了两种决策变体：度量引导选择与MLLM作为评判。实验证明其在多个基准上达到最先进性能，尤其在未见过的开放世界场景中表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体放置方法依赖手工规则或在有限数据集上进行监督学习，导致泛化能力和可解释性受限，尤其在涉及新颖物体和场景的开放世界环境中表现不佳。作者希望打破这一限制，提出一种无需训练且能适应开放世界的解决方案。

Method: 将开放世界物体放置问题形式化为由MLLM推理引导的启发式搜索任务。框架在想象动作空间（imaginary action space）中迭代优化物体的位置和尺度，采用粗到细的搜索策略加速收敛。同时提出两种决策变体：Metric-guided Selection（度量引导选择）和MLLM-as-a-judge（MLLM作为评判者）。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明presto达到最先进性能，尤其在未见的开放世界场景中表现优异。人类研究进一步显示，MLLM-as-a-judge变体产生的放置比度量驱动方法更具感知连贯性，揭示了标准评估指标与人类视觉判断之间存在差距。

Conclusion: 基于MLLM推理的启发式搜索是一种有效且可解释的开放世界物体放置方法，无需训练即可实现零样本泛化。同时，研究指出当前标准评估度量与人类感知之间的一致性不足，提示未来工作应关注更符合人类视觉判断的评价体系。

Abstract: Object placement is critical in image composition, requiring spatially and semantically coherent positioning of objects within diverse scenes. Existing approaches typically rely on hand-crafted rules or supervised learning on limited datasets, which restricts their generalization and interpretability, especially in open-world scenarios involving novel objects and scenes. In this work, we reformulate open-world object placement as a heuristic search task guided by reasoning from a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). We introduce \textsf{presto}, a zero-shot, training-free framework that operates within an imaginary action space to iteratively refine object position and scale. Our coarse-to-fine search strategy ensures fast convergence, and we evaluate two decision-making variants: Metric-guided Selection and MLLM-as-a-judge. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that \textsf{presto}~achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly in previously unseen, open-world settings. Human studies further reveal that the MLLM-as-a-judge variant produces more perceptually coherent placements than metric-driven approaches, highlighting a gap between standard evaluation metrics and human visual judgment.

</details>


### [190] [Extending the Horizon of Early Diagnosis: Lung Cancer Prediction with Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21571)
*Olivera Kotevska,Ian Goethert,Michael McGee,Maria Mahbub,Sean R. Wilkinson,Rowena Yip,Myvizhi Esai Selvan,Zeynep H. Gumus,Claudia Henschke,Robert J. Klein,Providencia Morales,Samuel M Aguayo,Ioana Danciu,Mayanka Chandrashekar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了Vision Transformers (ViTs)在胸部X光片上提前1-2年预测肺癌的能力。基于波士顿Jamaica Plains VA医院91,020项影像研究中的259,361张胸片，通过混合采样和类别加权损失应对约1:150的极端类别不平衡。三种ViT配置（从头训练、ImageNet预训练、Corona预训练）中，预训练模型较从头训练基线在AUC上提升6-10个百分点，平衡准确率提升约10-12%。ImageNet预训练模型表现最稳定，轻中度重采样比例可在性能损失不大情况下减少最高70%运行时间。尽管尚未达到临床部署阈值，但结果支持ViT分流系统的进一步开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，早期诊断对提高生存率至关重要。然而早期恶性病变在胸片上可能表现隐匿，给放射科医生带来诊断挑战。本研究旨在探索利用Vision Transformers从常规胸片中提前1-2年预测肺癌风险，以推动更早的临床干预。

Method: 采用259,361张胸片（来自91,020项影像研究），数据存在约1:150的极端类别不平衡。通过混合欠采样和过采样及类别加权损失优化来解决不平衡问题。评估三种ViT配置：从头训练模型、ImageNet预训练模型、Corona预训练微调模型，并比较不同重采样比例对性能与计算效率的影响。
