Result: 预训练模型显著优于从头训练基线，AUC提升6-10个百分点，平衡准确率提升约10-12%。ImageNet预训练模型整体表现最稳定；Corona预训练模型在部分设置下获得更高灵敏度但变异性更大。1:1欠采样和1.5:2过采样等中等重采样比例在灵敏度、精确率和计算效率间达到良好平衡，运行时间降低高达70%且无重大性能损失。

Conclusion: Vision Transformers展现出从常规胸片早期预测肺癌风险的潜力。尽管当前性能尚未达到临床部署阈值，但研究结果为基于ViT的分流系统开发提供了支持，该系统可标记高风险患者进行更早评估。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and early diagnosis is critical for improving survival. However, early-stage malignancies can be subtle on chest X-rays, creating challenges for radiologists. This study evaluates Vision Transformers (ViTs) for predicting lung cancer one to two years before clinical diagnosis. We analyzed 259,361 chest X-rays from 91,020 imaging studies at the Jamaica Plains VA Hospital in Boston, MA. The dataset showed extreme class imbalance, approximately 1:150 cancer to non-cancer, which was addressed using hybrid under- and over-sampling and class-weighted loss optimization. Three ViT configurations were evaluated: a model trained from scratch, an ImageNet-pretrained model, and a Corona-pretrained model fine-tuned on the lung cancer dataset. Transfer learning improved performance, with pretrained models exceeding the scratch baseline by 6-10 percentage points in AUC and about 10-12 percent in balanced accuracy. ImageNet-pretrained models showed the most stable overall performance, while Corona-pretrained models achieved higher sensitivity in some settings but greater variability. Moderate resampling ratios, including 1:1 undersampling and 1.5:2 oversampling, provided favorable trade-offs between sensitivity, precision, and computational efficiency, reducing runtime by up to 70 percent without major performance loss. These findings demonstrate the potential of ViTs for early lung cancer risk prediction from routine chest X-rays. Although performance remains below clinical deployment thresholds, the results support further development of ViT-based triage systems to flag high-risk patients for earlier evaluation.

</details>


### [191] [Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21595)
*Michael Jerge,Joseph Pelczar,Justin Downes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Noise-Contrastive GRPO（NC-GRPO），一种通过向提示编码阶段最后一层隐藏层注入尺度校准的高斯噪声来增强视觉语言模型推理能力的强化学习with可验证奖励（RLVR）方法。该方法在每个优化组中为一半rollout注入噪声，产生偏移的起始状态，并强化那些尽管受到扰动仍能到达答案的分支，将分支点的敏感性转化为策略梯度信号。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B + Geometry3K上，NC-GRPO显著提升跨域数学推理、域内准确率和幻觉鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR通过解码温度或像素空间图像失真来多样化rollout以增强推理能力，但作者质疑扰动是否应放在模型潜在空间中而非像素空间。像素空间扰动在感知密集型基准上取得了更大的OOD平均值，却在幻觉鲁棒性上表现退化，暗示需要一种更本质的扰动方式。

Method: NC-GRPO将尺度校准的高斯噪声注入提示编码阶段（prompt-encoding pass）的最后一层隐藏层，为每个优化组中一半的rollout添加噪声，使其从偏移的起始状态出发。能够在此位移下仍达到答案的分支被强化，而被扰动偏离的分支被抑制，从而将分支点的敏感性转化为策略梯度信号。奖励、目标和推理协议均保持不变，作为标准RLVR管线中约50行代码的推理引擎改动即可集成。

Result: 在五个保留的跨域基准上，NC-GRPO相比vanilla GRPO显著提升（合并McNemar p≤0.001），同时改善域内准确率和幻觉鲁棒性。机制消融表明内部随机多样性（independent stochastic diversity）而非噪声预算或方向是活跃成分；噪声尺度研究揭示了推理专门化与通用能力之间的权衡。

Conclusion: NC-GRPO通过在潜在空间而非像素空间进行扰动，提供了一种更有效的rollout多样化策略，显著优于现有方法，特别在幻觉鲁棒性这个像素噪声退化的维度上取得改进。该方法设计为模态无关（modality-agnostic），可轻松集成到现有RLVR管线。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the prompt-encoding pass for half of each rollout group, branching those rollouts from a displaced departure state. Branches that reach the answer despite the displacement are reinforced over those derailed by it, converting sensitivity at the branch point into policy-gradient signal; the objective, reward, and inference protocol are untouched. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B trained on Geometry3K, NC-GRPO significantly improves out-of-domain mathematical reasoning over vanilla GRPO across five held-out benchmarks (pooled McNemar $p \le 0.001$) while also improving in-domain accuracy and hallucination robustness -- the latter an axis on which image-space noise regresses even while posting a larger OOD average on perception-heavy benchmarks. Mechanism ablations indicate that independent stochastic diversity, not noise budget or direction, is the active ingredient, and a noise-scale study exposes a dial between reasoning specialization and general capability. NC-GRPO is designed to be modality-agnostic and integrates into a standard RLVR pipeline as a ~50-line change to the inference engine.

</details>


### [192] [Semantic Slots for Video Object-Centric Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21636)
*Khalil Sabri,Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau,Nicolas Saunier,Wassim Bouachir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SemanticSlots，一种基于Transformer解码器的视频物体中心学习方法。该方法认为传统OCL的瓶颈在于解码器而非编码器，传统解码器迫使槽位（slots）被空间锚定，限制其适配运动的能力。SemanticSlots利用图像上下文作为查询，使槽位成为物体位置不变（position invariant）的语义查询，能从单帧分解后续视频帧，无需复杂的时间预测器或辅助时间损失。在YouTube-VIS上，mBO较VideoSAUR提升31个点，较当前最先进方法提升21个点，达到86.6% ARI和62.8% mBO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频物体中心学习（OCL）以往研究聚焦于改进编码器架构以增强时间一致性，但作者论证核心瓶颈在于解码器——传统解码器迫使槽位被空间锚定，阻碍其适应物体运动的能力。

Method: 提出SemanticSlots，采用基于Transformer的解码器，利用图像上下文让槽位充当语义查询。槽位因此具备物体位置不变性，能够检索匹配特征而非记忆坐标。这种属性使单帧计算出的槽位可直接用于分解后续视频帧，无需复杂的时间预测器或辅助时间损失。

Result: 在YouTube-VIS数据集上，SemanticSlots相较VideoSAUR在mBO指标上提升31个点，相较当前最先进方法提升21个点，达到86.6% ARI和62.8% mBO。

Conclusion: 通过将解码器从空间锚定中解放出来，使槽位成为位置不变的语义查询，SemanticSlots大幅提升了视频物体中心学习的性能，并简化了时间一致性建模的需求。

Abstract: Video Object-Centric Learning (OCL) has traditionally focused on refining the encoder architecture to ensure temporal consistency. In this paper, we argue that the primary bottleneck lies in the decoder. We show that traditional decoders force slots to be spatially anchored, hindering their ability to adapt to motion. We propose SemanticSlots, which uses a Transformer-based decoder that leverages image context, relieving slots from encoding boundary precision and spatial location. This allows slots to function as semantic queries that are inherently object position invariant, retrieving matching features rather than memorizing coordinates. More importantly, this property allows slots computed from a single frame to decompose subsequent video frames, eliminating the need for complex temporal predictors or auxiliary temporal losses. Results on YouTube-VIS show that SemanticSlots improves upon VideoSAUR by 31 points in mBO and outperforms current state-of-the-art methods by 21 points, achieving 86.6% ARI and 62.8% mBO.

</details>


### [193] [SketchFlow: Zero-Shot Vector Sketch Generation via GMM Prior Flow in CLIP Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21659)
*Jin Zhou,Hongliang Yang,Pengfei Xu,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SketchFlow是一个基于最优传输理论和流匹配的矢量草图生成框架，通过CLIP潜在空间中的连续映射实现跨模态对齐，利用GMM先验配合OT-CFM学习确定性向量场，并由混合扩散解码器生成高质量的类人手绘风格笔画轨迹，在零样本泛化和语义插值方面表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矢量草图是简洁而直接的人类抽象表达媒介，但生成具有类人手绘风格的矢量笔画仍具挑战。主要障碍是细粒度、高质量的文生草图配对数据严重匮乏，现有文本条件生成方法要么依赖不稳定且耗时的优化过程，要么难以在零样本场景下泛化到未见类别。

Method: 1) 利用预训练CLIP模型绕过劳动密集的图像级文本标注；2) 在CLIP潜在空间中，将跨模态对齐建模为连续映射问题；3) 将噪声注入离散类别嵌入以构造连续的高斯混合模型（GMM）先验；4) 使用最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）模型学习从GMM先验到目标草图特征分布的确定性向量场；5) 设计融合1D U-Net和Transformer架构的混合扩散解码器，将特征解码为快速且高保真的笔画轨迹。

Result: 大量实验表明，SketchFlow在视觉质量和遵循自然人类绘画风格方面显著优于现有基线。该框架展示了针对超出QuickDraw训练词汇的提示（包括未见概念标签和语义修饰符）的良好局部零样本合成能力，同时支持不同概念之间的平滑连续语义插值。

Conclusion: SketchFlow通过将最优传输理论与流匹配结合，提出了一个几何保持的生成框架，有效解决了草图训练数据稀缺和跨模态对齐困难的问题，在生成质量、零样本泛化以及语义插值方面均取得了突破性进展。

Abstract: Vector sketches remain one of the most concise and immediate mediums for abstract human expression. However, generating high-quality vector strokes that exhibit human-like drawing styles remains an open challenge due to the severe scarcity of fine-grained, high-quality text-to-sketch paired data. Existing text-conditioned generation methods often rely on unstable, time-consuming optimization or struggle to generalize to unseen categories in a zero-shot manner. To address these limitations, we present SketchFlow, a novel generative framework rooted in Optimal Transport (OT) theory and flow matching. By leveraging pre-trained CLIP models to bypass labor-intensive image-level text annotations, we formulate cross-modal alignment as a continuous mapping problem directly within the CLIP latent space. To bridge the inevitable modality gap between discrete text concepts and continuous sketch features, we first inject noise into discrete category embeddings to construct a continuous Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) prior. We then utilize an Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) model to learn a deterministic vector field mapping from this continuous GMM prior to the target sketch feature distribution. Finally, a Hybrid Diffusion Decoder, fusing 1D U-Net and Transformer architectures, is designed to decode these features into fast and high-fidelity stroke trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SketchFlow substantially outperforms existing baselines in visual quality and adherence to natural human drawing styles. Furthermore, our geometry-preserving framework demonstrates promising local zero-shot synthesis for prompts beyond the QuickDraw training vocabulary, including unseen concept labels and semantic modifiers, while enabling smooth, continuous semantic interpolation between distinct concepts. Source code is available at: https://github.com/QiuHong-1202/SketchFlow.

</details>


### [194] [Emotion Intensity Matters: Generating Realistic Expressions in Virtual Humans with CVAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21697)
*Vitor Miguel Xavier Peres,Lara Volpato,Gabriel Ferri Scnheider,Soraia Raupp Musse*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的方法，利用真实人类面部表情数据训练模型，以合成可控强度、语义一致的情绪化面部表情，用于虚拟角色动画。尽管训练数据仅有7,680个样本，该模型仍能学习有意义的潜在表征并生成连贯的情绪变化，同时支持情绪强度的控制与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在虚拟角色动画中生成富有表现力的面部行为仍是情感计算领域的一项核心挑战，传统方法往往依赖演员表演或人工艺术干预，成本高且难以实现情感强度的精确控制。需要一种能够从有限数据中学习并生成可控情绪表情的自动化方法。

Method: 采用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）架构，在包含六种基本情绪、两种强度级别（低和高）的真实人类面部表情数据集上进行训练，通过条件信息引导潜在空间的学习，从而生成保留语义一致性的合成面部表情数据，并支持情绪强度的控制。

Result: 尽管训练数据量有限（仅7,680个面部表情样本），该方法仍能学习有意义的潜在表征，生成连贯的情绪变化。实验结果表明模型能够在不同强度级别间保留关键的表达性特征，并支持跨情感强度级别的泛化。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了CVAE方法能够从相对较小的数据集中生成具有情感强度的面部表情，为创建富有情感表现力的虚拟角色提供了一种不需要演员表演或人工干预的可行方案，对情感计算和角色动画领域具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Generating expressive facial behavior in virtual humans (VHs) remains a central challenge in affective computing and character animation. This paper presents a novel approach based on Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAEs), trained on real human facial expression data, to synthesize controllable emotional expressions at varying intensities. Using a dataset comprising six basic emotions represented at two intensity levels (low and high), we train a CVAE model to generate synthetic facial expression data while preserving semantic consistency with real human expressions. Despite the limited amount of training data (only 7,680 facial expression samples), the proposed approach learns meaningful latent representations and generates coherent emotional variations. Our method enables control over emotional intensity, making it suitable for animating virtual characters without requiring actor performances or manual artistic intervention. Our research aimed to evaluate whether the method (CVAE) preserves the characteristics associated with the different intensity levels present in the dataset. Results show that the proposed model preserves key expressive characteristics across intensity levels while supporting generalization across emotional intensity levels, contributing to the creation of emotionally expressive virtual characters from relatively small datasets.

</details>


### [195] [StereoDiffuer: Diffusion-based Progressive Geometry Modeling with Saliency Attention Perception for Stereo Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21710)
*Bohan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StereoDiffer，一种基于迭代扩散的立体匹配框架，通过显式建模几何细节并逐步细化视差估计，解决了现有方法在挑战区域中边缘模糊和过度平滑的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的立体匹配方法虽然随着深度神经网络的发展取得了进步，但在保持细粒度几何细节方面仍有不足，导致在挑战性区域出现边缘模糊和过度平滑的预测结果。

Method: 提出StereoDiffuer框架，包含两个关键组件：1) 显著性注意力感知（SAP）模块，用于提取包括物体边界、细结构和尖锐边缘在内的显著性几何线索；2) 置信度引导的SAP特征与初始视差估计相结合，作为迭代去噪扩散过程的条件，用于纠正残余视差误差并恢复在代价体正则化和上采样过程中被抑制的几何细节。

Result: 在Scene Flow和KITTI基准上的实验结果表明，该框架是有效的，相对于对比的立体匹配方法表现出有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 基于扩散的迭代细化策略能够有效恢复立体匹配中丢失的几何细节，为高精度视差估计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: With the advance of deep neural networks, the quality of disparity maps obtained through stereo matching has steadily improved. However, existing stereo matching methods still struggle to preserve fine-grained geometric details, resulting in blurred edges and over-smoothed predictions in challenging regions. To address these limitations, we propose StereoDiffuer, an iterative diffusion-based stereo matching framework that explicitly models geometric details and progressively refines disparity estimates. The framework incorporates a Saliency Attention Perception (SAP) module to extract salient geometric cues, including object boundaries, thin structures, and sharp edges. Confidence-guided SAP features are combined with the initial disparity estimate to condition an iterative denoising diffusion process, which corrects residual disparity errors and restores geometric details suppressed during cost-volume regularization and upsampling. Experimental results on the Scene Flow and KITTI benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and its competitive performance relative to the compared stereo matching methods.

</details>


### [196] [The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21713)
*Ashritha Gonuguntla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过可编辑的文本计划（对象名、属性、边界框）将推理增强型文生图模型（如GoT-R1）中的规划器（planner）与解码器（decoder）分离，系统性地验证了二者在组合提示失败中的责任归属。研究发现解码器是忠实的执行者（94%的生成布局实现了计划关系），而规划器才是瓶颈（存在左右方向偏置，右侧仅54%准确率）。通过不同层级的计划编辑（从重采样到整体替换）可在不重训练的情况下显著提升图像质量最高+13.3分，并发布了完整的计划保真度评测协议与12k张生成的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理增强型文生图模型会先输出文本计划再生成图像，但当组合提示失败时，无法确定是计划错误还是解码器不忠实。鉴于计划是机器可读且可在解码前编辑的，作者希望将二者分离，找到真正的失败瓶颈，从而指导模型的改进方向。

Method: 1) 首先验证评测"标尺"的可靠性：通过交换模型自身链中两个边界框来验证布局确实反转（基于检测器的准确率0.75降至0.48，p<1e-3），并对比基于VQA的空间度量与五名人类评审的结果（人类分别与检测器81%、与VQA 57%一致），最终选择几何评分。2) 在此可靠度量下测试解码器忠信度：94%的生成布局实现了计划中的关系；对象-框绑定在计划对象段重排后仍然成立。3) 针对规划器进行控制实验（如提及顺序控制、左右方向对比），识别出栅格顺序偏置等系统性错误。4) 通过不同层级的计划编辑（符号验证+重采样、最小就地修复、仅重写框几何、整体替换计划）测试不重训练情况下修复图像的效果。

Result: 1) VQA度量不可靠（与人类仅57%一致），几何评分更优。2) 解码器是忠实执行者，94%布局实现计划关系，对象-框绑定在重排后保持。3) 规划器是瓶颈：左右不对称（左98%对右54%），存在栅格顺序偏置（mention-order控制实验隔离），且生成拥挤的几何。4) 计划编辑可修复图像无需重训练：符号验证+重采样+5.0分、最小就地修复+6.0、仅重写框几何+10.7、整体替换计划+13.3。5) 增益对计划的文体风格和规划器下的似然不敏感，但与几何强相关。6) 框-文本矛盾会导致对象重复和身份融合。

Conclusion: 模块化的规划器-解码器设计是可行的，前提是计划内部一致性得到保证（框与文本的矛盾会造成严重伪影）。最有效的修复手段是直接修正计划的几何部分，而非文体或概率层面的调整。研究团队发布了完整的计划保真度评估协议、所有计划及12k张生成图像以推动该方向的后续研究。

Abstract: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the generated layout: detector-based accuracy falls 0.75 -> 0.48 (p<1e-3), while a widely used VQA-based spatial metric rises. A five-rater human study agrees with the detector on 81% of items and with the VQA judge on 57%. All spatial results therefore use geometric scoring. Under sound measurement the decoder is a faithful executor: 94% of generated layouts realize the planned relation, and object-box binding survives reordering of the plan's object segments. The planner is the bottleneck. It writes wrong relations for phrasing-dependent reasons - 98% accuracy on "left" against 54% on "right" for semantically identical layouts, a raster-order bias we isolate with a mention-order control - and cluttered geometry that the decoder faithfully reproduces. Editing the plan therefore fixes the image without retraining: symbolic verification with resampling gives +5.0 points (p<1e-3), minimal in-place repair +6.0 (p=.02), rewriting only box geometry +10.7 (p<1e-4), and replacing the plan outright +13.3 (p=1e-4). Gains are indifferent to the plan's prose style and to its likelihood under the planner, but not to its geometry. Modular planner-decoder designs are therefore viable, provided the plan is internally consistent: box-text contradictions induce object duplication and identity fusion. We release the plan-fidelity evaluation protocol, all plans, and 12k generated images.

</details>


### [197] [Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21748)
*Xuanhua Yin,Shunqi Mao,Wei Guo,Chuanzhi Xu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SHIP（Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies）框架，解决文本到图像系统中测试时搜索策略的校准问题。由于搜索会改变哪些提示获得输出以及释放哪个候选图像，候选级风险控制不保证释放输出的风险受控。SHIP通过对完整部署策略在留出提示上运行或重放，使用独立目标评判器评估实际释放的图像，并选择满足风险预算的最宽松阈值。实验表明SHIP在GenEval2+FLUX（N=16）上将释放风险从0.310降至0.162，并展示策略相关的风险-覆盖率-算力权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的验证器引导的文本到图像系统在测试时使用搜索来选择、精炼或停止多个候选，但释放阈值通常在单个图像上校准。搜索改变了候选分布和选择策略，导致候选级风险校准与策略级（释放输出）风险控制之间存在失配，需要形式化建模并解决这一estimand偏移问题。

Method: SHIP通过两个维度形式化estimand偏移：提示重加权（prompt reweighting）和提示内选择（within-prompt selection）。其核心流程为：在留出提示集上运行或重放完整的部署策略，用独立的目标评判器评估实际释放的图像，然后选择满足风险上界约束的最宽松阈值。对于基于预设阈值网格的可重放策略，使用同时置信控制（simultaneous confidence control）提供有限样本有效性保证。

Result: 在固定、序列和自适应三类T2I推理流程上的实验表明，策略级校准能恢复更低风险的工作点，并揭示风险、覆盖率与算力之间的策略依赖权衡。在GenEval2+FLUX（N=16）上，池化候选阈值给出释放风险0.310，而SHIP将其降至0.162。在200个缓存流切分上，固定网格证书无目标越界。

Conclusion: 可靠的推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）需要对完整部署策略所诱导的输出分布进行校准，而非仅在候选层级进行校准。SHIP提供了一个具有有限样本有效性的策略级校准方法，为释放阈值的合理设定提供了理论基础和实用工具。

Abstract: Verifier-guided text-to-image systems increasingly use test-time search to select, refine, or stop among multiple candidates, yet release thresholds are often calibrated on individual images. This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selection, and introduce SHIP, Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies. SHIP runs or replays the complete deployed policy on held-out prompts, evaluates the image it actually releases using an independent target judge, and selects the most permissive threshold whose risk upper bound satisfies a prescribed budget. For replayable policies with a prespecified threshold grid, simultaneous confidence control provides finite-sample validity. Experiments across fixed, sequential, and adaptive T2I inference procedures show that policy-level calibration recovers lower-risk operating points while exposing policy-dependent tradeoffs among risk, coverage, and compute. On GenEval2 with FLUX at N=16, a pooled-candidate threshold yields released risk 0.310, whereas SHIP reduces it to 0.162. Across 200 cached-stream splits, the fixed-grid certificate has no target crossing. Reliable inference-time scaling therefore requires calibrating the output distribution induced by the complete deployed policy.

</details>


### [198] [Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC): Data Pruning for Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21754)
*Dongyao Zhu,Ranga Raju Vatsavai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了数据剪枝（DP）在遥感变化检测中的应用，通过对六个代表性DP方法、两个数据集、CNN与Transformer两类模型以及三个剪枝预算的基准测试，发现现有方法相对于随机选择没有可靠优势。通过540个随机采样子集的回归分析，揭示了"变化分布保真度"是决定变化检测数据子集质量的最关键因素，并提出了Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC)两阶段剪枝方法，在多个基准和骨干网络上取得了一致的改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据剪枝在分类和分割任务中已证明能减少训练数据量并提升下游模型性能，但在遥感变化检测领域尚未被探索。作者希望填补这一空白，系统评估现有DP方法在变化检测任务中的有效性，并理解其背后的机制，以设计专门适合该任务的数据剪枝方法。

Method: 1) 对六个代表性DP方法在建筑和森林变化检测数据集上、CNN与Transformer骨干下、三个剪枝预算下进行基准测试；2) 对540个随机采样的数据子集进行系统回归研究，用四个描述符（标签统计、图像多样性、特征空间几何）表征每个子集；3) 训练随机森林模型识别影响子集质量的关键因素，发现"变化分布保真度"（change distribution fidelity）是最主导因素；4) 基于此发现，提出FDC两阶段剪枝方法，结合保真度、多样性和一致性三个原则。

Result: 现有DP基线在变化检测中相对随机选择没有可靠优势，最强的基线Feature Diversity被约33%的随机子集匹配或超越。回归分析表明变化分布保真度是决定子集质量的最突出因素，像素级图像多样性和标签-特征一致性是次要因素。FDC方法在变化检测基准和骨干网上相对现有基线表现出一致改进，尤其在较低的剪枝比率下优势更明显。

Conclusion: 通用数据剪枝方法在变化检测任务中并不直接适用，因为现有方法忽略了变化检测特有的"变化分布保真度"这一关键属性。通过理解变化检测数据子集质量的决定因素，可以设计出更有效的针对性剪枝方法（FDC），为遥感变化检测的数据高效训练提供了新方向。

Abstract: Despite the success of data pruning (DP) in reducing training data sizes and improving downstream model performance in classification and segmentation tasks, its potential in remote sensing change detection remains unexplored. For the first time, we benchmark six representative DP methods across building- and forest-change datasets, CNN- and transformer-based models, and three pruning budgets, and show that existing baselines yield no reliable advantage over random selection. Notably, even the strongest evaluated baseline, Feature Diversity, is matched or exceeded by $\sim$33\% of randomly sampled subsets. To understand the underlying mechanism, we conduct a systematic regression study over 540 randomly sampled data subsets, characterizing each with four descriptors covering label statistics, image diversity, and feature-space geometry. Random Forest models show that \emph{change distribution fidelity} is the most prominent factor in determining the quality of change detection data subsets, a property absent from the existing pruning literature. Our analyses further show that pixel-wise image diversity and label-feature consistency are secondary factors. We translate these findings into Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC), a simple two-stage pruning method that shows consistent improvements over existing baselines across change detection benchmarks and backbones, especially at lower pruning ratios. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}.

</details>


### [199] [Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21762)
*Jinchang Zhu,Rong Fu,Yi Ding,Chenghao Wu,Ying Liu,Menglin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GapSight提出一种让视觉语言模型（VLM）学会"重读"图像的框架：模型先全局扫视图像，再由一个轻量级路由器判断是否需要对局部区域进行放大细看。该路由器通过目标模型自身的失败信号（loss差距/选项边距）离线生成训练标签，学习何时、何处需要二次查看。在LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B和Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct三个模型上，GapSight在六个基准上全面超越基线，其中InternVL2.5-8B的六基准平均分从52.25提升至64.29。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在细节密集型问题上频繁失败，根本原因是图像在被压缩为低分辨率全局视图时丢失了关键信息。现有解决方案（如为所有查询分配更多视觉token）虽能改善部分OCR和文档任务，但计算分配不具针对性，且可能干扰依赖全局上下文的场景。因此需要一个有选择性的"局部重读"机制。

Method: GapSight包含两个阶段：离线阶段，利用目标VLM自身的失败信号生成标签——通过比较仅看全局视图时与候选裁剪增强视图时的答案loss或选项边距，将能改善答案的裁剪区域标注为"需重读"标签。在线阶段，一个轻量级的自由形式裁剪路由器从全局状态中蒸馏这些标签，一次性推理预测是否需要重读、重读的预期效用以及一个连续裁剪框。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B和Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct三个VLM上，GapSight在OCR、文档、图表、信息图、VStarBench和MME-RealWorld-Lite六个基准上均优于Base无缩放基线。在InternVL2.5-8B上，六基准平均分从52.25提升到64.29，超越CropVLM（57.16）、ViCrop（55.84）和ZoomRefine（54.43）。机制分析表明路由器能纠正具体错误答案、按任务自适应调整动作率，并形成有利的token-性能配置。

Conclusion: Loss差距监督（loss-gap supervision）是一种实用的训练VLM"何时重看、看哪里"的路径。通过让模型自身提供重读监督信号，GapSight在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了细节敏感任务的准确率，为VLM的视觉信息获取机制提供了新思路。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view. Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns to a free-form region when the question calls for local evidence. The supervision comes from the target model's own failure signal. Offline, we compare answer loss or multiple-choice option margin under a global-only view and candidate crop-augmented views; crops that improve the target answer become model-specific review labels. A lightweight free-form crop router distills these labels into a one-shot inference policy that predicts whether to review, expected utility, and a continuous crop box from the global state. Across LLaVA-1.5-7B, InternVL2.5-8B, and Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, GapSight improves the Base no-zoom baseline on six benchmarks spanning OCR, documents, charts, infographics, VStarBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite. On InternVL2.5-8B, GapSight raises the six-benchmark average from 52.25 to 64.29, above CropVLM (57.16), ViCrop (55.84), and ZoomRefine (54.43). Mechanism analyses show that the router rescues concrete wrong answers, adapts its action rate by task, and forms a favorable token-performance profile. These results position loss-gap supervision as a practical route to teaching VLMs when and where to look again.

</details>


### [200] [LiteEvent-AE: Lightweight Autoencoder for Event-Based Vision on Low-Latency Energy-Constrained Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21764)
*Riadul Islam,Joey Mule,Dhandeep Challagundla,Shahmir Rizvi,Sean Carson,Rachit Saini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种紧凑且可配置的基于事件驱动的自编码器，用于高效压缩神经形态数据并保留下游推理所需的时空结构。在SEFD和EBCD数据集上，该模型在仅需YOLOv9约1/35.6参数量下实现了竞争性或更优的准确率；在Jetson Nano上达到44.8 FPS实时吞吐，在Raspberry Pi 4B CPU上能耗比YOLOv9低约726.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件驱动视觉为节能AI提供了稀疏、低延迟的视觉信号范式，但异步和含噪的事件流对传统深度学习模型构成挑战——这些模型往往计算量过大，难以在低功耗嵌入式平台上运行。需要一个紧凑高效的事件驱动模型来在资源受限的边缘设备上实现节能感知。

Method: 设计了一个紧凑可配置的事件驱动自编码器架构，包含轻量级卷积编码器以实现高效压缩，在自适应事件阈值下保持稳健性能，并集成极简分类头以在显著降低计算成本的同时保持识别保真度。

Result: 在SEFD和EBCD数据集上达到与YOLOv9相当或更优的准确率，参数量减少高达35.6倍；在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上实现44.8 FPS的实时吞吐量；在Raspberry Pi 4B CPU上，50%自编码器分类器推理工作负载仅消耗16.19 J能量，比YOLOv9低约726.3倍。

Conclusion: 紧凑型事件驱动模型能够在资源受限的嵌入式平台上实现环境友好、低功耗的AI系统，为自主、移动和嵌入式计算环境中的高速感知提供可行方案，展示了神经形态数据处理在可持续边缘AI中的潜力。

Abstract: Event-based vision has emerged as a promising paradigm for energy-aware artificial intelligence (AI), offering sparse, low-latency visual signals that reduce redundant data processing and support sustainable edge computing. However, the asynchronous and noise-prone nature of event streams creates challenges for conventional deep learning models, which are often too computationally intensive for low-power embedded platforms. This work presents a compact and configurable event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data while preserving essential spatiotemporal structure for downstream inference. The architecture integrates lightweight convolutional encoding with robust performance under adaptive event thresholding and a minimal classifier head, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost without degrading recognition fidelity. Extensive evaluations on the Smart Event Face Dataset (SEFD) and Event-Based Crossing Dataset (EBCD) show that the proposed framework achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to YOLOv9 while requiring up to 35.6$\times$ fewer parameters. To assess real-world sustainability, the model is deployed on resource-constrained hardware: a Raspberry Pi 4B and a NVIDIA Jetson Nano. On NVIDIA Jetson Nano, it delivers real-time throughput of 44.8 FPS. On a Raspberry Pi 4B CPU, the 50\% autoencoder classifier consumes 16.19 J for the evaluated inference workload, corresponding to approximately 726.3$\times$ lower energy consumption than YOLOv9 under the same evaluation protocol. These results demonstrate the potential of compact event-driven models to advance environmentally conscious, low-power AI systems for high-speed perception in autonomous, mobile, and embedded computing environments.

</details>


### [201] [SpatialDiff: 3D-Aware Object Movement via Implicit Spatial Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21776)
*Zheng Liu,Zijian He,Huiguo He,Weizhi Zhong,Yejun Tang,Huan Yang,Kun Gai,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialDiff方法，通过隐式3D空间建模和全局空间监督两种核心创新，使图像编辑模型能够准确理解和执行复杂场景中的物体空间移动，显著提升编辑的准确性和保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑方法在复杂场景（如物体跨越不同深度层或被部分遮挡）中难以处理空间移动。大多数方法仅依赖2D数据集的先验信息，强调平面特征而缺乏空间结构支持；即使引入显式位置信息的方法也无法捕获真实的3D空间关系，从而限制了对复杂场景中物体的精确移动。

Method: 提出SpatialDiff方法，包含两项核心创新：(1) 隐式3D空间建模（Implicit 3D Spatial Modeling），引入3D先验知识，使模型内部构建对三维空间结构的全面理解；(2) 全局空间监督（Global Spatial Supervision），约束潜在空间特征，使模型能够感知编辑操作引起的物体空间位置变化。

Result: 实验结果表明，SpatialDiff方法在复杂场景中显著提升了物体空间移动的准确性和编辑结果的保真度。

Conclusion: 通过引入3D空间先验和全局空间监督，SpatialDiff有效解决了现有图像编辑方法在复杂场景中处理物体空间移动的局限性，验证了对三维空间结构建模的重要性。

Abstract: Recent advances in image editing allow impressive manipulation of objects, existing methods still struggle to handle spatial movement in complex scenes, such as objects span different depth layers or are partially occluded. Most image editing methods focus solely on prior information from 2D datasets, emphasizing planar features while lacking support for spatial structures. Even approaches that incorporate explicit positional information fail to capture true 3D spatial relationships, thus limiting accurate object movement in complex scenes. In this paper, we present SpatialDiff, a method that effectively captures 3D spatial structures, enabling precise and consistent object movements in complex scenes. Our core innovations are twofold: (1) Implicit 3D Spatial Modeling, which introduces 3D prior knowledge and enables the model to internally build a comprehensive understanding of the three-dimensional spatial structure; and (2) Global Spatial Supervision, which constrains the latent spatial features to enable the model to perceive changes in object spatial positions caused by editing operations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves the accuracy and fidelity of spatial movement in complex scenes.

</details>


### [202] [DefaultShift: Auditing Semantic Default Shift in Accelerated Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21784)
*Xuanhua Yin,Chuanzhi Xu,Shunqi Mao,Wei Guo,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DefaultShift框架，用于检测和校准快速文本生成图像模型替换慢速模型时产生的"语义默认值偏移"（semantic default shift），通过配对审计、语义词汇表和离线校准方法（DefaultShift-Select），测量并减少加速模型相对于参考模型的分布偏移，同时保持图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步文本到图像生成模型日益取代慢速生成器，但加速过程可能静默地改变某些未指定属性的分布，即使单张图像看起来合理且与提示词对齐。现有评估（质量、偏好、多样性）都无法检验替换模型是否保留了参考模型的语义默认分布，导致加速替换可能引入隐藏的系统性偏差。

Method: 提出DefaultShift配对审计方法：使用封闭语义词汇表对重复样本进行标注，测量概率质量移动，并区分可解释的排序分析与交叉拟合推断。同时提出DefaultShift-Select，一种离线校准方法，用于减少人工测量的语义偏移。

Result: 在14对参考-替换模型组合上，颜色校准后的差异范围从0.054到0.303，且随蒸馏方案呈现特定方向。1000张图像的人工审计复现了排序。DefaultShift-Select在Turbo、DMD2和FLUX上将人工测量的偏移降低10.3%至35.1%，且无明显质量损失。在均衡评估下，校准后的数据比未校准数据恢复4.3个准确率点和7.5个最差组准确率点。

Conclusion: DefaultShift使得加速场景下的语义保存在测量上可量化、在实践中可操作，为验证快速生成模型是否保持参考模型的语义默认行为提供了新的评估与校准手段。

Abstract: Few-step text-to-image models increasingly replace slower generators, yet acceleration can silently change distributions over unspecified attributes even when individual outputs remain plausible and aligned. We call these distributions semantic defaults and their change under replacement semantic default shift. Existing quality, preference, and diversity evaluations do not test whether a replacement preserves its reference model's semantic defaults. We introduce DefaultShift, a paired audit that labels repeated samples with closed semantic vocabularies, measures probability-mass movement, and separates interpretable ranking from confirmatory cross-fit inference. Across 14 reference and replacement pairs, adjusted color discrepancies range from 0.054 to 0.303 with recipe-specific directions. A 1,000-image human audit reproduces the ordering. We further introduce DefaultShift-Select, an offline calibration method that reduces human-measured shift by 10.3 percent to 35.1 percent across Turbo, DMD2, and FLUX without material quality loss. Under balanced evaluation, selected data recover 4.3 accuracy points and 7.5 worst-group points over uncalibrated replacement data. DefaultShift makes semantic preservation under acceleration measurable and actionable.

</details>


### [203] [HP-UniIF: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Unified Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21786)
*Xingxin Xu,Siqi Zhao,Xin Li,Xinjie Yao,Yiming Sun,Pengfei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HP-UniIF是一个基于扩散先验的统一视觉框架，通过深度层次条件调制策略（任务提示调制、退化提示路由器、应用提示库）将异构图像融合、退化恢复和下游感知任务解耦到网络不同阶段，在多个融合任务、多种退化和下游应用中取得优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界应用通常需要一个统一系统同时支持异构融合、退化恢复和面向任务的感知，但现有统一框架难以处理这些正交目标，导致表征纠缠和子任务性能下降。

Method: HP-UniIF利用扩散先验桥接异构融合、视觉恢复和下游感知。核心是深度层次条件调制策略：(1) 瓶颈层的任务提示调制使骨干适应不同融合模式；(2) 浅层的退化提示路由器注入退化感知约束用于局部恢复；(3) 解码阶段的应用提示库使生成与下游任务对齐。该层次化设计解耦了不同层级的优化目标。

Result: 在多个融合任务、多样退化和各种下游应用上的广泛实验表明，HP-UniIF相比现有统一框架具有优越性能，能同时产生视觉保真结果并保留任务相关语义。

Conclusion: HP-UniIF证明了通过层次化条件调制可以在单一管道中同时优化扩散模型对域级、退化级和任务级目标的适应性，实现异构融合、恢复与感知的统一，且各子任务性能均优于现有方法。

Abstract: General image fusion seeks to integrate complementary information from multiple source images, yet real-world applications often require a single system to support heterogeneous fusion, degradation restoration, and task-oriented perception simultaneously. Existing unified frameworks struggle with these orthogonal objectives, resulting in entangled representations and degraded performance across subtasks. We propose HP-UniIF, a unified vision framework that leverages diffusion priors to bridge heterogeneous fusion, visual restoration, and downstream perception. To address the limited adaptability of diffusion models to domain-, degradation-, and task-level objectives within one pipeline, HP-UniIF introduces a depth-wise hierarchical conditional modulation strategy that decouples these objectives across network stages. Task prompt modulation at bottleneck layers adapts the backbone to different fusion paradigms, the degradation prompt router at shallow layers injects degradation-aware constraints for local restoration, and the application prompt bank at decoding stages aligns generation with downstream tasks. This hierarchical design enables HP-UniIF to produce visually faithful results while preserving task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple fusion tasks, diverse degradations, and various downstream applications demonstrate the superior performance of HP-UniIF.

</details>


### [204] [SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21796)
*Long Shu,Shuochen Liu,Wei Chen,Junda Lin,Zhi Zheng,Huijun Hou,Tong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAFE-G是一个面向知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）的结构感知、忠实证据引导生成框架，通过粗粒度混合搜索+细粒度图检索精确定位证据，并利用强化学习策略确保推理严格锚定于检索证据，在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek基准上分别超越现有方法8.9%和3.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KB-VQA方法在融合多模态特征进行外部知识检索时，往往难以捕捉复杂上下文中的结构关联以有效过滤噪声，且无法保证推理过程严格忠实于检索到的证据，导致答案准确性和可信度受限。

Method: SAFE-G包含两个核心模块：(1) 粗粒度混合搜索融合视觉与文本模态召回候选文档，随后通过结构感知的细粒度图检索捕获结构依赖关系以过滤噪声并精确定位证据；(2) 引入带证据基础奖励的强化学习策略，仅当所选证据正确时才给予正确答案以奖励，通过严格的对齐约束迫使模型将回答锚定在检索上下文中。

Result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek基准上的实验表明，SAFE-G相比先前方法分别取得了8.9%和3.5%的性能提升，显著增强了整体推理准确率。源代码已公开。

Conclusion: SAFE-G验证了结构感知检索与证据约束推理相结合的有效性，为KB-VQA任务提供了更精确的证据定位和更可信的推理方案，同时强化学习策略有效确保了模型推理与检索证据的严格对齐。

Abstract: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, they frequently fail to ensure that the reasoning process remains strictly faithful to the retrieved evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SAFE-G, a Structure-Aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation framework, which enables precise evidence localization and trustworthy reasoning. Specifically, we first employ a coarse-grained hybrid search fusing visual and textual modalities to recall candidate documents, and subsequently implement a structure-aware fine-grained graph retrieval that captures structural dependencies to filter noise and pinpoint precise evidence. Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct. This strict alignment constraint compels the model to anchor its response in the retrieved context, effectively enhancing its capability to locate evidence via multimodal features and perform faithful reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek benchmarks demonstrate that SAFE-G outperforms prior methods by a margin of 8.9% and 3.5%, substantially enhancing the overall reasoning accuracy. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G.

</details>


### [205] [FlashReg: GPU-Accelerated 3-Clique Point Cloud Registration for Real-Time Correspondence-to-Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21804)
*Ziyang Yu,Xiang Li,Qiong Chang,Jun Miyazaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashReg提出了一种GPU导向的点云配准对应到位姿估计方法，通过快速一/二阶图构建和循环优化的三节点团搜索，避免了构建密集二阶梯形图，在室内外基准上将对应到位姿延迟比TurboReg降低2-3倍，峰值张量内存减少约50%，适合嵌入式GPU上的机载感知流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图的点云配准通过识别几何一致对应集实现高鲁棒性，但构建二阶兼容性图和枚举候选团在计算和内存上开销巨大，难以满足嵌入式平台上高吞吐感知流水线的实时需求。

Method: FlashReg是一个GPU对应对应到位姿估计器，包含两个核心组件：(1) Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) 构建，直接从二进一阶图构建容量有界的稀疏二阶图，避免物化密集评分的二阶图；(2) 数据流优化的三节点团（3-clique）搜索，从紧凑的逐行候选池中选择枢轴，并通过排序稀疏邻域交集枚举三元组。

Result: 在室内外基准测试中，FlashReg相比TurboReg将对应到位姿延迟降低2-3倍，同时保持相当的配准召回率；在嵌入式GPU上峰值分配的张量内存约为TurboReg的50%。

Conclusion: FlashReg在延迟和内存效率上显著优于现有方法，适合作为机载感知流水线中的高吞吐配准后端。

Abstract: Graph-based point cloud registration achieves high robustness by identifying geometrically consistent correspondence sets, but constructing second-order compatibility graphs and enumerating candidate cliques remain compute- and memory-intensive. This work presents FlashReg, a GPU-oriented correspondence-to-pose estimator that avoids materializing the dense scored second-order graph. Its Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) construction builds a capacity-bounded sparse second-order graph directly from the binary first-order graph. A dataflow-optimized three-node clique (3-clique) search then selects pivots from compact per-row candidate pools and enumerates triples through sorted sparse-neighborhood intersections. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, FlashReg reduces correspondence-to-pose latency by 2--3x relative to TurboReg at comparable registration recall, while using about 50% of its peak allocated tensor memory on an embedded GPU. These results make FlashReg suitable as a high-throughput registration backend within onboard perception pipelines.

</details>


### [206] [Through the Schrödinger Bridge: Benchmarking Antemortem Image Restoration from Postmortem Autolysis to Enhance Forensic Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21813)
*Shuang Hao,Jiacheng Yue,Yaxuan Zhao,Fan Wang,Jianhua Ma,Erwen Huang,Chunfeng Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次将法医组织病理学中的死后自溶修复形式化为一个无配对监督下的新任务：将严重自溶的尸检组织图像转化为具有诊断意义的"生前"表征。作者构建了首个同源但无配对的数据集AutoPath，利用Schrödinger Bridge建模自溶与未自溶分布间的随机形态退化，并提出基于诊断效用的滑片级评估方法，建立了可复现的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法医组织病理学对死因判定和疾病诊断至关重要，但死后自溶这一不可逆的随机降解过程会扭曲组织形态、引入诊断主观性。现有监督方法和循环/结构一致性无配对翻译方法均因自溶导致的大规模非确定性形态变化及无法获得像素级配对数据而失效，因此亟需一种新的形式化框架和评估方法来实现自溶图像的诊断级复原。

Method: 将自溶复原问题形式化为无配对监督下从自溶图像到诊断上有意义的"生前"表征的变换任务；构建AutoPath数据集，通过将标本切分为相邻组织块（一块立即处理、一块诱导自溶）获得近万个10×图块（来自69例不同肝脏病变病例）；将该问题建模为自溶与未自溶分布之间的Schrödinger Bridge；提出基于诊断效用的滑片级诊断分布一致性评估方法，取代泛化的图像级生成指标如FID。

Result: 构建了首个同源无配对的自溶恢复数据集AutoPath（近万张10×图块，69例肝脏病例），证明了通用图像级生成指标（如FID）与诊断效用不一致，并提出基于法医实践的滑片级诊断分布一致性评估方案，建立了涵盖任务定义、真实数据集与评估方法学的可复现基准。

Conclusion: 该工作为法医病理自溶恢复领域提供了一个严谨且有实践意义的基准框架，验证了Schrödinger Bridge在建模严重随机形态退化方面的原理合理性，并强调以诊断效用为核心的评估导向，为后续研究奠定了数据和评估基础。

Abstract: Forensic histopathology, essential for determining cause of death and disease diagnosis, is severely impeded by postmortem autolysis, i.e., an irreversible, stochastic degradation process that distorts tissue morphology and introduces diagnostic subjectivity, thereby underscoring the value of restoring autolyzed images to a diagnostically plausible, pre-autolysis state for improving objectivity in forensic practice. This restoration task is fundamentally challenging due to the large, non-deterministic morphological changes caused by autolysis and the infeasibility of pixel-wise paired data, which invalidates assumptions underlying supervised and cycle/structure-consistent unpaired translation methods. To address this, we formalize forensic histopathology autolysis restoration as a new task: under unpaired supervision, transform postmortem images with severe autolysis into diagnostically meaningful ``antemortem'' representations. We contribute AutoPath, the first homologous yet unpaired dataset for this problem, constructed by splitting specimens into adjacent tissue blocks---one processed immediately, the other exposed to induce autolysis---yielding nearly ten thousand $10\times$ patches from 69 cases with varying liver conditions. We further frame the problem as a Schrödinger Bridge between the autolyzed and non-autolyzed distributions, offering a principled approach to modeling stochastic, severe morphological degradation. Critically, we demonstrate the misalignment of generic image-level generative metrics (e.g., FID) with diagnostic utility and propose a forensically grounded, slide-level diagnostic distribution consistency evaluation. Overall, this work establishes a reproducible benchmark (encompassing task definition, a real-world dataset, and an evaluation methodology) toward rigorous and practically meaningful progress in autolysis restoration for forensic pathology.

</details>


### [207] [PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21819)
*Jihyung Ko,Eunji Jung,Hyeongsub Kim,Ziseok Lee,Jae Won Cho,Sanghyun Jo,Kyungsu Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本篇论文提出了PatchGate，一个无需训练的框架，用于提升视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图像描述生成中的目标物可靠性。它通过从冻结VLM解码器后半层的补丁级词汇证据中提取与任务提示无关的目标物信息，并在解码过程中用这些证据校准logits，同时提升可见目标的覆盖率并抑制幻觉目标物的生成，在AMBER基准上实现了CHAIR指标下降12%、可见目标覆盖率提升13.4%的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的训练无关方法只通过干预模型已预测的目标词来抑制无依据的目标物提到，但这些方法仅作用于模型已经倾向于提及的目标物，导致被遗漏的可见目标物难以被重新恢复。因此需要一种方法不仅能抑制幻觉，还能促进那些模型未提及但实际存在且应被描述的目标物的生成，以同时兼顾描述的精确性和完整性。

Method: PatchGate包含两个阶段：(1) 视觉证据提取（VEX）：在生成前，从冻结VLM的LM解码器后半层提取补丁级别的词汇证据，构建与任务提示无关的、基于图像条件的目标物集合；(2) 视觉证据包含-排除解码（VIED）：利用提取的目标物证据校准解码logits，对证据支持但低表达的目标词进行促进（包含），对证据支持弱但过度表达的目标词进行抑制（排除）。整个方法无需外部检测器或微调，仅需一次额外前向传播。

Result: 在AMBER基准上，PatchGate在目标物级可靠性两方面均获得提升：可见目标覆盖率从49.4提升至56.0（+13.4%），目标幻觉通过CHAIR从7.5降至6.6（-12.0%）。方法无需外部检测器、无需微调，代价仅是一次额外前向传播。

Conclusion: PatchGate证明通过提取冻结VLM内部固有的视觉证据，可以在无需外部工具或训练的情况下同时改善图像描述的精确性和完整性。其核心洞见是将"模型内在的目标物集合"与"最终生成的目标词集合"之间的差距缩小，从而有效解决现有训练无关方法只能抑制幻觉而难以恢复遗漏目标的局限。

Abstract: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We propose PatchGate, a training-free framework that extracts prompt-free object evidence intrinsic to a frozen VLM before generation and uses it to narrow the gap between an intrinsic object set and final object mentions. In the first stage, Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX) reads patch-level lexical evidence from the latter half of LM decoder layers and constructs an image-conditioned object set without any task prompt. In the second stage, Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED) uses this object evidence to calibrate decoding logits, promoting evidence-supported but under-verbalized objects and suppressing weakly supported but over-verbalized objects. On AMBER, PatchGate improves both sides of object-level reliability, increasing visible-object coverage from 49.4 to 56.0 (+13.4%) and reducing object hallucination by lowering CHAIR from 7.5 to 6.6 (-12.0%), without external detectors or fine-tuning and with one extra forward pass.

</details>


### [208] [Towards Alias-Free 4D Gaussian Representations with Motion-Aware Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21828)
*Ankit Dhiman,Kunal A Kathare,Pranav Vignesh,Lokesh R Boregowda,Venkatesh Babu Radhakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种面向4D动态场景表示的运动感知3D平滑滤波器，通过估计时间与焦距-深度比的联合密度函数来确定滤波强度，解决动态场景新视角合成中的混叠伪影问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态场景的新视角合成（如4D表示）在生成不同视角（缩放操作）的新视图时会出现混叠伪影。现有的Mip-Splatting中的3D平滑滤波器未能考虑局部运动信息，因此无法有效解决动态场景中的混叠问题。

Method: 提出运动感知的3D平滑滤波器：通过非参数估计方法估计时间与焦距-深度比的联合密度函数；在推理阶段，从该联合分布中采样以确定合适的平滑滤波强度。该滤波器根据局部运动信息自适应调整滤波强度，且可灵活集成到各种4D表示中（如4D高斯泼溅和4D神经辐射场）。

Result: 在标准数据集上的实验评估表明，该方法相比现有最先进的动态场景新视角合成方法取得了更优的性能，有效减轻了混叠伪影且不牺牲渲染质量。

Conclusion: 运动感知的3D平滑滤波器是解决动态4D表示中混叠问题的有效方案，其基于非参数密度估计的自适应滤波策略具有通用性和实用性，可推广到多种4D表示框架。

Abstract: Novel-view synthesis of dynamic scenes, crucial for AR/VR applications, remains a challenging problem. Recent methods adapt representations like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for dynamic scenes by incorporating time as the fourth dimension (4D representations). These 4D representations still suffer from aliasing artifacts, especially when generating novel views from divergent viewpoints (zoom-in/zoom-out operations). While using 3D smoothing filters like those proposed in Mip-Splatting might seem like a possible solution, they fail to account for local motion and also exhibit aliasing. To address this, we propose a motion-aware 3D smoothing filter specifically designed for 4D representations. Our approach adapts the filter strength based on local motion information, effectively mitigating aliasing without compromising rendering quality. This is achieved by estimating the joint density function of time and focal-to-depth ratio using a non-parametric estimation method. During inference, we sample from this joint distribution to determine the appropriate smoothing filter. This flexible strategy can be integrated with various 4D representations. Our evaluations on standard datasets demonstrate superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [209] [Towards Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding: Through Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21837)
*Chaoran Huang,Fangcheng Li,Tianyi Liu,Wenyang Liu,Kejun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BLMSP框架，通过比特流语言建模学习比特流原生的语义提示，并将其注入现成的视觉模型中，以解决比特流损坏下的恶劣视频理解（BcHVU）问题。该方法在视频恢复、描述生成和人体姿态估计三个任务上均取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BcHVU旨在理解真实多媒体通信中由严重损坏的比特流解码出的恶劣退化视频。由于BcHVU的病态性质，即使是细微的比特流损坏也可能导致不可逆的像素失真和显著的语义损失，这对现有视觉模型构成了重大挑战。

Method: BLMSP框架包含两个关键组成部分：1）视频比特流字节模型（VBBM），整合字节级建模和跨编解码器语义蒸馏，从多种损坏比特流格式的字节序列中解释鲁棒语义；2）将学习到的比特流语义作为鲁棒先验注入BcHVU模型骨干网络中，用于视频恢复、描述生成和人体姿态估计。此外，构建了大规模多源损坏比特流恶劣视频配对（CHP）数据集，包含607k损坏比特流片段和287k配对的恶劣视频片段。

Result: 实验结果表明，学习的比特流先验在视频恢复（PSNR提升2.51 dB）、描述生成（CIDEr提升0.20）和人体姿态估计（PCK@0.2提升0.18）方面均取得了显著平均提升。这些结果验证了损坏比特流可以作为鲁棒语义先验来解决BcHVU中的像素失真和语义丢失问题。

Conclusion: 损坏的比特流可以作为鲁棒语义先验在BcHVU中有效解决像素失真和语义丢失问题，为恶劣视频理解提供了新的研究思路。

Abstract: Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding (BcHVU) aims to understand harshly degraded videos originally decoded from a severely corrupted bitstream in real-world multimedia communication. The ill-posed nature of BcHVU poses a major challenge for existing vision models, as even subtle bitstream corruption can lead to irreversible pixel distortion and significant semantic loss. To address these challenges in BcHVU, we propose Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors (BLMSP), a framework for learning and injecting bitstream-native semantic cues. Our proposed BLMSP framework learns to extract bitstream-native semantic cues by bitstream language modeling, and leverages them as priors by injecting into off-the-shelf vision models of BcHVU tasks. Specifically, we present a Video Bitstream Byte Model (VBBM) that integrates byte-level modeling and cross-codec semantic distillation, enabling it to interpret robust semantics from byte sequences in multiple corrupted bitstream formats. The learned bitstream semantics are leveraged as robust priors and fused into BcHVU model backbones for improving the quality of video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation. To train BLMSP, we construct a large-scale multi-source Corrupted-bitstream Harsh-video Paired (CHP) dataset containing 607k corrupted bitstream segments and 287k paired harsh video clips. Extensive experimental results show that the learned bitstream priors improve video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation by 2.51 dB in PSNR, 0.20 in CIDEr, and 0.18 in PCK@0.2 on average, respectively. These results demonstrate that corrupted bitstream can serve as robust semantic priors in solving pixel distortion and semantic loss in BcHVU.

</details>


### [210] [FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21839)
*Peiyuan Zhang,Xiangyu Zhao,Hongbo Liu,Xiaoxing Hu,Mingxin Liu,Shuran Ma,Yunhang Shen,Jian Hu,Haihan Gao,Haoyu Cao,Xue Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FIRM-Video提出了一种统一的、基于检查表驱动（checklist-driven）的数据构建框架，采用"先检查再打分"（check-before-score）原则，为文本到视频（T2V）的奖励模型构建高质量的训练数据。该框架分别针对指令跟随、世界一致性和感知质量三个维度构建了不同的检查策略，并将验证后的标准与分数转化为自然语言分析用于端到端奖励建模。作者构建了FIRM-Video-90K数据集（88,044个维度特定实例，来自29,348个视频）和FIRM-Video-Bench基准（250个视频上的750个逐点人工标注）。基于Qwen3-VL的FIRM-Video-8B在基准上取得最佳整体MAE，并在多个视频生成器的Best-of-8采样中持续取得最高VBench得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V奖励模型依赖整体性评判（holistic judges）配合固定规则或开放式推理，导致检查不完整、论证不可信以及归因纠缠（entangled attribution）。作者希望解决评估准确性与推理效率之间的权衡问题，通过更高质量的训练监督来构建可靠的奖励模型。

Method: 提出FIRM-Video框架：(1) 针对指令跟随维度，将提示词分解为带权重的原子需求；(2) 针对世界一致性维度，构建基于可见实体和动作的、提示校准且目标特定的检查；(3) 针对感知质量维度，应用通用的视觉缺陷分类学。所有检查需对照时间上的视觉证据逐条验证，仅聚合通过验证的决策，并将验证后的标准和分数转化为自然语言分析进行端到端奖励模型训练。

Result: 构建了FIRM-Video-90K数据集（88,044个维度特定实例，29,348个视频）和FIRM-Video-Bench基准（750个逐点人类标注，250个视频）。FIRM-Video-8B（基于Qwen3-VL）在FIRM-Video-Bench上取得最佳整体MAE，并在三种视频生成器的Best-of-8采样中持续取得最高VBench Total、Quality和Semantic得分。

Conclusion: 基于check-before-score原则的检查表驱动框架能够显著提升T2V奖励模型的评估准确性和可靠性，证明分解式验证相较于整体评判在奖励建模上的优势，同时保持推理效率。

Abstract: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment. However, the trade-off between evaluation accuracy and inference efficiency places high demands on the quality of training supervision. Existing approaches often rely on holistic judges with fixed rubrics or open-ended reasoning, leading to incomplete inspection, unfaithful justification, and entangled attribution. We introduce FIRM-Video, a unified checklist-driven data construction framework based on a check-before-score principle: construct dimension-specific checklists, verify each criterion against temporal visual evidence, and aggregate only verified decisions. For Instruction Following, FIRM-Video decomposes prompts into weighted atomic requirements; for World Coherence, it constructs prompt-calibrated, target-specific checks grounded in visible entities and actions; and for Perceptual Quality, it applies a generic taxonomy of visual defects. The verified criteria and scores are further transformed into natural-language analyses for end-to-end reward modeling. Subsequently, we construct FIRM-Video-90K with 88,044 dimension-specific instances from 29,348 videos, and introduce FIRM-Video-Bench with 750 point-wise human annotations across 250 videos. The Qwen3-VL-based FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.

</details>


### [211] [BC-IHV: Conditioning the Color Space for Stable Rectified-Flow Low-Light Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21847)
*Yi Ai,Zheng Chen,Yuanhao Cai,Yulun Zhang,Xiaokang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-RF（结构锚定整流流）框架用于低光图像增强，通过分离的色度/强度通道、尺度匹配条件金字塔和HybridAda机制维持结构对应关系；同时引入BC-IHV可学习Box-Cox极坐标颜色空间，用单一指数控制逆梯度动态范围，平衡暗区扩展与梯度条件化，在多个基准上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像增强面临曝光模糊与结构保持的矛盾：生成式传输能建模曝光不确定性，但其灵活性可能破坏输入中已有的几何与色度结构；此外，固定的可逆颜色坐标仅被当作表示形式，忽视了其逆映射会重塑增强网络接收的RGB域梯度。

Method: 提出Structure-Anchored Rectified Flow (SA-RF)：通过（1）分离的色度/强度双通道保持对应关系；（2）尺度匹配的条件金字塔；（3）HybridAda机制——空间交叉注意力负责位置特定检索，池化AdaLN负责全局曝光调制。同时引入BC-IHV，一种可学习的Box-Cox极坐标颜色空间，其解析可逆的强度映射通过单一指数控制逆梯度动态范围，从而在暗区扩展与梯度条件化之间实现平衡。

Result: 在三个LOL基准、盲图像质量评估及跨数据集测试上，SA-RF一致地展现了优于SOTA的重建精度与感知质量；消融研究验证了所提框架与颜色表示各自的有效性。

Conclusion: 结构锚定的生成式流程结合可学习的可逆颜色空间，能有效化解低光增强中曝光修正与结构保持之间的张力，在重建与感知质量上均取得一致性提升。

Abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) must correct ambiguous exposure without overwriting structure already supported by the input. Generative transport can model exposure ambiguity; however, its flexibility may also alter observable geometry and chromatic content. Moreover, fixed invertible color coordinates are usually treated only as representations, although their inverse mappings reshape the RGB-domain gradients received by the enhancement network. To address these issues, we propose Structure-Anchored Rectified Flow (SA-RF), which maintains correspondence through separate chromaticity/intensity stems, a scale-matched condition pyramid, and HybridAda. HybridAda assigns location-specific retrieval to spatial cross-attention and global exposure modulation to pooled AdaLN. We further introduce BC-IHV, a learnable Box--Cox polar color space whose analytically invertible intensity mapping controls the inverse-gradient dynamic range through a single exponent. This allows the representation to balance dark-range expansion and gradient conditioning instead of adopting a fixed linear or logarithmic law. Experiments on three LOL benchmarks, blind image-quality evaluation, and cross-dataset tests demonstrate consistent reconstruction and perceptual advantages over the sota. Controlled studies further support the effectiveness of both the proposed framework and color representation.

</details>


### [212] [GaussVid: Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with 3D-Aware Video Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21849)
*Xinhui Liu,Can Wang,Wei Jiang,Wei Wang,Dong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种3D感知的视频修复框架，利用相机条件几何先验增强稀疏视图下的3DGS重建质量，通过边界锚定和相机关系编码实现多视图一致的修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS在稀疏视图下重建存在明显伪影，虽然视频扩散模型能提供时空先验，但直接微调用于修复缺乏对多相机几何的感知，导致多视图不一致，修复效果次优。

Method: 1) 构建大规模3DGS视频数据集用于专门微调；2) 引入相机条件几何先验，利用首帧和末帧作为边界锚点并编码相机关系，显式注入空间结构到视频生成管线，弥合2D视频生成与3D多视图约束之间的差距。

Result: 在视频先验修复方法中，该方法在像素级和结构级保真度（PSNR/SSIM）上取得最优，改善了多视图一致性，同时在感知质量（LPIPS）上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 边界锚定的相机感知先验能有效引导网络进行几何上可靠的修复，使不同视角间保持连贯性，验证了3D几何信息对视频生成修复的重要性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable success in novel view synthesis; however, reconstructions under sparse views often exhibit noticeable artifacts. While recent video diffusion models provide strong spatio-temporal priors for 3DGS restoration, directly fine-tuning them for restoration is suboptimal, as they lack awareness of the underlying multi-camera geometry, resulting in multi-view inconsistencies. In this work, we propose a novel 3D-aware video restoration framework designed to enhance the quality of sparse 3DGS reconstruction. Specifically, we construct a large-scale 3DGS video dataset to enable specialized fine-tuning. To bridge the gap between 2D video generation and 3D multi-view constraints, we introduce a camera-conditioned geometric prior. By using the first and last frames as boundary anchors and encoding the corresponding camera relationships, we explicitly inject spatial structure into the video generation pipeline. This boundary-anchored, camera-aware prior guides the network toward geometrically grounded restoration that remains coherent across viewpoints. Extensive experiments show that, among video-prior restoration methods, our approach attains the best pixel- and structure-level fidelity (PSNR/SSIM) and improves multi-view consistency, while remaining competitive in perceptual quality (LPIPS).

</details>


### [213] [Frame-Level Evaluation in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection Mostly Measures Video-Level Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21854)
*Inpyo Song,Jangwon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出弱监督视频异常检测模型常以视频级标签训练但以帧级池化指标（Micro-AUROC或AP）评估，这种评估方式存在根本缺陷：模型只需区分视频而非在视频内部对时间帧排序即可获得高分。作者通过将Micro-AUROC分解为帧内AUC和视频间AUC，并结合理论推导（O(1/V)的"时间稀释"）和大量实验证明，即使输出视频级恒定分数（帧间无任何区分）也能达到很高的池化得分，揭示现有评估指标无法有效衡量模型的时间定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱监督视频异常检测模型声称具备时间定位能力，但其评估指标（Micro-AUROC/AP）在池化帧上计算，可能仅反映了视频间区分能力而非帧内时间排序能力。作者希望揭示这种指标与任务目标之间的错配，说明现有评估框架可能高估模型性能。

Method: 1) 将Micro-AUROC按视频身份精确分解为Within-AUROC（视频内时间排序）和Cross-AUROC（视频间比较）；2) 理论推导当异常和正常帧分布在不同视频时，帧内比较占比随视频数V增大按O(1/V)衰减（称为temporal dilution）；3) 在ShanghaiTech、XD-Violence、UCF-Crime三个数据集上训练视频级二进制分类器，将每个视频的单一分数重复到所有帧上（video-constant输出）作为基线上界验证；4) 进行72次受控实验，将所有帧分数替换为视频均值，验证指标保留程度。

Result: 1) 三个数据集中仅有0.071%-0.388%的正常/异常帧对发生在同一视频内，即绝大多数比较为视频间比较；2) video-constant输出达到81.40-97.18的Micro-AUROC，尽管帧内无任何变化；3) 72次受控实验中，帧分数替换为视频均值后保留中位数98.6%的Micro-AUROC超过随机的余量；4) 该模式对作者发布的输出和XD-Violence官方AP评估同样成立。

Conclusion: 现有Micro-AUROC/AP池化评估指标无法验证模型的真实时间定位能力——模型完全可以在每个视频内输出恒定分数却在指标上表现优秀。评测社区需要重新设计能够直接衡量视频内时间排序质量的评估方法，避免"时间稀释"效应对基准公平性的影响。

Abstract: Weakly supervised video anomaly detectors are trained with video-level labels but are commonly evaluated as temporal localizers using Micro-AUROC or AP over pooled test frames. Because these metrics compare frames from different videos, a detector can score well by separating videos without accurately ordering moments within them. We exactly decompose Micro-AUROC by video identity into Within-AUROC for temporal ordering within videos and Cross-AUROC for comparisons across videos. Across ShanghaiTech, XD-Violence, and UCF-Crime, only 0.071-0.388% of comparisons between anomalous and normal frames occur within the same video. When both classes remain distributed across V videos, this share decreases as O(1/V), a benchmark property we call temporal dilution. We train anomaly video binary classifiers under the same video-level supervision and repeat each video score across all frames. These video-constant outputs reach 81.40-97.18 Micro-AUROC despite having no within-video variation. Across 72 controlled runs, replacing every frame score with its video mean preserves a median 98.6% of the Micro-AUROC margin above chance. The same empirical pattern holds for author-released outputs and for XD-Violence under its official AP evaluation. A detector can therefore achieve a high pooled score even when it assigns the same score to every moment within each video.

</details>


### [214] [GuardPaint:SpeculativeSafetyDecodingforText-to-ImageGeneration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21869)
*Shreyash Dhoot,Paras Dhiman,Arsh Abbas Naqvi,Aranbi Dutta,Aman Chadha,Vinija Jain,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GuardPaint是一种基于投机解码框架的文本到图像扩散模型安全防护方法，在不修改基础模型的前提下深入扩散轨迹内部进行干预，通过轻量级审核器监控中间图像、定位不安全区域并仅对需要修复的区域进行外科手术式修复，且通过受保护的锦标赛机制选择符合策略且保持提示保真度的修复结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的T2I扩散模型安全防护手段主要依靠生成前的提示词过滤或生成后的图像分类，但扩散过程本身缺乏防护。此外，现有方法往往仅提供拒绝生成而非安全的视觉修复，无法在保持生成能力的同时确保内容合规。

Method: GuardPaint采用投机解码框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 轻量级审计器在扩散过程中实时监控中间图像并定位不安全区域；(2) 策略对齐的修复模型对不安全区域进行仅需的外科手术式inpainting修复；(3) 受保护的锦标赛选择机制，仅接受能提升策略合规性同时保持提示保真度和感知质量的编辑。

Result: 在五种越狱攻击家族（SneakPrompt、MMA、PGJ、DACA和RABell）以及多种模型架构（UNet和flow-matching，包括SD 1.5、SDXL、SD 3.5和FLUX.1-dev）上，GuardPaint显著降低了攻击成功率和有害生成，同时仅对图像质量、提示保真度和良性行为产生最小退化。

Conclusion: GuardPaint证明了在扩散轨迹内部进行安全干预的有效性，为T2I生成安全提供了新的思路——从拒绝生成转向安全的视觉修复，在不修改基础模型的前提下实现策略合规。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models offer powerful visual generation, but their controllability creates a critical safety challenge: adversarial prompts can steer the denoising trajectory toward policy-violating content such as explicit nudity or graphic violence. Existing safeguards mostly act before generation through prompt filtering or after generation through image classification, leaving the diffusion process itself unguarded and often yielding only refusal rather than safe visual repair.
  We introduce GuardPaint, a speculative decoding framework for safe T2I generation that intervenes inside the diffusion trajectory without modifying the base model. A lightweight auditor monitors intermediate images, localizes unsafe regions, and triggers surgical inpainting repair only where needed. Candidate repairs are generated by a policy-aligned inpainter and selected through a guarded tournament that accepts edits only when they improve policy compliance while preserving prompt fidelity and perceptual quality.
  Across five jailbreak families SneakPrompt, MMA, PGJ, DACA, and RABell and UNet/flow-matching models including SD~1.5, SDXL, SD~3.5, and FLUX.1-dev. GuardPaint reduces attack success and harmful generations with minimal degradation to image quality, prompt fidelity, and benign behavior.
  Content warning: This paper contains examples involving nudity and violence that some readers may find disturbing, distressing, or offensive.

</details>


### [215] [ViSMoE: Visual-Aware Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Embodied Referring Expression Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21878)
*Shuo Feng,Piji Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViSMoE提出了一种基于稀疏混合专家网络与视觉感知路由策略的框架，用于具身指称表达定位任务，通过区分性地处理视图和物体两类视觉信息，在REVERIE和SOON数据集上超越了现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理具身指称表达定位时，使用统一的视觉编码器处理视图和物体两类截然不同的视觉信息，导致二者的表征混淆、缺乏判别性，进而影响导航和物体定位的准确性。

Method: 提出ViSMoE框架，将稀疏混合专家网络（sparse Mixture-of-Experts）与视觉感知路由策略结合，使代理能够针对不同类型的视觉输入（视图级与物体级）分别进行处理，从而获得更具判别性的视觉表征。

Result: 在REVERIE和SOON两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，ViSMoE的性能优于现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过区分视图与物体视觉信息的处理方式，ViSMoE有效解决了视觉表征模糊的问题，验证了视觉感知路由策略在具身指称表达定位任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Embodied Referring Expression Grounding is the task of enabling an agent to navigate in real environments and to localize a remote object based on natural language instructions. In this scenario, the agent needs to select one view for navigation at each step and identify a specific object among all candidate objects at the destination. However, most of the previous approaches fail to distinguish between views and objects, instead processing them using the vanilla vision encoder, which results in ambiguous representations of both views and objects. To address the above issues, we propose ViSMoE, which equips sparse Mixture-of-Experts with a visual-aware routing policy for the embodied agent. This framework processes different types of visual information specifically, resulting in discriminative visual representations for both views and objects. Experimental results on REVERIE and SOON datasets demonstrate that ViSMoE outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods, showing the superiority of our proposed method.

</details>


### [216] [Region-Weighted Losses and Model Fusion for Cross-Modal PET Attenuation Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21881)
*Khoa Tuan Nguyen,Joris Vankerschaver,Wesley De Neve*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了BIC-MAC挑战赛中的方法：利用NAC-PET、DIXON MRI和topogram合成伪CT（HU单位），并对伪CT及其重建的AC-PET进行评分。作者通过三个关键思想超越组织者的3D U-Net基线：在Carney衰减系数（μ）空间中计算按解剖区域加权的L1损失（比架构更重要）；在正确的损失基础上才将未配准的DIXON MRI作为额外输入通道；将两个独立训练模型的固定凸组合在四个指标中的三个上优于其成员模型，并在公开验证排行榜上排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决BIC-MAC挑战中的跨模态伪CT合成问题，即在PET/CT无法获取时，从NAC-PET、DIXON MRI和topogram中合成高质量的伪CT（HU单位），以提升衰减校正性能。作者发现损失函数设计比网络架构更能影响合成质量，并探索了多输入融合与模型集成策略。

Method: 采用3D U-Net作为基础架构，核心改进包括：(1) 在Carney衰减系数（μ）空间中计算按解剖区域加权的L1损失，该空间与CT评估指标所使用的空间一致；(2) 仅在正确损失建立后才引入未配准的DIXON MRI作为额外输入通道；(3) 对两个独立训练的模型进行固定凸组合集成，以提升整体性能。

Result: 所提出的方法在四个指标中的三个上，通过模型集成超越了单个模型，并在公开验证排行榜上总体排名第一。

Conclusion: 损失函数设计比网络架构对伪CT合成质量的影响更大；在正确的损失空间下训练，多模态输入才能真正发挥作用；模型集成（固定凸组合）是进一步提升性能的有效策略。

Abstract: We describe our approach to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) challenge, which asks for a pseudo-CT in Hounsfield Units to be synthesized from Non-Attenuation-Corrected PET (NAC-PET), DIXON MRI and a topogram, and scores both the pseudo-CT and the Attenuation-Corrected PET (AC-PET) reconstructed from it. Three ideas carried our improvements over the organizers' 3D U-Net baseline. The loss matters more than the architecture: we compute the $L_1$ error in the Carney attenuation-coefficient ($μ$) space that the CT metric itself uses, weighted by anatomical region. Only once that loss was in place did the unregistered DIXON MRI work as extra input channels. A fixed convex combination of two independently trained models then beat both of its members on three of the four metrics and ranks first overall on the public validation leaderboard.

</details>


### [217] [VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21883)
*Wen Luo,Xiaohan Yi,Xiaotao Huang,Liqun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VIG（视觉信息增益），一种基于信息论的GRPO奖励，用于衡量多模态推理中每个推理token是否真正锚定于图像信息，通过两次前向传播（有无图像）计算token的预测不确定性减少量，在多个基准和不同模型规模上一致提升准确率-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大推理模型中长CoT轨迹包含大量与视觉无关的填充token（如重复视觉描述、自我反思），这些token增加推理成本却不贡献答案。现有CoT压缩方法只优化输出长度，从未度量推理token是否真正基于图像信息。

Method: 提出VIG奖励函数：对策略进行两次前向传播（一次带图像、一次不带图像），计算每个推理token在有无图像条件下预测不确定性的减少量，作为该token的视觉信息增益得分，并作为GRPO奖励进行在线优化。无需参考链、外部标注或辅助奖励模型。

Result: 在六个主要多模态推理基准和三个Qwen3-VL-Thinking模型规模（2B/4B/8B）以及额外的R1-Onevision-Bench 8B评估上，VIG一致改善了准确率-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 高效的多模态推理源于提升视觉信息密度——每个推理token通过锚定于图像而"挣得"其存在的价值，而非通过施加长度预算。

Abstract: Multimodal large reasoning models often rely on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces in which a substantial fraction of tokens, such as repeated visual descriptions, self-reflection, and other visually-disengaged filler, inflate inference cost without contributing to the answer. Existing CoT compression methods optimize output length but never measure whether a reasoning token is actually grounded in the image. We propose \textbf{VIG} (Visual Information Gain), an information-theoretic GRPO reward that scores each reasoning token by how much the image reduces its predictive uncertainty. VIG is computed online from two forward passes of the same policy, one with and one without the image, so no reference chains, external annotations, or auxiliary reward models are needed. Across six main multimodal reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL-Thinking model sizes (2B/4B/8B), plus an additional R1-Onevision-Bench evaluation on 8B, VIG consistently improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off, supporting our central claim: \emph{efficient multimodal reasoning emerges from raising visual information density, where every reasoning token earns its place by anchoring to the image, rather than from imposing a length budget.} Our source code is available at https://github.com/chaser682/vig.

</details>


### [218] [Pixel-Space Diffusion via Observation Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21885)
*Shaojie Guo,Lichen Ma,Haoyang Tong,Yu He,Zipeng Guo,Xiaoan Liu,Feng Yan,Yu Guo,Fei Wang,Junshi Huang,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Observation Operator Diffusion框架，通过时间索引的观测轨迹替代固定全图监督目标，并引入GL-CoDA解码器实现从粗到细的特征细化，解决像素空间扩散模型中尺度与时间不匹配的问题，在ImageNet-256上取得FID 1.52的SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间扩散模型直接建模图像分布但难以优化。现有方法通过目标重参数化缓解优化困难，但整个去噪过程中仍依赖固定的干净图像目标。作者通过实证分析发现尺度-时间不匹配问题：图像结构随噪声降低呈现从粗到细的可预测顺序，而现有模型在高噪声下仍被迫预测完整图像，导致低信噪比梯度阻碍优化。

Method: 提出Observation Operator Diffusion统一框架，将标准流路径上的固定全图监督替换为随去噪过程演化的时间索引观测轨迹（从粗结构到全图）。该轨迹由不同观测尺度的Gaussian-Lanczos算子实例化，形成路径一致的训练目标。同时引入GL-CoDA解码器，在解码各阶段注入尺度特定的Gaussian-Lanczos观测，实现从粗到细的特征细化。

Result: 实验表明该方法收敛速度显著加快，同时持续提升生成质量，在ImageNet-256上取得FID 1.52的成绩。

Conclusion: 通过将监督轨迹与特征细化都对齐图像结构的固有恢复顺序（粗到细），有效缓解了尺度-时间不匹配问题，在加速收敛的同时提升生成质量。

Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models directly model image distributions but remain difficult to optimize. Recent methods alleviate this challenge through target reparameterization, while still relying on a fixed clean-image target throughout denoising. Through empirical analysis, we identify a scale-time mismatch: image structures become predictable from coarse to fine as noise decreases, whereas existing models are forced to predict the full image even under high noise, resulting in low-SNR gradients that hinder optimization. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Observation Operator Diffusion, a unified framework that aligns both the supervision trajectory and feature refinement with the intrinsic recovery order of image structures. Specifically, we replace fixed full-image supervision along the standard flow path with a time-indexed observation trajectory that evolves from coarse structures to the full image during denoising. This trajectory is instantiated with a family of Gaussian-Lanczos operators at varying observation scales, yielding a path-consistent training objective. We further introduce GL-CoDA, a decoder that injects scale-specific Gaussian-Lanczos observations across decoding stages for coarse-to-fine feature refinement. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach converges substantially faster while consistently improving generation quality, achieving an FID of 1.52 on ImageNet-256.

</details>


### [219] [A Scalable Vector Graphics Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21893)
*Leonardo Zini,Elia Frigieri,Lorenzo Baraldi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SLS（SVG Latent Space），一种基于Transformer的自编码器，为SVG路径学习紧凑、稠密、可逆的潜空间表示，使向量图形获得类似VAE对光栅图像的基础性潜表征能力，并可将计算开销降低150倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向量图形（SVG）是分辨率无关视觉内容的基本媒介，但深度学习社区缺乏连续、稠密且可逆的潜空间用于向量表示——这种基础组件在光栅图像领域已被VAE及其后继模型长期提供。这一缺失阻碍了向量图形上的表征学习、相似性搜索和下游生成任务。

Method: SLS是一个Transformer自编码器，以单个SVG路径（构成任意SVG图像的原子视觉元素）为处理单元。通过统一的基于BPE的token词汇表建模SVG命令、坐标数据和视觉属性，学习固定大小的潜表示以联合捕获结构和外观，并能解码回有效且风格一致的SVG路径。嵌入位于单位超球面上，支持高效相似性搜索、组合和向量空间操作的下游条件化。

Result: SLS在多样化任务上展现泛化能力，相比基于token的方法将FLOPs降低超过150倍，同时保持高保真度，能够重建有效且风格一致的SVG路径。

Conclusion: SLS建立了向量图形研究的通用潜空间基础，其嵌入空间鲁棒、可逆且具有良好结构，为向量图形的表征学习、相似性搜索和条件生成等下游任务提供了统一基础。

Abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics are a fundamental medium for resolution-independent visual content, yet the deep learning community lacks a continuous, dense, and invertible latent space for vector representations, the kind of foundational building block that Variational Autoencoders and their descendants have long provided for raster images. We introduce SLS (SVG Latent Space), a Transformer-based autoencoder that learns compact dense representations of individual SVG paths, the atomic visual elements from which any SVG image can be composed. By modeling SVG commands, coordinate data, and visual properties within a unified BPE-based token vocabulary, SLS learns fixed-size latent representations that jointly capture structure and appearance, and can be decoded back into valid, style-consistent SVG paths with high fidelity. The resulting embedding space is robust, invertible, and structured: embeddings lie on a unit hypersphere, enabling efficient similarity search, composition, and downstream conditioning through simple vector-space operations. Finally, we demonstrate that SLS generalizes across diverse tasks reducing their FLOPs by over 150 times compared to token-based approaches, and establishing a general-purpose latent foundation for vector graphics research.

</details>


### [220] [Entity-Constrained CBCT Retrieval for Low-Resource Dental Record Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21913)
*Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen,Thai Nguyen,Kiet Huynh Cao Tuan,Huy-Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ECCR框架，一种无参数的实体约束检索方法，用于在仅50个标注CBCT样本的低资源场景下完成七字段牙科记录；通过分离"证据可得性"与"证据权威性"，仅允许检索到的图像证据在"不扩充先验实体集"的前提下被采纳，在MMDental Task 3公开验证集上取得0.3134加权分数并在最终测试中获得第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 牙科CBCT记录补全面临标注稀缺（仅50例）且不同临床字段由不同类型证据支持的问题。MMDental Task 3要求完成七字段记录，检索到的视觉上合理的记录若引入不支持的新实体反而有害。因此需要在极端低资源条件下控制多模态证据对记录的修改范围，避免过度信任检索结果。

Method: ECCR是参数无关框架，核心思想是分离"证据可得性"与"证据权威性"：(1) 由语料库推导的先验提供完整记录；(2) 冻结的3D编码器检索以图像为条件的诊断证据；(3) 仅当检索到的诊断证据不扩大先验中已有的FDI位置或ICD代码实体集时才追加该证据，从而在构造上保证断言实体集不变。该框架还有一个"守护"机制，会阻止63.3%的检索候选（这些候选原本会向先验中注入不存在的实体）。

Result: 公开验证集上加权分数0.3134，优于完整记录多模态检索（0.2237）和静态纯文本先验（0.2915）。守护机制阻断了63.3%的检索候选。最终测试中获得11.37分（满分97.4），排名第二。

Conclusion: 在极端低资源场景下，控制多模态证据"允许修改什么"比直接迁移整条检索记录更可靠。ECCR表明"证据权威性"应受限于"证据可得性"，通过实体集不变式约束来防止检索结果引入缺乏支持的实体。

Abstract: Completing dental records from cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is difficult when annotation is scarce and individual clinical fields are supported by different types of evidence. MMDental Task 3 requires seven-field record completion from only 50 labeled CBCT cases and scores the correctness of structured FDI positions and ICD codes; consequently, a visually plausible retrieved record can still be harmful when it introduces an unsupported entity. We propose Entity-Constrained CBCT-Guided Retrieval (ECCR), a parameter-free framework that separates evidence availability from evidence authority. A corpus-derived prior first supplies the complete record. A frozen 3D encoder retrieves image-conditioned Diagnosis evidence, which is appended only if it does not expand the prior FDI or ICD entity set, so the asserted entity set is invariant by construction. On public validation, ECCR reaches a weighted score of 0.3134, improving on both full-record multimodal retrieval (0.2237) and a static text-only prior (0.2915); the guard blocks 63.3% of retrieved candidates, each of which would otherwise have injected an FDI position or ICD code absent from the prior. On the final test evaluation, ECCR obtains 11.37 of a 97.4-point attainable maximum, securing second place overall. The result indicates that, in an extreme low-resource setting, controlling what multimodal evidence is allowed to modify can be more reliable than transferring an entire retrieved record.

</details>


### [221] [AirAlign: Geometry-Aware Relative Pose Alignment for UAV Last-Meter Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21926)
*Jinyi Zhou,Shuo Feng,Yufei Wu,Piji Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AirAlign是一个用于无人机RGB图像对相对位姿对齐的框架，采用预训练视觉几何重建模型作为骨干网络提取几何感知特征，并通过场景分离交叉验证和集成推理来提升性能。在ACMMM 2026 PairUAV挑战赛中验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在低空环境的"最后一米"导航阶段需要精确的位姿对齐以获取目标信息或进行操控，但严重的视角和外观变化使这项任务极具挑战性，现有方法难以在最终接近阶段提供足够的位姿对齐精度。

Method: AirAlign使用预训练的视觉几何重建模型作为骨干网络，从源-目标图像对中提取几何感知特征；训练时将数据集按场景划分为多个不相交的折叠用于盲交叉验证和模型选择；推理时对多个选定模型的预测取平均形成集成输出。

Result: 在ACMMM 2026无人机多媒体研讨会的PairUAV挑战赛上验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性，消融研究证实了每个组件的贡献。

Conclusion: AirAlign通过利用几何感知的预训练特征和基于场景分离交叉验证的集成策略，有效解决了无人机低空环境下"最后一米"导航中的RGB图像对相对位姿对齐难题。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation in modern low-altitude environments requires more accurate pose alignment in the final approach stage for target information acquisition or manipulation, making "last-meter" navigation increasingly important. However, severe viewpoint and appearance variations make this task challenging. To tackle this problem, we propose AirAlign, a framework for RGB-only image-pair relative pose alignment for UAVs. AirAlign uses a pretrained visual geometry reconstruction model as the backbone to extract geometry-aware features from source-target image pairs. In addition, to better utilize the limited training data, we split the training set into multiple scene-disjoint folds for unseen cross-validation and model selection. During inference, the predictions of the selected models are averaged to form the ensemble output of the overall framework. Experiments on the PairUAV challenge at the ACMMM 2026 Workshop on UAVs in Multimedia demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our method, while comprehensive ablation studies validate the contribution of each component.

</details>


### [222] [C$^2$Path: Class-Conditional Pathway Decoupling for Vision-Language Incremental Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21937)
*Lecheng Xu,Feifei Shao,Ouyangzi Ye,Zhen Wang,Lin Li,Kexin Li,Zhao Wang,Changqin Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出C²Path，一种面向视觉-语言增量式目标检测的类条件通路解耦框架，通过类别专家库和类条件解耦模块构建类别专用计算通路，实现参数隔离更新和类别分离注入，有效解决增量检测中的类别知识耦合问题，在COCO 2017多个增量设置下超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有增量式目标检测方法存在两类类别知识耦合问题：一是共享参数更新导致的类别边界侵蚀，二是混合特征编码引起的类别表征纠缠。作者认为有效增量学习需要类别专用的计算通路，以实现隔离的参数更新和分离的类别注入。

Method: 提出C²Path框架，包含两部分：1) 类别专家库（category expert library），由可学习的低秩计算节点组成，捕获类别特定知识；2) 类条件解耦模块（class-conditional decoupling module），利用token级类别线索生成类别感知路由信号，动态组合这些专家形成ClassLoRA适配器，从而为不同类别构建专用计算通路，实现隔离更新和分离注入。

Result: 在COCO 2017数据集上，在多种增量学习设置下，C²Path均一致超越现有最先进方法，验证了其有效性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: C²Path通过类条件通路解耦策略有效解决了增量检测中的类别知识耦合问题，为视觉-语言检测器的持续类别扩展提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Incremental Object Detection (IOD) aims to enable detectors to continuously learn novel categories while preserving previously acquired knowledge. However, existing methods suffer from two forms of \textbf{class knowledge coupling}: class boundary erosion induced by shared parameter updates and class representation entanglement arising from mixed feature encoding. We argue that effective incremental learning requires class-specific computational pathways that enable isolated parameter updates and separated class-wise injection. To this end, we propose \textbf{C$^2$Path}, a class-conditional pathway decoupling framework for vision-language incremental object detection that leverages token-level class cues to establish dedicated and updatable computational pathways for different categories. Specifically, C$^2$Path introduces a category expert library and a class-conditional decoupling module. The expert library consists of learnable low-rank computational nodes that capture category-specific knowledge, while the decoupling module generates class-aware routing signals to dynamically compose \textit{ClassLoRA} adapters from these experts, thereby forming class-specific computational pathways for isolated updates and separated injection across categories. Extensive experiments on COCO 2017 under multiple incremental learning settings demonstrate that C$^2$Path consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing an effective and scalable solution for continual category expansion in vision-language detectors.

</details>


### [223] [Sparse Multi-Stage Expert-Agent Routing for Complex Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21948)
*Sike Xiang,Shuang Chen,Qian sun,Jia Cheng,Yusi Wei,Amir Atapour-Abarghouei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏多阶段专家-智能体路由（Sparse Multi-Stage Expert-Agent Routing）框架，将临床诊断建模为阶段性路由过程，自适应地激活稀疏的医学专家智能体，并引入事实感知的语义评估协议ClinFEScore，在保持高诊断质量的同时大幅降低专家调用数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的临床推理系统要么进行单次预测，要么依赖固定的多智能体工作流，导致专家参与方式静态或过度穷举，无法有效模拟真实临床中随着新证据出现而逐步更新诊断假设、并在有限会诊资源下协调多专科的动态过程。

Method: 提出Sparse Multi-Stage Expert-Agent Routing框架：(1) 将诊断建模为阶段式路由过程，利用多模态临床证据逐步更新病例状态；(2) 自适应激活稀疏的医学专家智能体集合，而非全部专家；(3) 为各专家维护跨阶段的特定记忆；(4) 引入ClinFEScore，一种面向临床推理输出的事实感知语义评估协议，用于评估自由文本诊断结论。

Result: 在重建的MAC和AgentClinic-NEJM多阶段病例上，平均激活专家数从17.0降至3.0，同时保持强事实级诊断质量；在200个真实医院MDT病例上，ClinFEScore与临床医生判断高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.81，Pearson r=0.87），方法达到91.5%的临床医生验证诊断准确率，每次病例仅需约5次专家智能体/LLM调用。

Conclusion: 稀疏的阶段式协调是高效且临床相关的LLM临床推理方法，能够在显著降低计算/会诊资源开销的同时保持高水平诊断质量。
