Abstract: Complex clinical reasoning requires models to update diagnostic hypotheses as new evidence emerges and to coordinate different medical specialities under limited consultation resources. Existing LLM-based clinical reasoning systems typically perform single-pass prediction or rely on fixed multi-agent workflows, making expert participation either static or unnecessarily exhaustive. We propose Sparse Multi-Stage Expert-Agent Routing, a language-based clinical reasoning framework that models diagnosis as a stage-wise routing process. Given progressively available clinical evidence derived from multiple modalities, the framework maintains an evolving case state and adaptively activates a sparse set of medical expert agents, supported by expert-specific memory across stages. To evaluate free-text diagnostic conclusions beyond surface similarity, we further introduce ClinFEScore, a fact-aware semantic evaluation protocol for clinical reasoning outputs. On reconstructed multi-stage cases from MAC and AgentClinic-NEJM, our framework reduces the average number of activated experts from 17.0 to 3.0 whilst maintaining strong fact-level diagnostic quality. On 200 real-world hospital MDT cases, ClinFEScore correlates strongly with clinician judgements (Spearman's $ρ=0.81$; Pearson's $r=0.87$), whilst our method achieves 91.5\% clinician-verified diagnostic accuracy with approximately five expert-agent/LLM calls per case. These results support sparse stage-wise coordination as an efficient and clinically relevant approach to LLM-based clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [224] [Trustworthy Visual Quality Inspection under Data Scarcity in Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21967)
*Panagiotis Sapoutzoglou,Jessy Ribaira,Martin Kanounnikoff,Bas Tijsma,Christian Geiß,Maria Pateraki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向制造业自动视觉检测的阶段性流水线方法：利用扩散模型生成合成缺陷样本以缓解真实缺陷数据稀缺问题，并通过贝叶斯分类器提供置信度估计，将模糊样本交由人工复核而非硬分类，从而在数据稀缺条件下降低构建可信、可部署检测模型的成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产线中的缺陷样本极为稀缺（工艺优化倾向于生产良品），导致仅依赖真实数据的监督检测模型受限；同时，硬标签缺陷决策缺乏置信度估计，会产生不对称的经济代价：误拒浪费良品，漏检则增加缺陷流入生产流程的风险。因此需要在数据稀缺与决策不确定的双重约束下，提升自动视觉检测的可信度。

Method: 通过扩散模型生成合成缺陷样本以缓解数据稀缺；采用贝叶斯分类器输出置信度并对模糊单元延迟到人工审查而非强制分类；两者嵌入一个由串联互补检查组成的阶段式流水线中。评估涵盖合成增强对真实缺陷分类与定位的影响，并在决策、合成数据、流水线结构三个层面考察系统可信度。

Result: 初步结果表明，扩散模型生成的缺陷与不确定性感知分类相结合，能够在数据稀缺情境下降低达到可信且可部署检查模型的成本。论文为工作进行中状态，暂未给出最终完整结果。

Conclusion: 在数据稀缺和不对称错误成本的制造业检测场景下，合成缺陷数据增强与置信度感知分类的组合策略是有前景的方向，有助于构建值得信赖且可实际部署的自动视觉检测系统。

Abstract: Automated visual inspection in manufacturing aims to replace slow and inconsistent manual checks, but its economic value depends on whether its decisions can be trusted enough to automate routine inspection while reserving human expertise for ambiguous cases. In production-line settings, defective samples are scarce, since the process is optimized to produce good parts, which limits any learning-based inspector trained on real data alone. Compounding this, defect decisions emitted as hard labels with no confidence estimate carry an asymmetric cost: a false reject wastes a good product, while a false accept may increase the risk of undetected defects progressing through the production process. We address both problems by mitigating data scarcity through the generation of synthetic defective samples with a diffusion model, and meeting the need for confidence-aware decisions with a Bayesian classifier that defers ambiguous units to human review rather than misclassifying them. These components are embedded in a staged pipeline of successive, complementary checks. We evaluate how synthetic augmentation affects classification and localization on a test set of real defects, and examine the system's trustworthiness at three points: the decision, the synthetic data, and the pipeline structure. This work-in-progress reports preliminary results suggesting that diffusion-generated defects, combined with uncertainty-aware classification, can lower the cost of reaching a trustworthy, deployable inspection model under data scarcity.

</details>


### [225] [Retrieval-Augmented Visual Prompting: Guiding Foundation Models in Two-Photon Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21970)
*Salvatore Calcagno,Marco Finocchiaro,Giovanni Bellitto,Daniela Giordano,Concetto Spampinato,Federica Proietto Salanitri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出检索增强视觉提示（RAVP）框架，通过向SAM 3输入中注入检索到的外部视觉记忆（标注示例的边界框作为概念提示），实现双光子钙成像中神经元的零样本检测与实例分割，无需微调模型参数。实验表明单个精心挑选的示例比多个示例更有效，证明了推理时视觉记忆注入是专用生物医学成像中参数适配的简单有效替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双光子钙成像对基础模型构成挑战：图像外观在记录和实验条件间差异显著、标注稀缺、通常需要快速适应。现有的权重微调适配方式成本高且不灵活，作者探索是否可以在推理时通过向模型输入注入外部视觉记忆来引导基础模型，避免参数适配。

Method: 提出RAVP框架：将每个目标tile与检索到的标注示例配对，示例的边界框作为SAM 3的概念提示注入输入。研究了多种示例选择策略，包括荧光引导启发式方法和轻量级召回预测器（用于估计哪个示例对目标tile最具信息量）。

Result: 在Allen Brain Observatory数据集上的实验表明，示例增强推理持续提升了零样本神经元检测和实例分割性能。消融研究显示，单个精心选择的示例比多个检索示例的提示更有效。

Conclusion: 推理时视觉记忆注入被定位为基础模型在专用生物医学成像领域中一种简单有效的参数适配替代方案，通过输入设计即可实现模型适应。

Abstract: Two-photon calcium imaging presents a challenging setting for foundation models: image appearance varies substantially across recordings and experimental conditions, annotations are scarce, and rapid adaptation is often needed. Rather than adapting model weights through fine-tuning, we ask whether a foundation model can be guided at inference time by injecting external visual memory directly into its input. We implement this idea with SAM 3 and introduce Retrieval-Augmented Visual Prompting (RAVP), a framework in which each target tile is augmented with a retrieved annotated exemplar whose bounding box is used as a concept prompt.
  RAVP turns retrieval into a form of visual prompting and enables adaptation through input design alone. We study multiple exemplar selection strategies, including fluorescence-guided heuristics and a lightweight recall predictor trained to estimate which exemplar is most informative for a target tile. Experiments on the Allen Brain Observatory show that exemplar-augmented inference consistently strengthens zero-shot neuron detection and instance segmentation. Ablation studies further show that a single carefully selected exemplar is more effective than prompting with multiple retrieved examples. These results position inference-time visual memory injection as a simple and effective alternative to parameter adaptation for foundation models in specialized biomedical imaging.

</details>


### [226] [Close Shortcut Wins Long: Seeking Diverse and Stable Generators for Data-Free Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22003)
*Kailin Lyu,Zherui Zhang,Junhao Dong,Kexue Fu,Weiguang Pang,Rongtao Xu,Qizheng Wang,Di Wu,Chee-Keong Kwoh,Longxiang Gao,Shibiao Xu,Changwei Wang,Ce Hao,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CSWL框架，从频域视角解决数据无关知识蒸馏（DFKD）中生成器存在的"生成性捷径学习"问题（过度依赖特定频率分量和位置），通过频域增强和跨阶段频率重建辅助任务，提升生成器的多样性与训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于生成器的DFKD方法在频域中表现出"生成性捷径学习"现象：过度依赖特定频率分量和频率位置，导致合成图像质量不一致、类别多样性不足，且训练不稳定。

Method: 提出CSWL框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 特征级别的频域增强，迫使生成器关注完整频率谱以抑制捷径学习行为；(2) 跨阶段频率重建（CSFR）辅助任务，通过隐式构造指数移动平均（EMA）机制促进长期优化与训练稳定性。

Result: 在多个图像识别数据集及多分辨率设置下的广泛实验（包括下游任务）验证了CSWL在从频域视角提升生成器多样性和训练稳定性方面的有效性。

Conclusion: CSWL框架通过引入频域层面的洞察，有效解决了DFKD中生成器的捷径学习问题，在提升生成多样性和训练稳定性方面取得了显著成效。

Abstract: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) preserves privacy by transferring knowledge without real data access. However, existing generator-based DFKD methods suffer from over-reliance on teacher preferences and pattern collapse, exhibiting "generative shortcut learning" in the frequency domain: dependent on specific frequency components and frequency positions, resulting in inconsistent synthetic image quality and class diversity. In this paper, we propose a CSWL framework aimed at introducing insights from the frequency domain perspective to improve generator diversity and training stability to Close the phenomenon of Shortcut learning to Win in the Longer term. To address the issue of generative shortcut learning, we introduce frequency-domain augmentation at the feature level, encouraging the generator to attend to the full frequency spectrum and thereby suppress shortcut learning behavior. To tackle training instability, we propose a Cross-Stage Frequency Reconstruction (CSFR) auxiliary task, which implicitly constructs an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) mechanism to promote long-term optimization and stability. Extensive experiments, including downstream tasks and various image recognition datasets at multiple resolutions, validate the effectiveness of CSWL in improving both diversity and stability from the frequency view.

</details>


### [227] [ORBIT++: Benchmarking SfM in the Wild with 360° Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22039)
*Sara Sabour,Linyi Jin,Richard Tucker,Amir Hertz,Marcus Brubaker,Saurabh Saxena,Junhwa Hur,Andrea Tagliasacchi,Deqing Sun,David J. Fleet,Richard Szeliski,Noah Snavely*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了ORBIT基准，通过利用在线全景360°视频构造具有挑战性的相机位姿估计测试集，并从中裁剪重投影生成透视视角片段，用于评估SfM方法在复杂相机运动和动态场景下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SfM方法在面对复杂视频（如挑战性相机运动或动态场景）时常常失效，且该领域缺乏针对此类困难场景的可靠地面真值基准，难以衡量实际进展并定位改进方向。

Method: 利用在线全景360°视频作为数据来源构建具有挑战性的视频片段，同时保证地面真值轨迹的可恢复性。全景视频提供更丰富的视觉上下文以跟踪相机运动（即使部分视野受模糊、运动或动态物体影响），随后裁剪并重投影选定区域生成透视视角片段，构成ORBIT基准。

Result: 实验表明COLMAP以及基于优化的和基于前馈的SfM方法在ORBIT基准上均难以准确估计相机位姿，证明该基准具有足够的挑战性。

Conclusion: ORBIT为研究者提供了一个有价值的测试平台，能够有意义地衡量在真正具有挑战性的真实世界SfM问题上的进展。

Abstract: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is a cornerstone of 3D perception, yet current methods often fail when applied to complex videos involving challenging camera motions or dynamic scenes. Compounding the problem, the field lacks reliable ground-truth benchmarks for such difficult scenarios, making it hard to gauge real-world progress or to pinpoint where improvements are most needed. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark for evaluating camera pose estimation. Our key insight is to leverage online panoramic 360° video as a source of data from which to construct challenging clips, while still enabling robust ground-truth trajectory recovery. The panoramic nature of these videos provides richer visual context for tracking camera motion, even when parts of the view are affected by blur, motion, or dynamic objects. After tracking camera motion across full 360° videos, we crop and reproject selected portions to generate perspective-view clips that serve as our benchmark, called ORBIT. Experiments show that COLMAP, as well as recent optimization-based and feed-forward SfM methods struggle to accurately estimate camera poses on our benchmark. Hence, ORBIT provides a valuable testbed where researchers can meaningfully measure progress on truly challenging, real-world SfM problems.

</details>


### [228] [Robust Global Structure-from-Motion via View Graph Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22054)
*Jiamin Xu,Lixing Yao,Weichen Dai,Renshu Gu,Zunjie Zhu,Weiwei Xu,Gang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种子图引导的视图图剪枝框架，用于提升全局运动恢复结构（SfM）在视觉模糊匹配场景下的鲁棒性。该方法通过将视图图划分为局部一致的子图，在每个子图内执行全局SfM获得可靠相机位姿，再通过RANSAC跨子图剪枝移除不一致的边，最终在精化后的视图图上执行全局SfM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局SfM相较于增量SfM具有更好的可扩展性，但性能高度依赖于视图图中边的质量。视觉上具有歧义的匹配会产生错误边，导致相机位姿估计不正确和重建伪影，因此需要一种方法来识别并移除这些不可靠的连接。

Method: 提出子图引导的视图图剪枝框架：(1) 将视图图划分为局部一致的子图；(2) 在每个子图内执行全局SfM以获得可靠相机位姿；(3) 利用RANSAC进行跨子图边剪枝，移除不一致的边；(4) 在精化后的视图图上执行最终全局SfM。

Result: 在有歧义、序列化和无序图像数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在具有挑战性的条件下提升了全局SfM的鲁棒性。进一步通过神经渲染评估显示，改进后的相机位姿估计带来了更高质量的新视角合成结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的子图引导剪枝框架能有效利用可靠子图的内部一致性来识别并移除不可靠连接，从而提升全局SfM在视觉歧义场景下的稳健性，并间接提升下游神经渲染任务的质量。

Abstract: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) aims to estimate camera poses and reconstruct 3D structures from a collection of unordered images. Compared with incremental SfM, global SfM achieves better scalability by jointly estimating camera poses based on a view graph constructed from pairwise correspondences. However, its performance is highly sensitive to erroneous edges caused by visually ambiguous matches, which may lead to incorrect camera registration and reconstruction artifacts. In this work, we propose a subgraph-guided view graph pruning framework for robust global SfM. Our key idea is to exploit the internal consistency of reliable subgraphs to identify and remove unreliable connections. Specifically, we first partition the view graph into locally consistent subgraphs and perform global SfM within each subgraph to obtain reliable camera poses. We then apply RANSAC-based edge pruning across subgraphs to remove inconsistent edges, and finally perform global SfM on the refined view graph. Extensive experiments on ambiguous, sequential, and unordered image datasets demonstrate that our method improves the robustness of global SfM under challenging conditions. Further evaluation with neural rendering shows that the improved camera estimation leads to higher-quality novel view synthesis results.

</details>


### [229] [Competitive Memory Readout for Robust Video Object Segmentation: 2nd Place Technical Report for the MOSEv2 Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22064)
*Mingqi Gao,Sijie Li,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对ECCV 2026 LSVOS挑战赛MOSEv2赛道（排名第2）的视频目标分割方法。该方法基于SAM 3，引入竞争性记忆读取（Competitive Memory Readout）机制，显式建模同类别干扰目标以减少目标身份混淆，并辅以轻量级自适应恢复规则防止对弱目标或重现目标的过度抑制，最终在挑战得分上达到66.20。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂的视频目标分割场景中，传统的仅针对目标的内存检索会将同类别的非目标物体隐式表示为背景，导致被标注目标与外观相似的干扰物之间产生混淆，从而损害目标身份保持。

Method: 1) 基于SAM 3构建系统，聚焦于其记忆读取（memory readout）模块；2) 提出竞争性记忆读取（Competitive Memory Readout），在检索目标信息时显式纳入同类别竞争者的证据；3) 在竞争之后应用轻量级自适应恢复规则（adaptive restoration rule），以防止对弱目标或重现目标的过度抑制。

Result: 在MOSEv2赛道中取得66.20的挑战主要得分，排名第2。

Conclusion: 该系统在保留原始SAM 3跟踪流程的同时，通过显式的竞争性记忆读取机制改善了具有挑战性视频场景下的目标身份保持能力，验证了处理同类别干扰对于鲁棒视频目标分割的有效性。

Abstract: We present our solution for the MOSEv2 track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge at ECCV 2026. The challenge evaluates robust video object segmentation under complex temporal dynamics, including long-term occlusion, disappearance and reappearance, large appearance changes, and strong interference from visually similar objects. Our method builds on SAM~3 and focuses on its memory readout. Standard target-only memory retrieval can confuse the annotated target with same-class non-target objects because such distractors are represented only implicitly as background. Our method introduces Competitive Memory Readout, which explicitly incorporates same-class competitor evidence when retrieving target information from memory. To prevent excessive suppression of weak or reappearing targets, we further apply a lightweight adaptive restoration rule after competition. The resulting system retains the original SAM~3 tracking pipeline while improving target identity preservation in challenging videos. Our submission achieves 66.20 on the primary challenge score and ranks 2nd in the MOSEv2 track.

</details>


### [230] [ADMIL: Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning for Selective Foundation Model Inference in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22066)
*Duncan Stothers,Ren-Chin Wu,William Lotter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ADMIL是一个选择性计算框架，通过将ABMIL教师的注意力分布蒸馏到一个轻量级瓷砖选择模型PriorNet中，仅对少量信息量最高的瓷砖调用昂贵的基础模型嵌入，在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16数据集上匹配完整教师的性能，同时避免超过98%的基础模型推理FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于注意力机制的MIL方法（ABMIL）使用病理基础模型嵌入在切片级任务上表现优异，但穷举式推理需要对每个前景瓷砖都应用大型图像编码器。然而，后续的注意力分布往往集中在少量信息丰富的区域，这意味着大量计算被浪费在无关瓷砖上。在临床部署中，延迟和计算成本是关键考量，因此需要一种方法在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅减少昂贵编码器的调用次数。

Method: ADMIL包含两个核心组件：(1) PriorNet——采用EfficientNet架构的轻量级瓷砖选择模型，通过KL散度从ABMIL教师的注意力分布中学习蒸馏，仅从原始瓷砖像素预测注意力分数；(2) 推理阶段——PriorNet对前景池中的瓷砖进行评分，选择Top-K瓷砖，只对该子集调用昂贵的病理基础模型（Virchow2）生成嵌入，然后由基于选中瓷砖包的ABMIL学生模型预测切片标签。实验设置中K值分别为BRACS=4、PANDA=8、CAMELYON16=128。

Result: 在BRACS、PANDA和CAMELYON16三个数据集上，ADMIL在K=4、8、128个瓷砖时匹配完整教师模型的最优性能，避免超过98%的基础模型瓷砖嵌入和推理FLOPs。随机选择和教师注意力oracle对照实验表明，该性能提升依赖于任务相关性的瓷砖选择而非单纯的瓷砖数量减少。定量和定性分析显示PriorNet能够高保真地恢复教师的瓷砖排序，并聚焦于任务相关的形态学区域。

Conclusion: ADMIL证明了几乎所有的昂贵瓷砖编码都可以被移除而不牺牲切片级性能，这为在延迟和计算成本关键的临床环境中更高效地部署病理AI系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) using pathology foundation model embeddings is effective for slide-level tasks, but exhaustive inference requires applying a large image encoder to every foreground tile despite the subsequent attention distribution often concentrating over a small subset of informative regions. We introduce ADMIL (Attention-Distilled Multiple Instance Learning), a selective-compute framework that distills an ABMIL teacher's attention into a lightweight tile-selection model, PriorNet. Using an EfficientNet architecture, PriorNet learns the teacher attention distribution from raw tile pixels with KL divergence; at inference, it scores the foreground pool, selects the top-K tiles, and invokes the expensive foundation model only on that subset before a selected-bag ABMIL student predicts the slide label. Across BRACS, PANDA, and CAMELYON16, ADMIL matches full-teacher headline performance at K=4, 8, and 128 tiles, respectively, avoiding >98% of foundation model (Virchow2) tile embeddings and model inference FLOPs. Random and teacher-attention oracle controls show that this result depends on task-relevant selection rather than tile-count reduction alone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses suggest that PriorNet recovers the teacher's tile ordering with high fidelity while focusing on task-relevant morphological regions. ADMIL shows that nearly all expensive tile encodings can be removed without sacrificing slide-level performance, providing a potential path for more efficient deployment in clinical settings where latency and compute costs are key considerations.

</details>


### [231] [Spiking Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Object Detection in Forward-Looking Sonar Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22072)
*Gwenevere Frank,Gert Cauwenberghs*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpikeYOLO是一种完全脉冲神经网络(SNN)，首次被应用于前视声纳(FLS)图像中的目标检测。在三个FLS数据集上，SpikeYOLO以显著更低的计算能耗（最高4.4×）达到与YOLOv8m等CNN基线竞争性的精度，并展现出更优的抗斑点噪声鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主水下航行器(AUV)依赖前视声纳作为主要感知手段，但CNN目标检测能耗极高（如YOLOv8m每推理322mJ），在AUV有限电池容量下严重制约任务续航。SNN凭借二进制脉冲激活与仅累加运算，在神经形态硬件上可实现极低能耗，且声纳图像的高对比度稀疏结构天然匹配脉冲编码特性，但此前无人评估SNN在FLS目标检测中的适用性。

Method: 提出SpikeYOLO，一个完全脉冲神经网络，采用替代梯度(surrogate gradient)方法进行训练。在三个FLS目标检测数据集（UATD、Marine-Debris-FLS等）上，与YOLOv8m、YOLO-SONAR、Fast R-CNN等SOTA CNN基线进行系统对比基准测试，分别评估精度(mAP)、理论计算能耗以及对抗乘性斑点噪声的鲁棒性。

Result: 1) 在UATD上，SpikeYOLO(T=2)实现3.3×更低的能耗（97 vs 322 mJ），精度达0.529 mAP@0.5:0.95，接近YOLOv8m的0.575；2) 在Marine-Debris-FLS上，SpikeYOLO在mAP@0.5上匹配YOLOv8m并以4.4×更低能耗超越其他基线；3) 面对斑点噪声，SpikeYOLO在σ=0.4时仅3.0%精度退化（YOLOv8m为8.9%），在σ=0.6时完全超越YOLOv8m。

Conclusion: SNN能够以前所未有的能效优势在FLS目标检测中达到与CNN相竞争甚至在某些方面更优的性能，特别是在真实世界声纳往往面临的斑点噪声环境下表现出更强鲁棒性。该工作验证了SNN在AUV等功耗受限平台上的实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are increasingly important tools in industries ranging from research, to energy, to defense. AUVs are power-constrained platforms operating in remote environments with fixed battery capacities, where propulsion competes with compute and sensors for power over lengthy mission durations. AUVs frequently operate in dark or turbid waters where optical sensing is of limited value, and rely on sonar as their primary sensing modality. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the state-of-the-art solution for object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery, but are energy expensive (e.g. YOLOv8m: 322 mJ/inference). Spiking neural networks (SNNs) rely on binary spike activations and thus sparse accumulate-only operations, allowing them to be remarkably energy efficient, particularly when paired with dedicated neuromorphic hardware. The sparse, high-contrast structure of forward-looking sonar (FLS) returns is structurally matched to spike coding in a way that optical imagery is not. No prior work has assessed the suitability of SNNs for object detection in FLS imagery. SpikeYOLO, a fully spiking network trained with surrogate gradients, was benchmarked against state-of-the-art CNN baselines on three FLS object detection datasets. Key results: SpikeYOLO T=2 achieves 3.3$\times$ lower theoretical compute energy on UATD (97 vs 322 mJ) at competitive accuracy (0.529 mAP@0.5:0.95 vs. YOLOv8m's 0.575); SpikeYOLO matches YOLOv8m on mAP@0.5 and outperforms YOLO-SONAR and Fast R-CNN baselines on the sparse Marine-Debris-FLS dataset at 4.4$\times$ lower energy; SpikeYOLO demonstrates superior robustness to multiplicative speckle noise (3.0% degradation at $σ{=}0.4$ vs. 8.9% for YOLOv8m), outperforming YOLOv8m outright at $σ{=}0.6$, directly relevant to real-world FLS deployment.

</details>


### [232] [When More References Hurt: Contamination-Aware DINOv2 Memory Banks for Few-Shot Steel Defect Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22082)
*Hannaneh Kalantari,Javad Khoramdel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在补丁记忆异常检测中，当参考库包含未经验证的工业图像时，用少量可信正常图像安全地恢复有用正常补丁。提出基于距离裁剪的方法，在Severstal上将异常补丁污染从9.46%降至2.59%，AUPRC从0.0950提升至0.1084，实验证明参考库纯净度是首要设计变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的补丁记忆异常检测方法假设参考库完全正常，但实际工业场景中额外收集的图像往往未经验证，可能包含缺陷。直接使用这些未验证图像会引入异常补丁污染，损害检测性能。作者希望探索是否能用少量可信的正常图像，无需缺陷掩码，安全地从这类参考库中恢复出有用的正常补丁。

Method: 基于AnomalyDINO的DINOv2补丁记忆框架：1）将候选补丁按到干净种子库的距离进行评分；2）丢弃最可疑的20%补丁；3）将保留的补丁与种子库合并；4）通过贪心coreset选择强制执行固定预算。使用少量可信正常图像作为种子库来引导过滤过程。

Result: 在Severstal上，朴素的额外参考包含9.46%异常补丁，所提出的裁剪方法拒绝其中78.1%，将残余污染降至2.59%。在等量51,200补丁的开发预算下，所提方法达到0.1084 AUPRC，优于朴素扩展（0.0950）、随机移除（0.0952）和八张干净图像（0.1030）。注入仅0.5%异常补丁即将AUPRC从0.1030降至0.0759。在所有五个完成的保留测试对上，所提方法均优于朴素扩展，平均增益0.0142 AUPRC。

Conclusion: 参考库的纯净度是补丁记忆异常检测中的一阶设计变量。未经验证的图像只有在明确过滤其贡献时才有用，仅靠随机移除或朴素合并不足以保证性能。所提出的基于种子库距离的裁剪方法能有效从混合参考中恢复正常补丁，同时保持固定预算。

Abstract: Patch-memory anomaly detectors assume that their reference bank is normal, an assumption that is difficult to guarantee when additional industrial images are unverified. We study whether a few trusted normal images can safely recover useful normal patches from such references without defect masks. Starting from the DINOv2 patch-memory formulation used by AnomalyDINO, we score candidate patches by distance to a clean seed bank, discard the most suspicious 20%, merge the retained patches with the seed, and enforce a fixed budget by greedy coreset selection. On Severstal, naive additional references contain 9.46% anomalous patches; the proposed trim rejects 78.1\% of them and reduces residual contamination to 2.59%. At an equal 51,200-patch development budget, the proposed bank reaches 0.1084 AUPRC versus 0.0950 for naive expansion, 0.0952 for random removal, and 0.1030 for eight clean images. Injecting only 0.5\% anomalous patches into a clean bank reduces AUPRC from 0.1030 to 0.0759. On all five completed held-out pairs, the proposed bank improves over naive expansion, with a mean gain of 0.0142 AUPRC. Reference purity is therefore a first-order design variable, and unverified images are useful only when their contribution is filtered explicitly.

</details>


### [233] [Three-Phase Scribble-Adaptive Curriculum Learning for autoPETV Grand Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22096)
*Libo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Libo Zhang针对autoPETV Grand Challenge提出的交互式全身PET/CT病灶分割算法方案。该方法将交互编码为额外的输入通道，训练了一个约1.4亿参数的残差编码器U-Net，通过4000轮次的三阶段课程学习（先学全自动分割，再观察真实标注衍生的涂抹，最后通过在线模拟适应自身错误），并在五折集成后于交互式交叉验证中取得AUC-Dice 3.836、AUC-DMM 3.869的优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对autoPETV挑战赛中交互式病灶分割的任务需求，需要提出一种有效利用用户交互信号（前景/背景涂抹）来提升PET/CT图像中病灶分割精度的方法。

Method: 将交互涂抹栅格化为两个额外输入通道；训练一个约1.4亿参数的残差编码器U-Net；采用三阶段课程学习（静默交互通道的全自动分割学习、随机可见性模式下观察真实涂抹、通过最多五步错误驱动的在线仿真适应自身错误）；使用1811例autoPET和DeepPSMA数据训练；通过五折的最佳与最终检查点logit平均进行集成。

Result: 在六步交互的五折交叉验证中，最终检查点达到平均AUC-Dice为3.836、平均AUC-DMM为3.869，每一折均单调提升，约一半的总增益由首次修正涂抹贡献。

Conclusion: 所提出的课程学习策略配合交互通道编码及集成方法，能有效利用用户修正信号实现交互式分割性能的稳定、单调提升，且代码与模型权重已开源。

Abstract: This report describes Libo Zhang's algorithmic solution to autoPETV Grand Challenge on interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT. Interaction is encoded as two additional input channels that rasterize the accumulated foreground and background scribbles, and a residual-encoder U-Net of about 140 million parameters is trained with a three-phase curriculum over 4000 epochs: the network first learns fully automatic segmentation with silent interaction channels, then observes ground-truth-derived scribbles under randomly sampled visibility modes, and finally adapts to its own mistakes through online simulation of up to five error-driven correction steps. Training draws on 1811 autoPET and DeepPSMA studies, and the submission ensembles the best and final checkpoints of five folds by logit averaging. In interactive five-fold cross-validation with six interaction steps, the final checkpoints reach a mean AUC-Dice of 3.836 and a mean AUC-DMM of 3.869, improving monotonically in every fold, with roughly half of the total gain delivered by the first corrective scribble. Our code and trained model checkpoints are available on https://github.com/Libo1023/autoPETV-Curriculum.

</details>


### [234] [Learning Implicit Constitutive Laws for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22102)
*Xiaoyang Liu,Kai Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GCA框架，利用3D高斯表示从单目动态视频中学习隐式本构定律。通过LoRA自适应结合两个对齐模块（基于秩的深度几何锚点RDGA和本构先验正则化器CPR），在合成、真实到仿真及真实数据集上均优于现有方法，合成基准上比最强基线降低48%的Chamfer距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐式方法在噪声监督下易陷入局部最小值且缺乏物理可解释性，而显式方法依赖预定义本构方程，泛化能力受限且在单目设置下不稳定。因此需要一种既能保持隐式建模灵活性又具有物理可解释性的框架，从单目动态视频中学习可变形物体的内在物理动力学。

Method: GCA框架包含三部分：1) LoRA-based自适应机制统一冻结的3D高斯表征；2) 秩基深度几何锚点（RDGA），通过尺度不变的秩基深度对齐建立鲁棒几何约束，减少对不可靠像素级颜色监督的依赖；3) 本构先验正则化器（CPR），将经典本构模型作为软可微先验集成到优化中，即使实际材料不在假设集合中也保持隐式建模的灵活性。

Result: 在合成、真实到仿真和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，GCA优于现有方法，在合成基准上比最强基线实现了48%更低的Chamfer距离，并在单目监督下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GCA通过将经典本构模型作为可微先验与隐式学习结合，成功在单目动态视频场景下学习可变形物体的本构定律，兼顾了物理可解释性与隐式建模的泛化能力，为从单一视角视频中推断材料属性提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We present GCA (Gaussian Constitutive Alignment), a framework for learning implicit constitutive laws from monocular dynamic video of deformable objects represented by 3D Gaussians. Given a static multi-view scan for geometric initialization, our method learns intrinsic physical dynamics solely from a single fixed-viewpoint video of the moving object. Existing implicit methods often suffer from local minima under noisy supervision and lack physical interpretability, while explicit approaches rely on predefined constitutive equations, limiting generalizability and becoming unstable in monocular settings. To address these challenges, our framework unifies LoRA-based adaptation with two key alignment modules. First, we propose Rank-based Depth-Geometric Anchors (RDGA) to establish robust geometric constraints from monocular dynamic observations via scale-invariant rank-based depth alignment, reducing the reliance on unreliable pixel-level color supervision. Second, a Constitutive Prior Regularizer (CPR) integrates classical constitutive models as soft differentiable priors, regularizing the optimization while preserving the flexibility of implicit modeling---even when the actual material is absent from the hypotheses. Extensive experiments on synthetic, real-to-sim, and real-world datasets demonstrate that GCA outperforms existing methods, achieving 48% lower Chamfer Distance than the strongest baseline on synthetic benchmarks while remaining robust under monocular supervision.

</details>


### [235] [Vehicle speed dataset for the major European road network derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, 2022-2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22116)
*Maciej Adamiak,Sascha Fendrich,Julian Psotta,Alexander Zipf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一个基于Copernicus Sentinel-2卫星光学影像提取欧洲E级公路（2022-2026年）单车速度观测数据集。利用推扫式仪器蓝、绿、红三个波段间微小且已知的采集延迟，运动车辆在影像中形成位移回波，通过预测-匹配算法将检测到的强度峰值链接为轨迹，并转换为地面速度。数据以GeoPackage格式发布，每辆车一条记录，支持大陆尺度交通模式、速度行为、交通建模和路网属性标定等研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有欧洲公路速度数据通常依赖地面传感器或众包数据，覆盖范围有限且分布不均。该工作旨在利用卫星遥感手段，实现大陆尺度的、统一的、可重复的车辆速度观测，以满足交通研究和大规模路网建模对广域速度数据的需求。

Method: 利用Sentinel-2推扫式成像仪蓝（B02_10m）、绿（B03_10m）、红（B04_10m）波段之间短且已知的采集时间延迟，运动车辆在不同波段出现轻微位移形成"移动回波"；通过预测-匹配过程将检出的位移强度峰值链接为逐车轨迹；利用公开的波段间时间延迟将位移转换为地面速度。每条记录包含轨迹几何、各通道位移与航向、内部质量指标、估计速度、采集时间戳和源Sentinel-2产品标识。数据以GeoPackage格式按车分发。

Result: 生成一个覆盖欧洲E级公路（含高速公路、干线公路、主要及次要道路）2022-2026年逐车速度观测的数据集，每条记录含轨迹几何、位移、航向、质量指标、速度、时间戳及源数据标识，以GeoPackage文件形式发布。

Conclusion: 该数据集可为交通模式研究、速度行为分析、交通建模以及大陆尺度公路网络属性标定提供支持，展现了光学遥感在大范围交通监测中的应用潜力。

Abstract: The dataset provides individual vehicle speed observations on European E-roads: motorways, trunk roads, primary and secondary roads, as tagged in OpenStreetMap as e-road, for the years 2022-2026. Speeds are derived from Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A satellite optical imagery using a processing pipeline that exploits the short, well-characterized acquisition delays between the blue (B02_10m), green (B03_10m), and red bands (B04_10m) of the Sentinel-2 push-broom instrument. A moving vehicle appears at slightly displaced positions in the three bands, forming a moving echo. The detected displaced intensity peaks are linked into per-vehicle trajectories through a prediction-and-matching procedure. The resulting displacements are converted into ground speeds using publicly accessible inter-band time delays. Each record contains the trajectory geometry, per-channel displacements and headings, internal quality indicators, the estimated speed, the acquisition timestamp, and the source Sentinel-2 product identifier. The dataset is distributed as GeoPackage files, with one record per detected vehicle, and can support studies of traffic patterns, speed behavior, transport modeling, and the calibration of road network attributes at a continental scale.

</details>


### [236] [TRACE: Artifact-Robust Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect Surface Scans - A Case Study in Craniosynostosis 3D Photography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22131)
*Sanjay Bhandari,Nawazish Khan,Alzbeta Novotna,Tiffany Jeong,Loretta Bowman,Michael Hernandez,Tobi Somorin,Viraj Govani,Jesse Goldstein,Shireen Elhabian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRACE是一个无监督框架，用于直接从含有伪影的临床3D头部照片构建统计形状模型（SSM）。它通过预测稀疏解剖对应控制点、粗细粒度表面感知变形级联精化，以及薄板样条（TPS）变形将干净模板网格变形为个体头部重建，从而在抑制非头部伪影的同时保持密集对应关系。该框架与多种骨干网络（PointNet、DGCNN、Point Transformer V3）兼容，显著优于现有SSM方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 颅缝早闭的严重程度分析日益依赖统计形状模型（SSM）来量化颅骨形态，但现有方法多依赖CT或经过重度处理的3D照片。原始临床3D照片虽然无辐射且可重复采集，却常含有肩膀、手、头发、衣物、扫描噪声和不完整边界等伪影，会破坏对应的准确性。因此需要一种能够直接从伪影污染的临床照片中构建SSM的鲁棒方法。

Method: TRACE框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 从原始点云中预测稀疏解剖对应的头部表面控制点；(2) 通过粗细粒度（coarse-to-fine）的Surface-Aware Deformation级联对控制点进行精化；(3) 使用薄板样条（TPS）变形将干净的模板网格形变为个体特定的头部重建。该模板约束的公式化设计使密集对应保持在临床相关的头部解剖结构上，同时抑制非头部伪影。对应模块与点云编码器解耦，可搭配不同骨干网络。

Result: 在多种骨干网络（PointNet、DGCNN、Point Transformer V3）下的实验表明，TRACE在表面采样质量、拓扑保持性和形状模型质量方面均显著优于现有的SSM方法，为基于照片的颅缝早闭形状分析提供了可扩展的基础。

Conclusion: TRACE为伪影污染的颅面3D照片提供了鲁棒的无监督SSM构建方案，验证了模板约束与伪影感知对应估计的有效性，并展示了扩展到其他伪影污染表面扫描领域的潜力（只要存在合适的干净模板）。

Abstract: Craniosynostosis severity analysis increasingly relies on statistical shape models (SSMs) to quantify cranial morphology, but most existing workflows depend on computed tomography or heavily curated three-dimensional (3D) photographs. Raw clinical 3D photographs provide a radiation-free and repeatable alternative, yet often contain shoulders, hands, hair, clothing, scanner noise, and incomplete boundaries that corrupt correspondences. We introduce the Template-constrained Robust Artifact-aware Correspondence Estimation (TRACE) framework, an unsupervised method for constructing SSMs directly from artifact-contaminated clinical 3D head photographs. TRACE predicts sparse anatomically corresponding head-surface control points from the raw point cloud, refines them through a coarse-to-fine Surface-Aware Deformation cascade, and uses thin-plate spline warping to deform a clean template mesh into a subject-specific head reconstruction. This template-constrained formulation keeps dense correspondences on clinically relevant head anatomy while suppressing non-head artifacts. The correspondence module is decoupled from the point-cloud encoder, enabling the same deformation pipeline to be paired with different backbones, including PointNet, DGCNN, and Point Transformer V3. Across all backbones, TRACE substantially improves surface sampling, topology preservation, and shape-model quality over prior SSM methods, providing a scalable foundation for photograph-based craniosynostosis shape analysis and a framework that may extend to other artifact-contaminated surface scans when an appropriate clean template is available.

</details>


### [237] [When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22174)
*Yubo Zhu,Zhehan Kan,Jingyi Yang,Miaolin Chen,Jinbo Xing,Kai Zhu,Zijian Wang,Sheng Zhong,Wei Tong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VGAU-Diag，一个细粒度的视觉生成辅助理解评估框架，用于回答"视觉生成能否提升统一多模态模型的理解能力"这一核心问题。通过难度分层、多推理范式统一评估和Oracle辅助参考协议，研究发现：生成视觉辅助在简单样本上有帮助，但随着推理复杂度增加变得不可靠；主要瓶颈在于视觉理解侧而非视觉生成侧；有效的视觉生成应针对视觉理解瓶颈而非增加推理步骤；并识别出从任务无关噪声到误导性伪引导再到有用辅助的三阶段转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）同时具备理解与生成能力，但现有评估对"视觉生成能否提升理解"这一问题给出了混合证据，且混淆了任务难度、推理范式和生成与理解之间的闭环交互三个因素。缺乏一个解耦这些因素的细粒度评估框架。

Method: 提出VGAU-Diag评估框架，包含三个关键设计：(1) 按难度对样本进行分层；(2) 实现多种推理范式的统一评估；(3) 引入Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols，通过引入"上帝视角"的辅助参考来精确诊断瓶颈所在（是视觉理解侧还是视觉生成侧）。

Result: 分析发现：生成的视觉辅助在较简单实例上有助于理解，但随着推理复杂性增加变得不可靠；Oracle辅助诊断揭示主要瓶颈通常在视觉理解侧而非视觉生成侧，因为当前UMMs即使面对忠实的视觉辅助也难以有效利用；有效的视觉生成应瞄准视觉理解瓶颈而非增加推理步骤；识别出从任务无关噪声到误导性可行引导再到有用辅助的三阶段转变。

Conclusion: 这些发现为开发更好的统一多模态模型提供了指导方向：应优先解决视觉理解侧的瓶颈，视觉生成应作为针对性的帮助手段而非通用插件，同时需要理解不同难度和推理阶段下视觉辅助的效果边界。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can perform both understanding and generation, raising a central question: can visual generation improve understanding? Existing evaluations provide mixed evidence, but confound task difficulty, reasoning paradigms, and the closed-loop interaction between generation and understanding. We introduce VGAU-Diag, a fine-grained evaluation framework for vision generation-assisted understanding. It stratifies samples by difficulty, enables unified evaluation of multiple reasoning paradigms, and uses Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols. Our analysis shows that generated visual aids help on easier instances but become unreliable as reasoning complexity increases. Oracle-assisted diagnosis further reveals that the main bottleneck often lies on the visual-understanding side rather than the visual-generation side, as current UMMs struggle to leverage even faithful visual aids. We also show that effective visual generation should target visual-understanding bottlenecks rather than add more reasoning steps, and identify a three-stage transition from task-irrelevant noise, to misleading plausible guidance, and finally to useful assistance. These findings would be useful to guide the development of better UMMs.The code is available at https://github.com/zyb1029/VGAU-Diag.

</details>


### [238] [VERDICT: Agreement Beats Pixel-Space Verification in Real-Document OCSR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22183)
*Yani Guan,Dengpan Dong,Shuang Luo,Zi Wei,Joah Han,Dan Hannah,Yumin Zhang,Qichao Hu,Kang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VERDICT框架，用于在缺乏ground truth的情况下自动评估OCSR（光学化学结构识别）预测的可靠性。通过在263篇ACS期刊图像上的系统比较，发现三种无标签信号中，多个识别器之间的"一致性"（AUROC 0.916）远优于"重新渲染相似度"（AUROC 0.547）和单一模型置信度。"两票通过"规则以88.8%精度接受81.7%图像，"三票通过"规则以98.5%精度接受52.1%图像。经物质过滤器去除通配符和R基团片段后，VERDICT在PMC Open Access上生成6,146个结构标签，化学家仲裁显示三票层精度0.995，两票层精度0.958，已在SES AI的Molecular Universe平台作为基于图像的分子检索接口部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模化学训练数据集的构建需要从文献中自动提取分子结构（OCSR），但在缺乏ground truth的真实场景中，无法依赖标注数据来筛选不可靠的预测。现有方法缺乏对无标签信号的系统比较，且合成基准无法反映真实退化场景（如重渲染相似度在真实数据上近乎随机）。需要开发一种无需真值即可验证OCSR预测可靠性的方法。

Method: 系统比较三类无标签信号：模型置信度、重新渲染相似度（像素空间重建）以及多个架构不同识别器之间的预测一致性。在263篇ACS期刊图像上验证，随后采用"两票/三票通过"规则作为集成投票策略，并设计物质过滤器以排除通配符和R-基团片段产生的假一致性。最终将框架（VERDICT）应用于PMC Open Access大规模语料，输出带置信度分层标签的分子库。

Result: 重渲染相似度AUROC仅0.547（接近随机），且oracle调优阈值使正确标签从0.745降至0.205；而四个架构不同识别器的共识达到AUROC 0.916。两票规则在88.8%精度下接受81.7%图像，三票规则在98.5%精度下接受52.1%。该模式在CLEF-IP、UOB、USPTO数据集中一致复现。物质过滤器移除2,193个通配符/R-基团假一致性，使三票规则拒绝全部68个通用结构图。在PMC上生成6,146个标签，化学家仲裁显示三票层精度0.995、两票层精度0.958。

Conclusion: 多识别器一致性是OCSR无标签可靠性的最有效信号，而像素空间重渲染在真实退化数据上不可靠（该信号仅对合成基准有效，掩盖了真实差异）。VERDICT框架能够在大规模真实文献中生成经仲裁验证的高精度分子标签，可用于构建连接结构图像、机器可读表示和来源文献的多模态分子数据库，并已在工业平台中作为图像检索接口实际部署。

Abstract: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) converts 2D molecular depictions in the published literature into SMILES, and is increasingly important for constructing large-scale chemical training datasets. Automation at that scale requires identifying unreliable predictions in the absence of ground truth. Three families of label-free signals were compared on $263$ ACS journal depictions with verified ground truth: model confidence, re-rendering similarity, and agreement among recognizers. Pixel-space re-rendering performed little better than chance (AUROC $0.547$, $95\%$ CI $[0.465,0.629]$), and an oracle-tuned threshold on it reduced correct labels per image from $0.745$ to $0.205$. Agreement among four architecturally distinct recognizers instead reached an AUROC of $0.916$ ($[0.880,0.952]$). The two-of-four rule accepted $81.7\%$ of images at $88.8\%$ precision, the three-of-four rule $52.1\%$ at $98.5\%$. The same pattern held on CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO. This distinction is obscured on synthetic benchmarks, where re-rendered predictions naturally resemble their inputs. A substance filter removed $2{,}193$ false agreements on wildcards and R-group fragments, after which the three-of-four rule rejected all $68$ generic depictions. VERDICT was then applied to PMC Open Access, producing $6{,}146$ structure labels for $4{,}833$ molecules; chemist adjudication of $400$ released labels in two independent samples yielded precisions of $0.995$ for the three-of-four tier and $0.958$ for the two-of-four tier. VERDICT therefore enables validated labels for multimodal molecular databases linking structure images, machine-readable representations, and source-publication information. In SES AI's Molecular Universe platform, VERDICT further serves as an image-based interface for searching and retrieving molecular records.

</details>


### [239] [SAM3Dual: A 3rd Place Solution to the MOSEv2 Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22193)
*JeongRae Kim,Chaehyun Kim,Changwon Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAM3Dual是ECCV 2026第8届大规模视频目标分割挑战赛MOSEv2赛道的第三名方案。它是对预训练SAM 3的一种无需训练的推理扩展，将时间记忆显式分为短期分支和长期分支，通过确定性序列相对融合调度结合两者的响应，并用前一帧目标置信度进行保守调制。所有SAM 3参数保持冻结，无需任何训练或参数优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长期视频目标分割（VOS）任务中，如何在不破坏预训练模型的情况下高效组织和管理时间记忆是关键挑战。作者希望探索仅通过推理阶段重构时间记忆结构，即可获得竞争力的长期VOS性能，同时完全保留预训练模型参数。

Method: SAM3Dual将时间记忆分为两个分支：短期分支处理最近的观测帧，长期分支处理间隔采样的历史表示。两个记忆响应通过一个确定性的序列相对融合调度进行组合，并使用前一帧的目标置信度进行保守调制。整个系统基于预训练SAM 3，参数全部冻结，不涉及任何任务特定训练、微调、测试时训练或在线参数优化。

Result: 该方案在MOSEv2赛道取得官方J&F分数64.37，排名第三。

Conclusion: 该结果证明了在推理阶段重组时间记忆即可获得具有竞争力的长期VOS性能，同时保留预训练模型，展示了训练无关记忆组织的潜力。

Abstract: We present SAM3Dual, our third-place solution to the MOSEv2 track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge at ECCV 2026. SAM3Dual is a training-free inference extension of pretrained SAM 3 that explicitly separates temporal memory into a short-term branch for recent observations and a long-term branch for interval-sampled historical representations. The two memory responses are combined using a deterministic sequence-relative fusion schedule and conservatively modulated by the previous-frame object confidence. All pretrained SAM 3 parameters remain frozen, requiring no task-specific training, fine-tuning, test-time training, or online parameter optimization. The complete system achieved an official J&F score of 64.37 and ranked third in the MOSEv2 track. This result highlights the potential of reorganizing temporal memory entirely at inference time to obtain competitive long-term VOS performance while preserving the pretrained model.

</details>


### [240] [UR$^{2}$-MLLM: Uncertainty-aware Revisit Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22217)
*Yucheng Chen,Yang Yu,Jiazhou Zhou,Yufei Shi,Yongying Lan,Yichi Zhang,Liyi Li,Si Yong Yeo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UR²-MLLM框架，通过不确定性感知训练、多模态推理轨迹数据集与检测-复制机制，以及视觉定位奖励的强化学习，让放射学报告生成模型在推理过程中动态重访不确定区域，模拟放射科医生的迭代审阅行为，在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有放射学报告生成（RRG）的多模态大语言模型虽已从纯文本推理转向"带图像思考"范式，但提供的是静态视觉证据，缺乏动态重访机制，无法模拟放射科医生在推理过程中对不确定观察进行反复审视的行为。

Method: UR²-MLLM包含三个核心模块：(1) 在不确定性感知数据集上训练以获得不确定性感知能力；(2) 构建多模态推理轨迹数据集并引入检测-复制机制，指导何时何地重访；(3) 通过视觉定位奖励配合强化学习精炼重访行为，使重访区域与对应解剖结构对齐。

Result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray两个公开数据集上达到最先进性能，验证了不确定性感知的视觉重访推理对生成可靠且临床对齐的报告的有效性。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的视觉重访推理机制是提升放射学报告生成可靠性和临床对齐度的有效范式，模拟放射科医生的动态审阅行为对诊断报告质量有显著增益。

Abstract: Radiologists generate diagnostic reports through iterative and selective revisiting of suspicious regions to refine their interpretations. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for radiology report generation (RRG) have shifted from text-only reasoning toward a ``Thinking-with-Images'' paradigm, incorporating visual evidence into the reasoning process. However, existing methods provide static visual evidence without a dynamic revisit mechanism during reasoning, neglecting how radiologists re-examine uncertain observations. To this end, we propose an Uncertainty-aware Revisit Reasoning MLLM (UR$^{2}$-MLLM) framework that dynamically revisits uncertain regions during reasoning for RRG. UR$^{2}$-MLLM is first equipped with uncertainty perception by training on an uncertainty-aware dataset. We then construct a multimodal reasoning trajectory dataset together with a detect-and-copy mechanism, which guides when and where to revisit. Finally, a visual grounding reward refines this behavior through reinforcement learning, aligning the revisited regions with corresponding anatomical structures. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray show that UR$^{2}$-MLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the value of uncertainty-aware visual revisit reasoning for reliable and clinically aligned report generation.

</details>


### [241] [Hyper^2: Unleashing Hyperbolic Geometry's Full Potential via Dual-Space Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22238)
*Guantian Zheng,Haiyang Xu,Tianyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Hyper²双空间一致性框架，通过在细化注意力中复用双曲距离编码并与双曲Chamfer损失共享曲率，解决了HyperbolicCD中编码器为欧氏而损失为双曲的跨几何失配问题，在ShapeNet-55上相对SVDFormer实现-22.9% Chamfer距离改善，两个指标r_FL和u_G从(0.68,39%)跃升至(0.95,87%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HyperbolicCD虽然将点云补全的Chamfer距离替换为双曲距离，但增益有限（仅3-7%），作者认为瓶颈在于损失是双曲的而编码器是欧氏的，造成跨几何失配：位置相关的监督信号在链式法则回传中被平均抵消，无法有效到达参数。

Method: 提出两个模型无关的指标来衡量跨几何失配：特征-损失相关性r_FL和有效梯度利用率u_G。提出Hyper²框架，将与HyperbolicCD相同的arcosh(1+alpha*d^2)函数形式作为细化注意力的位置偏置（双曲距离编码），并与双曲Chamfer损失共享同一曲率alpha。两个算子均为O(N log N)标量非线性操作，仅增加约1.6% FLOPs。

Result: Hyper²在ShapeNet-55上相对SVDFormer实现-22.9% Chamfer距离改进，远超单空间消融线性叠加的13.2%（-12.0%损失单独+ -1.2%编码单独）；在21个未见过的ShapeNet-34类别上达到-37.5%。两个指标在单空间配置下基本持平，仅在编码器和损失同时为双曲时共同跃升至(0.95, 87%)。

Conclusion: 双曲监督在点云补全中的有效性依赖于编码器与损失之间的几何一致性，而非任一算子单独作用。共享曲率的双曲编码与双曲损失协同，才能充分发挥双曲几何在点云补全中的潜力。

Abstract: HyperbolicCD pioneered hyperbolic geometry for point cloud completion by replacing the Euclidean Chamfer distance with arcosh(1+alpha||x-y||^2), but the reported gains are modest (3-7% Chamfer reduction across SeedFormer, PointAttN and PMP-Net backbones on PCN and ShapeNet-55). We argue the bottleneck lies elsewhere: the loss is hyperbolic but the encoder it back-propagates through is Euclidean, so the position-dependent supervision of the loss is averaged away by the chain rule before it reaches the parameters. We call this a cross-geometry mismatch, and make it testable through two model-agnostic indicators, feature-loss correlation r_FL and effective gradient utilisation u_G. On an SVDFormer backbone trained with HyperbolicCD's loss alone we measure (r_FL, u_G) = (0.68, 39%). We propose Hyper^2, a dual-space consistency framework that extends HyperbolicCD by reusing the identical arcosh(1+alpha d^2) functional form as a positional bias on the refinement attention (a hyperbolic distance encoding), paired with HyperbolicCD's hyperbolic Chamfer loss under a single shared curvature alpha. Both operators are O(N log N) scalar non-linearities on Euclidean distances and together add only ~1.6% FLOPs over SVDFormer. Hyper^2 delivers -22.9% Chamfer on ShapeNet-55 over SVDFormer (well above the 13.2% linear sum of the -12.0% loss-only and -1.2% encoding-only single-space ablations) and -37.5% on the 21 unseen ShapeNet-34 categories. The two indicators remain essentially flat for any single-space configuration but jump together to (0.95, 87%) only when both encoder and loss are hyperbolic, supporting the claim that geometric consistency across encoder and loss, rather than either operator alone, is what enables hyperbolic supervision in point cloud completion. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Zheng136/Hyper-2.

</details>


### [242] [Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22263)
*Jiaao Yu,Yujian Ma,Xianming Hu,Pengran Wang,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的校准残差解码框架（calibrated residual decoding），通过构造正例、反事实和空三种证据条件，显式估计个性化信号的边际贡献，并引入基于归一化熵的不确定性校准，在无需微调的情况下提升视觉语言模型的个性化多模态理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接进行个性化提示（training-free personalized prompting）无法保证模型可靠利用用户档案中的证据。模型在正例档案下的预测分布混合了两种来源：真正由当前档案支持的个性化信号，以及模型自身的通用视觉或语言先验。因此仅从正例档案的响应难以判断高置信度答案是否真正由用户档案支持，而非模型默认偏好。

Method: 提出训练自由（training-free）的校准残差解码框架。对同一图像和问题构建三种证据条件：正例档案（positive profile）、反事实档案（counterfactual profile）和空档案（empty profile）。以空档案条件下的预测作为锚定基线，通过三种条件下评分差异显式估计个性化的边际贡献。进一步引入基于归一化熵（normalized-entropy）的不确定性校准，使个性化增强的强度自适应于残差信号的可靠性。

Result: 在MMPB、YoLLaVA和MyVLM三个基准上，该方法在无需微调的情况下提升了个性化多模态理解性能，在身份敏感的视觉个性化任务上取得一致增益。额外分析表明熵校准能在对比个性化信号不确定时稳定残差解码。

Conclusion: 通过显式分离个性化信号的边际贡献并引入熵校准，所提方法有效解决了训练自由个性化提示中模型无法可靠利用用户档案证据的问题，实现了无需参数更新的稳健个性化多模态理解。

Abstract: Vision-language models can be personalized in a training-free manner by directly providing user profiles, preferences, or visual references at inference time, without updating model parameters. However, direct personalized prompting does not guarantee that the model will reliably exploit such evidence. The predictive distribution under the positive user profile often mixes two sources: personalized signals genuinely supported by the current profile, and the model's generic visual or linguistic priors. As a result, from the positive-profile response alone, it is difficult to determine whether a high-confidence answer is supported by the user profile or merely reflects the model's default preference. To address this problem, we propose a training-free calibrated residual decoding framework. Given the same image and question, we construct three evidence conditions: a positive profile , a counterfactual profile , and an empty profile . Our method keeps the prediction under
  as the anchored base, and explicitly estimates the marginal contribution of personalization from score differences across the three conditions. We further introduce normalized-entropy-based uncertainty calibration, allowing the strength of personalized enhancement to adapt to the reliability of the residual signal. Experiments on MMPB, YoLLaVA, and MyVLM show that the proposed method improves personalized multimodal understanding without fine-tuning, with consistent gains on identity-sensitive visual personalization tasks. Additional analysis shows that entropy calibration stabilizes residual decoding when the contrastive personalization signal is uncertain.

</details>


### [243] [GAN-Diff : Coupling Pretrained WGAN-GP Features with Conditional Diffusion U-Nets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22272)
*Saif Ahmed,Ashadulla Hil Galib,S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu,Ahmed Faizul Haque Dhrubo,Souvik Pramanik,Mohammad Abdul Qayum,Mohsin Sajjad,Mohammad Ashrafuzzaman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合GAN引导的扩散框架，利用预训练的WGAN-GP作为特征先验，通过交叉注意力将GAN生成器的中间特征注入条件扩散U-Net中，用于图像恢复。在CelebA数据集上的高斯去噪和2倍超分辨率任务中，PSNR分别比输入基线提升4.40 dB和3.70 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GAN能够高效生成图像但恢复质量有限，扩散模型能提供高质量图像恢复但需要迭代采样。作者希望结合两者的优势，利用GAN作为特征先验来引导扩散模型，实现稳定且高效的图像恢复。

Method: 采用预训练并冻结的WGAN-GP生成器作为特征提取器，将其中间层特征通过交叉注意力机制注入扩散U-Net中；在DDIM采样过程中保持该先验特征固定不变。论文还针对训练中发现的多种不稳定源（对抗学习率不平衡、不当的扩散初始化、过度损坏、参数平均不足）进行了识别和解决。

Result: 在CelebA人脸图像上的高斯去噪和2倍超分辨率任务中，该框架显著提升了退化图像和低分辨率图像的质量：去噪任务PSNR提升4.40 dB，超分辨率任务PSNR提升3.70 dB。

Conclusion: 冻结的GAN特征先验可以有效引导扩散模型实现稳定且高效的图像恢复，证明了GAN与扩散模型混合架构的潜力。

Abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) can provide efficient image generation, while diffusion models offer high-quality image restoration but require iterative sampling. This paper presents a hybrid GAN-guided diffusion framework that uses a pretrained Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) as a feature prior for conditional diffusion-based image restoration. Intermediate features from the frozen WGAN-GP generator are incorporated into a diffusion U-Net through cross-attention and remain fixed during the DDIM sampling process. The framework is evaluated on two restoration tasks, Gaussian denoising and 2Xsuper-resolution, using CelebA face images. During development, several sources of instability were identified and addressed, including adversarial learning-rate imbalance, inappropriate diffusion initialization, excessive corruption, and insufficient parameter averaging. The resulting framework consistently improves the quality of both degraded and low-resolution images. In particular, it improves denoising performance by 4.40 dB in PSNR and super-resolution performance by 3.70 dB over their respective input baselines. These results demonstrate the potential of a frozen GAN feature prior to guide diffusion models toward stable and effective image restoration.

</details>


### [244] [OVIBench: Benchmarking Online Video Question Answering under Interruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22279)
*Naiming Liu,Zhiheng Wu,Shuning Wang,Tie Zhang,Bowen Liu,Tong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了在线视频问答（Online Video QA under Interruption）任务，并构建了首个标准化基准OVIBench，用于评估视觉语言模型在处理用户中断（取消、误触发、纠正）时的能力。同时构建了训练集OVI-Train，微调后的模型在OVIBench上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频问答研究和基准大多采用离线、单轮范式，忽视了真实交互中用户可能在模型生成答案过程中打断它这一现实场景，缺乏对该场景下VLM能力的系统评估。

Method: 1) 形式化定义在线视频问答中断任务的规范；2) 构建OVIBench基准，将中断分为取消、误触发、纠正三类，并支持开放式和多项选择两种评估方式；3) 开发离线仿真协议，在统一时间设置下复现生成过程中的中断；4) 提出多维评估指标套件；5) 构建OVI-Train训练集用于中断感知微调。

Result: 实验表明OVIBench能有效区分不同模型处理中断的能力，尤其在遵循纠正请求方面表现突出；在OVI-Train上微调的模型在OVIBench上取得显著性能提升，验证了基准和数据的有效性。

Conclusion: OVIBench填补了在线视频问答中断场景评估的空白，为评估和提升VLM的实时交互能力提供了标准化基准和训练数据，相关资源将公开发布。

Abstract: Recent vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding. However, most existing video QA research and benchmarks still follow an offline, single-round paradigm, overlooking realistic interactions where users may interrupt the model during answer generation. To address this gap, we formulate the task of Online Video Question Answering under Interruption and introduce OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating VLMs in this setting. OVIBench categorizes interruptions into three types: Cancellation, False Trigger, Correction and supports both open-ended and multiple-choice evaluations. To enable large-scale and reproducible testing, we develop an offline simulation protocol that reproduces interruption during generation under a unified temporal setup, together with a multi-dimensional metric suite for assessing interruption understanding and response generation. Experiments demonstrate that OVIBench effectively distinguishes models' interruption-handling abilities, especially in following correction requests. Finally, we construct a train set OVI-Train for interruption-aware fine-tuning. Models fine-tuned on this dataset achieve significant gains on OVIBench, validating the effectiveness of our benchmark and data design. OVIBench, OVI-Train, and the evaluation code will be released.

</details>


### [245] [DECO: Depth-Guided Co-Visibility Reasoning for Low-Altitude UAV Visual Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22289)
*Yibin Ye,Xichao Teng,Shuo Chen,Xiaokai Song,Dongdong Guan,Qifeng Yu,Zhang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DECO框架，利用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何，估计无人机图像与地理参考地图之间的共视区域，并引入结合几何共视性与检测显著性的评分来筛选关键点，从而提升GNSS拒止环境下的视觉定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在GNSS拒止环境下的视觉定位依赖与正交参考地图的关键点匹配和PnP位姿求解，但参考地图主要记录屋顶和地面等俯视表面，垂直结构（如立面、墙壁）常被压缩或缺失，导致低空无人机图像中的许多显著关键点在参考地图中无对应，产生冗余匹配和位姿估计不准确的问题。

Method: 提出DECO（DEpth-guided CO-visibility reasoning）框架：1）利用单目深度先验推断局部表面几何；2）估计无人机图像与参考地图之间的共视区域；3）引入Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score，联合考虑几何共视性和检测器显著性对关键点进行排序，保留既视觉显著又几何共视的关键点。

Result: 大量实验表明DECO在定位性能上优于现有方法，且可灵活集成不同的深度模型、特征检测器和匹配器。

Conclusion: 通过深度引导的共视性推理，DECO有效解决了低空无人机视觉定位中正交参考地图缺失垂直结构信息导致的关键点冗余匹配问题，提升了PnP位姿估计的准确性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly require robust visual localization in GNSS-denied environments. A common solution estimates UAV poses by matching keypoints between UAV images and geo-tagged orthographic reference maps derived from satellite or aerial imagery, followed by Perspective-\(n\)-Point (PnP) pose solving. However, such reference maps mainly record top-down surfaces such as roofs and ground planes, while vertical structures such as facades and walls are often compressed or missing. Consequently, many visually distinctive keypoints in low-altitude UAV images have no valid counterparts in the reference map, leading to redundant matches and inaccurate pose estimation. To address this issue, we propose DECO, a DEpth-guided CO-visibility reasoning framework for low-altitude UAV visual localization. DECO uses monocular depth priors to infer local surface geometry and estimate co-visible regions between UAV images and the reference map. Based on this prior, a Geometry-Saliency Coupled Co-visibility Score is introduced to jointly consider geometric co-visibility and detector saliency for keypoint ranking. In this way, DECO retains keypoints that are both visually distinctive and geometrically co-visible, improving feature matching and PnP-based pose estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DECO achieves superior localization performance and can be integrated with different depth models, feature detectors, and matchers. The source code will be available at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/DECO.

</details>


### [246] [Targeted Iterative Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22299)
*Freddie Åström,Michael Felsberg,George Baravdish,Claes Lundström*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新颖的非线性扩散去噪方案，它源于在由应用场景确定的值空间中的线性扩散过程，并证明其在应用驱动的变换空间中优于现有非线性扩散技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像去噪结果的评估高度依赖于具体应用领域（如图像压缩、静态图像采集、医学图像），不同场景对去噪方法的行为要求完全不同，而现有方法难以针对性地适应不同应用需求。

Method: 提出一种从应用驱动的线性扩散过程推导出的非线性扩散方案：首先在由具体应用确定的值空间（变换空间）中执行线性扩散，再将其转化为非线性扩散形式，使扩散行为与应用场景相匹配。

Result: 实验表明，在应用驱动的变换空间中进行线性扩散，其去噪效果优于现有的非线性扩散技术。

Conclusion: 应用驱动的变换空间线性扩散方法是一种有效的去噪方案，能够根据不同应用场景定制扩散行为，在性能上超越传统非线性扩散方法。

Abstract: The assessment of image denoising results depends on the respective application area, i.e. image compression, still-image acquisition, and medical images require entirely different behavior of the applied denoising method. In this paper we propose a novel, nonlinear diffusion scheme that is derived from a linear diffusion process in a value space determined by the application. We show that application-driven linear diffusion in the transformed space compares favorably with existing nonlinear diffusion techniques.

</details>


### [247] [Self-Calibrating Dense Displacement Fields for Reliable Co-Registration of Large Optical Satellite Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22300)
*Shoukun Sun,Zhe Wang,Sanaz Salati,Jiyin Zhang,Hui Wang,Xiaogang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SCDF（自校准位移场），一种无需训练、无需GPU的图像配准方法。其运动模型即稠密逐像素位移场本身，通过"预测-测量-滤波"循环在分辨率金字塔上运行，参数阈值由图像对自身校准，无需数据集级调参。实验表明其在584对真实图像上零失败，配准精度显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多时相、多传感器光学卫星影像的共配准（co-registration）是变化检测、时间序列和数据融合的基础，但现有操作产品仍存在远超像素级以下的系统性配准误差。现有工具将运动模型和常量嵌入其开发数据的分布中，当数据对不符合该模型时，要么失败要么返回数十像素误差而不报告失败；学习型匹配器则依赖GPU且对训练分布外数据无精度保证。

Method: SCDF采用稠密逐像素位移场作为运动模型，确保任何场景运动都在模型内。方法在分辨率金字塔上执行单一的"预测-测量-滤波"循环：累积位移场预测移动影像每个patch在参考影像中的位置；RootSIFT匹配和相关性通过（correlation pass）以亚像素精度测量该处位移；所有滤波阈值均由图像对自身校准（self-calibrating），而非依赖预设常数。该方法无需训练、无需GPU，单一配置即可处理8192^2大小的完整场景。

Result: 在584对基于真实Sentinel-2、Landsat-8/9和NAIP影像构建的真实地真值对上进行评估，SCDF与七个经典基线和两个零样本预训练匹配器对比：SCDF对所有图像对实现零失败配准，将最佳基线的真实图像对中位端点误差从6.83米降至4.17米，并将第90百分位误差从17.8米降至7.77米。

Conclusion: SCDF通过将运动模型泛化为稠密逐像素位移场并引入自校准机制，在无需训练和GPU的条件下实现了比现有方法更高精度、零失败的配准性能，且对任意图像对无需数据集级调参，适用于多传感器、多时相光学卫星影像配准任务。

Abstract: Co-registration underlies nearly every multi-temporal and multi-sensor use of optical satellite imagery, and operational products still carry documented offsets well above the fraction-of-a-pixel scale at which change detection, time series, and data fusion degrade. Real image pairs differ along several axes at once (sensor response, scene content, viewing geometry, resolution, mosaic seams), and the last of these is not a single global motion. Existing tools embed a motion model and constants tuned to their development data; a pair that fits is registered precisely, while one that does not either fails to match or returns a result wrong by tens of pixels with no failure reported. Learned matchers add a GPU requirement and carry no accuracy guarantee outside their training distribution. We present SCDF (self-calibrating displacement fields), a training-free, GPU-free estimator whose motion model is the dense per-pixel displacement field itself, so no scene motion falls outside the model. A single predict--measure--filter loop runs over a resolution pyramid: the accumulated field predicts where each patch of the moving image falls in the reference, RootSIFT matching and a correlation pass measure the displacement there to sub-pixel precision, and filters whose thresholds are all calibrated on the image pair itself decide what survives. One configuration, with no per-dataset tuning, processes full $8192^2$ scenes on a single CPU core. On 584 constructed-ground-truth pairs built from real Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and NAIP imagery, against seven classical baselines and two zero-shot pretrained matchers, SCDF registers every pair with zero failures, reduces the best baseline's real-pair median end-point error from 6.83 to 4.17m, and cuts its 90th percentile from 17.8 to 7.77m.

</details>


### [248] [On Tensor-Based PDEs and their Corresponding Variational Formulations with Application to Color Image Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22302)
*Freddie Åström,George Baravdish,Michael Felsberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了偏微分方程（PDE）何时可以作为某个能量泛函（由数据项和平滑项组成）的欧拉-拉格朗日（E-L）方程，给出了PDE能成为对应泛函E-L方程的必要条件，并将该能量泛函应用于彩色图像去噪问题，实验表明其性能优于当前最先进的彩色图像去噪方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索PDE与变分能量泛函之间的理论联系，即何时一个PDE可以被视为某个能量泛函的E-L方程，从而为图像处理任务（尤其是彩色图像去噪）提供理论基础和新的求解框架。

Method: 通过推导PDE成为能量泛函（由数据项和平滑项组成）E-L方程的必要条件，构建对应的能量泛函，并将其应用于彩色图像去噪；通过实验与最先进的彩色图像去噪方法进行比较评估。

Result: 该方法在彩色图像去噪方面与当前最先进的彩色图像去噪技术相比表现更好，具有竞争优势。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上阐明了PDE作为能量泛函E-L方程的必要条件，并将所构建的能量泛函成功应用于彩色图像去噪，验证了该方法的有效性和先进性。

Abstract: The case when a partial differential equation (PDE) can be considered as an Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation of an energy functional, consisting of a data term and a smoothness term is investigated. We show the necessary conditions for a PDE to be the E-L equation for a corresponding functional. This energy functional is applied to a color image denoising problem and it is shown that the method compares favorably to current state-of-the-art color image denoising techniques.

</details>


### [249] [Adapting Dense Vision-Language Relationships for Multi-label Classification with Partial Label](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22313)
*Cheng Chen,Yifan Zhao,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出语言驱动的密集语义适配器（LDSA），利用CLIP多模态预训练模型中的先验自适应关系，解决不完整标注下的多标签图像分类任务，实现最新最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖统计先验来恢复部分标注中缺失的语义，但统计先验容易产生不稳定的语义错误，导致灾难性过拟合。因此需要更鲁棒的先验来源来缓解这一挑战。

Method: 提出LDSA方法，包含两个核心模块：(1) 密集对比适配器，构建密集视觉对比约束，将任务特定知识迁移到视觉域；(2) 语言驱动的交互解码器，结合类别特定提示调优，使语言代理与视觉域自适应地交互协作。

Result: 在公开多标签分类基准上取得最新最优（SOTA）结果；可解释性分析表明LDSA能够通过先验自适应学习方案发现隐式语义关系。

Conclusion: LDSA通过挖掘CLIP多模态预训练模型中的先验自适应关系，有效避免了统计先验导致的语义错误和过拟合问题，为不完整标注下的多标签分类提供了新思路。

Abstract: Learning multi-label image classification with incomplete annotations is a challenging task that has been widely studied for its superior trade-off between high efficiency and less labor consumption on large-scale datasets. Predominant methods rely on strong prior assumptions to recover the missing semantics from partial annotations. However, these statistic priors suffer from unstable semantic mistakes and thus lead to catastrophic overfitting. Toward this end, we propose a Language-driven Dense Semantic Adaptor (LDSA) that excavates prior-adaptive relationships from multimodal pretrained CLIP models. In our approach, the densely contrastive adaptor is first proposed to construct dense visual contrastive constraints, transferring the task-specific knowledge to visual domains. We then propose a language-driven interactive decoder with the help of class-specific prompt tuning, which adapts language proxies with visual domains. With the collaborative learning of proposed modules, experimental results demonstrate our proposed LDSA achieves a new state of the art on public multi-label classification benchmarks, and interpretable analyses reveal that our LDSA discovers implicit semantic relationships with the prior-adaptive learning scheme.

</details>


### [250] [On the Choice of Tensor Estimation for Corner Detection, Optical Flow and Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22314)
*Freddie Åström,Michael Felsberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将梯度能量张量（Gradient Energy Tensor）作为结构张量（Structure Tensor）的替代方案，应用于角点检测、光流估计和图像增强等常见图像处理任务。实验结果表明，该方法可在GPU上实现实时张量图像增强，帧率提升40%且图像质量无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多图像处理方法（如角点检测、光流和迭代增强）都依赖图像张量，而传统上这些张量通常通过结构张量估计。作者希望探索梯度能量张量是否能在多种应用场景中作为结构张量的有效替代，从而带来性能提升。

Method: 作者将梯度能量张量应用于三类典型的图像问题——角点检测、光流估计和图像增强，并与传统结构张量的方法进行对比实验。在图像增强方面，利用GPU并行计算能力实现基于梯度能量张量的实时处理。

Result: 实验结果表明，梯度能量张量可在角点检测、光流和图像增强等多个任务中有效替代结构张量。特别地，在GPU上实现了基于梯度能量张量的实时图像增强，帧率提高了40%，同时没有图像质量损失。

Conclusion: 梯度能量张量是结构张量的可行替代方案，在多个图像处理任务中表现良好，并且通过GPU加速可以实现实时性能提升，为张量驱动的图像处理方法提供了新的高效选择。

Abstract: Many image processing methods such as corner detection, optical flow and iterative enhancement make use of image tensors. Generally, these tensors are estimated using the structure tensor. In this work we show that the gradient energy tensor can be used as an alternative to the structure tensor in several cases. We apply the gradient energy tensor to common image problem applications such as corner detection, optical flow and image enhancement. Our experimental results suggest that the gradient energy tensor enables real-time tensor-based image enhancement using the graphical processing unit (GPU) and we obtain 40% increase of frame rate without loss of image quality.

</details>


### [251] [MedReaMM: Evaluating Large Multimodal Models on Expert-Level Clinical Diagnostic Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22323)
*Lai Wei,Yuchao Chen,Zhenbiao Cao,Xiaojin Zhang,Zhongyu Wei,Bangting Wang,Wei Chen,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MedReaMM基准，用于评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）在完整信息范式下整合临床叙述与医学影像进行鉴别诊断的能力。该基准包含625个专家验证的病例、1,042个标准诊断（带ICD-11编码），平均每例2.79张医学图像，主要涵盖罕见、非典型或多系统病例。评估23个LMMs后发现大多数模型诊断准确率低于50%，揭示多模态诊断综合能力的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要聚焦于文本推理或孤立的视觉问答任务，缺乏对临床叙述和医学影像的整体整合，因而无法评估专家临床判断所必需的多模态诊断综合能力。作者旨在弥合这一差距，提供一个能真正测试模型在多源临床证据上综合推理能力的基准。

Method: 从顶级医学期刊的病例报告和临床病例数据库中构建MedReaMM基准，包含625个专家验证的病例，每个病例包含详细病史和多张医学图像。所有1,042个诊断均以ICD-11编码进行标准化标注。随后在完整信息范式下对23个大型多模态模型进行系统评估，并分析医学知识熟练度、医学图像理解力和证据整合能力与诊断表现的相关性。

Result: 在23个被评估的LMMs中，大多数模型的诊断准确率低于50%，表明多模态诊断综合能力存在显著不足。进一步分析显示，医学知识水平、医学图像理解能力和证据整合能力与诊断性能高度相关。

Conclusion: MedReaMM揭示了当前LMMs在多模态诊断综合方面的显著不足，特别是面对罕见、非典型或多系统表现的病例时。该基准为评估和改进多模态医学诊断AI提供了重要工具，其分析结果也为未来改进方向（如增强医学知识、图像理解和证据整合）指明了路径。

Abstract: The application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to diagnostic decision-making has garnered growing interest. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on textual reasoning or isolated visual question-answering (VQA) tasks, lacking holistic integration of clinical narratives and medical imaging, and thus failing to assess the multimodal diagnostic synthesis capability central to expert clinical judgment. To bridge this gap, we introduce MedReaMM, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate models' ability to synthesize heterogeneous clinical evidence consisting of detailed patient histories alongside multiple medical images into accurate differential diagnoses under a complete-information paradigm. Constructed from case reports sourced from top-tier medical journals and curated clinical case databases, MedReaMM comprises 625 expert-validated cases with an average of 2.79 medical images per case and a total of 1,042 standardized diagnoses annotated with ICD-11 codes. These cases predominantly represent rare, atypical, or multi-system presentations that demand expert-level evidence integration beyond routine pattern recognition. We evaluate 23 Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) and find that most achieve diagnostic accuracy scores below 50%, underscoring a substantial gap in multimodal diagnostic synthesis capability. Further analysis reveals that medical knowledge proficiency, medical image understanding, and evidence integration are all highly correlated with diagnostic performance.

</details>


### [252] [AcroMELD: Recovering Interactive PDF Forms with Structure-Aware Graph Set Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22338)
*Samuel Abramov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AcroMELD，一个39.4M参数的检测器，用于识别缺失的PDF交互表单字段（AcroForm widgets）。它结合高分辨率视觉transformer与PDF原始结构信息，使用896个查询（视觉proposal、结构种子proposal和学习恢复查询），通过图集层进行信息交换和交叉注意力，配合same-field关系学习和containment-aware定位质量头。在内部测试上达到0.9344的native containment micro-F1，外部留存集上为0.8477，超过了注册的FFGBT-v8基线；但在更严格的外部适配器评估下表现显著下降（0.7786 IoU-0.5 F1，0.2900 COCO mAP），低于CommonForms-L参考，且签名类在选定阈值下无预测，暴露了显著的领域差距和罕见类限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式PDF表单字段（AcroForm widgets）经常在视觉上看似表单的文档中缺失，导致用户无法直接输入数据而需要打印或使用外部编辑工具。检测缺失widgets具有挑战性：一个字段可能由多个重叠线索指示，原生PDF虽提供有用的但不完整的绘图结构，且密集页面可能包含数百个字段。因此需要一种高效且鲁棒的检测方法来识别这些缺失的表单字段。

Method: AcroMELD是一个39.4M参数的检测器，采用高分辨率视觉transformer与无标签的PDF原始结构（primitives）相结合。其896-query集合由384个视觉proposal、384个结构种子proposal和128个学习恢复查询组成。四个图集层在几何偏置的稀疏邻域上交换信息并对PDF结构进行交叉注意力。还引入了学习的same-field关系来链接共指候选，以及一个基于containment-aware重叠训练的定位质量头，该重叠用于下游恢复决策。评估采用hash-bound协议，包含开发、校准、内部测试和隔离的外部留存集角色。

Result: 在内部测试集上，密封单种子候选达到0.9344的native containment micro-F1，外部一次性留存集上为0.8477（95% PDF聚类bootstrap区间[0.8339, 0.8605]），超过注册的FFGBT-v8参考0.0186绝对F1。但在更严格的外部适配器下，性能降至0.7786 IoU-0.5 F1和0.2900 COCO mAP，低于本地评估的CommonForms-L参考；签名类在选定阈值下未获得任何预测。结果表明模型通过了注册的操作门限，但暴露了显著的领域差距和罕见类限制。

Conclusion: AcroMELD在标准评估协议下成功超越了历史参考基线，支持注册的操作门限通过；然而，在更严格的外部适配器和更困难的数据分布下性能显著下降，尤其是在罕见类别（如签名类）上表现不足。这揭示了当前模型存在明显的领域泛化差距和长尾类别问题，需要在未来工作中加以解决。

Abstract: Interactive PDF form fields are often absent from documents that visually resemble forms, leaving users unable to enter data without printing or external editing tools. Detecting the missing widgets is difficult because a field may be indicated by several overlapping cues, born-digital PDFs expose useful but incomplete drawing structure, and dense pages can contain hundreds of fields. We introduce AcroMELD (AcroForm Multi-source Evidence Linking Decoder), a 39.4M-parameter detector that combines a high-resolution visual transformer with label-free PDF primitives. Its 896-query set comprises 384 visual proposals, 384 structure-seeded proposals, and 128 learned recovery queries. Four graph-set layers exchange information over geometry-biased sparse neighborhoods and cross-attend to PDF structure. A learned same-field relation links co-referent candidates, while a localization-quality head is trained on the containment-aware overlap used by the downstream recovery decision. We define a hash-bound evaluation protocol with disjoint development, calibration, internal-test, and quarantined external-holdout roles. The sealed, single-seed candidate reaches native containment micro-$F_1$ 0.9344 on the internal test and 0.8477 on the one-shot external holdout (95% PDF-cluster bootstrap interval [0.8339, 0.8605]). This passes the registered historical FFGBT-v8 reference by 0.0186 absolute $F_1$. Under the stricter external adapter, however, performance is 0.7786 IoU-$0.5$ $F_1$ and 0.2900 COCO mAP, below a locally evaluated CommonForms-L reference; the signature class receives no prediction at the selected threshold. Thus the result supports the registered operational gate while exposing substantial domain and rare-class limitations.

</details>


### [253] [TransHands: Repurposing Human Pose Encoders as Hand Pose Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22341)
*Milo Piccioli,Gianluca Amprimo,Claudia Ferraris,Gabriella Olmo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TransHands是一个骨干网络无关的迁移学习框架，将从大规模人体姿态数据中学到的运动表征迁移到3D手部姿态估计任务中，通过两阶段训练和轻量级手部输入适配模块，在四种主流运动建模架构上均获得一致的精度提升和跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D手部姿态估计面临大规模、多样化带3D标注手部数据集的稀缺问题，而人体运动数据则相对丰富。现有方法需要从头训练手部专用的生物力学模型，未充分利用人体运动数据中蕴含的丰富运动先验知识。

Method: 提出TransHands框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 两阶段训练与微调策略，先在大规模人体姿态语料上预训练运动编码器，再在手部数据上进行微调；(2) 轻量级手部输入适配模块，将手部运动学与全身运动表征空间对齐。该框架是骨干网络无关的，适用于Transformer、图神经网络和频域模型等多种架构。

Result: 在四种先进运动建模架构（Transformer、图神经网络、频域模型等）上均验证了TransHands的有效性。从人体姿态数据中学习的运动先验能够跨架构一致地迁移，带来稳定的精度提升，并展现出强大的跨域泛化能力，尤其在具有挑战性的以自我为中心（egocentric）场景中表现突出。

Conclusion: 人体运动先验可以有效地迁移到手部姿态估计任务中，无需从头训练手部专用模型。TransHands证明了跨领域运动表征迁移的可行性，在多种架构上取得一致的性能提升，并支持真实世界下游任务的应用。

Abstract: Lifting 3D hand poses from 2D monocular representations remains challenging due to the limited availability of large-scale, diverse 3D-annotated hand datasets, in contrast to the abundance of human body motion data. We address this limitation by transferring motion representations learned from large body pose corpora to the hand domain. We introduce TransHands, a backbone-agnostic transfer learning framework that enables pre-trained human motion encoders to be effectively adapted for 3D hand pose estimation from 2D pose inputs. Rather than training hand-specific biomechanical models from scratch, TransHands combines a two-stage training and fine-tuning strategy with a lightweight hand-specific input adaptation module that aligns hand kinematics with the representation space learned for full-body motion. We evaluate TransHands across four state-of-the-art motion modeling architectures, including transformer-based, graph-based, and frequency- domain models. Results demonstrate that motion priors learned from body pose data transfer consistently across architectures, yielding consistent accuracy gains, strong cross-domain generalization, particularly in challenging egocentric settings, and applicability for downstream tasks in real-world contexts.

</details>


### [254] [Fast and Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting with Polarized Opacity Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22344)
*Zi-Ming Wang,Kai-Wen Duan,Kowei Huang,Akihiro Sugimoto,Shang-Hong Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种高效训练框架，通过L2重建损失和新型极化不透明度先验（POP）构建内在紧凑的3D高斯表示，替代传统的densify-then-prune循环，在保持重建质量的同时显著减少高斯数量和训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS在实现实时渲染速度的同时存在"模型膨胀"问题——大量冗余、低不透明度的高斯导致内存占用和训练成本过高。这种低效源于标准的"先密集化后剪枝"范式，该范式在依赖剪枝实现紧凑性之前会激进地扩展模型。

Method: 提出一个协同设计的高效训练框架：（1）L2重建损失提供与误差成比例的梯度以稳定优化；（2）新颖的极化不透明度先验（Polarized Opacity Prior, POP）主动管理高斯种群——将信息丰富的高斯推向完全不透明，将无信息的高斯推向透明，实现自然剪枝并通过早期射线终止（Early Ray Termination）加速渲染。

Result: 在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持可比视觉重建质量的同时，一致性地加速了3DGS训练并显著减少了高斯数量。

Conclusion: 该框架为快速且内在紧凑的3DGS训练提供了一条简单而有效的路径，有望替代传统的密集化-剪枝范式。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality at real-time speeds but suffers from "model bloat" - a large number of redundant, low-opacity Gaussians that inflate memory usage and training costs. This inefficiency stems from the standard "densify-then-prune" paradigm, which expands the model aggressively before relying on pruning to achieve compactness. To mitigate this problem, we present an efficient training framework that builds an intrinsically compact representation, replacing the conventional densify-then-prune cycle. Our method leverages a synergistic design: an L2 reconstruction loss to provide error-proportional gradients that stabilize optimization, and a novel Polarized Opacity Prior (POP) to actively manage the Gaussian population. POP steers informative primitives toward full opacity and uninformative ones toward transparency, enabling natural pruning and accelerating rendering through Early Ray Termination. Experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently achieves accelerated 3DGS training with significantly fewer Gaussians while maintaining comparable visual reconstruction quality. These results show that the proposed framework provides a simple and effective path toward fast and inherently compact 3DGS training.

</details>


### [255] [Multimodal examination answer data with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education rubrics for criterion-level assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22346)
*Jahangir Alam SM,Md Khalid Syfullah,Saad Ahmed,Munira Akter Mou,A K Z Rasel Rahman,A. K. M. Masudur Rahman,Mohammed Sowket Ali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个多模态扫描考试答卷数据集，包含来自4所院校415名学生的485份答卷，配有专家设计的OBE（成果导向教育）评分元数据（12个评分量规、47个标准）。每个条目将扫描PDF与随机标识符、题目、模型答案、标准定义、表现描述、标准分数和总分关联。数据涵盖手写、印刷文字、方程、表格、代码、图形、草图等丰富视觉内容，并通过多种扫描方式引入光照、对比度、方向、压缩和分辨率的差异。数据可用于自动化评估、多模态文档理解、标准级反馈、分数预测等研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集缺乏结合成果导向教育（OBE）评分标准的真实考试答卷扫描数据，难以支持rubric-aware自动化评估、多模态文档理解及分数预测等研究方向的发展。作者旨在构建一个真实、多样且附带专家设计评分元数据的多模态考试答卷数据集，以填补这一空白。

Method: 数据收集与构建过程包括：(1)从四所学术机构的415名同意参与的学生处收集485份答卷；(2)由8位教师贡献涵盖9个学科和12种题目模板的考试材料；(3)构建12个评分量规（共47个标准），每个答案条目链接扫描PDF、随机标识符、题目、模型答案、标准定义、表现描述、标准分数和总分；(4)通过异构源整合、标签与文本标准化、分数验证、标识符与文件名随机化、JSON-to-PDF完整性检查等流程处理数据；(5)进行答案级审计，验证485个唯一标识符、485个唯一文件名、总分与标准分数之和的一致性、分数在量规最大值范围内。

Result: 最终数据集包含485份答案提交，来自4所院校的415名学生，涉及9个学科和12种题目模板，12个评分量规含47个标准。扫描数据保留了手写、印刷文本、方程、表格、代码、图形、草图和图表等真实学术内容，并通过CamScanner、Adobe Scan和常规扫描仪引入光照、对比度、方向、压缩和分辨率的变化。答案级审计确认所有标识符和文件名唯一，总分与标准分数之和一致，分数均在量规最大值范围内。

Conclusion: 该数据集可支持rubric-aware自动化评估、多模态文档理解、标准级反馈、分数预测以及隐私保护的OBE评估研究。数据访问受限于研究用途，可通过向通讯作者提出合理请求获取。

Abstract: This data article describes a multimodal collection of scanned examination answers paired with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education (OBE) grading metadata. The collection contains 485 answer submissions from 415 consenting students at four academic institutions. Eight faculty contributors supplied examination materials covering nine subjects and 12 distinct question templates. Each answer-level item links a scanned PDF to a randomized identifier, subject label, question, model answer, criterion definitions, performance-level descriptions, criterion marks, and a total mark. The 12 rubrics contain 47 criteria in total. The scans retain realistic academic content, including handwriting, printed text, equations, tables, code, figures, sketches, and diagrams. CamScanner, Adobe Scan, and conventional scanners contributed variation in illumination, contrast, orientation, compression, and resolution. Diverse handwriting, crossed-out work, revised calculations, and inserted corrections add further visual variability for robustness and generalization studies. Preparation involved heterogeneous-source consolidation, label and text standardization, score validation, identifier randomization, filename randomization, and JSON-to-PDF integrity checks. An answer-level audit confirmed 485 unique identifiers, 485 unique PDF filenames, agreement between each total mark and its criterion-mark sum, and scores within the applicable rubric maximum. The data can support rubric-aware automated evaluation, multimodal document understanding, criterion-level feedback, score prediction, and privacy-aware OBE assessment research. Access is restricted to research use and is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

</details>


### [256] [Pre-Decoding Acoustic Triage for Budgeted Vision-Language Captioning of Untrimmed Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22359)
*Masoud Jalayer,Changyi Li,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出音频优先的分诊（audio-first triage）策略来选择长视频中的关键窗口供VLM处理，在解码任何视频帧之前，使用最轻量级的音频模态评分窗口，以显著降低计算成本并提升动作覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析数小时长的自我中心视频对进度监控、质量控制和安全性至关重要，但现有基于VLM处理短窗口的流程成本高昂，而之前的视觉特征分诊策略违背预算约束，仍需要视频解码。

Method: 训练一个选择器基于frozen AudioSet预训练特征，以每次动作触发一次（rather than per-frame sound-event detection）为目标，在视频帧解码之前用音频模态对窗口进行评分和排序，选择需要VLM调用的窗口。该目标优化使方法可自然与token压缩或量化组合。

Result: 动作覆盖率在所有调用率下提升4.0-10.8个百分点；在EK-100上以不到一半的调用数削减9-20%的VLM调用量并保持匹配的覆盖率；在Ego4D上247个片段中超过均匀采样；优于两个最新的视觉关键帧选择器。

Conclusion: 音频优先分诊通过在解码前利用轻量级音频模态进行窗口选择，既极大降低了VLM调用成本，又改进了动作覆盖率，为长时自我中心视频分析提供了低成本且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Automatically analyzing hours-long egocentric video is increasingly essential for progress monitoring, quality control, and safety in logistics, construction, and manufacturing. Yet current pipelines that process short, fixed-size windows with a vision-language model (VLM) are prohibitively expensive because cost scales with the number of model calls. To reduce this cost, prior work proposes triage policies to select which windows merit a VLM invocation. However, these policies either sample uniformly or rank windows using visual features, which ironically requires the video decoding that the budget constraints are meant to avoid. We propose audio-first triage: select windows using the lightest modality, scored before any video frame is decoded, so the approach composes naturally with token compression or quantization. The novelty lies in the objective, not the representation: rather than a per-frame sound-event detector, we train the selector to trigger once per action. This objective shift improves action coverage by 4.0-10.8 percentage points across all evaluated call rates, using frozen AudioSet-pretrained features without domain-specific sound-event labels. Using fewer than half of the available calls, the triage cuts 9-20% of VLM calls at matched coverage on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100), surpasses uniform sampling through the mid-range on Ego4D over 247 clips, and outperforms two recent visual keyframe selectors. Code, the reference implementation and every results file this manuscript reads are at https://github.com/masjalayer/PreDecoding-AcousticTriage.

</details>


### [257] [When Do VLMs Help Arabic Manuscript OCR? A Cross-Dataset Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22366)
*Moshiur Farazi,Firoj Alam,Abderrahmane Maaradji,Zakaria Maamar,Hamdy Mubarak,Wajdi Zaghouani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了传统OCR、通用VLM、阿拉伯语专用VLM以及OCR条件VLM校正器在八个阿拉伯语文本数据集（涵盖历史手稿、古籍、现代印刷、多领域文档和手写体）上的表现，提出了"OCR先验可恢复性原则"，并设计了自适应的OCR-VLM混合工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被用于文档理解领域，但在阿拉伯语和伊斯兰手稿识别中的应用尚未被充分探索。现有研究缺乏对该特定场景下多种方法（传统OCR、通用VLM、专用阿拉伯语VLM等）的系统性对比评估。

Method: 在八个覆盖多种场景（历史手稿、年代久远的印刷书籍、清晰印刷品、多领域文档、手写体）的阿拉伯语数据集上，系统评估了传统OCR（如Tesseract）、通用VLM、阿拉伯语专用VLM以及OCR条件VLM校正器。基于实验结果提出了"OCR先验可恢复性原则"：当OCR输出在视觉和文本上仍可恢复时，OCR条件化能够提供锚点供VLM对照图像进行细化。同时进行了额外诊断，考察了变音符号敏感性、预处理、生成预算和重复循环等因素的影响。

Result: 没有任何单一方法在所有场景中占据主导地位。在行级历史手稿上，VLM与Tesseract接近；在页级手稿图像上VLM表现更好；在多种设置中，OCR条件校正器优于单独使用OCR和单独使用VLM。OCR条件化在年代久远的印刷品、清晰印刷品、混合领域阿拉伯语及部分Naskh手稿上提升了识别率，但在脚本不匹配或系统性误导（如Maghribi手稿和真实学生手写体）时性能退化。诊断显示阿拉伯语VLM-OCR对变音符号、预处理、生成预算和重复循环均敏感。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持一个自适应的OCR-VLM工作流，该工作流根据脚本类型、OCR先验可恢复性、长度诊断和失败模式指标来路由处理页面，从而实现不同场景下的最优识别性能。
