A cumulative-mass rule determines both how many and which entries are selected. The selected entries are aggregated into a visual readout and fused with the current draft hidden state through a lightweight gated residual correction. Rather than inserting visual tokens into the autoregressive context, the correction modifies only the representation passed to the language-model head. Experiments across multiple vision-language backbones and multimodal benchmarks show that FOVEA improves draft acceptance and end-to-end decoding speed, achieving up to $2.13\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate that state-conditioned evidence retrieval is an effective alternative to reusing a fixed visual representation throughout multimodal generation.

</details>


### [291] [DRAgent: Discriminative Reasoning Agent for Referring Expression Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22885)
*Yujie Qi,Luyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DRAgent是一个基于多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的判别式推理框架，用于指代分割(RES)任务。它不依赖MLLM直接生成定位坐标，而是先通过检测器构建候选空间，再用MLLM作为视觉语义目标判别器，通过两阶段判别推理机制筛选目标和实例验证，最后用分割模型生成像素级掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MLLM的RES方法通常采用一次性的坐标预测进行视觉定位，将连续的时空位置序列化为离散文本token，可能导致定位偏差和对齐错误。作者希望通过分离定位与判别任务来解决这一问题。

Method: DRAgent框架包括：(1) 检测器生成的候选空间构建；(2) MLLM作为视觉语义目标判别器，通过两阶段判别推理(DR)机制——先筛选高召回候选，再进行实例级验证；(3) 选中的目标框作为空间提示输入基础分割模型生成像素级掩码；(4) 构建自一致性过滤的推理链数据管道用于LoRA微调。

Result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg三个标准基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 通过将定位任务从判别任务中解耦，DRAgent有效避免了坐标序列化带来的定位偏差，利用MLLM更强的语义判别能力实现了更可靠的指代分割。

Abstract: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to generate a pixel-level mask for the object specified by a language expression. Recent methods based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often rely on one-pass coordinate prediction for visual localization, which serializes continuous spatial locations as discrete text tokens and may lead to localization bias and alignment errors. To address these issues, we propose DRAgent, an MLLM-driven discriminative reasoning (DR) framework for RES. Instead of requiring the MLLM to generate localization coordinates, DRAgent first constructs a detector-generated candidate space and then uses the MLLM as a visual-semantic target discriminator. Specifically, the MLLM performs reliable target selection among potential distractors through a two-stage DR mechanism, which first screens high-recall candidates and then performs instance-wise verification. The selected target box is subsequently used as a spatial prompt for a foundation segmentation model to produce the final pixel-level mask. Furthermore, we construct a self-consistency-filtered reasoning-chain data pipeline for LoRA-based fine-tuning, providing more reliable supervision for enhancing the MLLM's discriminative reasoning capability. Experiments demonstrate that DRAgent achieves competitive performance on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg.

</details>


### [292] [NemoSplat: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Media-Aware Underwater Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22888)
*Xiaopeng Guo,Wai Chung Tse,Yipeng Zhu,Hanwen Zhang,Huajian Huang,Sai-Kit Yeung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NemoSplat是首个面向水下环境的前馈4D高斯泼溅框架，可直接从未标定的海洋视频中进行媒体感知的动态重建。它通过Promptable Dynamic Disentangler分离动态瞬态物体，利用Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor联合估计3D高斯属性与物理媒体参数以抵消光学衰减，并引入大规模水下动态数据集，在跟踪精度与渲染质量上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下非受控环境中的场景重建面临严重挑战：介质引起的光散射与不可预测的动态物体会破坏视觉特征。现有前馈视觉基础模型虽在通用新视角合成和跟踪上表现优异，但直接应用于水下视频时，光学衰减和运动干扰会致命地破坏特征聚合，导致跟踪与重建严重失败。

Method: NemoSplat包含三个核心组件：(1) 鲁棒的相机位姿与稠密场景深度估计；(2) Promptable Dynamic Disentangler，利用学习到的动态概率与可选语义文本先验的置信度感知融合策略，有效分离大规模瞬态实体；(3) Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor，联合估计内在3D高斯属性与物理媒体参数，通过单次前向传播恢复无退化的场景外观。此外引入了大规模含大量动态元素的水下数据集用于训练与评估。

Result: 在自建大规模水下数据集上进行的大量实验表明，NemoSplat在跟踪精度与新视角渲染保真度上均达到最先进水平（SOTA）。

Conclusion: NemoSplat证明了在前馈4D高斯泼溅框架中显式建模水下媒体物理特性并解耦动态内容，能够有效克服水下环境的退化因素，实现高质量的动态场景重建，为该领域提供了新的研究范式与基准数据集。

Abstract: Reconstructing photorealistic scenes in unconstrained underwater environments remains challenging due to severe media-induced light scattering and unpredictable dynamic objects. Recent feed-forward visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generalized novel view synthesis and tracking. However, when directly applied to aquatic videos, optical attenuation and motion interference fatally corrupt their feature aggregation, leading to severe tracking and reconstruction failures. To overcome these limitations, we present NemoSplat, the first feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored for media-aware dynamic reconstruction directly from uncalibrated marine videos. Beyond providing robust estimations of camera poses and dense scene depth, we devise a Promptable Dynamic Disentangler that utilizes a confidence-aware fusion strategy of learned dynamic probabilities and optional semantic text priors, effectively isolating massive transient entities. Furthermore, to counteract visual degradation, a Media-Aware Gaussian Predictor is formulated to jointly estimate intrinsic 3D Gaussian attributes alongside physical media parameters, rendering pristine scene appearance in a single forward pass. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale underwater dataset with massive dynamic elements to facilitate training and evaluation. Extensive experiments on our dataset demonstrate that NemoSplat achieves state-of-the-art tracking accuracy and high-fidelity rendering.

</details>


### [293] [AquaFlow: A Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Underwater Streaming Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22906)
*Yingxiang Xu,Kerui Ren,Wenqi Guo,Changjian Jiang,Tao Lu,Linning Xu,Mulin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AquaFlow，一个用于水下场景的单目3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）流式重建框架。它通过微调3D视觉基础模型实现鲁棒的位姿和点图估计，引入介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略，并开发了结合结构化、距离条件神经高斯与物理启发光学模型的混合场景表示，以补偿水下图像形成效应。在62条水下轨迹数据集上，AquaFlow相较WaterSplat-SLAM将平均定位误差降低13.2%，PSNR提升4.74 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单目3DGS流式重建方法在常规场景中效果出色，但在水下环境中因光衰减和散射等视觉退化问题导致相机位姿跟踪精度下降、场景几何失真。因此需要开发针对水下场景的高效、高保真流式重建框架。

Method: AquaFlow包括三个核心组件：(1) 在大规模水下数据上微调3D视觉基础模型，用于鲁棒的位姿和点图估计；(2) 提出介质引导的增量高斯初始化策略，用于流式建图；(3) 设计流式兼容的混合场景表示，将结构化、距离条件神经高斯与物理启发光学模型结合，补偿水下图像形成效应。

Result: 在包含62条多样化水下轨迹（涵盖公开基准和野外网络视频）的综合数据集上，AquaFlow在跟踪和渲染性能上均达到最先进水平：平均定位误差降低13.2%，PSNR较WaterSplat-SLAM提升4.74 dB。

Conclusion: AquaFlow验证了通过将水下物理光学建模与3D基础模型微调相结合，可以有效解决单目3DGS流式重建在水下场景中的退化问题，实现高效且高保真的水下场景重建，为该领域提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Recent monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) streaming reconstruction methods have achieved impressive performance by balancing reconstruction quality and efficiency. However, extending these frameworks to underwater scenes remains challenging due to severe visual degradation, such as light attenuation and scattering, which degrades camera pose tracking and distorts scene geometry. To address these challenges, we propose AquaFlow, a monocular Gaussian Splatting streaming reconstruction framework for efficient and high-fidelity underwater reconstruction. Specifically, AquaFlow fine-tunes a 3D vision foundation model on large-scale underwater data for robust pose and pointmap estimation, and introduces a medium-guided incremental Gaussian initialization strategy for streaming mapping. Furthermore, we develop a streaming-compatible hybrid scene representation that integrates structured, distance-conditioned neural Gaussians with a physics-inspired optical model to compensate for underwater image formation effects, enabling accurate scene reconstruction. We evaluate AquaFlow on a comprehensive dataset of 62 diverse underwater trajectories, collected from both public benchmarks and in-the-wild web videos across various scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AquaFlow achieves state-of-the-art tracking and rendering performance, reducing average localization error by 13.2% and improving PSNR by 4.74 dB compared to WaterSplat-SLAM.

</details>


### [294] [Results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in Conjunction with CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22914)
*Luca Rossetto,Werner Bailer,Cathal Gurrin,Graham Healy,Omar Shahbaz Khan,Stevan Rudinac,Klaus Schöffmann,Allie Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文报告了在CVPR 2026联合自我中心视觉研讨会上举办的第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛的贡献和结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动异步（asynchronous）场景下的自我中心视觉（egocentric vision）相关任务的研究与发展，通过竞赛形式汇集社区力量。

Method: 组织了第一届异步CASTLE挑战赛，作为CVPR 2026联合自我中心视觉研讨会的一部分，邀请参赛者解决相关任务。

Result: 报告总结了该挑战赛的参赛贡献及最终结果。

Conclusion: 该报告概述了挑战赛的成果，为异步自我中心视觉领域提供了基准和参考。

Abstract: This report summarizes the contributions and results of the 1st Asynchronous CASTLE Challenge at the Joint Egocentric Vision Workshop in conjunction with CVPR 2026.

</details>


### [295] [Motion-Based Tokenization for Cross-Dataset Egocentric Gaze Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22926)
*Virmarie Maquiling,Zhuojiang Cai,Enkelejda Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对事件对齐的自我中心视线流，提出了一种以角位移为特征事件条件的运动词表表示，并系统比较了多种凝视表征方式（事件仅、空间、绝对角度、学习向量量化及连续表征），通过多维度评估（下一词预测、目标域后悔、冷启动结构探针等）发现角运动词表在跨数据集迁移中具有低后悔的优势，而事件构建方式（I-VT、原生、帧跨度）会显著影响迁移结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凝视作为视觉和多模态模型的输入信号日益普遍，但不同数据集的凝视表征方式缺乏共识：原始轨迹虽然保留细节但存在噪声且依赖设备，粗粒度事件标签易于建模却可能丢失局部运动结构。因此需要一种既能保留运动结构又便于建模的凝视表征，并对其跨数据集迁移能力进行系统评估。

Method: 提出事件对齐的固定时间窗角位移（angular displacement）作为可解释的、以事件为条件的运动词表表示。将其与事件仅、空间、绝对角度、学习向量量化（VQ）和连续表征进行比较。评估框架结合了下一词预测、目标域后悔、低阶目标参考、配对bootstrap、顺序敏感性、基序重叠和冻结结构探针等多种指标，并在事件对齐头戴基准数据集及第三个自我中心数据集上进行跨数据集迁移测试。

Result: 在事件对齐头戴基准中，角运动词表在一个迁移方向上比冻结码本VQ token具有更低的目标域后悔，反向迁移结果不明确。探针揭示了互补的表示属性；事件仅token表明低困惑度可能保留很少的运动信息。在第三个自我中心数据集上，原生事件的迁移后悔最低，而帧跨度事件基序重叠为零且作为源域严重失败，说明事件构建方式显著改变迁移结论。

Conclusion: 运动基的token化提供了一种紧凑的事件对齐自我中心凝视流表示；评估结果表明目标可预测性和事件构建方式显著塑造跨数据集的结论，为凝视表征选择提供了方法论指导。

Abstract: Gaze is increasingly used as an input signal for vision and multimodal models, yet no consensus exists on how to represent it across datasets. Raw traces preserve detail but are noisy and device-dependent, while coarse event labels are easy to model but can discard local motion structure. We formulate event-aligned, fixed-horizon angular displacement as an interpretable, event-conditioned motion vocabulary and compare it with event-only, spatial, absolute-angle, learned vector-quantized, and continuous representations. To assess transfer alongside target predictability and token collapse, our evaluation combines next-token prediction with target-domain regret, low-order target references, paired bootstrap, order sensitivity, motif overlap, and frozen structural probes. In an event-aligned headset benchmark, angular-motion tokens have lower target-domain regret than frozen-codebook VQ tokens in one transfer direction, while the reverse direction is inconclusive. The probes reveal complementary representation properties, and event-only tokens show that low perplexity can retain little motion information. On a third egocentric dataset, a matched comparison of I-VT, native, and frame-span interfaces shows that event construction materially changes transfer: native events have the lowest regret into EGTEA, while frame-span events have zero motif overlap and fail severely as a source. Motion-based tokenization therefore provides a compact representation for event-aligned egocentric gaze streams, while the evaluation identifies how target predictability and event construction shape cross-dataset conclusions.

</details>


### [296] [Quality Inspection of Printed Circuit Board Pin Insertion via Semantic Segmentation and Board-Level Feature Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22937)
*Nils Rabeneck,André Kiunke,Nicole Hoess,Wolfgang Mauerer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于PCB引脚插入缺陷检测的自动化方法，结合U-Net语义分割、基于轮廓的特征提取和逻辑回归分类，在工业数据集上达到0.990的ROC-AUC，在公开数据集上达到1.000，展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PCB组装过程中的质量控制对于确保电子产品可靠性至关重要，引脚错位检测是一项具有挑战性的视觉检测任务。现有方法在检测误插引脚方面存在困难，需要一种自动化、高效的缺陷检测方案来替代人工检查。

Method: 该方法采用U-Net架构进行语义分割生成引脚分割掩码，从掩码中提取单引脚轮廓表示，进而提取板级特征（如平均轮廓尺寸），并使用逻辑回归对整板进行通过/失败分类。将方法与PatchCore异常检测方法和基于实例分割的引脚检测进行了对比。

Result: 该方法在工业数据集随机测试集上达到ROC-AUC 0.990，在公开数据集上达到1.000，表明能强效区分通过和失败的电路板。在跨数据集评估中（两个数据集视觉特征差异显著），经过数据集特定训练后仍表现优异。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法在工业环境中具有应用于自动引脚检测的潜力，在两个视觉特征差异显著的数据集上均取得了强性能，是自动化引脚检测的有力候选方案。

Abstract: Quality control during printed circuit board (PCB) assembly is a critical step in ensuring reliable electronic products. Detecting misaligned pins during or after pin insertion remains a particularly challenging inspection task. This paper presents an automated defect detection method for identifying incorrectly inserted pins on PCBs. The proposed pipeline combines semantic segmentation using a U-Net architecture with contour-based feature extraction and logistic regression for board-level pass/fail classification. Segmentation masks are used to derive contour representations of individual pins, from which board-level features -such as average contour size- are extracted and used to train a logistic regression classifier. We evaluate the method on two datasets: an industrial collection of real-world PCB images, and a publicly available PCB pin-inspection dataset with substantially different visual characteristics. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach, a comparison against PatchCore, an anomaly detection technique new to be applied to pin inspection, as well as instance segmentation-based pin detection is made. The developed method achieved Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (ROC-AUC) values of 0.990 on a random test set split from the industrial data and 1.000 on the public dataset indicating strong separation between pass and fail boards. The results indicate that the proposed approach is a promising candidate for automated pin inspection in industrial environments and achieves strong performance on datasets with substantially different visual characteristics after dataset-specific training.

</details>


### [297] [WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22950)
*Md. Asaduzzaman Shuvo,Ahsan Farabi,Md. Abdul Ahad Minhaz,Mahedi Hasan,Israt Khandaker,Ibrahim Khalil Shanto,Muhammad Nomani Kabir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WADE，一个包含2,167张孟加拉国乡村水域图像、13,608个边界框和10个废物类别、附有类别级识别规则注释的水上漂浮垃圾推理基准。在零样本、两样本、推理引导和微调设置下评估了六种紧凑型VLM，发现对Qwen3-VL-2B进行QLoRA联合微调可显著提升检测性能（召回率从0.0248提升至0.2339，F1从0.0257提升至0.2163，幻觉率从0.6836降至0.0883），但仍有多于四分之三的实例未被检测到，表明WADE对紧凑型VLM而言是一个具有挑战性的密集目标定位基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内河水道漂浮垃圾威胁水生生态系统，需要在杂乱多目标条件下及时监测。现有水上垃圾数据集地理覆盖有限、多实例标注稀疏、且除边界框和标签外缺乏监督信号，导致紧凑型视觉语言模型在联合定位、分类、计数和解释漂浮垃圾方面未被充分评估，因此需要一个新的推理标注基准来填补这一空白。

Method: 构建WADE基准：收集2,167张孟加拉国乡村水域图像，标注13,608个边界框与10类垃圾标签，并为每类标注附加类别级识别规则（涵盖视觉线索、易混淆物、判别性特征）。随后在零样本、两样本、推理引导及微调四种设置下评估六种VLM；针对资源配置高效的自适应，采用QLoRA对Qwen3-VL-2B进行边界框、标签和推理链的联合微调，并使用检测、计数和幻觉指标进行评价。

Result: 联合微调使Qwen3-VL-2B的召回率从0.0248提升到0.2339，F1从0.0257提升到0.2163，图像级幻觉率从0.6836大幅降至0.0883。然而超过四分之三的实例仍未被检测到，证明WADE是一个高难度的密集漂浮垃圾定位基准。

Conclusion: WADE作为附带推理注释的水上漂浮垃圾基准，为紧凑型VLM的密集目标定位提供了严峻的测试场景。尽管微调显著改善了检测与幻觉控制，但整体检测率仍偏低，说明紧凑型VLM在复杂水域场景下的定位能力尚有很大提升空间，该基准可作为未来模型优化的重要评估工具。

Abstract: Floating waste in inland waterways threatens aquatic ecosystems and requires timely monitoring under cluttered, multi-object conditions. Existing aquatic-waste datasets provide limited geographic coverage, sparse multi-instance annotations, and little supervision beyond boxes and labels. Compact vision-language models (VLMs) therefore remain insufficiently evaluated for jointly localizing, classifying, counting, and explaining floating waste. We introduce WADE, a reasoning-annotated benchmark containing 2,167 images from rural Bangladesh, 13,608 bounding boxes, and ten waste categories. Each annotation is associated with class-level recognition rules covering visual cues, likely confusions, and discriminative features. We evaluate six VLMs under zero-shot, two-shot, reasoning-guided, and fine-tuned settings using detection, counting, and hallucination metrics. For resource-efficient adaptation, we jointly fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B on boxes, labels, and reasoning chains using QLoRA. Fine-tuning increases recall from 0.0248 to 0.2339 and F1 from 0.0257 to 0.2163, while reducing image-level hallucination from 0.6836 to 0.0883. However, over three-quarters of instances remain undetected, establishing WADE as a challenging benchmark for dense floating-waste grounding with compact VLMs.

</details>


### [298] [WildHandBench: A Benchmark for Handwritten Text Understanding that Challenges MLLMs and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22959)
*Jun Zhang,Qiao Zhao,Cheng Cui,Jianying Qu,Zhongkai Sun,Jianwen Yang,Changda Zhou,ZhuoXin Liu,Shubin Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WildHandBench基准，包含500份手写文档（覆盖3种结构、4种语言、9种真实场景），并引入先验驱动误差（PDE）指标来量化模型错误源于语言先验而非视觉证据的程度。评估18个SOTA模型和人类基线后发现：最佳模型仅达71.85%整体准确率，人类以77.09%略胜一筹，且63-91%的模型错误是先验驱动型，而人类仅为49%，揭示了传统准确率指标无法捕捉的系统性语言先验依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准（如OmniDocBench）虽在印刷文档解析上表现优异（96.34%），但对手写文档的处理能力尚未被充分表征。现有基准局限于孤立文本或公式，忽视手写表格与真实世界退化，且仅报告总体准确率而无法解释模型失败的原因。

Method: 构建包含500份手写文档的WildHandBench基准，覆盖三类结构（自由文本、表格、公式）、四种语言和九种真实场景；提出Prior-Driven Error（PDE）指标，用于区分错误源于语言先验还是视觉证据；评估18个SOTA模型并引入校准的人类基线进行对比。

Result: (1) 最佳模型整体准确率仅71.85%；(2) 人类表现优于所有模型但差距不大（77.09% vs 71.85%）；(3) 模型错误与人类错误在性质上不同——63-91%的模型错误为先验驱动，而人类仅49%，表明模型存在传统准确率指标无法捕捉的系统性语言先验依赖。

Conclusion: 即使最先进的手写文档解析模型仍有显著提升空间，且模型与人类在手写文档理解上的差距主要体现在对语言先验的过度依赖，而非视觉识别能力本身。PDE指标补充了传统准确率指标的不足，为理解模型失败机制提供了新的分析维度。

Abstract: While the top model on OmniDocBench now reaches 96.34% overall on printed-document parsing, the ability of current models to handle challenging handwritten documents remains largely uncharacterized. Existing benchmarks focus on isolated text or formulas, overlook handwritten tables and real-world degradation, and report aggregate accuracy without explaining why models fail.
  We present WildHandBench, a benchmark containing 500 handwritten documents across three structures (free text, tables, formulas), four languages, and nine real-world scenarios. We introduce a Prior-Driven Error (PDE) metric that quantifies whether errors originate from language priors rather than visual evidence. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art models together with calibrated human baselines, we find: (1) the best model achieves only 71.85% overall; (2) humans outperform all models yet the gap is narrow (77.09% vs. 71.85%); and (3) model errors are qualitatively different from human errors -- 63-91% of model errors are prior-driven versus only 49% for humans, exposing systematic reliance on language priors that conventional accuracy metrics cannot capture.

</details>


### [299] [Simplified Cross-Modal Calibration for Heterogeneous Event-RGB Stereo Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22965)
*Nico Hessenthaler,Adam T. Müller,Nicolaj C. Stache*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于时间调制的混合ChArUco靶标、在静态场景下实现事件相机与帧相机跨模态内外参标定的框架，无需运动、精确同步或事件重建，相比运动基方法（E2Calib+Kalibr）均方重投影误差降低44%，相比非运动基方法（Plasberg等）降低6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机与帧相机组成的异构立体系统缺乏简单、可靠的标定方法。现有方法依赖目标或传感器运动、精确时间同步，或需计算昂贵的event-to-image重建，限制了实际部署的可用性。

Method: 在标准消费级显示器上呈现时间调制的混合ChArUco靶标：交替显示原始图案与部分混合（blended）版本，使靶标既能触发事件信号又对帧相机持续可见。将事件离散化为与RGB图像粗略对齐的帧，结合轻量去噪后执行ChArUco内外参标定，仅需粗粒度的trigger-based对齐。

Result: 广泛实验评估了混合不透明度、显示亮度、外部光照、视角及手持采集等条件下的鲁棒性。相比最强运动基方法（E2Calib+Kalibr），平均重投影误差降低44%；相比非运动基方法（Plasberg等）降低6%，同时显著简化了标定流程。在机器人eye-to-hand标定案例中验证了实际效用，即使在部分遮挡下仍输出一致的变换与稳定的下游几何测量。

Conclusion: 所提出的免运动、跨模态标定框架在精度和易用性上均优于现有方法，大幅降低了事件-帧相机标定的实践门槛，且代码已公开。

Abstract: Accurate extrinsic calibration between event-based and frame-based cameras remains a practical bottleneck for heterogeneous stereo systems. Existing approaches often require sensor or target motion, precise synchronization, or computationally expensive event-to-image reconstruction. We propose a simple, motion-free cross-modal calibration framework that uses a temporally modulated, blended ChArUco target presented on standard consumer displays. By alternating between the original pattern and a partially blended version, the target reliably triggers events while remaining continuously observable to a frame-based camera, avoiding blank frames and reducing synchronization constraints to a coarse, trigger-based alignment. We discretize events into frames coarsely aligned with the RGB images, apply lightweight denoising, and perform ChArUco-based intrinsic and stereo extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments assess robustness to blending opacity, display brightness, external illumination, viewing angle, and handheld acquisition. Compared to the strongest motion-based reference (E2Calib + Kalibr) and a non-motion-based reference (Plasberg et al.), our approach reduces the mean reprojection error by $44\%$ and $6\%$, respectively, while substantially simplifying the calibration procedure. Finally, we demonstrate practical utility in a robotic eye-to-hand calibration case study, showing consistent transformations and stable downstream geometric measurements even under partial occlusions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/nhessenthaler/simple-evrgb-cal.

</details>


### [300] [Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22972)
*Yiyi Zhang,Yuchen Yuan,Ying Zheng,Jialun Pei,Jinpeng Li,Zheng Li,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MoeCo框架，一种由知识驱动学习的专家混合引导协同优化框架，用于解决机器人辅助手术中的手术动作三元组识别问题，通过组件定制适配器、协调梯度学习策略和知识驱动的专家混合机制分别应对组件级优化冲突、类别级优化冲突和领域知识缺乏三大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术动作三元组识别方法在处理复杂手术场景时面临三大问题：(1) 特征空间纠缠导致组件级优化冲突；(2) 严重数据不平衡引发类别级优化冲突；(3) 缺乏领域知识引导限制了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。这些问题阻碍了自动手术动作感知的准确性和可靠性。

Method: 提出Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (MoeCo)框架，具体包括：(1) 组件定制适配器（component-tailored adapter），将时空维度上的任务特定特征解耦，实现组件专业化；(2) 协调梯度学习策略（coordinated gradient learning strategy），自适应地重新平衡正负梯度以增强稀有类别感知；(3) 知识驱动的专家混合机制（knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts），通过激活专家动态整合多模态大语言模型引导的知识，丰富协同优化管线的表达能力。

Result: 在公开的CholecT45和CholecT50数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了所提出的协同优化管线的有效性，以及通过知识驱动的专家混合机制进行动态先验集成的方法在性能上的优越性。

Conclusion: MoeCo框架通过协同优化和知识驱动的动态专家集成，有效解决了手术动作三元组识别中的组件级和类别级优化冲突，并利用领域知识提升了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性，在公开基准数据集上证明了其优越性。

Abstract: Surgical action triplet recognition constitutes a critical task in context-aware robot-assisted surgery, facilitating automatic surgical action perception by identifying instrument, verb, target, and their association. However, existing works struggle to analyze such complex surgical scenes due to three main issues: (1) component-level optimization conflicts caused by entangled feature spaces, (2) category-level optimization conflicts arising from severe data imbalance, and (3) lack of domain knowledge guidance that limits model interpretability and robustness. To address these challenges, we propose a Mixture-of-Experts-guided Co-Optimization (\textit{MoeCo}) framework powered by knowledge-driven learning. Within the co-optimization pipeline, to first mitigate component-level conflicts, we introduce a component-tailored adapter that disentangles task-specific features across spatial-temporal regimes, facilitating effective component specialization. Next, we develop a coordinated gradient learning strategy to handle category-level conflicts, which adaptively rebalances positive-negative gradients to enhance the perception of rare categories. Notably, inspired by surgical domain expertise, we introduce a knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism that dynamically integrates multimodal large language model-guided knowledge via activated experts, thereby enriching the co-optimization pipeline with more expressive and robust representations. Extensive experiments on the public CholecT45 and CholecT50 datasets confirm the effectiveness of the proposed co-optimization pipeline and the superiority of dynamic priors integration via the knowledge-driven mixture-of-experts mechanism.

</details>


### [301] [ENCORE: Entropy-Guided Cropping and Attention Regularization for Robust Vision--Language Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22996)
*Yuanhao Sun,Huawei Ji,Jiaxin Ding,Luoyi Fu,Xinbing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ENCORE框架，通过熵引导解决轻量级VLM中视觉编码器将图像分割为固定分辨率子图像而破坏目标完整性的问题。包含推断期的熵基裁剪策略（ECS）和训练期的熵正则化训练（ERT）两个组件，在十个VQA基准上仅微调0.14%参数即获得平均1.43%的准确率提升，达到2B参数VLM的最新最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Transformer的视觉编码器将图像分割成固定分辨率的子图像，在轻量级VLM中会破坏目标完整性；现有方法仅关注视觉模态，无法动态保留与提示相关的区域完整性，从而限制了性能表现。

Method: 首先观察到跨模态注意力早层图像-文本熵与答案接地质量和任务准确率强相关。基于此提出ENCORE框架，包含两个组件：(1) 推断期采用基于熵的裁剪策略（ECS），评估少量候选裁剪并选择熵最小的一个，以保留与提示相关的连续区域；(2) 训练期采用熵正则化训练（ERT），在下一个词元预测中加入熵项，增强对关键视觉词元的注意力并降低无关词元的权重。

Result: 在十个VQA基准上进行实验，ENCORE仅微调0.14%的参数即实现平均1.43%的准确率提升，在近期2B参数VLM中达到最新最优性能。

Conclusion: 通过熵引导机制能够有效动态保留与提示相关的图像区域完整性，以极低的参数微调成本显著提升轻量级VLM在VQA任务上的表现，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on diverse vision-language tasks, but transformer-based visual encoders split images into fixed-resolution sub-images, compromising object integrity in lightweight VLMs. Existing methods only focus on the visual modality and fail to dynamically preserve the integrity of prompt-relevant regions, limiting performance. In this work, we observe that the early-layer image-text entropy of cross-modal attention strongly correlates with answer grounding quality and task accuracy. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ENCORE}, an entropy-guided framework with two components: At inference, an \textbf{Entropy-based Cropping Strategy} (ECS) evaluates a small set of candidate crops and selects the one with minimal entropy, preserving contiguous regions relevant to the prompt. At training, \textbf{Entropy Regularization Training} (ERT) augments next-token prediction with an entropy term that sharpens attention on key visual tokens while down-weighting irrelevant ones. Experiments on ten VQA benchmarks show that ENCORE, fine-tuning only 0.14\% of parameters, achieves an average 1.43\% accuracy gain and state-of-the-art performance among recent 2B-parameter VLMs. Our code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/ENCORE.

</details>


### [302] [Coarse Indexing, Fine Evidence: Decoupling Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23011)
*Zhe Jin,Zhimin Lin,Bin Zheng,Junhua Fang,Huihua Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出密度感知图构建方法(DAGC)，一种无需训练的图RAG框架，用于长视频理解。DAGC通过将查询无关的粗粒度检索索引与原始细粒度证据空间解耦，合并视觉冗余的相邻分块构建紧凑的密度自适应图索引，在仅保留40-50%图节点的情况下实现1.3-1.7倍端到端加速，同时保持约99%的原始问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图的RAG系统在构建检索索引时通常继承视频分割的固定时间粒度，将索引粒度与证据粒度不必要地耦合。然而粗粒度表示足以定位相关时间区域，细粒度证据仅对下游推理重要，这种耦合设计是低效的。

Method: DAGC是一种训练免费的方法，通过合并视觉冗余的相邻分块构建紧凑的密度自适应图索引，同时保留到原始时间单元的映射。检索到的粗粒度区域随后扩展回原始分块粒度，用于细粒度证据精炼和答案生成。该方法将查询无关的粗粒度检索索引与原始细粒度证据空间完全解耦。

Result: 在MLVU、VideoMME和LongVideoBench上的实验表明，DAGC仅保留原始图节点的约40-50%，实现1.3-1.7倍的端到端墙钟加速，同时保持约99%的原始问答性能。增益可迁移至不同的LVLM骨干网络和视频RAG流水线。

Conclusion: 长视频RAG不需要在索引和证据推理上保持相同的时间粒度。粗粒度索引用于定位、细粒度证据用于推理的解耦设计在保持性能的同时显著提升效率，这种密度自适应的图构建方式为长视频理解提供了更高效的新范式。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides a scalable paradigm for long-video understanding, but existing systems typically inherit a fixed temporal granularity from video segmentation when constructing their retrieval index. We argue that this design unnecessarily couples indexing granularity with evidence granularity: coarse representations can often suffice for locating relevant temporal regions, while fine-grained evidence remains important for downstream reasoning. We propose \textbf{Density-Aware Graph Construction (DAGC)}, a training-free approach that decouples a query-independent coarse retrieval index from the original fine-grained evidence space. DAGC constructs a compact, density-adaptive graph index by merging visually redundant neighboring chunks, while preserving mappings to the original temporal units. Retrieved coarse regions are subsequently expanded back to the original chunk granularity for fine-grained evidence refinement and answer generation. Experiments on MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench show that DAGC retains only about 40--50\% of the original graph nodes and achieves $1.3$--$1.7\times$ end-to-end wall-clock acceleration while preserving approximately 99\% of the original QA performance. The gains transfer across different LVLM backbones and video RAG pipelines, suggesting that long-video RAG need not maintain the same temporal granularity for indexing and evidence reasoning.

</details>


### [303] [Misanthrope: A Privacy-Preserving Keypoint Detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23012)
*Francesco Vultaggio,Predrag Djindjic,Markus Gerke,Sebastian Tschiatschek,Phillipp Fanta-Jende*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 介绍Misanthrope，一种通过自蒸馏训练的新型隐私保护关键点检测器，通过避免检测人身上的关键点来从源头缓解图像特征的反演攻击，同时在匹配性能上与现有最先进方法持平甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部图像特征易受反演攻击，攻击者可从特征中重建隐私敏感场景内容。在分布式计算场景中，预计算特征离开边缘设备交由远程服务器处理，使该威胁尤为严重。现有方法多采用事后混淆（post-hoc obfuscation），无法从源头解决问题。

Method: 提出Misanthrope，一种通过自蒸馏（self-distillation）训练的隐私保护关键点检测器。核心思想是训练检测器避免在人身上检测关键点，从而在源头（而非事后混淆）缓解反演攻击。作者利用传统特征检测管道生成的反演图像来检测和重新识别场景中的人物以验证攻击威胁，并展示Misanthrope能够缓解这些攻击。

Result: Misanthrope在保持与最先进方法相当的图像匹配性能的同时，能够有效缓解反演攻击。在挑战性场景（如phototourism和野外里程计）中，当人物作为干扰物时，Misanthrope的性能甚至超越现有方法。在Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism测试集上，Misanthrope在9个场景中的7个中是最佳稀疏特征提取器。

Conclusion: Misanthrope通过在源头避免检测人身上的关键点，成功在不牺牲甚至提升匹配性能的前提下保护场景隐私，提供了一种将有前景的隐私保护思路用于局部特征检测器的实际方案。模型和评估脚本已开源。

Abstract: Image matching is a core component of applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), Visual Localization, and Structure from Motion (SfM). However, the local image features central to this task are vulnerable to inversion attacks, which enable adversaries to reconstruct privacy-sensitive scene content from local features. These attacks pose a particular threat in distributed computing scenarios where the pre-computed features leave edge devices to be processed by remote servers. In this work, we introduce Misanthrope, a novel privacy-preserving keypoint detector trained through self-distillation to avoid detecting keypoints on people---a predominant source of privacy-sensitive content in most localization scenarios---thus mitigating inversion attacks at the source rather than through post-hoc obfuscation. We demonstrate how inverted images from traditional feature detection pipelines can be used to detect and re-identify people in the scene, while Misanthrope is able to mitigate these attacks. Furthermore, Misanthrope maintains image matching performance on par with the state of the art and even surpasses it in challenging settings where people act as distractors, such as phototourism and in-the-wild odometry. On the Image Matching Challenge 2021 Phototourism test set, Misanthrope is the top-performing sparse feature extractor in 7 out of 9 scenes. We make our model and its evaluation script available here: https://github.com/fratopa/misanthrope

</details>


### [304] [AnaDiffusion: Anatomically CompositionalLatent Diffusion for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23014)
*Huiwen Han,Lulin Liu,Bangya Liu,Yuanhao Cai,Nuo Chen,Xiaoqing Wang,Ziqian Xie,Chenyu You,Shuiwang Ji,Degui Zhi,Zhiwen Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnaDiffusion是一个解剖学组合式潜空间扩散框架，将3D脑部MRI生成分解为多个解剖区域分别建模，再通过部件到整体的组装和全局精炼生成连贯的脑部体积，实现局部可控编辑而不需要推理时的个体分割图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D脑部MRI生成模型通常整体生成体积，忽视了区域解剖结构，从而限制了局部可控性。用户需要能够对特定脑区进行编辑和生成的能力，而现有方法无法做到这一点。

Method: 首先训练多个部件扩散模型以捕获各脑区的局部结构先验；然后将组装的解剖学部件注入全脑潜空间表示中，并继续去噪过程；这一机制使模型在解析全局上下文的同时保留注入的解剖结构。

Result: 在subject-disjoint ADNI测试集上，AnaDiffusion在FID指标上实现了全脑、左右半球、小脑-脑干复合体和接缝区域的最低值；在小脑的绝对Cohen's d上取得最佳，脑室和脑干上取得次优；局部编辑实验中，配对MS-SSIM展示了高目标转移和离目标保留。

Conclusion: AnaDiffusion能够同时生成显式的部件资产和全局连贯的体积，支持可控的部件编辑，且推理时无需个体特异性分割图，同时保持部件到整体的脑结构一致性。

Abstract: 3D brain MRI generation has made significant advances in medical imaging, simulation, and controllable anatomical analysis. However, existing generative models typically synthesize 3D volumes monolithically, often overlooking regional anatomical structures and limiting local controllability. To address these limitations, we introduce AnaDiffusion, an anatomically compositional latent diffusion framework that factorizes the generation process into distinct, anatomically meaningful regions, followed by part-to-whole assembly and global refinement. Our approach first trains part diffusion models to capture local structural priors. We then inject an assembled anatomical composite of the parts into the whole-brain latent representation and continue denoising. This mechanism enables the model to resolve global context while preserving the injected anatomy. As a result, AnaDiffusion produces both explicit part assets and a globally coherent volume, thereby enabling controllable part editing without requiring subject-specific dense segmentation maps at inference time while maintaining consistent part-to-whole brain structure. On the subject-disjoint ADNI test split, AnaDiffusion achieves the lowest FID across the whole brain, left and right hemispheres, cerebellar-brainstem complex, and seam regions. It also achieves the best cerebellar and second-best ventricular and brainstem absolute Cohen's d values among the evaluated methods. In localized editing experiments, paired MS-SSIM demonstrates high target transfer and off-target preservation, supporting controllable part replacement with minimal unintended anatomical alterations.

</details>


### [305] [When the Edit Changes the Patient: Measuring Identity Preservation in Counterfactual Retinal Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23024)
*Andrea Posada,Wenke Karbole,Bach Ngoc Doan,Alexander Weers,Solmaz Abdolrahimzadeh,Maria Patsiamanidi,Kahkashan Haider,Vaishali Khare,Daniel Rueckert,Andrew Lotery,Sobha Sivaprasad,Martin J. Menten*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三种文本条件编辑方法（源锚定、结构化提示、配对训练）在视网膜OCT图像反事实生成中的身份保持能力。研究发现所有方法生成的图像质量和编辑成功率相当，但身份保持差异显著：配对训练方法保持身份最佳，源锚定方法经常改变受试者身份。作者呼吁医疗反事实生成领域必须将身份保持作为与图像真实性和编辑成功同等的显式评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗图像反事实生成方法大多直接借用通用图像编辑技术，假设通过锚定源图像就能隐式保持身份，但这一假设在生物学特征微妙（如视网膜OCT）的领域可能失效，且从未被明确检验。作者希望通过系统性评估来验证这一假设，并推动该领域建立更严格的评估标准。

Method: 对三类文本条件编辑方法（源锚定、结构化提示、配对训练）进行身份保持的显式量化评估，采用三种指标：裁判分类器（referee classifiers）用于判断生成图像是否属于同一受试者、嵌入对齐分数（embedding alignment scores）度量特征空间中的身份一致性，以及盲法读者研究进行人为主观验证。同时评估图像质量和编辑成功率作为对照指标。

Result: 所有方法均能生成高质量的OCT图像且编辑成功率相当，但身份保持表现差异显著：源锚定编辑常改变所描绘的受试者身份，而配对训练方法最能保持身份。

Conclusion: 未来医疗图像反事实生成研究必须将身份保持作为与图像真实性和编辑成功同等的显式评估维度进行测量和报告，不能依赖隐式假设。

Abstract: Counterfactual medical image generation aims to modify an existing image to reflect a hypothetical scenario in which certain characteristics of the imaged subject are altered, while keeping their identity fixed. Most existing works repurpose established image editing methods, which do not directly supervise identity preservation. Instead, they assume that identity is implicitly preserved by anchoring generation to the source image. This assumption is rarely tested and may fail in domains where biometric cues are subtle, such as retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). In this work, we explicitly measure identity preservation for three groups of text-conditioned editing methods - source-anchored, structured-prompt, and paired-training - using referee classifiers, embedding alignment scores, and a blind reader study. We find that all methods produce high-quality OCT images with comparable editing success, yet their identity preservation differs markedly. Source-anchored editing frequently alters the depicted subject, while paired-training preserves it best. We argue that future work on medical counterfactual generation must explicitly measure and report identity preservation alongside image realism and editing success.

</details>


### [306] [Cultural Moment Benchmark: Evaluating Video Cultural Reasoning and Grounding in Southeast Asia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23065)
*Burak Satar,Zhixin Ma,Cheng Yu-Tong,Huy Hoang Tran,Phuong Anh Nguyen,Chong-Wah Ngo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出文化时刻基准（CMB），将视频中的文化理解分解为三个能力：命名概念象征、在视频中识别概念、定位子事件的时间位置。CMB包含来自东南亚七国的306个专家策展概念，通过三个阶段分别评估每个能力。实验发现最强闭源模型三阶段全对的得分低于30%，三种能力并不完全级联，音频模态在不同概念上呈现互补、冗余或干扰的多种作用。14人专家人工研究表明甚至专家对邻国概念的表现也低于随机水平，证明CMB需要国家特定的文化知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频文化基准将"命名概念象征"、"视觉识别"、"时间定位"三种能力混为一谈，用单一分数掩盖了模型能力的瓶颈，无法诊断模型在哪个环节失败。作者希望构建一个能够归因失败到具体能力或模态的诊断性基准。

Method: 构建CMB基准，包含306个来自东南亚七国、横跨五个类别的专家策展文化概念。每概念通过三个阶段评估：S1从四个候选概念名中选择（含语义相似干扰项），S2从四个候选视频时刻中选择（含未标注视频时刻），S3在另一示例视频上自由形式预测子事件起止时间。通过语义相似干扰项、未标注视频时刻、不同示例视频自由定位三种设计选择确保各阶段聚焦独立能力。在六个视觉语言模型上评估，并进行14人的专家人工研究。

Result: i) 即使最强的闭源模型，三阶段全部正确的得分低于30%；ii) 三个能力不完全级联——正确命名概念对一半模型在视频上的识别有帮助，但识别对时间定位帮助甚微；iii) 音频模态根据概念不同呈现互补、冗余或干扰作用，在非拉丁文字国家中音频更常为干扰因素；移除音频和字幕对"游戏"和"音乐"类别的伤害最大。14专家人工研究中，专家对邻国概念得分低于随机水平，证明CMB需要国别特定的文化知识。

Conclusion: CMB作为一个诊断性测试平台，能够将模型的失败归因于特定能力或模态，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在深层文化理解上（尤其时间定位层面）存在显著不足，且文化能力高度依赖国家特定知识，对跨文化评估提出了更高的要求。

Abstract: Cultural understanding in video means more than recognizing what is visible; it requires grasping the symbolic and temporal significance of cultural concepts. We decompose this into three abilities: naming what a concept symbolizes, visually recognizing it on video, and locating its sub-events in time. Existing video-cultural benchmarks tend to test what is seen, collapsing these three abilities into a single score that hides the bottleneck. We introduce the Cultural Moment Benchmark (CMB): 306 expert-curated concepts from seven countries in Southeast Asia across five categories. We evaluate each concept through three stages, one per ability. Given a description, Stage 1 (S1) selects from four candidate concept names, Stage 2 (S2) selects from four candidate video moments, and Stage 3 (S3) predicts the start and end times of the moment in a video. To keep each stage focused on a distinct ability, we use three design choices: semantic-similarity distractors (S1, S2), unlabeled video moments (S2), and free-form localization on a different example video (S3). Across six vision-language models, failure modes vary by ability and modality. i) Even the strongest closed-source models score below 30% when all three stages must be correct; ii) The three abilities do not fully cascade: naming a concept correctly helps half the models recognize it on video, but recognizing it has little effect on locating the sub-event in time; iii) Audio is complementary, redundant, or distracting depending on the concept, more often distracting in non-Latin-script countries; removing both audio and subtitles hurts Games and Music the most. Our 14-rater human study shows that even Expert raters score below chance on concepts from a neighboring country, indicating that CMB requires country-specific cultural knowledge. CMB acts as a diagnostic harness, attributing failures to a specific ability or modality.

</details>


### [307] [Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23074)
*Xiwei Liu,Yulong Li,Xinlin Zhuang,Xuhui Li,Zhixiang Lu,Haolin Yang,Imran Razzak,Yutong Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. In this work, we investigate two representative model families, LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis. We find that spatial relation prediction follows a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in which object-aligned tokens establish coarse target-reference anchors, while precise bounding-box boundaries are not required. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions emerge, and a small set of attention heads mediates the causal effects of both localization and spatial reasoning. The two tasks share early grounding-related processing but ultimately rely on partially distinct specialized pathways. Through rigorous experiments, we provide a token-, layer-, and head-level account of how VLMs transform object grounding into spatial relations, showing that knowing where objects are is not equivalent to knowing how they relate.

</details>


### [308] [Loopy: Seamless Video Loop Generation via Anchored Looping Shift of Positional Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23090)
*Haotian Dong,Wenjing Wang,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Xin Wang,Di Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Loopy框架，首次揭示DiT中不同注意力层的位置嵌入对时序控制具有不同强度，其中最显著层可作为锚点。基于此提出锚定位置嵌入移位策略，将DiT的时间感知从直线变为循环，实现高质量循环视频生成，支持RGB和RGBA视频以及身份控制和风格迁移等AIGC功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环视频生成方法忽略了视频生成模型如何感知时间顺序以及这与循环行为的关系，导致生成的循环视频质量不佳。作者希望通过理解DiT中各层位置嵌入的时序控制特性来提升循环视频质量。

Method: 1) 首次揭示DiT中不同注意力层的位置嵌入具有不同程度的时序控制力，最显著层作为锚点；2) 将该锚定层作为循环视频的参考点，为其余层提供强上下文先验；3) 提出锚定位置嵌入移位（anchored position embedding shifting）策略，根据各层时序控制效果应用层次特定的移位长度，将DiT的时序感知从直线转变为圆形。

Result: 实验表明该方法显著提升了生成循环视频的时序一致性和视觉保真度，支持RGB和RGBA格式，并支持身份控制和风格迁移等高级AIGC功能。

Conclusion: Loopy作为一种通用框架，通过利用DiT各层位置感知的差异性实现高质量循环视频生成，为循环视频生成领域提供了新的技术路线，模型已开源发布。

Abstract: Looping videos are essential for practical applications such as web graphics, game development, and social media. However, existing approaches typically fail to generate high-quality looping videos due to the neglect of how video generation models perceive temporal order and how this relates to the looping behavior. In this work, we are the first to reveal that position embedding at different attention layers within DiT exhibits varying levels of positional control, with the most pronounced layer acting as an anchor. We formulate this anchored layer as the reference point of the looping video, offering strong contextual priors for the remaining layers to facilitate the generation of seamless and coherent video content. Based on this insight, we propose an anchored position embedding shifting strategy that applies layer-specific shift lengths according to each layer's temporal control effect, effectively transforming DiT's temporal perception from a straight line to a circle. Leveraging this strategy, we develop a general framework, Loopy, for high-quality looping video generation, supporting both RGB and RGBA videos, while also enabling advanced AIGC features such as identity control and style transfer. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves temporal consistency and visual fidelity in generated looping videos. The released model is available on our website: https://donghaotian123.github.io/Loopy.

</details>


### [309] [Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23102)
*Fan Xu,Luis A. Leiva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PeFuse，一个无需训练的零样本组合图像检索（CIR）框架，利用预训练的扩散模型和多模态大语言模型通过生成式转换将组合查询桥接为四种单模态检索问题，在标准基准上达到与SOTA相当或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CIR方法依赖多模态融合训练模块来对齐组合查询与目标，需要大量任务特定训练数据且缺乏灵活性；现有方法无法充分利用预训练模型的强大能力进行零样本组合图像检索。

Method: 提出PeFuse框架，包含两种新颖策略：单向转换和双向转换，将CIR转化为四种单模态检索任务（模态内或跨模态单查询检索）。利用预训练的扩散模型和多模态大语言模型通过生成式转换（伪融合）在无需训练的情况下桥接视觉和文本模态。

Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，将CIR转换为文本到图像检索任务比其他转换策略更有效，达到与SOTA方法相当或更优的性能，同时由于转换管道的组件可替换而保持高度灵活性。

Conclusion: 伪融合范式对零样本CIR是有效的，通过将组合检索转化为单模态检索问题可以避免任务特定训练，实现灵活且高性能的零样本组合图像检索。

Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an emerging paradigm in content-based image retrieval that enables users to formulate compositional queries by combining a reference image with an auxiliary modality, usually text-based. This approach supports fine-grained search where the target image shares structural elements with the user-provided image while incorporating the modifications specified by the auxiliary text. Conventional CIR methods rely on multimodal fusion to combine visual and textual features into a joint query embedding, which requires training modules that align composed queries with the targets. In this work, we propose PeFuse (for pseudo-fusion), a training-free framework that leverages pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models to bridge modalities via generative conversion. We introduce two novel strategies: uni-directional and bi-directional conversion, which convert CIR into four single-modality retrieval problems. These methods reformulate CIR as either intra-modal or cross-modal single-query retrieval tasks, bypassing the need for dedicated task-specific training. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that converting CIR into text-to-image retrieval tasks is more effective than alternative conversion strategies, achieving competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining high flexibility thanks to replaceable components of the conversion pipeline. These results highlight the effectiveness of the pseudo-fusion paradigm for zero-shot CIR. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/StevenXuf/PeFuse4CIR.

</details>


### [310] [Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23136)
*Hu Wang,Hongxu Pu,Zhiqi Hu,Fangzhou Lin,Wang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DaL-MoE，一个与检测器无关的退化感知图像复原前端，用于在低光照无人机桥梁图像中提升损伤检测性能。该方法结合ISP感知的低光合成训练管线、退化感知引导估计以及多专家互补模块（噪声抑制、色彩调整、结构细节恢复），在合成数据上达到23.12 dB PSNR和0.8482 SSIM，并将YOLOv11m的box mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923、mask mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529，同时在真实低光图像上验证了sim-to-real迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光照条件下，无人机桥梁图像中的小型、低对比度缺陷被遮蔽，严重影响了自动化检测的可靠性和操作灵活性。现有方法在低光环境下检测性能大幅下降，亟需一种能够适应退化条件的图像复原方案来提升损伤检测能力。

Method: 提出DaL-MoE架构，包含三个关键组件：(1) ISP感知的低光合成训练管线，用于生成逼真的配对训练数据；(2) 退化感知的引导估计模块；(3) 由噪声抑制、色彩调整和结构细节恢复三个互补专家组成的MoE（专家混合）结构。该复原前端与检测器无关，可即插即用地提升下游检测模型性能。

Result: 在配对合成数据上，DaL-MoE取得23.12 dB PSNR和0.8482 SSIM；在YOLOv11m检测器上，box mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923（+58.9%），mask mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529（+54.7%）。在无配对参考的真实低光无人机图像上，sim-to-real评估显示缺陷可见性提升且检测更完整。

Conclusion: 退化感知的图像复原能够有效提升低光条件下的桥梁损伤检测性能，并且具备从合成退化到真实场景的迁移能力。未来工作将开发低光感知的桥梁损伤检测器，以增强跨桥梁场地、成像条件和光照水平的跨场景泛化能力。

Abstract: Poor illumination obscures small, low-contrast defects in UAV bridge imagery, reducing the reliability and operational flexibility of automated inspection. This paper investigates whether degradation-aware image restoration can improve bridge damage detection under low-light conditions and transfer from synthetic degradations to real inspection scenes. We propose DaL- MoE, a detector-agnostic restoration front end trained with an ISP-aware low-light synthesis pipeline and equipped with degradation-aware guidance estimation and complementary experts for noise suppression, color adjustment, and structural-detail recovery. On paired synthetic data, DaL-MoE achieves 23.12 dB PSNR and 0.8482 SSIM, increasing YOLOv11m box mAP50 from 0.3097 to 0.4923 and mask mAP50 from 0.2281 to 0.3529. On real low-light UAV imagery without paired normal-light references, sim-to-real evaluation shows improved defect visibility and more complete detections than direct inference on raw low-light inputs. Future work will develop low-light-aware bridge damage detectors with stronger cross-scene generalization across bridge sites, imaging conditions, and illumination levels.

</details>


### [311] [A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23137)
*Seungho Eum,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于仿真器的数据构建框架，并实例化为3DTongueQA——一个通过ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型将11维肌肉激活映射到舌头网格、生成结构化生物力学记录及问答对的数据集。该框架从295,157个配置中筛选出295,115个有效网格，每语言构建891,156条QA记录，支持英语和韩语的自然语言化；基线模型达到62.9±9.2 Muscle EM，任务特定结构化读取可达88.7±0.7 Muscle EM，验证了构建监督的通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于实时MRI和电磁发音描记术的发音语料库虽能捕获舌头形状和运动，但缺乏对产生观测构型的肌肉驱动过程的可追溯标注。作者旨在引入仿真器驱动的数据构建方法，以提供带标签的肌肉状态、几何和目标导向变化的密集监督信号。

Method: 通过ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型将受控的11维肌肉激活映射到固定拓扑的舌头网格，转换为结构化生物力学记录，并渲染为有关肌肉状态、几何和目标导向变化的确定性QA任务。对配置进行筛选以保留有效网格，并通过改变表面形式实现语言自然化（英语和韩语），同时用可替换的SpiralNet++-Qwen3-8B基线评估。

Result: 构建了295,115个有效网格和每语言891,156条QA记录。基线达到62.9±9.2 Muscle EM、74.0±0.2 Value Accuracy和65.9±4.7 Direction EM；错配配对网格使Muscle EM降至2.2。锚点留出模型保留80.4-98.6%全库分数。任务特定结构化读取实现88.7±0.7 Muscle EM和93.3±1.0 Direction EM。

Conclusion: 构建的监督信号既支持高效的结构化预测，也支持异构自然语言QA，不依赖于特定解码器架构；通过锚点留出实验控制了数据泄漏，验证了框架的可移植性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Existing articulatory corpora based on real-time MRI and electromagnetic articulography capture tongue shape and motion but do not provide traceable labels for the muscle-driven process that generated an observed configuration. We introduce a simulator-grounded data-construction framework and instantiate it as 3DTongueQA. Controlled 11-dimensional muscle activations are mapped to fixed-topology tongue meshes with the ArtiSynth Badin finite-element model, converted into structured biomechanical records, and rendered as deterministic QA on muscle state, geometry, and target-directed change. We screen 295,157 configurations, retain 295,115 valid meshes, and construct 891,156 QA records per language. Language naturalization changes only surface form and is verified against the source records; English and Korean instantiations demonstrate construction-level portability. A swappable SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B baseline reaches 62.9 $\pm$ 9.2 Muscle EM, 74.0 $\pm$ 0.2 Value Accuracy, and 65.9 $\pm$ 4.7 Direction EM, while mismatching the paired mesh reduces Muscle EM to 2.2; a dataset-leakage-controlled anchor-held-out model retains 80.4--98.6\% of the full-inventory scores on unseen anchors. Task-specific structured readouts further reach 88.7 $\pm$ 0.7 Muscle EM and 93.3 $\pm$ 1.0 Direction EM. These complementary results show that the constructed supervision supports both efficient structured prediction and heterogeneous natural-language QA rather than being tied to a particular decoder architecture.

</details>


### [312] [MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23140)
*Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp,Begüm Altunbas,Jiayi Wang,Yan Xia,Maarten Bieshaar,Xinyu Huang,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出多视角鱼眼图像生成问题，基于体积语义表示进行条件生成。提出了两种方法：SyntheOcc-FE（改编SyntheOcc架构）和MIVIFI（利用等距柱状投影进行跨域学习）。MIVIFI通过结合KITTI-360鱼眼图像和nuScenes多视角标准图像，克服鱼眼数据集稀缺的问题，实现高保真场景内容操控，包括语义占位输入的修改、角色的增删以及多样天气和光照条件的渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶视觉感知系统需要360°全覆盖，鱼眼相机以低成本实现这一目标，但现有鱼眼多视角数据集有限，合成罕见角落案例通常需要计算昂贵的3D仿真。虽然生成模型在标准透视图像上取得了显著成功，但尚未应用于广角畸变领域。因此需要一种能够在鱼眼图像数据稀缺条件下高效生成多视角鱼眼图像的方法。

Method: 本文提出两种方法：(1) SyntheOcc-FE，将SyntheOcc架构适配到鱼眼数据上；(2) MIVIFI（multi-view fisheye），利用等距柱状投影（Equirectangular Projections）进行跨域学习，通过KITTI-360鱼眼图像与nuScenes多视角标准图像的跨域桥接来弥补鱼眼数据集稀缺问题。框架支持对语义占据输入进行结构修改以引入或消除特定角色，并能渲染多样气象条件和光照场景。

Result: 定量和定性实验表明，两种方法均能实现稳健的照片级真实感多视角鱼眼图像生成，并且跨域策略（MIVIFI）在处理数据稀缺性方面展现出特定的优势。

Conclusion: 本文正式引入了以体积语义表示为条件的多视角鱼眼图像生成这一新问题，并通过跨域学习策略有效克服了鱼眼数据集稀缺的限制，为自动驾驶场景中低成本、可操控的360°视觉数据合成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Achieving 360° coverage is critical for the visual perception systems of autonomous vehicles. Fisheye cameras offer a cost-effective solution by enabling full surround coverage with as few as two sensors. However, existing multi-view fisheye datasets are limited, and synthesizing rare corner cases typically requires computationally expensive 3D simulations, hindering the training. While generative models have achieved significant success in standard perspective imagery, their application to wide-angle distortion remains unexplored. In this work, we formally introduce the novel problem of multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantic representations and present two distinct methods. We first propose SyntheOcc-FE, which adapts the SyntheOcc architecture to fisheye data. While effective, this method is constrained by the scarcity of fisheye datasets, which limits its generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose our second method, MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye), which leverages cross-domain learning with Equirectangular Projections. By bridging the gap between dataset domains using KITTI-360 fisheye images alongside nuScenes multi-view standard images, our approach enables high-fidelity manipulation of scene content. This framework enables the structural modification of semantic occupancy inputs to introduce or eliminate specific actors and facilitates the rendering of diverse meteorological conditions and illumination scenarios absent in the limited fisheye datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our methods achieve robust photorealistic multi-view fisheye image generation and highlight the specific advantages of our cross-domain strategy for handling data scarcity.

</details>


### [313] [How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23142)
*Simon Ravé,Pejman Rasti,David Rousseau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对训练-free的token合并方法（ToMe和Mutual Pair Merging）在基于视觉的小麦表型分析任务（生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、麦穗器官分割）中进行了系统基准测试，在任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和峰值GPU内存方面进行评估，并额外在Raspberry Pi 5上进行测量。结果发现分类任务对token合并高度容忍，而检测和分割任务受重复实例、细薄器官、密集边界等限制；优化后的注意力后端可能抵消表面上的加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉小麦表型分析需要在部署约束下进行重复测量，涵盖生长阶段识别、麦穗计数和器官分割等任务。虽然Plain ViT提供了统一架构，但二次复杂度注意力限制了高通量和边缘推理。训练-free的token合并方法具有吸引力（可直接插入训练好的模型而无需重训练），但目前缺乏对这些方法在小麦表型分析各任务上的系统性评估。

Method: 对ToMe（Token Merging）和Mutual Pair Merging两种训练-free token合并方法进行系统基准测试，覆盖生长阶段分类、麦穗检测和麦穗器官分割三个任务。评测维度包括任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和峰值GPU内存，并额外在Raspberry Pi 5上进行部署测量，以评估边缘推理场景下的实际性能。

Result: 基准测试揭示了清晰的能力层次：分类任务对token合并高度容忍，而检测和分割任务则受限于重复实例、细薄器官、密集边界、重建需求和运行时开销。此外，优化后的注意力后端可以消除token合并带来的表面加速收益，表明部署价值必须在实际目标运行时上进行性能剖析，而非仅仅依据token数量推断。

Conclusion: 训练-free token合并方法在小麦表型分析中的实用性因任务而异：分类场景可安全合并token以提升效率，但检测和分割场景需谨慎。部署时必须在具体目标硬件上实测性能，而非依赖token数量等间接指标来判断加速效果。

Abstract: Vision-based wheat phenotyping requires repeated measurements under deployment constraints, from growth-stage recognition to wheat-head counting and organ segmentation. Plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide a common architecture for these tasks, but quadratic attention limits high-throughput and edge inference. Training-free token merging is attractive because it can be inserted into trained models without retraining. We provide a systematic benchmark of ToMe and Mutual Pair Merging across growth-stage classification, wheat-head detection, and wheat-organ segmentation, measuring task quality, throughput, token count, and peak GPU memory, with additional Raspberry Pi 5 measurements. The benchmark reveals a clear hierarchy: classification is highly merge-tolerant, while detection and segmentation are constrained by repeated instances, thin organs, dense boundaries, reconstruction, and runtime overhead. Optimized attention backends can erase apparent speedups, so deployment value must be profiled on the target runtime rather than inferred from token count.

</details>


### [314] [An end-to-end-trained vision-language model for native-language prostate pathology report generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23143)
*Christian Grashei,Fabian Gülhan,Maximilian Legnar,Fabian Stögbauer,Cleo-Aron Weis,Carolin Mogler,Peter Schüffler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个语言无关的幻灯片级前列腺活检报告生成框架，从头训练tokenizer和模型（以德语为例），通过自动流水线利用本地大语言模型将复合报告拆分为核心级别的图像-文本对，获得17,344对无人工标注的训练数据。模型在恶性肿瘤检测上达到96.2% F1，在Gleason分级上达到65.2%，与FDA批准的分类器相当，并在三个外部队列上通过潜在空间增强得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺癌是全球最常见恶性肿瘤之一，对每个活检核心进行结构化报告给病理学家带来沉重负担。现有工具将任务框架化为分类问题，仍需病理学家整合生成连贯报告；而许多幻灯片级视觉-语言模型依赖以英语为中心的编码器，在其他临床语言上迁移效果差。

Method: 1）构建语言无关的幻灯片级报告生成框架，tokenizer和模型均从头训练（以德语为例）；2）设计自动化流水线，使用本地部署的大语言模型将复合报告拆分为核心级别的图像-文本对，利用2,402个历史病例生成17,344对训练数据，无需人工标注；3）针对临床属性而非语言相似性进行模型评估；4）通过潜在空间增强在三个外部队列上验证Gleason分级性能。

Result: 模型在恶性肿瘤检测上达到96.2% F1分数，在Gleason分级上达到65.2%，与FDA批准的临床分类器性能相当。Gleason分级在三个外部队列上通过潜在空间增强得到进一步验证。

Conclusion: 该框架使各机构能够利用自身历史档案训练母语级别的病理报告生成模型，解决了非英语临床环境中视觉-语言模型的数据稀缺问题，展示了语言无关架构在医学影像报告生成中的可行性。

Abstract: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies worldwide, and structured reporting of each biopsy core burdens pathologists. Existing tools frame this as classification, leaving pathologists to assemble coherent reports, while many slide-level vision-language models rely on English-centric encoders that transfer poorly to other clinical languages. We present a slide-level framework generating prostate biopsy reports that is language-independent by construction: tokenizer and model are trained from scratch, demonstrated here in German. To address paired-data scarcity, an automated pipeline uses a locally deployed large language model to split composite reports into core-specific image-text pairs, yielding 17,344 pairs from 2,402 historical cases without manual annotation. Evaluated for clinical attributes rather than linguistic similarity, the model achieves 96.2% F1 for malignancy detection and 65.2% for Gleason grading, competitive with an FDA-cleared classifier. Grading is further validated on three external cohorts with latent-space augmentation. Institutions can thus train native-language reporting models on their own archives.

</details>


### [315] [BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23173)
*Joaquín Figueira,Camile Lendering,Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez,Giacomo D'Amicantonio,Erkut Akdag,Egor Bondarev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BenthicFlow是一个基于条件流匹配模型的统一框架，能够联合生成对齐的纹理和深度图，通过MultiDiffusion启发的采样过程生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克，并利用表面对齐的高斯曲面体将其提升为显式3D海底环境，解决了水下场景数据缺失和域差距问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下3D场景理解面临高质量3D数据缺乏以及表面训练的模型无法泛化到水下环境等挑战。现有方法使用独立训练的模型拼接后处理的图块来组装大场景，但仅能展示单个调查点内的异构景观，缺乏统一的生成框架。

Method: 提出BenthicFlow框架：(1) 使用单个条件流匹配模型联合生成对齐的纹理和深度图；(2) 采用MultiDiffusion启发的采样过程在生成轨迹中调和重叠窗口，无需独立拼接模型即可生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克；(3) 通过表面对齐的高斯曲面体将生成结果提升为显式3D海底场景。

Result: 在地理位置不同的调查点上的实验表明，BenthicFlow能够保留站点特定的外观特征，同时生成连贯的大规模3D场景，并与目标分布紧密匹配。

Conclusion: BenthicFlow首次实现了无需独立拼接模型的统一生成式3D海底场景构建，为水下场景理解提供了一种可扩展且保持站点特异性的生成方案。

Abstract: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.

</details>


### [316] [Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23175)
*Sakshi Goel,Ayush Goyal,K S Venkatesh,Koteswar Rao Jerripothula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）的生成框架，用于恢复光场相机阵列中因硬件故障而缺失的视点图像。通过利用精心选取的相邻相机图像和目标位置编码图，该框架能够以几何一致的方式生成缺失视点，在合成与真实数据集上均优于现有的视点插值基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光场成像系统中，相机阵列的硬件故障会导致子孔径图像缺失，严重退化后处理能力（如重聚焦和深度估计）的重建质量。现有方法对缺失视点的恢复效果有限，需要一种能够利用相邻相机信息、以几何一致方式合成缺失视点的鲁棒方案。

Method: 提出一个生成式框架：首先从相邻相机中精心选取一个子集，将其图像与表示相机位置和目标视点位置的位置编码映射一同输入条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）。网络被训练以生成几何一致的缺失视点图像，实现端到端的视点合成。

Result: 在合成与真实光场数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在视觉上产生合理、光度学上准确的视点重建，在定量和定性方面均优于视点插值基线方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为容错的光场图像采集提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案，能够有效应对相机阵列中的硬件故障，恢复高质量的多视点图像。

Abstract: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.

</details>


### [317] [EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23189)
*Songchun Zhang,Yaowei Li,Junhao Zhuang,Weiyang Jin,Haoyu Wang,Xin Lu,Yilang Sun,Shiyi Zhang,Haoran Li,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yuming Li,Yijun Liu,Yaofeng Su,Yanwen Ma,Haoyu Wu,Zihan Su,Yue Ma,Lvmin Zhang,Haoyang Huang,Zeyue Xue,Anyi Rao,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EchoWM，一个全模态（omnimodal）世界模型，能够响应连续导航指令同时生成720p视频、环境音、音乐和语音。它围绕"相机意图"组织交互，将离散命令和连续姿态映射到共享的公制尺度相对6-DoF轨迹，并通过数据集级校准保持运动量级的一致性。采用互补数据引擎和渐进训练加自回归后训练，实现视觉、音频与轨迹控制的联合学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型大多只处理视觉模态且交互方式受限（如键盘命令），缺乏对多模态（视频+音频+语音）生成及连续导航响应的统一支持，尤其是第一人称和第三人称场景中相机控制与角色动态的建模缺乏通用方案。

Method: 1) 以相机意图（camera intent）作为交互核心，第一人称下解释为观察者运动，第三人称下通过数据学习相机-角色动态，无需视角专属控制器；2) 将离散命令与连续姿态统一映射到公制尺度相对6-DoF轨迹，并通过数据集级校准保持不同数据源的运动幅度一致；3) 构建互补数据引擎，采用渐进训练（progressive training）随后进行自回归后训练（autoregressive post-training），以支持长时序生成。

Result: 在公开世界模型基准上实现了强轨迹跟随和高视觉质量，支持第一人称与第三人称交互，覆盖多种主体，并能在长时序生成中保持环境音与语音的同步。

Conclusion: EchoWM验证了将连续导航控制、视觉生成与音频模态（环境音、音乐、语音）统一到单一世界模型中的可行性，为可进入式生成媒体提供了新的范式。

Abstract: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.

</details>


### [318] [Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23190)
*Haley Duba-Sullivan,Patxi Fernandez-Zelaia,Obaidullah Rahman,Amirkoushyar Ziabari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究能否用一个跨多个成像域训练的单一扩散模型作为多种CT重建问题的通用先验。该方法在三种不同的数据集（不同模态、几何、材料和退化类型）上使用同一冻结模型进行测试，均优于解析重建方法，为异构CT重建问题提供了可复用的基础先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT的通量受限于扫描时间，而高质量重建依赖信息先验。现有的神经先验通常针对单一扫描设置训练，每当模态、几何或材料改变时都需要重新训练，缺乏泛化能力。作者希望探索一个跨领域训练的扩散模型能否同时作为多种CT问题的基础先验。

Method: 训练一个跨多个成像域的单一扩散模型作为CT重建的先验，然后在三个差异显著的数据集上使用同一个冻结模型进行评估：增材制造金属零件的锥束X射线CT缺陷分析，以及混凝土微观结构的平行束中子CT。三个数据集在模态、光束几何、材料和退化类型上各不相同。

Result: 所提出的方法在全部三个案例中均优于解析重建方法，验证了单一冻结扩散模型能够同时胜任多种异构CT重建任务。

Conclusion: 这项工作向可复用的CT重建基础先验迈出了一步，表明跨领域训练的扩散模型可以泛化到不同的CT成像问题，无需针对每个扫描设置重新训练。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.

</details>


### [319] [Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23206)
*YiHsuan Tsai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将球面占用轮廓（spherical occupancy profiles）——即从多视角3D高斯重建中提取的逐射线占用概率分布——作为判别式与生成式3D重建的统一中间表示。在Google Scanned Objects的999个物体上训练了判别式逐射线解码器和基于VAE+潜在扩散模型的生成式管线，分别实现低深度误差与不确定性可量化的多解重建，并验证了其在真实照片上的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索一个统一、紧凑且具备不确定性感知能力的中间表示，以桥接多视角重建与生成式先验，同时支持判别式（单解回归）和生成式（多解采样）两种3D重建范式。

Method: (1) 在999个Google Scanned Objects物体（各48张转台视图）上构建球面占用轮廓作为中间表示；(2) 判别式部分：训练逐射线解码器，将全局视图平均与射线特定图像证据注入FiLM条件化轮廓头；(3) 生成式部分：构建轮廓VAE加潜在扩散模型，支持无条件采样与基于classifier-free guidance的图像条件多解重建；(4) 形态分析：通过后验能量锐化与学习锐化目标恢复宽度，揭示L1逐射线损失族的单调宽度-峰值前沿；(5) 在两个DTU场景上进行真实照片验证。

Result: 判别式解码器在独立90物体测试集上达到归一化中位软深度误差0.035；生成式管线支持与重建流形匹配的无条件采样以及可量化、可调节解散布的图像条件多解重建；能量锐化与学习锐化均能恢复真实轮廓宽度且不损害深度精度；真实照片验证确认管线可迁移至非合成输入。

Conclusion: 逐射线占用轮廓提供了一种紧凑、可学习且具备不确定性感知能力的接口，连接多视图重建与生成式先验，在判别式与生成式3D重建任务中均表现优异，并为轮廓形态门控提供了原则性重定义依据。

Abstract: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.

</details>


### [320] [Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23213)
*Thi Thu Thao Nguyen,Johannes Reschke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于YOLO11迁移学习和ByteTrack跟踪算法的自动蜜蜂入口监测系统。系统通过渐进式骨干解冻策略实现约97.0%的精度和98.7%的mAP50，在独立25 FPS侧视视频中对47只进巢蜜蜂正确计数43只（91.5%），对30只出巢蜜蜂正确计数7只（23.3%）。研究证明适度数据增强、渐进式骨干解冻和ByteTrack参数优化能提高真实环境下蜜蜂入口监测的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜜蜂入口监测对研究蜂群健康和行为至关重要，但小体积、快速运动的蜜蜂在真实拍摄条件下（如运动模糊）难以被准确检测和计数。现有方法在检测精度和跟踪连续性方面存在挑战，需要开发一个能够在实际场景中可靠工作的自动化监测系统。

Method: 本研究采用YOLO11结合迁移学习进行蜜蜂检测，并集成ByteTrack算法进行跟踪计数。实验系统地探讨了三个关键因素：(1)数据增强策略对检测的影响；(2)骨干网络冻结策略（渐进式解冻与完全微调）对模型收敛稳定性的影响；(3)ByteTrack跟踪器参数优化对低置信度检测下轨迹连续性的改善。

Result: 渐进式骨干解冻策略达到约97.0%的精度和98.7%的mAP50，且收敛比完全微调更稳定。轻度数据增强优于重度增强。优化的YOLO11-ByteTrack系统在独立25 FPS侧视视频中对进巢蜜蜂计数准确率为91.5%（43/47），但对出巢蜜蜂仅为23.3%（7/30）。错误分析表明主要计数错误源于蜜蜂快速运动导致的运动模糊和漏检，跟踪失败在参数优化后显著减少。

Conclusion: 中等强度的数据增强、渐进式骨干解冻以及ByteTrack参数调优能够有效提升自动蜜蜂入口监测系统在真实拍摄条件下的可靠性。然而，出巢蜜蜂计数准确率仍然较低，说明出巢方向的监测仍是后续需要重点解决的挑战。

Abstract: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.

</details>


### [321] [BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23215)
*Taqi Hamoda,Hayat Rajani,Nuno Gracias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息自蒸馏框架的侧扫声呐(SSS)图像自动感知方法，通过物理驱动的数据增强和HSIC正则惩罚强制视图不变性，并在DINOv3架构上实现高效表征学习，在S3Seg数据集上仅用10%标注数据即可达到峰值性能的96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 侧扫声呐图像受到物理声学伪影的严重影响，将海底反射率与瞬态观测几何混叠在一起。现有的自监督学习框架基于自然图像设计的数据增强方法，未能考虑声学退化问题，也缺乏显式的视图不变性约束，导致SSS图像自动感知性能受限。

Method: 提出物理信息自蒸馏框架，基于DINOv3架构和ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干网络。通过两种机制强制视图不变性：(1)物理驱动的数据增强，模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射校正误差；(2)HSIC惩罚项，显式地将密集补丁特征与物理观测参数解耦。此外，在四个网络阶段之间采用密集层次化特征融合策略，保留细粒度沉积物细节和深层语义抽象。

Result: 在S3Seg数据集上的监督下游任务中，融合表征展现出优异的数据效率：仅用10%标注数据即可达到绝对峰值性能的96%，最终实现71.4%的mIoU和86.5%的整体精度。框架无需人工标注即可将复杂海底地形原生地聚类为稳定、无噪声的语义簇。

Conclusion: 物理感知的自监督学习框架能够有效克服声学伪影对侧扫声呐图像感知的干扰，通过显式的视图不变性约束和跨阶段特征融合，在极低标注比例下实现高精度海底地形语义分割，为水下声呐影像的自动化感知提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.

</details>


### [322] [MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23234)
*Liangtao Shi,Jinxia Xie,Xiantao Hu,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的音频引导视频目标分割框架，集成多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与基于SAM的分割模型。该方法将任务分解为多个阶段，利用MLLMs的多模态推理能力建模文本-视觉对应关系，并使用SAM系列模型生成精确的目标掩码，在第八届LSVOS挑战赛的MeViS-Audio赛道取得有竞争力的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频引导的视频目标分割任务复杂且标注数据稀缺，传统方法需要大量任务特定的训练或微调。本文旨在探索一种无需额外模型训练或任务特定微调的框架，通过利用现有的基础模型（特别是MLLMs和SAM）来高效解决该任务。

Method: 该框架将音频引导视频分割任务分解为多个阶段，并在每个阶段选用合适的基础模型。具体而言，利用MLLMs强大的多模态推理能力建立文本与视觉之间的对应关系，随后采用基于SAM的分割模型生成精确的目标掩码。整个流程无需引入额外的模型训练或任务特定的微调。

Result: 该框架在第八届LSVOS挑战赛的MeViS-Audio赛道中取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了利用基础模型进行音频引导视频分割方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在不进行额外训练的情况下，通过合理组合MLLMs与SAM等基础模型能够有效解决音频引导的视频目标分割任务，为基础模型在跨模态视频理解任务中的应用提供了有力证据。

Abstract: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.

</details>


### [323] [Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23238)
*Haoyi Zhong,Fang-Lue Zhang,Andrew Chalmers,Taehyun Rhee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mover360 是一个面向360°全景图的可控物体操作框架，聚焦物体平移任务，同时支持参考引导的插入和移除。它通过统一点、框、掩码引导控制，利用ERP对齐指令图和深度条件，基于预训练扩散Transformer实现轻量适配，并构建UE5合成管线生成大规模配对数据和双域基准，在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量上超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与透视图像不同，360°全景图（ERP投影）具有水平环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性等特点，使得现有透视编辑器和用户都难以进行物体级编辑；需要专门为全景图设计可控物体操作框架。

Method: 框架以物体平移为核心，辅助支持参考引导的插入和移除；将点、框、掩码三类引导统一编码为固定提示词和紧凑的ERP对齐指令图；默认单点模式通过全景上下文和辅助深度条件推断物体大小、支撑和光照；基于预训练扩散Transformer做轻量适配；利用UE5数据生成管线（含表面感知物体放置和随机光照）构造大规模配对数据，并建立合成与真实全景的双域基准。

Result: 在两个测试域和两种评估协议下，Mover360在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量上均优于透视编辑、插入和修复的强基线方法。

Conclusion: Mover360有效解决了360°全景图像中物体级操作的关键挑战，验证了统一引导编码与ERP对齐设计在环绕场景编辑中的有效性，并开源代码与基准数据集以推动后续研究。

Abstract: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.

</details>


### [324] [Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23249)
*Amir Rezaei,Wen-Xin Pan,Giuseppe Caire*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究各向异性多静态射频成像问题，将反射角相关回波通过逆问题求解器生成每对收发天线的重建图，并输入3D U-Net进行隐式融合和逐体素语义分类，最终通过聚类和PCA等几何后处理得到目标实例与定向边界框。在信噪比大范围变化下，语义重建和3D检测的退化远缓于经典强度重建，并通过异常值暴露训练的unknown类来处理未见过的对象类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统射频成像的多静态强度重建在噪声下迅速退化，而真实应用需要语义级理解（分类与实例分组），而非仅仅像素强度。此外，多收发对的融合通常显式且低效，需要一种隐式融合方法；同时真实场景包含训练中未出现的对象类别，需要鲁棒地识别为unknown。

Method: 对每个Tx-Rx对使用标准逆问题求解器（BP、LASSO、incoherent BP、group-LASSO）生成单独重建，然后送入训练好的3D U-Net，其输入通道对应六对Tx-Rx对，实现隐式多视角融合和逐体素语义分类。分类输出概率向量，取最大概率类别得语义重建体积；随后通过聚类和PCA等几何后处理获得对象实例及定向边界框。引入基于异常值暴露的unknown类以处理未见类别的对象。

Result: 在受控的子确定多静态设置下，语义重建（以分割IoU为指标）和3D检测性能在宽范围SNR下远优于经典强度重建：检测可靠度在强度重建已完全失效的噪声水平下仍保持稳定。异常值暴露训练的unknown类能正确地将未见的新对象标为unknown而非误标为已知类别。

Conclusion: 结合逆问题求解与3D U-Net隐式融合的方法能够实现鲁棒的多静态射频语义重建与3D检测，在强噪声条件下比传统强度成像更可靠，且通过unknown类实现了对新类别的泛化处理能力。

Abstract: We consider a multistatic radio-frequency imaging problem with anisotropy, in which the reflection from a point depends on the positions of the transmit (Tx) and receive (Rx) arrays. The goal is to label the voxels of a field of view by a finite set of semantic classes and to group them into object instances. For the image formation of each Tx--Rx pair we apply a standard inverse-problem solver, and we feed the resulting per-pair reconstructions into a trained three-dimensional (3-D) U-Net that performs the fusion implicitly and the per-voxel classification explicitly. On a controlled, under-determined multistatic setup, we consider the following image formation methods: back-projection (BP) and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) from a single deterministic snapshot, and incoherent BP and group-LASSO from multiple fading snapshots. For each imaging method we train a separate U-Net that fuses the six Tx--Rx pairs (its input channels) and assigns each voxel a probability vector over the classes. Taking the most probable class gives a labeled volume---the semantic reconstruction. Object instances and their oriented bounding boxes then follow by geometric post-processing (clustering and principal-component analysis). Across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio, the semantic reconstruction (scored against ground truth by segmentation intersection-over-union) and the resulting 3-D detection degrade far more gracefully than the classical intensity reconstruction: the detection in particular stays reliable well into noise levels at which that reconstruction has dissolved.
