Because real scenes contain objects of classes the network was not trained on, we add an explicit unknown class trained by outlier exposure, which labels held-out novel objects as unknown instead of mislabeling them as a known class by reconstructed shape.

</details>


### [325] [E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23253)
*Taoyu Qian,Qi Wang,Daqian Shi,Yuanhao Jiang,Shang Gao,Hualong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出E2S-Pruner，一种无需辅助模型、可训练参数或微调的两阶段证据融合框架，用于视觉token剪枝。它利用Dempster-Shafer证据理论在注意力头和网络层间量化不确定性与冲突，并引入空间新颖性约束来保证保留token的覆盖范围。在LLaVA-1.5-7B上保留128个token时保持96.8%性能且吞吐提升1.96x，并在Qwen2-VL-7B上验证了跨模型泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型通常将图像编码为数百个视觉token，导致严重的推理延迟和GPU内存开销。现有剪枝方法大多依赖注意力分数且直接跨注意力头和网络层聚合输出，难以刻画证据不确定性和冲突，因此需要一种更严谨的证据融合机制。

Method: E2S-Pruner包含两个渐进阶段：第一阶段将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，从证据清晰度和头间一致性估计其可靠性，并将每个视觉token表示为重要、不重要和不确定三种状态；第二阶段利用Dempster-Shafer证据理论量化层间冲突并融合多层互补证据。此外引入空间新颖性约束，防止保留token过度集中在局部显著区域。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，保留192、128、64个token时分别保持98.0%、96.8%、90.6%的聚合性能，其中128和64 token设置下吞吐分别提升1.96x和2.09x。Qwen2-VL-7B实验验证了跨模型泛化能力。

Conclusion: E2S-Pruner通过两阶段证据融合框架有效解决了视觉token剪枝中的不确定性和冲突问题，在保持高比例性能的同时显著提升推理速度，且无需额外训练，具备良好的跨模型泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.

</details>


### [326] [Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23258)
*Yue-Yi Zhang,Ming Gong,Linpu He,Wei-Shi Zheng,Zhilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HetSkills框架，在统一潜在空间中渐进式学习异构技能，用于基于物理的角色控制。通过共享动作解码器和运动直觉蒸馏，实现动作追踪、文本生成动作、动作补全及下游任务适应等多任务的统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于物理的角色控制方法通常针对单一类型技能或单一数据源设计，难以将来自不同数据源、不同监督形式、不同任务的异构技能无缝整合到一个统一的控制系统中。需要一种能够渐进式扩展技能库且无需为每个任务单独训练控制器的统一框架。

Method: HetSkills包含三个关键组件：(1) 追踪技能学习阶段，建立运动控制基础并创建可跨任务复用的共享动作解码器；(2) 运动直觉蒸馏（motion intuition distillation），将文本到动作生成锚定在语言语义上，防止模型利用捷径捷径路径而非真正学习语言含义；(3) 任务引导模块（task-guidance module），根据高层语言指令动态调整动作输出，支持长时程任务。

Result: 实验在动作追踪、文本到动作生成、动作补全和下游任务适应四个方面均验证了有效性，在具有挑战性的条件下也取得了令人满意的成功率。

Conclusion: HetSkills通过将潜在空间作为共享可执行接口，成功实现异构技能的统一学习和渐进扩展，在保持自然运动的同时具备面向长时程任务的高度适应性。

Abstract: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.

</details>


### [327] [Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23268)
*Jieke Wang,Tiancheng Shen,Yibo Yang,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DG-Mem，一个针对冻结多模态大语言模型的双粒度代理记忆框架，通过非参数外部存储（实例级范例记忆+类别级IF-THEN模式记忆）增强科学和数学推理能力，无需梯度更新即可部署在闭源或端侧模型上，在多个基准上表现优于无记忆和竞争性记忆基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿多模态大语言模型在感知上表现出色，但在科学和数学推理上仍存在不足。参数量级适配对闭源权重或端侧骨干不可行，而无状态提示无法利用已解决问题的累积收益。

Method: DG-Mem采用双粒度代理记忆框架：(1) 基于互补学习系统理论，将存储分为实例级范例记忆和类别级IF-THEN规则模式记忆，并配有临时反射存储来桥接两者；(2) 在线概念分类器在训练期间增量扩展类别空间而非使用预定义分类体系；(3) Shapley上下文归因方法将正确性分解到整个检索规则集上，生成每条规则的效用值以在测试时重新加权检索。整个过程无梯度更新。

Result: 在MathVista、MMMU和MMMU-Pro三个基准上，对四个开放权重和专有骨干模型（Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano、Gemini-3-Flash）进行测试，DG-Mem一致优于无记忆基线和竞争性的记忆基线。

Conclusion: 该工作证明通过非参数外部记忆增强冻结MLLM的推理能力是可行且有效的，其双粒度记忆结构、增量类别增长和基于Shapley的规则加权机制共同构成了一个无需训练即可部署的通用记忆增强方案。

Abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.

</details>


### [328] [Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23279)
*Chengqun Yang,Liang Xu,Yanping Li,Fulong Liu,Jingnan Gao,Weili Zeng,Yichao Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为DeMoDiff的统一时空解耦框架，用于文本驱动的人体运动合成。该框架通过空间-时间VAE对每个身体关节点进行编码，并结合空间-时间掩码和注意力机制的自回归扩散生成器，同时提升运动表示的提取能力和细粒度可控性，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上取得SOTA重构性能与优秀的生成和编辑效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动合成方法存在两方面不足：一是表示层面，VQ方法存在固有的信息损失，影响生成质量、多样性和泛化性，而连续表示作用于整体全身运动，缺乏部位级灵活性；二是架构层面，扩散和自回归扩散模型对单个身体部位缺乏细粒度可控性。因此需要联合重新设计表示和架构。

Method: 提出DeMoDiff统一时空解耦框架：1) 设计空间-时间VAE，对每个身体关节进行编码而非将全身运动压缩到单一隐空间，增强表示提取能力并实现部位级控制；2) 在自回归扩散生成器中融入空间-时间掩码和注意力机制，兼顾生成能力与可控编辑性。

Result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上的大量实验表明，该模型达到了最先进的运动重构性能，并产生了优秀的运动生成结果；同时框架展现出强大的时间和空间编辑能力。

Conclusion: 通过联合重新设计表示（逐关节空间-时间VAE）和架构（带时空掩码与注意力的自回归扩散生成器），DeMoDiff在生成质量、重构性能以及时空编辑可控性上均取得显著优势，验证了统一时空解耦框架的有效性。

Abstract: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/

</details>


### [329] [Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23290)
*Antoni Valls,Jordi Sanchez-Riera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Spotter，一个鲁棒且实时的视觉定位框架，利用建筑立面作为全局地理参考源，同时保留GPS信号集成能力。离线阶段通过处理Google街景全景图（语义分割立面、多视角立体深度与制图数据配对）构建紧凑度量数据库；运行时通过级联检索与几何验证流水线实现查询图像的细粒度全局相机定位。在巴塞罗那多区域智能眼镜行人序列数据集上，Spotter优于基于里程计的基线，精度媲美最先进的基于地图的方法，但运行帧率显著更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集城市环境中GPS信号因多径效应严重退化，视觉里程计随漂移累积误差，而地图匹配方法不仅依赖不可靠的GPS先验且计算开销过大难以在边缘端实时执行。现有定位方案在精度、实时性和鲁棒性之间存在难以调和的矛盾，亟需一种不依赖GPS却仍能提供全局地理参考的高效定位框架。

Method: Spotter采用离线+在线两阶段架构：离线阶段利用Google Street View全景图，通过语义分割提取建筑立面，并将多视角立体深度与制图数据配对构建紧凑的度量数据库；在线运行时，通过级联的检索与几何验证流水线将查询图像匹配到数据库，从而恢复细粒度的全局相机位姿。系统保留GPS信号可用时的融合能力，形成多源定位策略。

Result: 在包含巴塞罗那多个街区、由智能眼镜采集的行人序列新数据集上进行基准测试，Spotter在精度上超越基于里程计的基线，定位精度与最先进的基于地图的方法相当，同时以显著更高的帧率运行，验证了其在实时边缘场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: Spotter证明了以建筑立面作为全局地理参考是一种可靠且高效的城市场景定位途径，能够在GPS受限环境下提供与地图方法相当的精度，同时满足实时性要求，为机器人和可穿戴平台在密集城区中的视觉定位提供了实用可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.

</details>


### [330] [What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23295)
*Joongwon Chae,Runming Wang,Peiwu Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于记忆的异常检测器中，覆盖度选择器与稀疏训练污染之间的耦合问题。通过引入CLEANCON（一种跨图像支持门控机制），在固定表示、内存预算、构建器和推理规则的条件下改变候选图像的资格，发现全局覆盖选择会严重过度代表稀疏污染。CLEANCON能将最终内存污染降至近乎为零，并在所有12组匹配对比中提升类别宏平均P-AP。然而，在保留扫描过程中，最低污染的内存并未达到最高的P-AP，性能在污染上升时仍在提升，表明内存污染程度并不能决定最终内存的P-AP排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于记忆的异常检测器将训练补丁存入记忆中作为正常参考，但选择用于覆盖的补丁时并未独立检查其几何稀有性是否足以保证可被信任。作者希望探究这种耦合关系，特别是在稀疏训练污染条件下，不同覆盖选择策略（随机、质心、局部、全局）会如何影响检测性能。

Method: 在固定表示和内存预算下，比较随机、质心、局部和全局这四种覆盖选择器。随后引入CLEANCON——一种基于袋外交叉图像的支持门控机制，在固定表示、绝对内存大小、构建器和推理规则的条件下改变候选图像的资格，从而解耦"覆盖选择"与"污染控制"。

Result: 全局覆盖策略会严重过度代表稀疏污染。CLEANCON可将最终内存污染降至近似为零，并在全部12组匹配对比中提升类别宏平均P-AP。但保留扫描显示，最低污染内存并非获得最高P-AP，性能在污染上升过程中持续改善。

Conclusion: 内存污染程度不能作为排序最终内存性能的可靠指标——低污染并不必然对应高P-AP。这挑战了"污染越少越好"的直觉假设，并表明覆盖选择与污染控制之间需要更精细的解耦与权衡分析。

Abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP

</details>


### [331] [What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23299)
*Joongwon Chae,Runming Wang,Peiwu Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器中补丁选择策略与训练数据污染之间的耦合关系，并提出CLEANCON——一种基于样本外（out-of-bag）交叉图像的支持门控机制，在不改变表示、记忆大小、构建器和推理规则的前提下修改候选图像的资格。结果表明全局覆盖会严重过度代表稀疏污染，CLEANCON可将近零化最终记忆污染并在全部12组配对比较中提升类别宏平均P-AP；但沿保留扫描，最低污染记忆并未取得最高P-AP，性能随污染上升仍持续改进，说明记忆污染程度并不能按P-AP排序最终记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于记忆的异常检测器将选中的训练补丁直接视为正常参考，而不会单独检查该补丁在几何上的稀有性是否足以保证其可信。这种"覆盖即信任"的耦合在训练数据存在稀疏污染时可能被利用，导致检测器将污染补丁当作正常参考。作者希望探究该耦合机制，并提供一个在不改变表示、记忆预算、构建器与推理规则的条件下净化记忆的解决方案。

Method: 在固定表示和记忆预算下，作者比较了随机、质心（medoid）、局部和全局四种覆盖选择器；随后提出CLEANCON，采用样本外（out-of-bag）交叉图像支持门控，通过改变候选图像资格来过滤不可信的补丁，同时保持表示、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则不变。

Result: 全局覆盖选择器会严重过度代表稀疏污染；CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降至约零，并在全部12组配对比较中提升类别宏平均P-AP。然而在保留扫描（retention sweep）中，污染最低的记忆并未取得最高P-AP，性能随污染上升仍持续改进。

Conclusion: CLEANCON能有效消除记忆中的稀疏污染并普遍提升异常检测性能，但记忆污染程度并不与最终记忆的P-AP排序一致——污染最低并非性能最优，提示"去污染"与"最优检测记忆"之间并非简单的单调关系。

Abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

</details>


### [332] [Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23302)
*Matteo Attimonelli,Claudio Pomo,Alessandro De Bellis,Danilo Danese,Dietmar Jannach,Tommaso Di Noia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"自由形式指令下的时尚互补图像生成"任务，引入多模态语言接地设定：模型需根据种子图像和自然语言指令生成匹配的服装。作者为三个CIG基准扩充了低/中/高特异性的指令数据，并提出StyleFlow模型——一种基于Rectified Flow Matching的单一多模态Transformer，联合条件化种子图像与指令。实验表明StyleFlow在图像质量、目录对齐、消融与人工评估上均优于辅助模块方法，且架构更简、推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时尚互补图像生成（CIG）基准依赖刚性模板提示（如"一张裙子的照片"），无法反映真实用户查询的多样性，也掩盖了模型在不同语言特异性层级下的行为差异。因此需要引入自由形式的自然语言指令，使CIG成为真正的多模态语言接地问题。

Method: 1) 构建基准：利用视觉-语言模型为三个CIG基准生成低、中、高三种特异性级别的自由形式指令，并经人工标注者验证；2) 提出StyleFlow模型：基于Rectified Flow Matching，在单一多模态Transformer中联合条件化种子图像和文本指令，无需外部辅助模块。

Result: 在图像质量指标、目录对齐分析、消融实验和人工评估中，StyleFlow均一致地生成指令对齐且风格连贯的服装，同时相比辅助模块方法减少了架构复杂性和推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过引入自由形式指令并以统一多模态架构实现互补服装生成，本文验证了语言接地能力对CIG任务的重要性，表明简化架构（单一Transformer+Rectified Flow）可在保持甚至提升生成质量的同时降低计算开销。

Abstract: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.

</details>


### [333] [Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23329)
*Wenqi Liu,Shijie Ma,Yunxiao Wang,Meng Liu,Qile Su,Han Liu,Bohan Hou,Xuanyu Zheng,Changyi Liu,Tianke Zhang,Haonan Fan,Kaiyu Jiang,Yingxin Li,Jiankang Chen,Xu Wang,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Jianhua Yin,Yinwei Wei,Xuemeng Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究框架，通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览来解决开放世界视频理解中稀疏视觉证据定位与外部知识获取的联合难题。该框架构建了26K监督微调轨迹和3K强化学习实例，并推出了按视频时长和研究难度分层的VideoRover-Bench基准。实验表明VideoRover-8B-RL在无需工具的直接回答场景下达到与专有模型相当的性能，在使用相同工具套件时超越更大规模的开源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界的视频理解往往需要模型同时定位稀疏视觉证据并获取视频及参数记忆中不存在的外部知识。然而，Thinking-with-Videos（主动时序感知）和Deep Research（多步信息检索）两种关键能力通常被孤立地开发，缺乏统一框架来协同这两种能力。

Method: 1) 提出VideoRover框架，统一协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览三种工具，根据每次工具结果自适应选择下一个动作，实现"视频裁剪指导外部检索，检索证据反向促进视频检查与验证"的闭环。2) 构建自动化数据策展流水线，生成26K经过验证的SFT轨迹和3K具有挑战性的RL实例。3) 推出VideoRover-Bench基准，按视频时长和研究难度进行分层评估。

Result: 在VideoDR和VideoRover-Bench两个基准上，VideoRover-8B-RL在无工具的直接回答设置中达到与专有模型相当的性能，在使用相同工具套件时超越更大的开源模型。消融实验和训练动态分析进一步验证了主动视频定位、外部检索和长程强化学习三者的互补作用。

Conclusion: 主动视频定位、外部证据检索和长程强化学习的协同整合是提升开放世界视频深度理解能力的关键路径，VideoRover证明了小型开源模型在该统一框架下可以达到甚至超越专有模型的性能水平。

Abstract: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [334] [IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23330)
*Jiapeng Li,Ping Wei,Wenjuan Han,Song-Chun Zhu,Lifeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IntentQA任务及大规模VideoQA数据集，用于视频理解中的意图推理（"社交智能暗物质"）。为克服标准指标因数据集偏差高估能力的问题，作者通过LLM生成五种对比测试集并引入"对比性能下降"指标评估鲁棒性。提出X-CaVIR框架，整合三种认知上下文（情境、对比、常识），并通过透明管线融合LLM与VQA模型输出，实现可解释的意图推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频理解需要智能体超越视觉事实识别，理解人类行为背后的意图（被称为社交智能的"暗物质"）。现有方法依赖标准指标可能因数据集偏见而高估能力，且传统黑盒模型缺乏可解释性，难以满足意图推理这一高阶认知需求。

Method: 1) 提出IntentQA任务并构建大规模VideoQA数据集；2) 利用LLM生成五种不同的对比测试集，引入"Contrast Performance Decline"（对比性能下降）指标评估鲁棒性；3) 提出X-CaVIR框架，包含三个模块：跨模态Video Query Language（VQL）模块提供情境上下文、对比学习模块提供对比上下文、常识推理模块提供常识上下文；4) 通过透明管线将视频字幕与VQA模型输出协同整合LLM，使推理过程可解释。

Result: 大量实验表明：各组件均有效，X-CaVIR在意图推理任务上优于现有最先进基线，且在对比测试集上对扰动表现出良好的稳定性。

Conclusion: X-CaVIR通过多维度认知上下文的整合与透明可解释的LLM融合方式，有效提升了VideoQA中的意图推理能力与鲁棒性，为视频社交智能理解提供了新的评测基准与方法范式。

Abstract: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

</details>


### [335] [Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23336)
*Eugenia Moris,José Ignacio Orlando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于智能体(Agentic)的AI科学家工作流，将文献引导推理、自动代码生成和假设驱动实验相结合，用于自动生成医学影像挑战的竞争性基线模型。在四个公开基准（覆盖分割、分类、检测任务）上评估，包括PUMA两个赛道（15支队伍中排名第6）和MILK10k（125支队伍中排名第31），并在MIDOG25上展示了良好的跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的域泛化能力。该框架无需任务特定重新设计即可工作，显著减少了开发竞争性医学影像基线所需的工程工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发竞争性的医学影像深度学习基线是一个高度迭代的过程，需要文献综述、实现、实验和专家优化。现有自动化方法通常仅优化孤立组件（如架构搜索或超参数调优），而非完整的基线开发流程。作者希望填补这一空白，实现从文献引导到实验迭代的端到端自动化。

Method: 提出一个Agentic AI Scientist工作流，包含三个核心组件：(1) 文献引导推理（literature-guided reasoning）用于指导模型选择与设计；(2) 自动代码生成（automated code generation）用于快速实现模型；(3) 假设驱动实验（hypothesis-driven experimentation）用于迭代优化。该框架在分割、分类、检测任务上使用统一工作流，无需任务特定的重新设计。

Result: 在四个公开基准上取得竞争性结果：PUMA两个赛道均获第6名（共15支队伍），MILK10k获第31名（共125支队伍）；MIDOG25上展示了跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的强域泛化能力。实验管线在所有任务上持续提升了验证性能。

Conclusion: 基于技能(skill-based)的、文献引导的Agentic工作流可以在不需要任务特定重新设计的情况下，显著减少开发竞争性医学影像基线所需的工程工作量，证明了智能体驱动的全流程自动化在医学影像AI中的可行性。

Abstract: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.

</details>


### [336] [Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23343)
*Imane Si Salah,Emile Cribelier,Thomas Veit,Wolf Hauser,Arthur Leclaire*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SuperSharpen，一种基于扩散模型的盲去模糊方法，通过模糊度量对恢复强度进行显式控制，并比较了ControlNet风格适配器与全量微调两种条件化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业摄影中的图像采集常因光学系统、传感器或低层处理引入未知的模糊退化，而盲去模糊需要对未知的各向同性模糊核进行逆变换。此类逆问题中高频信息丢失，使用生成模型同时保证照片真实性与对输入的忠实度存在挑战。

Method: 提出基于扩散的盲去模糊方法SuperSharpen，通过模糊度量提供对恢复强度的显式控制。对比两种条件化策略：(1) 在冻结骨干网络上使用ControlNet风格适配器；(2) 对扩散先验进行全量微调。

Result: 实验表明全量微调在保真度上表现更好，产生更少的幻觉细节。在合成与真实模糊数据上验证了方法，展示了改进的感知质量和可控的恢复强度。

Conclusion: SuperSharpen在专业摄影盲去模糊任务中实现了感知质量与保真度的良好平衡，全量微调策略优于适配器策略，且所提出的模糊度量能够有效控制恢复强度。

Abstract: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.

</details>


### [337] [DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23363)
*Vlad Hondru,Florinel Alin Croitoru,Iuliana Georgescu,A. Sophia Koepke,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DF-MoE框架，通过从音频和视觉模态中提取多种高级线索（如嘴部运动、面部解析、表情、头部姿态、视线追踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动），并利用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络集成单模态和多模态线索进行深度伪造检测。在五个基准数据集（MAVOS-DD、AVLips、PolyGlotFake、BioDeepAV、FakeAVCeleb）上的域内和跨域实验均超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频深度伪造检测的主要挑战是开发能够跨伪造生成方法泛化的检测器。作者推测过拟合可以通过从音频和视觉模态中提取多个高级线索（借助预训练模型）来缓解。

Method: 1) 组装多种预训练模型提取多样特征：嘴部运动、面部解析、面部表情、头部姿态、视线追踪、心率、音频情感和语音活动；2) 通过Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络集成单模态和多模态线索进行伪造检测。

Result: 在五个深度伪造检测基准（MAVOS-DD、AVLips、PolyGlotFake、BioDeepAV、FakeAVCeleb）上，DF-MoE在域内和跨域实验中均获得优于所有竞争方法的检测性能。

Conclusion: DF-MoE通过多预训练模型提取多级线索并结合MoE集成，有效提升了深度伪造检测的跨域泛化能力，超越了当前最先进方法，代码已开源。

Abstract: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes. We perform in-domain and cross-domain experiments on five benchmarks for deepfake detection (MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb) to compare our framework (DF-MoE) with state-of-the-art methods. Our results indicate that DF-MoE obtains superior deepfake detection results, surpassing all competing methods. We release our code at https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE.

</details>


### [338] [Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23383)
*Nan Duan,Haoyang Huang,Weiyang Jin,Haoran Li,Yaowei Li,Yuming Li,Yijun Liu,Xin Lu,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yanwen Ma,Yaofeng Su,Yilang Sun,Haoyu Wang,Zeyue Xue,Songchun Zhang,Junhao Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JoyAI-Echo-1.5是一个统一的音视频生成系统，包含长视频与世界模型两个变体，分别通过可组合的跨镜头记忆和几何感知条件的度量6-DoF轨迹注入来支持长时叙事与交互式世界生成，并采用渐进式教师强制和Self-Gradient Forcing实现高效的因果少步生成，在长视频和世界模型基准上均取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成正从孤立片段向长叙事和交互式世界方向发展，现有模型在跨镜头身份保持、用户控制遵循以及长时间rollout稳定性方面存在不足，亟需统一的系统来解决这些长时生成挑战。

Method: 该系统提出两个专用变体：(1) 长视频变体采用可组合的跨镜头记忆，聚合多个先前景的视觉证据和来自语音过滤音频的说话人线索；(2) 世界模型变体将异构导航输入转换为校准的度量6-DoF相机轨迹，并通过几何感知条件通路注入。训练上，将双向音视频骨干转化为因果少步生成器，采用渐进式教师强迫和长短时Self-Gradient Forcing在自生成rollout上训练。

Result: JoyAI-Echo-1.5在长视频基准上超越现有基线，在跨镜头一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐和语音保真度上均有提升；其世界模型变体在WBench排名第一（平均分81.7），并在SANA-WM-Bench上取得领先的视觉质量和长时持续性。

Conclusion: 记忆、几何控制和rollout感知训练为生成连贯故事和持续演化的交互式世界提供了实用基础，验证了统一音视频生成系统在长时生成任务上的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts. We present JoyAI-Echo-1.5, a unified audio-visual generation system with two purpose-built variants. The long-video variant introduces composable cross-shot memory that aggregates visual evidence across multiple prior shots and speaker cues derived from speech-filtered full-shot audio, enabling persistent character appearance and voice identity across flexible combinations of text, image, and memory conditioning. The world-model variant converts heterogeneous navigation inputs into calibrated metric 6-DoF camera trajectories and injects them through a geometry-aware conditioning pathway, enabling controller-agnostic interaction across flexible viewpoints. To support efficient long-horizon generation, we transform a bidirectional audio-visual backbone into a causal few-step generator using progressive teacher forcing and short- and long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing on self-generated rollouts. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in both settings. JoyAI-Echo-1.5 achieves improvements over existing long-video baselines in cross-shot consistency, visual quality, text alignment, and speech fidelity. Its world-model variant ranks first on WBench, with an average score of 81.7, and achieves leading visual quality and long-horizon persistence on SANA-WM-Bench. Together, these results indicate that memory, geometric control, and rollout-aware training provide a practical foundation for generating coherent stories and continuously evolving interactive worlds. Project page: https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.

</details>


### [339] [MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23405)
*Ziying Song,Shengkai Zhang,Lin Liu,Peiliang Wu,Lei Yang,Dongyang Xu,Bin Sun,Li Wang,Shaoqing Xu,Caiyan Jia,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MomADv2是一个面向长时域端到端自动驾驶的可靠状态空间记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块过滤与当前指令不一致的历史信息，并利用流匹配轨迹残差精炼器消除局部轨迹偏差与误差累积，在NAVSIM、Bench2Drive和nuScenes等基准上相比MomAD将平均碰撞率降低15.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过时间记忆提升规划连续性，但当驾驶指令变化时，历史记忆可能失效并误导决策。如何在保持有用历史信息的同时抑制与当前指令不一致的记忆，是长时域自动驾驶规划的关键挑战。

Method: MomADv2包含两个核心模块：1) 选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块，基于时间连续性和指令一致性过滤历史规划查询，选择与当前指令相关的规划模式，并通过选择性状态空间机制建模规划意图的演化；2) 流匹配轨迹残差精炼器，从精炼规划输出到专家轨迹学习连续残差修正场，在保持基于锚点规划稳定性的同时实现细粒度轨迹精炼。

Result: 在闭环NAVSIM、Bench2Drive以及开环nuScenes上的大量实验表明，MomADv2提升了长时域规划一致性，在6秒规划场景下相比MomAD将平均碰撞率降低了15.6%。

Conclusion: MomADv2通过选择性记忆过滤与流匹配残差精炼的双重机制，有效解决了复杂场景下长时域自动驾驶规划中历史记忆失效和误差累积的问题，验证了该框架在闭环与开环多种评测协议下的有效性。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.

</details>


### [340] [Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23410)
*Federico Stella,Fei Jiang,Zhongshi Jiang,Zohar Barzelay,Emanuel Garbin,Amin Jourabloo,Liuhao Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于next-scale自回归范式的多视角人物新视角合成方法，能够在单次前向传播中生成高分辨率、多视角且跨视角一致的人脸图像，并可与3D高斯提升模型结合生成逼真的人脸3D模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率、多目标相机条件下的人物新视角合成仍具挑战性，核心难点在于保持身份一致性、精细外观细节和几何连贯性。现有扩散模型依赖2D预训练且需要大量目标数据，难以高效地实现多视角一致的高质量合成。

Method: 基于next-scale自回归范式，将其扩展到更高图像分辨率、多视角输出与跨视角一致性增强，在单一前向传播中完成合成。训练使用包含多样身份和服饰的合成人脸数据集。由于next-scale架构可利用低分辨率通用预训练，仅最后阶段使用全分辨率目标任务数据，因此减少了特定任务数据需求，可选用更小但更真实的数据集。同时支持同时合成多个新视角以增强视角间一致性，并耦合基于transformer的像素对齐3D高斯提升模型用于3D人脸重建。

Result: 在人体对象上，实验在感知保真度和跨视角连贯性方面均取得提升，验证了next-scale自回归作为可扩展的多输出人物视角合成骨干网络的有效性；与3D高斯提升耦合后能生成准确且逼真的人脸3D模型。

Conclusion: next-scale自回归范式是人物新视角合成的有效骨干网络，兼具高分辨率、多视角输出、跨视角一致性和数据效率优势，为可扩展的人物视角合成及3D人脸重建提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.

</details>


### [341] [Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23432)
*Clea Dronne,Catharine H Clark,Xavier Loizeau,Elizabeth Miles,Peter Hoskin,Jamie R McClelland*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文比较了VAE框架与图像条件分割扩散模型在头颈部CT放疗分割错误检测中的表现，通过RADCURE数据集上的脑干和脊髓分割模拟扰动评估，发现扩散模型在定位细微边界错误方面更一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放疗计划中器官危及结构（OAR）的准确分割至关重要，但人工审查分割结果耗时且主观。现有方法缺乏客观、自动化的分割错误检测手段，需要一种规范化的建模框架来自动识别分割中的错误，提高放疗QA的效率和可靠性。

Method: 比较两种生成框架：1) VAE架构；2) 图像条件分割扩散模型。在RADCURE数据集的脑干和脊髓分割上，通过模拟边界和宽度扰动生成错误，利用Dice相似系数和输入与重建分割之间的Distance to Agreement (DTA)来评估错误检测性能。

Result: 两种模型都能检测部分模拟错误，但区域DTA分析表明扩散模型在一致性地定位细微边界错误方面表现更好，为分割QA提供了更可靠的局部化错误检测能力。

Conclusion: 图像条件扩散重建是面向局部化、解剖感知的分割QA的有前景框架，在放疗分割质量保证中优于VAE，尤其是在细微边界错误的检测定位方面。

Abstract: Accurate organ-at-risk segmentation is essential for radiotherapy planning, but reviewing segmentations is time-consuming and subjective. We investigate normative modelling for segmentation error detection in head-and-neck CT, comparing a VAE framework with an image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model. Models were evaluated on RADCURE brainstem and spinal cord segmentations using simulated boundary and width perturbations. Error detection was assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient and the Distance to Agreement (DTA) between the input and reconstructed segmentations. While both models detected some simulated errors, regional DTA showed that the diffusion model localised subtle boundary errors more consistently. These results support image-conditioned diffusion reconstruction as a promising framework for localised, anatomy-aware segmentation QA.

</details>


### [342] [Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23435)
*Yirong Hu,Jiayuan Rao,Yu Zhang,Shangzhe Di,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了BasketballBench，一个包含7,980个问题、涵盖文本/图像/视频三种模态、跨越十个任务的多模态篮球理解基准，以及BasketballSkills智能体，通过组合八个领域专用工具形成四个可复用技能，在需要多能力整合的复杂问题上显著优于现有MLLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有篮球理解基准通常孤立地评估单个能力（如事件识别、动作定位、球员识别、结构知识关联），但实际理解一场篮球比赛需要这些能力的协同交互。这种"单能力评估"模式无法揭示能力间的相互作用，导致多能力整合场景下的模型表现未被充分探索。

Method: 构建BasketballBench基准：基于2025-2026 NBA赛季数据，包含官方逐球记录（play-by-play）、530名现役球员的名册与资料，以及2,501个控球级别（possession-level）的转播片段，共生成7,980个问题，覆盖文本、图像、视频三种模态和十个任务。同时提出BasketballSkills智能体，将八个篮球专用感知与检索工具组合为四个可复用技能，每个技能明确指定工具调用顺序、证据绑定和停止条件。

Result: 实验表明，现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在需要多种能力整合的问题上表现困难，而BasketballSkills在这些问题上显著优于基线模型，验证了显式组合领域专用能力的有效性。

Conclusion: 显式地组合领域专用能力是实现全面篮球理解的有效途径；将感知与检索能力以结构化的技能形式编排，能够弥补通用MLLM在多能力整合任务上的不足。

Abstract: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.

</details>


### [343] [Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23479)
*Taqi Hamoda,Nuno Gracias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动的框架，利用SfM重建的3D海底网格作为几何锚点，实现侧扫声呐（SSS）与光学图像的像素级跨模态配准，并通过FBR提取算法、逆Lambertian模型和双高斯加权函数消除声学畸变，生成严格配准的多模态数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 侧扫声呐是水下大范围测绘的主要手段，但声学图像受散斑噪声、阴影和极端视点依赖的影响，传统手工特征与深度学习匹配方法无法在没有3D几何约束的情况下弥合光学与声学图像之间的物理域差异，严重制约了自动化感知与跨模态对齐。

Method: 1) 利用SfM重建稠密3D海底网格作为视觉与声学域之间的几何锚点；2) 提出首底回波（FBR）提取算法动态校正SfM未标定重建导致的非线性高度漂移；3) 应用逆Lambertian模型和双高斯加权函数分离固有海底反射率，中和斜距传播损耗与几何视点依赖；4) 将分离后的声学属性与光学像素确定性关联，生成严格共配准的多模态数据集。

Result: 该方法能够自动生成高精度、严格共配准的跨模态数据集，无需人工标注，在像素级光-声共配准和视点不变的反射率映射方面优于传统手工描述子和深度学习匹配方法。

Conclusion: 该自动化、物理引导的方法消除了对人工标注的需求，为底栖栖息地测绘中的高级自监督学习铺平了道路，有效解决了光学与声学图像间的物理域差异问题。

Abstract: Side-Scan Sonar (SSS) is a primary modality for large-scale underwater mapping, yet automated perception and cross-modal alignment are severely bottlenecked by acoustic complexities such as speckle noise, shadows, and extreme viewpoint dependencies. Traditional handcrafted descriptors and modern deep learning matchers fail to bridge the physical domain gap between optical and acoustic imagery without 3D geometric constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel geometry-driven framework for pixel-level opti-acoustic co-registration and view-invariant reflectivity mapping. Our method utilizes Structure-from-Motion (SfM) to reconstruct a dense 3D seafloor mesh, acting as a geometric anchor between the visual and acoustic domains. We introduce a First Bottom Return (FBR) extraction algorithm to dynamically correct non-linear altitude drift caused by uncalibrated SfM reconstruction. Furthermore, we apply an inverse Lambertian model and a dual-Gaussian weighting function to isolate the intrinsic seabed reflectivity, effectively neutralizing slant-range propagation loss and geometric view-dependence. By deterministically associating these isolated acoustic properties with optical pixels, our pipeline generates highly accurate, strictly co-registered multi-modal datasets. This automated, physics-guided approach eliminates the need for manual annotation and paves the way for advanced self-supervised learning in benthic habitat mapping.

</details>


### [344] [GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23486)
*Yiren Lu,Xin Ye,Jiaming Liu,Jin Yao,Yi-chung Chen,Liam Merino,Dhruva Dixith Kurra,Min Cai,Tom Lampo,Yu Yin,Danhua Guo,Burhan Yaman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoWAM，一种基于视觉几何的世界动作模型（WAM），用于自动驾驶。与现有基于像素预测未来图像的方法不同，GeoWAM预训练去预测未来的场景几何（点云），从而更自然地捕捉三维空间结构和时变变换，并通过几何条件化的动作头预测未来自车轨迹。开放环路和闭环实验表明，视觉几何世界建模显著优于基于图像的替代方法，验证了未来几何预测作为自动驾驶预训练目标的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）在像素空间学习场景动力学，但像素将几何与外观、纹理、光照纠缠在一起，迫使模型从二维观测推断三维变换，是间接且低效的表征方式。作者认为点云代表的几何信息是驾驶中更自然的状态空间，因为它显式捕捉空间结构及控制场景演化的刚性和非刚性变换，并直接与驾驶动作执行空间对齐。

Method: GeoWAM的核心方法包括：(1) 用点云（几何）替代像素作为状态空间表示；(2) 预训练任务从预测未来图像改为预测未来场景几何（point clouds），使得学到的表征同时编码空间结构与时间演化；(3) 设计一个几何条件化的动作头，利用学到的时间几何动力学来预测未来自车轨迹。

Result: 在开放环路（open-loop）和闭环（closed-loop）评估中，GeoWAM均显著优于基于图像的WAM替代方法，表明视觉几何世界建模能产生更强的驾驶策略。

Conclusion: 未来场景几何预测是一种有效的自动驾驶预训练目标，相较于像素预测能够提供更优的驾驶策略学习信号，为世界模型在自动驾驶中的应用提供了新的方向。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.

</details>


### [345] [SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23499)
*Aldo Sean Sartor,Leandro de Souza Rosa,Andriy Enttsel,Mauro Mangia,Riccardo Rovatti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于权重矩阵几何结构（SVD）分析Vision Transformer内部表征的方法。通过对每层仿射层权重进行SVD分解，将激活投影到主右奇异向量上，每层拟合类条件密度模型，生成跨层堆叠的"典型性图谱"。从图谱中导出两种无需重训练或OOD数据暴露的后验OOD检测分数：原型对齐分数(PAS)和多层软投票分数(MLSV)。在CIFAR-100上微调的ViT-B/16上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD检测方法通常需要重训练、访问OOD数据或修改网络结构，缺乏一种能够深入利用ViT内部层表示几何结构且无需额外训练开销的后验检测方法。作者希望通过在参数空间中捕获类特定证据随深度演化的模式，实现轻量级的OOD检测。

Method: 1) 对每层仿射层的权重矩阵进行SVD分解；2) 将激活投影到前导右奇异向量获得紧凑的层内表征；3) 每层拟合基于类别的密度模型，生成每类的典型性分数；4) 将各层分数沿深度堆叠为"典型性图谱"；5) 从图谱中导出两种OOD检测分数——PAS通过对照类参考原型模式的相似度，MLSV通过跨层软投票实现共识判定，无需存储原型。

Result: 在CIFAR-100上微调的ViT-B/16上，PAS和MLSV两种分数均取得了与现有方法相当的竞争力OOD检测性能，且无需重训练或接触OOD数据。

Conclusion: 利用ViT权重矩阵的奇异值几何结构能够有效提取轻量的层内表征，从而在无需额外训练或OOD暴露的情况下实现可靠的OOD检测，证明了参数空间几何信息对理解与利用深度模型内部表征的价值。

Abstract: We present a method for analyzing the internal representations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) exploiting the geometry of their learned parameters. Each affine layer's weight matrix is factored via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and activations are projected onto the leading right singular vectors to obtain compact, layer-intrinsic representations. A class-conditional density model is then fitted at each layer, producing per-class \emph{typicality scores} that are stacked across depth into \emph{typicality maps}: two-dimensional summaries of how class-specific evidence evolves through the network. From these maps, we derive two post-hoc scores for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) detection: a \emph{Prototype Alignment Score} (PAS), measuring agreement with class reference prototype patterns, and a \emph{Multi-Layer Soft Voting} (MLSV) score, capturing cross-layer consensus without stored prototypes. On ViT-B/16 fine-tuned on CIFAR-100, the proposed scores achieve competitive detection performance without retraining or OOD exposure.

</details>


### [346] [Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23503)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thanh-Nhan Vo,Trong-Thuan Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了ActPair，一个三阶段从粗到细的框架，用于基于文本的行人异常行为搜索。该框架结合了动作对齐的多模态检索和成对重排序，弥合了姿态-语义鸿沟，在PAB公共测试集上达到最佳效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于文本的行人异常搜索需要区分细粒度、上下文依赖的行为而非单纯外观。现有方法存在三大局限：仅依赖孤立的骨骼几何信息、重写过程中丢失原始查询细节、以及使用绝对逐点打分进行多模态验证，无法充分捕获上下文条件化的动作。

Method: ActPair采用三阶段粗到细框架：1）用动作对齐的多任务目标微调视觉-语言模型(VLM)，使表征编码动作判别语义；2）并行执行晚期融合检索，同时使用原始查询和LLM生成的上下文接地重写，保留两种语义视图的互补细节；3）提出高效的即插即用重排序模块，利用pivot-promote算法进行直接成对视觉比较，缓解残余的空间和构图歧义，同时避免详尽评估的高昂推理成本。

Result: 在PAB公共测试集上，ActPair在所有对比方法中取得最佳结果，并能有效迁移到未见过的非异常特定数据集。

Conclusion: ActPair通过动作对齐检索与成对多模态重排序的统一框架，有效解决了基于文本的行人异常搜索中的姿态-语义鸿沟问题，且具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Text-based person anomaly search requires distinguishing individuals based on fine-grained, context-dependent behaviors rather than mere appearance. Existing methods struggle to capture these context-conditioned actions, frequently relying on isolated skeletal geometry, discarding raw query details during reformulation, or utilizing absolute pointwise scoring for multimodal verification. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{ActPair}, a unified three-stage coarse-to-fine framework that combines action-aligned retrieval with pairwise multimodal reranking to bridge the pose-semantic gap. First, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) with an action-aligned multi-task objective that encourages the representations to encode action-discriminative semantics. Second, we perform parallel late-fusion retrieval using the original query and a large language model (LLM)-generated context-grounded rewrite, retaining complementary details from both semantic views. Finally, we propose an efficient off-the-shelf reranking module that leverages a pivot-promote algorithm to perform direct pairwise visual comparisons, mitigating residual spatial and compositional ambiguities without the prohibitive inference costs of exhaustive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves the best results among the compared methods on the Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) public test and transfers effectively to an unseen, non-anomaly-specific dataset.

</details>


### [347] [Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23518)
*Adhithya Laxman Ravi Shankar Geetha,Aulia Kharis Rakhmasari,Haleema Ramzan,Xander Yap*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过合成几何图形数据集和精细构造的语言线索查询，解码了Qwen3-VL-4B视觉语言模型各层对视觉信息的编码方式，发现当前VLM同时结合了真实的视觉推理和主要源于语言线索的捷径策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉推理任务中表现优异，但不清楚它们是否真正理解视觉关系，还是仅使用语言线索或先验等捷径。作者希望通过受控实验来揭示VLM是否依赖真实的视觉证据。

Method: 提出一个合成几何图形数据集进行受控分析，设计了用于精确测试语言线索的查询，并修改数据集以测试模型对视觉证据的因果依赖。使用Qwen3-VL-4B作为现代VLM代表，跨层解码视觉信息的编码方式。

Result: 实验结果显示，当前的视觉语言模型将真实的视觉推理与主要基于语言线索的捷径策略相结合，即模型并非纯粹依赖视觉证据进行推理。

Conclusion: VLM在视觉推理中混合使用真实视觉理解和语言捷径，未来需要改进模型使其真正依赖视觉证据，减少对语言先验的依赖。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. Furthermore, the dataset is modified to test causal reliance on visual evidence. Our results show that current VLMs combine genuine visual reasoning with shortcut strategies primarily rooted in language cues.

</details>


### [348] [Predicting Multiple Clinical Outcomes Related to Functional Recovery and Social Isolation Among Older Adults After Lower-Limb Fracture or Hip Replacement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23531)
*Santosh Ray,Pratik K. Mishra,Ali Abedi,Charlene H. Chu,Amir Ahmad,Shehroz S. Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究利用MAISON-LLF多模态传感器数据集（18名社区康复的下肢骨折或髋关节置换术后老年患者，最长8周监测），提取46个每日特征预测5种临床结局指标。将问题建模为多输出回归任务，发现联合预测优于单独预测，其中表格深度学习模型NODE表现最佳（MSE=3.96，MAE=1.02），SHAP分析证实了多模态传感器数据的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下肢骨折或髋关节置换术后的老年患者康复轨迹复杂，但以往研究通常孤立地分析各临床指标，忽略了它们之间的联合影响。需要一种能够同时评估功能恢复和社会参与的多输出预测方法，以更全面地捕捉康复轨迹。

Method: 使用MAISON-LLF数据集，包含18名社区康复老年患者的室内运动、加速度、步数、心率、户外行动和睡眠等多模态传感器数据，提取46个每日特征。每两周评估5种临床结局（社会隔离量表、牛津髋/膝评分、起立行走测试、30秒椅子站立测试）。将问题建模为多输出回归，比较多种机器学习和深度学习单/多输出回归算法。

Result: 多输出（联合）预测临床评分优于单输出预测。表格深度学习多输出回归器NODE表现最佳，达到MSE=3.96和MAE=1.02。SHAP特征分析证实多模态传感器对准确估计患者康复轨迹具有重要贡献。

Conclusion: 本研究支持通过对社区老年患者进行多模态传感器监测，实现功能恢复和社会参与的同步评估，有望改善老年患者的护理质量和生活质量。

Abstract: Older adults recovering after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement may experience complex recovery trajectories. Most of the time, these clinical aspects are studied in isolation, masking their joint impact on recovery. This study used the MAISON-LLF dataset, which contains multimodal sensor and clinical assessment data from 18 older adults recovering in the community after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement. Participants were monitored for up to eight weeks, corresponding to a maximum of 1,008 participant-days of sensor monitoring. Forty-six daily features were extracted from indoor motion, acceleration, step count, heart rate, out-of-home mobility, and sleep data. Five clinical outcomes were assessed every two weeks: the Social Isolation Scale, Oxford Hip Score, Oxford Knee Score, Timed Up and Go test, and 30-second Chair Stand test. We utilize an inherent relationship between multi-modal sensor data and different clinical scores and formulate it as a multi-output regression problem. We tested various machine learning and deep learning single- and multi-output regression algorithms to predict these scores simultaneously. The results showed that predicting clinical scores jointly was better than separately. The tabular DL multi-output regressor, NODE, gave a remarkable performance of MSE=3.96 and MAE=1.02 in comparison to other multi- and single-output regressors. The SHAP feature analysis further showed the importance of including multimodal sensors to provide a good estimate of patients' recovery trajectory. This work may support the simultaneous assessment of functional recovery and social engagement among community-dwelling older adults and ultimately help improve their care and quality of life.

</details>


### [349] [FixAnything: 3D-Consistent Rendering Refinement via Video Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23549)
*Khiem Vuong,Deva Ramanan,Srinivasa Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FixAnything是一个统一的模型，通过重利用预训练视频生成模型并仅需轻量微调，即可修复多种3D表示（如3DGS、NeRF、网格、点云）的渲染伪影。它将去伪影问题构造成视频到视频的翻译任务，利用二进制掩码锚定高质量像素，并采用基于相机位姿精度的直接偏好优化（DPO）来确保3D一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏输入视角或远离输入的视角会导致多种3D表示（3DGS、NeRF、网格、点云）产生渲染伪影。现有基于扩散先验的方法都是针对特定表示定制的，需要自定义架构或大量重新训练，缺乏通用性。

Method: 1) 重利用预训练视频生成模型作为骨干，利用其隐式多视角先验，仅需最小修改和轻量微调；2) 将渲染伪影修复形式化为视频到视频翻译任务，因为带噪渲染序列仍保留相机运动和粗略场景结构；3) 引入二进制掩码标注干净像素，使模型锚定高质量输入（如训练视角）同时细化其余部分；4) 使用结构从运动（SfM）恢复的相机位姿精度作为奖励信号，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）鼓励3D一致的渲染输出。

Result: 在四种不同的3D表示（3DGS、NeRF、网格、点云）上，FixAnything通过轻量微调一致地提升了渲染质量，证明单一通用视频先验可以替代多个专门的细化流水线。

Conclusion: FixAnything展示了单一通用视频生成先验足以处理多种3D表示的伪影修复任务，框架简单且具有可扩展性，能够即时适配未来更强的视频模型而无需架构重新设计。

Abstract: Rendering views using 3D scene representations such as Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), meshes, or even point clouds produces artifacts when input views are sparse or target views lie far from the input. Recent work mitigates these artifacts using diffusion-based generative priors, but is specialized to individual representations and require custom architectures or extensive retraining. We present FixAnything, a single model for fixing a wide range of rendering artifacts. It does so by repurposing a pretrained video generative model, leveraging its implicit multi-view priors with only minimal modification and lightweight finetuning. Our key insight is that even noisily-rendered sequences preserve camera motion and coarse scene structure, allowing cleanup to be formulated as video-to-video translation. To control what scene structure should be preserved, we introduce a binary mask denoting the clean pixels, enabling the model to anchor its output to high-quality inputs (e.g. training views) while refining the rest. To encourage FixAnything to produce 3D-consistent renderings that support downstream reconstruction, we use camera pose accuracy (recovered via structure-from-motion) as a reward signal for direct preference optimization (DPO). Across four distinct 3D representations, FixAnything consistently improves rendering quality with lightweight finetuning, demonstrating that a single generalist video prior can replace multiple specialist refinement pipelines. The simplicity of the framework enables immediate adoption of stronger future video models without architectural redesign.

</details>


### [350] [EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23563)
*Md Thamed Bin Zaman Chowdhury,Moazzem Hossain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出专家接地蒸馏（EGD）框架，将机构道路安全专业知识蒸馏到紧凑的视觉语言模型中，用于可扩展的视觉道路安全审计。引入首个开放的孟加拉国道路安全审计数据集BD-ARSA（21,947条图像审计记录）和首个针对该任务的视觉语言模型EG-ARSA，实验证明紧凑型学生模型超越了其310亿参数教师模型和Gemini-2.5-Flash。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中低收入国家道路交通事故伤害仍然是重大挑战，但主动式道路安全审计受到不完整的碰撞记录、合格审计人员短缺以及大规模现场检查成本高昂的限制。

Method: 提出Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD)框架，核心创新是量化专家接地阶段，将教师视觉语言模型与权威实地审计校准（Cohen's kappa=0.74）；校准后的教师生成结构化监督信号，通过低秩适配（LoRA）和单一无泄漏提示蒸馏到80亿参数的学生视觉语言模型中。同时构建BD-ARSA数据集和EG-ARSA模型。

Result: 接地微调显著改善了相较于零样本基线的有序风险评估；盲法专家评估显示紧凑型学生模型在性能上超越了310亿参数的教师模型以及Gemini-2.5-Flash。教师与专家风险评估达到Cohen's kappa=0.74的实质一致性。

Conclusion: EGD为资源受限环境下的主动式道路安全审计提供了有效且可扩展的工程解决方案，表明接地蒸馏能够将机构专业知识高效转移到紧凑模型中。

Abstract: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [351] [Scalable PII Discovery in Mobile App Databases via Hypothesis-Driven Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21469)
*Jeel Piyushkumar Khatiwala,Samad Afolabi,Ruoyao Xiao,Yu Luo,Dianxiang Xu,Weifeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于假设驱动的框架，将移动设备取证数据库中的PII定位问题建模为有界、自适应的不确定性搜索。Agent对候选表-列区域进行排序、采样验证，并维护历史证据与置信度来迭代优化假设，将轻量级PII探索与针对已验证区域的定向提取、规范化及去重分离。在包含25个SQLite数据库（来自10个Android/iOS应用）的Cellebrite CTF语料上，以Gemini 2.5 Pro作为后端实现了94.5%的F1分数，同时将有效提取搜索空间平均减少79.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动取证数据库中个人信息（PII）的定位面临三大挑战：相关的表-列区域未知、异构SQLite schema分布分散、值可能嵌入自由文本或半结构化字段中，使得传统穷举式检测效率低下且不切实际。

Method: 提出假设驱动框架，将PII定位视为有界自适应搜索：一个agent对候选表-列区域进行排序，采样探测值，并维护包含先前证据、置信度分数和决策的记忆以细化后续假设。框架将轻量级PII探索与基于已验证区域的定向提取/规范化/去重分离，将穷举检查限制在有采样证据支撑的区域。

Result: 在Cellebrite CTF语料库的25个SQLite数据库（来自10个Android/iOS应用）上评估，针对邮箱、电话号码、域名、人名和邮政地址五类PII。在3,751个实体的语料级ground-truth上，Gemini 2.5 Pro达到94.5% F1，同时平均减少79.9%的有效提取搜索空间。12个模型后端的对比显示前沿模型表现强劲，但结果对模型能力高度敏感。

Conclusion: 假设驱动的自适应搜索框架能够高效且准确地定位移动取证数据库中的PII，显著降低搜索空间，但框架性能依赖底层模型能力，这为实际部署时的模型选择提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Discovering personally identifiable information (PII) in mobile forensic databases is difficult because the relevant table-column regions are unknown, distributed across heterogeneous SQLite schemas, and may contain values embedded in free-text or semi-structured fields. We present a hypothesis-driven framework that treats PII localization as bounded, adaptive search under uncertainty. An agent ranks candidate table-column regions, probes sampled values, and maintains a memory of prior evidence, confidence scores, and decisions to refine subsequent hypotheses. The framework separates lightweight PII exploration from targeted extraction, normalization, and deduplication over validated regions, thereby limiting exhaustive inspection to regions supported by sampled evidence. We evaluate the framework on 25 SQLite databases from 10 Android and iOS applications in the Cellebrite CTF corpus, targeting email addresses, phone numbers, domain names, person names, and postal addresses. Against a corpus-level distinct ground-truth set of 3,751 entities, Gemini 2.5 Pro achieves 94.5% F1 while reducing the effective extraction search space by 79.9% on average. Results across 12 model backends show strong performance among several frontier models, but substantial sensitivity to model capability.

</details>


### [352] [Structural Inference in Undocumented Mobile Databases: A Reproducible Benchmark for Evaluating Agentic Reasoning in Digital Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21470)
*Jeel Piyushkumar Khatiwala,Divyangkumar Patel,Weifeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文评估了代理式大语言模型在数字取证场景中对未文档化移动应用数据库进行结构化推断的能力，将执行成功与结构正确性作为独立维度进行评价。结果表明：在规则模式（如Android短信数据库）下结构推断可靠，但在不规则模式（如Snapchat数据库，含多变标识符和多态关系）下性能急剧下降，频繁产生结构上看似合理但实际错误的连接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理式LLM越来越多地被用于数字取证分析，但其从未文档化的移动应用数据库中推断关系结构的能力尚未得到充分理解。在取证语境下，结构错误的推断可能产生看似合理但在证据上不成立的结果，因此需要单独评估这一能力。

Method: 将代理式结构推断作为独立能力进行评估，区分执行成功与结构正确性两个评价轴。采用固定、确定性的评估流程，应用于两个对比性SQLite仓库：规则模式的Android短信数据库和irregular的Snapchat数据库。使用专家验证的SQL作为基准真相，从三个维度评估：(i)推断关系链接的结构正确性；(ii)多表推理下的执行一致性；(iii)当执行成功但关系解释偏离专家基准时的鲁棒性与失败模式。评估独立于语义解释，完整查询与执行轨迹在附录中提供。

Result: 结构推断在规则模式中保持可靠，但随着模式模糊性增加而急剧退化，频繁产生结构上看似合理但实际错误且能成功执行的连接。

Conclusion: 研究阐明了模式无关的代理推理在哪些方面可以支持取证分析，其鲁棒性如何在真实模式不规则性下退化，以及为何在推断关系被视为可靠证据前必须进行额外验证。

Abstract: Agentic large language models are increasingly used in digital forensic analysis, yet their ability to infer relational structure inside undocumented mobile application databases remains poorly understood. In forensic contexts, structurally incorrect inferences can yield results that appear plausible while remaining evidentially unsound. This work evaluates agentic structural inference as an isolated capability, treating execution success and structural correctness as distinct evaluation axes. It examines how an agent reconstructs table relationships, linking attributes, and executable join paths when given only a raw database and a natural-language investigative prompt. We apply a fixed, deterministic evaluation pipeline to two contrasting SQLite repositories: Android's SMS database with stable identifier propagation, and Snapchat's database with irregular schemas, ephemeral identifiers, and polymorphic relationships. Using expert-verified SQL ground truth, we evaluate (i) structural correctness of inferred relational links, (ii) execution coherence under multi-table reasoning, and (iii) robustness and failure modes of inferred structure when execution succeeds but relational interpretation diverges from expert ground truth. Evaluation is performed independently of semantic interpretation, with full queries and execution traces provided in the Appendix. Results show that structural inference remains reliable in regular schemas but degrades sharply as schema ambiguity increases, frequently producing structurally plausible yet incorrect joins that execute successfully. These findings clarify where schema-agnostic agentic reasoning can support forensic analysis, how its robustness degrades under realistic schema irregularities, and why additional verification remains essential before inferred relationships can be treated as reliable evidence.

</details>


### [353] [A Case-Control Measurement Study of OSINT Source Effectiveness for Critical Infrastructure Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21471)
*Ekrem E. Emeksiz,Jeel Piyushkumar Khatiwala,Divyangkumar Patel,Weifeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对2010-2024年间54起已确认的CI网络攻击及其12个对照漏洞案例，审计了十类满足最低体量阈值的公开OSINT源的攻击覆盖率、对照污染率和信号提前量，发现来源可清晰分为前兆、披露暴露和广覆盖混合三类任务画像（Fisher精确p=3.4x10^-8），并发布语料库与分类规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键基础设施防护者订阅大量公开OSINT源，但缺乏经验证据表明哪些源真正能先于攻击提供情报，作者试图填补这一空白，为防御者提供有实证基础的来源选择依据。

Method: 构建54起已确认CI网络攻击（2010-2024，覆盖12个命名部门加跨部门类别）与12个来自同一源空间的无效控制漏洞案例组成的语料库，对十类达到最低体量阈值的公开OSINT源审计三类指标：攻击覆盖率、无效案例污染、信号提前量；使用Fisher精确检验进行统计分类，并结合2019年时间划分与美/非美地域划分做稳健性验证，再评估贪心组合组合的增量覆盖。

Result: 来源分为三种操作使命画像：六类前兆源（零无效引爆且覆盖率≥5%）、三类披露暴露源（无效污染≥攻击覆盖）、一类广覆盖混合源（语料内精确度91.3%）。分类跨时间与地域分区稳定。两个源覆盖92.6%攻击，三个源覆盖96.3%；k=3贪心组合比随机三源子集平均高39.8个百分点。多个被广泛视为工控防御经典的源实际属披露暴露画像（按任务而非质量）。各行业、行为体和司法辖区的组合排序各异，但共享同一排名第一源。

Conclusion: OSINT源存在可操作的任务画像分化，防御者应按前兆性而非仅覆盖率选源；某些经典源无效污染高但非质量差，仅是任务定位不同；组合策略显著优于随机选择，语料库与协议已公开供复现。

Abstract: Defenders of critical infrastructure (CI) subscribe to many public open-source intelligence (OSINT) feeds without an empirical basis for which feeds actually precede attacks. We provide one. Across 54 confirmed CI cyberattacks from 2010 through 2024 spanning twelve named CI sectors plus a cross-sector category (consolidation rules in Section IV), paired with 12 null-control vulnerability cases drawn from the same source space, we audit per-source attack coverage, null-case contamination, and signal lead time for ten public OSINT source classes that meet a minimum-volume threshold. Sources separate cleanly into three operationally distinct mission profiles (pooled Fisher exact p = 3.4x10^-8): precursor (six classes with zero observed null firings at coverage at or above 5%), disclosure-exposure (three classes whose null contamination meets or exceeds attack coverage), and one large broad-coverage class that mixes the two profiles but retains 91.3% within-corpus precision. The precision-side classification is stable across a 2019 temporal partition and across a US-versus-non-US geographic partition. Two sources, one broad-coverage and one precursor, cover 92.6% of corpus attacks; three cover 96.3%. The greedy portfolio at k = 3 outperforms the mean random three-source subset by 39.8 percentage points. Several source classes widely treated as canonical for industrial control system defense fall into the disclosure-exposure profile by operational mission, not by quality. Per-sector, per-actor, and per-jurisdiction portfolios diverge in rank order despite a shared rank-one source. The corpus, linkage protocol, and classification rules are released.

</details>


### [354] [Explainable Adaptive Zero Trust Framework for AWS with Adversarial Robustness Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21477)
*Om Singh,Yagyaraj Pandey,Nandini Pathak*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: EAZTF是一个云原生自适应零信任安全框架，利用Isolation Forest和XGBoost实时评估API会话中的行为特征，生成信任风险评分（TRS），并配合SHAP/LIME提供可解释审计记录。在8,500条合成CloudTrail数据上，Isolation Forest达到94.4%精确率、91.2%召回率和0.928的F1分数，四种对抗性规避场景平均检测率达91.0%，NIST SP 800-207合规评分93%，检测时间从小时级降至分钟级以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AWS云环境存在结构性安全漏洞：一旦凭据通过认证，会话在整个持续期间往往被视为可信，这种假设在凭据被盗时失效。因此需要一个能持续重新评估API操作合法性的安全机制，而不仅仅是认证时的一次性检查。

Method: EAZTF结合Isolation Forest和XGBoost，评估从CloudTrail和IAM提取的8个行为特征，实时产生信任风险评分（TRS），据此决定会话继续、需要逐步MFA或受限。每个决策由SHAP或LIME生成可解释的审计记录。框架针对四种对抗性规避策略（凭据窃取、行为模仿、API速率规避、权限提升）进行了评估。

Result: 在8,500条合成CloudTrail数据集上，Isolation Forest达到94.4%精确率、91.2%召回率和0.928 F1分数。四种对抗场景平均检测率91.0%，行为模仿最难检测（83.9%）。SHAP分析显示IP信誉、登录时间偏差和API调用速率是三个主导特征。NIST SP 800-207自评估合规得分93%（对比传统边界基线38%），MTTD从小时级降至1分钟以内。

Conclusion: EAZTF在持续会话安全评估、可解释性和合规性方面展现出显著优势，但由于使用合成数据进行评估，结果应视为指示性而非经过验证的生产性能，需要进一步在真实环境中验证。

Abstract: Cloud environments built on Amazon Web Services face a structural security vulnerability: once a credential passes authentication, the resulting session is often treated as trusted for its entire duration. This assumption fails when credentials are stolen. We introduce the Explainable Adaptive Zero Trust Framework (EAZTF), a cloud-native security layer that continuously reevaluates the legitimacy of API actions throughout a session.
  EAZTF combines Isolation Forest and XGBoost to evaluate eight CloudTrail and IAM-derived behavioral features in real time and produce a Trust Risk Score (TRS) that determines whether a session continues, requires step-up MFA, or is restricted. Each decision is accompanied by a SHAP or LIME explanation, providing human-readable audit records for security analysis and compliance. The framework is also evaluated against four adversarial evasion strategies: credential theft, behavioral mimicry, API rate evasion, and privilege escalation.
  Experiments on an 8,500-record synthetic CloudTrail dataset show that Isolation Forest achieves 94.4% precision, 91.2% recall, and an F1 score of 0.928. Across the four adversarial scenarios, the mean detection rate is 91.0%, with behavioral mimicry being the most difficult at 83.9%. SHAP analysis identifies IP reputation, login-time deviation, and API call velocity as the three dominant features. A structured NIST SP 800-207 self-assessment gives EAZTF a mean compliance score of 93%, compared with 38% for a traditional perimeter baseline. Mean time to detect decreases from hours to under one minute. Because the evaluation uses synthetic data, these results should be interpreted as indicative rather than validated production performance.

</details>


### [355] [SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21500)
*Yibo Peng,Long Lian,David Wagner,Sizhe Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出SecOPD（Secure On-Policy Distillation），一种基于token级反馈的防御性微调方法，以应对AI智能体面临的提示注入攻击。相比依赖序列级反馈的现有DPO/GRPO方法，SecOPD通过让初始模型对带有注入样本的模型输出进行token级评分，提供更细粒度的训练信号，从而大幅降低攻击成功率。实验表明其在自适应提示注入下ASR仅9.0%，远优于此前SOTA方法Meta-SecAlign的94.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示注入被列为AI智能体的头号威胁。现有防御性微调方法（DPO/GRPO）依赖序列级反馈信号，将整个输出视为同等对待，导致模型无法精确学习哪些输出token是不安全的，因此在自适应提示注入下仍面临接近100%的攻击成功率。需要一种提供token级反馈的防御微调方案来解决这一根本局限。

Method: SecOPD（Secure On-Policy Distillation）采用token级反馈指导防御性微调。具体流程为：LLM接收一个注入样本并产生rollout输出，随后由初始化模型在对应的干净输入下对rollout中的每个token进行评分，以此提供细粒度的训练信号，引导模型学习区分安全与不安全的输出行为。

Result: 防御后的Qwen3.6-27B在SOTA PISmith自适应提示注入下达到9.0%的攻击成功率，而此前SOTA方法Meta-SecAlign为94.0%。在训练中完全未见过的域（智能体工具调用）中，SecOPD达到4.7%的ASR，优于Meta-SecAlign的5.5%。

Conclusion: token级反馈信号是提升LLM抗提示注入能力的关键。SecOPD通过提供比序列级反馈更精细的训练信息，显著降低了自适应攻击下的成功率，并且其防御能力可泛化到训练中未见过的领域，证明了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Prompt injection is listed as the \#1 threat to AI agents. When an agent accesses external data from websites, files, or emails, an attacker may inject a prompt into the data, saying, "Ignore all prior instructions and perform <an attacker's task>." To prevent arbitrary manipulation of agents, defenders try to train secure LLMs, which, however, still suffer from near 100% attack success rates (ASRs) against adaptive prompt injections. We note that this is because existing defensive finetuning recipes rely on sequence-level feedback signals (in DPO or GRPO). Treating an entire output equally prevents the model from learning precisely which output tokens are insecure. In this paper, we propose Secure On-Policy Distillation (SecOPD) that provides token-level feedback to guide defensive fine-tuning. The LLM receives an injected sample and produces a rollout, whose tokens are scored by the initialization model given the corresponding clean input. With more fine-grained training signals, our defended Qwen3.6-27B achieves a 9.0% ASR against the SoTA PISmith adaptive prompt injections, compared to 94.0% for the prior SoTA, Meta-SecAlign. The obtained security generalizes to domains completely unseen in training: in agentic tool calling, SecOPD achieves a 4.7% ASR compared to 5.5% for Meta-SecAlign. Code and the model are available at https://github.com/pppyb/SecOPD and https://huggingface.co/pybbb/Qwen3.6-27B-SecOPD.

</details>


### [356] [Enhancing User Resilience Against AI-Augmented Phishing: A Two-Stage Framework for Detection and Personalized Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21547)
*Weihao Qu,Gurmeet Singh,Daniel Crawford,Bingjun Li,Jalen Smith*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出了一个名为CyberGLA的两阶段反钓鱼框架，结合技术防御（EmailKnight欺诈检测工具）与用户中心的安全教育（基于LLM的安全教练进行个性化培训），以应对融合了AI深度伪造等先进技术的新型网络钓鱼攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代钓鱼攻击已融合社交工程、URL欺骗和AI深度伪造等多种手段，攻击门槛降低且更加复杂，而现有的安全意识教育难以跟上这些威胁的演变速度，传统检测系统也容易被绕过。

Method: 提出两阶段反钓鱼框架CyberGLA：检测阶段使用EmailKnight工具进行多层级邮件分析以检测欺诈；培训阶段引入基于大语言模型的安全教练，根据检测阶段的结果动态选择个性化培训模块，实现技术防御与用户教育相结合的双重防护设计。

Result: 论文提出了CyberGLA框架及其核心组件，尚未在该摘要中给出具体的实验评估结果或量化性能指标。

Conclusion: CyberGLA通过将技术检测与用户教育动态结合的双重设计理念，能够有效抵御现代邮件钓鱼攻击不断演变的威胁。

Abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence, including agents and deepfake techniques, has accelerated phishing attacks and lowered the threshold for attackers. Modern phishing attacks now blend multiple tactics, including social engineering, URL spoofing, and AI deepfakes enabling adversaries to craft highly convincing messages that exploit human vulnerabilities and bypass traditional detection systems. At the same time, current security awareness education struggles to keep up with the speed, sophistication, and complexity of these evolving threats. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage anti-phishing framework, CyberGLA, that combines technical defense and user-centered security education. In the Detection stage, we introduce EmailKnight, a spoof detection tool that performs multi-level email analysis. To enhance user awareness, the Training stage incorporates a large language model (LLM)-based security coach that dynamically selects personalized training modules based on the outcomes of the Detection stage. This dual purpose design philosophy enables effective protection against the evolving threats of modern email phishing attacks.

</details>


### [357] [Hiding Directions, Leaking Structure: Breaking ArrowCloak through Low-Rank Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21615)
*Beijie Liu,Junyi Ouyang,Haoxuan Xu,Vincent Quentin Ulitzsch,Potung Yu,Yajie Zhao,Mengyuan Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文从密码学和结构角度重新审视ArrowCloak防御方案，指出其LWE硬度论证不成立且共享掩码方向会导致秩一可恢复结构，并提出了一种端到端、无需查询的攻击方法，能在六组模型-任务对上恢复99.92%-100%的隐藏向量对应关系，重建的分类模型达到94.39%-99.54%的受害者一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在TEE保护的推理场景中，轻量级防御方案试图通过掩码混淆保护模型权重，但已有研究（Game of Arrows）表明这些方案会泄露向量方向。ArrowCloak被提出以解决此问题，但其安全性论证存在缺陷，需要从密码学和结构角度进行严格审视和攻击验证。

Method: 作者从两个角度分析ArrowCloak：1) 密码学角度，指出其LWE公式化在归约方向、量化算术和联合实例分布上不满足标准LWE硬度要求；2) 结构角度，发现重复使用单一掩码方向会导致释放矩阵中残留可恢复的秩一分量。基于此结构弱点，提出一种端到端且无需查询的攻击方法：给定公开检查点与混淆权重，移除掩码子空间、恢复隐藏的一对一对应关系并重构受保护权重。该攻击无需变换秘密、受害者查询或微调数据。

Result: 在涵盖分类、分割和扩散模型的六组模型-任务对上，攻击恢复了99.92%-100%的隐藏向量对应关系。重建的分类模型实现94.39%-99.54%的受害者一致性，准确率差异不超过1.59个百分点；恢复的分割模型达到98.35%的输出一致性。

Conclusion: 轻量级防御方案应同时关注逐向量几何破坏和跨释放权重的联合结构隐私，单独依赖LWE硬度论证不足以保障实际安全性。

Abstract: TEE-shielded inference keeps sensitive state in a trusted execution environment (TEE) while offloading linear algebra to an untrusted accelerator. Wang et al., in Game of Arrows (USENIX Security 2025), showed that five widely adopted lightweight defenses preserve vector directions and introduced ArrowMatch to exploit this leakage. They then proposed ArrowCloak, which adds a different multiple of one shared mask direction to each vector and bases its weight-recovery hardness argument on Learning with Errors (LWE). ArrowCloak successfully reduces ArrowMatch to near-black-box levels.
  In this paper, we revisit ArrowCloak from cryptographic and structural perspectives. Its LWE formulation does not by itself establish standard LWE hardness: the reduction direction, quantized arithmetic, and joint instance distribution do not meet the required conditions. Reusing one mask direction leaves a recoverable rank-one component across the released matrix. We exploit this structure with our proposed attack, an end-to-end, query-free recovery attack. Given a public checkpoint and the obfuscated weights, the attack removes the masking subspace, recovers the hidden one-to-one correspondence, and reconstructs protected weights without transformation secrets, victim queries, or fine-tuning data. Across six model-task pairs spanning classification, segmentation, and diffusion, the attack recovers 99.92%-100% of hidden vector correspondences. Reconstructed classification models achieve 94.39%-99.54% victim agreement and differ by at most 1.59 percentage points in accuracy; the recovered segmentation model achieves 98.35% output agreement. These findings suggest that lightweight protection should address both per-vector geometry and joint structure across released weights.

</details>


### [358] [Cross-Layer Roots of Trust: Integrating Biometrics, PUFs, and Hardware Obfuscation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21643)
*Nima Karimian*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了现代网络物理系统、物联网、可穿戴与边缘系统中的人-设备-功能三层信任框架，将生物识别、物理不可克隆函数（PUF）和硬件混淆/逻辑锁定三种原语统一分析，并形式化探讨了其两两组合及三向架构的安全性挑战与研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代系统中信任需求同时涉及三个不同实体：发起访问的人类、执行计算的物理设备以及被允许运行的硬件功能。然而这三个方向分别在生物识别、PUF和硬件混淆/逻辑锁定三个独立社区中研究，缺乏统一的信任框架来理解它们之间的组合安全问题，如跨层错误传播、接口泄漏和密钥生命周期管理等。

Method: 本文采用综述方法：首先将每种安全原语分解为完整的处理链，识别其安全假设、实现机制和评估指标；然后形式化定义三种两两组合（生物识别-PUF、PUF-混淆、生物识别-混淆）以及将正确功能同时绑定到授权用户和真实设备的三向架构；并对生物识别密钥重建、PUF稳定性和建模抗性、逻辑锁定攻击评估等关键问题进行深入分析。

Result: 提出了一种统一的人-设备-功能信任视图，建立了原语分解框架和组合形式化模型，识别了跨层错误传播、注册信任、密钥生命周期和接口泄漏等关键安全问题，最终提供了可撤销的人-设备凭证、组合安全性、泄漏感知集成、可重构激活和标准化端到端评估的研究分类与议程。

Conclusion: 该综述填补了生物识别、PUF和硬件混淆三个研究社区之间的空白，为构建同时验证人类身份、设备身份和硬件功能的组合安全架构提供了系统化的分析框架和未来的研究方向。

Abstract: Modern cyber--physical, Internet-of-Things (IoT), wearable, and edge systems increasingly require trust in three distinct entities: the human requesting access, the physical device executing the computation, and the hardware function that is permitted to operate. These requirements are usually studied in separate communities. Biometrics establish human identity but remain vulnerable to presentation attacks, intra-user variability, template leakage, and limited revocability.
