We construct a NIC EM dataset covering active benign workloads and seven representative threat behaviors under diverse execution conditions, and systematically evaluate signal dependence, execution variation, measurement perturbation, and cross-device transfer. NICWhisper achieves 80.67\% Macro-F1 across eight behavior classes, while further experiments show that the observed behavior-related information extends beyond simple signal magnitude and remains partially transferable across execution conditions and NIC hardware. These results establish NIC EM leakage as a complementary physical observation source for network security monitoring when direct access to conventional traffic or host telemetry is limited or undesirable.

</details>


### [392] [Rational Dolev--Yao Attackers: Decidable Incentive-Aware Verification of Security Protocols in Strategic Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22954)
*Ioana Boureanu,R. Ramanujam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"理性Dolev-Yao攻击者"模型：将标准DY入侵者赋予行动成本与违规目标奖励，用加权ATL（WATL）表达"理性安全"（无入侵者策略能在严格正效用下实现违规），并证明对有界理性DY入侵者在有限成本标注并发博弈结构上可判定、刻画其复杂度，且该安全概念严格细分DY安全。框架在两个案例中验证：带会话不确定性的认证支付，以及无密码学的ThreeBallot方案中的贿赂-收益比阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号协议验证假设Dolev-Yao入侵者会做其知识允许的一切行为，但真实对手是追求效用最大化的理性主体，只在收益为正时才发起攻击。现有DY模型高估了攻击者能力，导致过度保守的安全判定，需要引入理性攻击者模型以更精确地刻画真实威胁。

Method: 引入带成本（actions carry costs）和奖励（goals carry rewards）的理性DY攻击者，在加权ATL（WATL）片段中表达协议理性安全的判定问题；将问题归约为有界理性DY入侵者在有限成本标注并发博弈结构上的可判定性验证，并分析其计算复杂度。

Result: 证明了该验证问题可判定，刻画了其复杂度；并证明理性安全严格细分DY安全——存在DY不安全但理性安全的协议，二者以可计算阈值分隔。两个案例（认证支付、ThreeBallot）展示了框架的适用性与不完美信息对攻击成本的抬升效应及贿赂-收益比阈值。

Conclusion: 理性DY攻击者框架将经济学理性引入符号协议验证，提供了比传统DY安全更精确、可判定的安全概念，通过成本-奖励建模能区分DY不安全但实际不会遭受理性攻击的协议。

Abstract: Symbolic protocol verification models the network attacker as a Dolev--Yao (DY) intruder, which does everything its knowledge permits, whether or not it serves any purpose; real adversaries instead maximise utility, attacking only when the payoff is positive. We introduce a rational Dolev--Yao attacker, a DY intruder whose actions carry costs and whose security-violating goals carry rewards, and call a protocol rationally secure when no intruder strategy achieves a violation with strictly positive utility, expressed in a weighted fragment of ATL (WATL). We prove this decidable for a bounded rational DY intruder over a finite cost-annotated concurrent game structure, characterise its complexity, and show it strictly refines DY security: some protocols are DY-insecure yet rationally secure, separated by a computable threshold. We illustrate the framework on two contrasting use-cases: an authenticated payment under session uncertainty, where a rational intruder must strategise across indistinguishable sessions and its imperfect information strictly raises the attack cost a designer must price against; and ThreeBallot, a cryptography-free scheme where we pinpoint the bribe-to-benefit ratio below which no rational coercer attacks.

</details>


### [393] [The Anonymity Gap: Understanding Real Privacy in Shielded UTXO-based Protocols for DeFi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22987)
*Hanze Guo,Stefanos Chaliasos,Yebo Feng,Jiahua Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一个针对屏蔽式UTXO协议（如Railgun和Hinkal）的分层系统模型与分析管道，利用历史状态、累积剪枝和跨证明传播来推导交易级匿名集大小，并在六个EVM链上的四个Railgun部署和五个Hinkal池的完整链上历史（186,356笔提款交易）上进行评估，发现匿名集大小相对时间基线缩减40.1%-59.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 屏蔽式UTXO协议已成为DeFi隐私基础设施的核心形式，其匿名性不再是一个扁平的池规模问题，而是跨note/UTXO、证明和交易层传播的来源问题。但该设置下缺乏统一的匿名性分析框架。

Method: 提出分层系统模型和分析管道：以历史状态为时间基线，对每个证明的Commitment Set应用累积剪枝和跨证明传播，并通过历史隐藏状态转换递归追踪幸存者，最终推导交易级匿名集大小。仅使用公开协议痕迹和约束，采用非启发式分析。

Result: 覆盖所有四个Railgun生产部署和五个独立Hinkal池（六个EVM链），分析186,356笔未屏蔽消费交易。平均匿名集大小缩减为40.1%-59.0%；3,679笔交易保留至多10个地址，其中1,228个为单例。公共代币约束是两种协议中最强且最稳定的剪枝来源。

Conclusion: 结果表明可解释的匿名性损失模式，揭示了用户行为和未来协议设计的启示；树编号、证明根和值约束的影响因协议设计和历史状态而异。

Abstract: Shielded UTXO-based protocols are becoming a core form of privacy infrastructure for DeFi. Unlike mixers that organize privacy mainly around deposits and withdrawals, these protocols allow assets, once inside the shielded pool, to continue moving and being re-spent within the hidden state, and to become public only when users withdraw or interact with public DeFi protocols. Their anonymity is therefore no longer a flat pool-size problem, but a provenance problem that propagates across the note/UTXO, proof, and transaction layers. Yet, a unified analysis framework for this setting is still missing. We propose a layered system model and an analysis pipeline that uses prior history as the temporal baseline, applies cumulative pruning and cross-proof propagation to each proof's Commitment Set, and recursively traces the survivors through historical hidden-state transitions to derive the final transaction-level Anonymity Set Size.
  We evaluate our methodology on the complete on-chain histories of all four Railgun production deployments and five independent Hinkal pools across six EVM chains, analyzing 186,356 unshielding spend transactions. Using only public protocol traces and constraints, our non-heuristic analysis yields mean Anonymity Set Size reductions of 40.1%-59.0% relative to each deployment's temporal baseline; 3,679 transactions retain at most 10 addresses, including 1,228 singletons. Public token constraints are the strongest and most stable source of pruning in both protocols, while the effects of tree number, proof roots, and value constraints vary with protocol design and historical state. Together with representative cases, these results reveal interpretable anonymity-loss patterns and implications for user behavior and future protocol design.

</details>


### [394] [CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23181)
*Jian Yang,Haau-Sing Li,Shawn Guo,Zixi Zhao,Yibo Tan,Jiajun Wu,Aishan Liu,Xianglong Liu,Tianyu Zheng,Bryan Dai,Chengran Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: CyberFactory是一个统一的开源框架，涵盖PoC生成、漏洞修复和CyberQA等网络安全任务的数据构建、轨迹合成与模型训练。它将公共漏洞工单（如CVE）转化为可执行可验证的任务实例，通过可复用的漏洞分析技能指导教师模型完成源码检查、基于领域先验的问题求解和证据验证，生成体现代理交互的训练轨迹。基于这些轨迹训练的模型Aegis在CyberGym上达到52.4% Pass@1（一小时预算），较Qwen 3.5基座提升22.8个百分点，优于同框架下评估的通用主干模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭源LLM已展现出先进的网络安全能力，但现有开源方案存在明显不足：前沿开源权重的模型缺乏可复现的网络安全训练方案；已有的开源训练方案局限于孤立任务且缺乏可扩展的代理数据；扩展代理式rollout需要很强的领域先验。作者旨在提供一个统一、可复现且可扩展的开源网络安全训练框架，弥补开源与闭源之间的能力差距。

Method: CyberFactory框架包含三大核心组件：(1) 数据构建：将公共漏洞工单（如野外CVE）自动转化为可执行、可验证的任务实例，覆盖PoC生成、漏洞修复和网络安全问答（CyberQA）三类任务；(2) 轨迹合成：利用可复用的漏洞分析技能引导教师模型，通过源码检查、基于领域先验的问题求解和基于证据的验证三个步骤生成监督数据，使模型与工具和目标环境交互，并根据执行反馈修正方案，形成代理式（agentic）训练轨迹；(3) 模型训练：基于这些轨迹训练Aegis模型，使其内化技能引导的流程，推理时无需显式技能提示。

Result: Aegis在CyberGym基准上达到了52.4%的Pass@1（一小时预算），相比其Qwen 3.5基座模型提升了22.8个百分点，并且在相同脚手架下优于所评估的通用主干模型，验证了CyberFactory框架生成代理式训练数据对网络安全能力的显著提升效果。

Conclusion: CyberFactory提出了一个统一的开源框架，通过将野外漏洞工单转化为可执行任务实例、利用可复用技能引导的代理式轨迹合成，成功训练出具备先进网络安全能力的开源模型Aegis。该方法为开源社区提供了可复现的网络安全训练方案，显著缩小了与闭源模型的差距，未来有望扩展到更广泛的网络安全任务和场景。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in coding capabilities, their potential in cybersecurity has drawn increasing research attention, with closed-source LLMs (e.g., Mythos) delivering advanced cybersecurity capabilities. However, existing open-source efforts remain limited: frontier open-weight models do not provide reproducible cybersecurity training solutions, open-source training solutions focus on isolated tasks and lack scalable agentic data, and scaling agentic rollouts requires strong domain priors. In this work, we introduce \textbf{CyberFactory}, a unified open-source framework that connects data construction, trajectory synthesis, and model training across proof-of-concept (PoC) generation, vulnerability patching, and cybersecurity question answering (CyberQA). CyberFactory transforms public vulnerability artifacts, including CVEs from the wild, into executable and verifiable task instances. It further uses a reusable vulnerability-analysis skill to guide the teacher through source inspection, problem solving with domain prior, and evidence-based validation. The resulting supervision is agentic: the model interacts with tools and target environments and revises its solutions according to execution feedback. Using these trajectories, we train and release \modelname\footnote{\emph{Aegis} is, in Greek mythology, the protective shield of Zeus and Athena; the name reflects the model's defensive, security-oriented purpose.}, which internalizes the skill-guided procedure without requiring the skill at inference time. On CyberGym, \modelname reaches 52.4% Pass@1 under a one-hour budget, improving over its Qwen~3.5 base model by +22.8 points and outperforming the evaluated general-purpose backbones under the same scaffold.

</details>


### [395] [Towards Automated Cyber Threat Intelligence Elicitation in Underground Forums](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23185)
*Lorenzo Bossi,Federico Saccani,Francesco Panebianco,Antonio Maci,Stefano Zanero,Stefano Longari,Michele Carminati*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出DarkBot，据作者所知这是首个基于多智能体LLM的地下论坛主动网络威胁情报(CTI)获取系统。DarkBot将交互任务分解为十一个专业智能体，分属三个功能模块：参与门控（相关性与安全性过滤）、基于MITRE ATT&CK战术的上下文感知问题生成、以及语言风格适配以贴近真实用户。在CrimeBB的100场对话受控评估中，该系统仅凭每条交互的初始帖子即恢复了原讨论中72.8%的经验证MITRE ATT&CK技术，并持续优于单一模型基线。分层安全设计在管线层面拦截了所有注入的越狱尝试。真实世界实验进一步验证：前瞻性配对部署中，DarkBot线程平均比对照组多积累3.85个CTI实体；104场真实论坛对话中，系统在不出现账号封禁、版主干预或明确自动化指控的情况下诱发了CTI相关泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下论坛的传统被动监控方法因用户对大规模数据收集的警惕而失效，有价值的威胁情报逐渐迁往私密或难以触及的空间。作者基于"可通过主动诱导获取相关信息"的直觉，旨在解决被动方法难以获取地下论坛CTI的困境。

Method: 构建DarkBot多智能体LLM系统，将主动提问的交互任务分解为十一个专业化智能体，组织为三个功能模块：1) 参与门控模块负责相关性和安全性过滤；2) 上下文感知问题生成模块由MITRE ATT&CK战术驱动；3) 语言风格适配模块使系统更贴近真实论坛用户的表达方式。系统设计了分层安全机制以阻止越狱攻击。

Result: 受控评估中，DarkBot在100场CrimeBB对话中凭借初始帖子恢复72.8%的经验证MITRE ATT&CK技术，优于单一模型基线；分层安全设计拦截了所有注入的越狱尝试。真实世界中，前瞻性配对部署中DarkBot线程平均多积累3.85个CTI实体；104场真实对话中成功诱出CTI相关信息，且未出现账号封禁、版主干预或自动化指控。

Conclusion: 主动诱导策略在地下论坛CTI获取方面优于被动监控，DarkBot通过多智能体协作的主动询问方式有效恢复和诱出威胁情报信息，同时具备良好的安全性与隐蔽性，证明主动CTI获取在实际部署中是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Cyber threat intelligence from underground forums has traditionally relied on passive monitoring. However, as users have become more aware of large-scale data collection, valuable intelligence has become increasingly rare in open forums, often migrating instead to private or harder-to-reach spaces, making passive approaches inadequate. Building on the intuition that relevant information can be obtained through active elicitation, this paper presents DarkBot, to the best of our knowledge, the first multi-agent LLM-based system for active CTI elicitation in underground forums. DarkBot decomposes the interaction task across eleven specialized agents organized into three functional blocks: engagement gating for relevance and safety filtering, context-aware question generation driven by MITRE ATT&CK tactics, and linguistic style adaptation to better align with real forum users. In a controlled evaluation across 100 CrimeBB conversations, the system recovered 72.8% of the validated MITRE ATT&CK techniques present in the original discussions by observing only the initial post at the start of each interaction, and it consistently outperformed a monolithic baseline. The proposed layered safety design contained all injected jailbreak attempts at the pipeline level. These results were further supported by real-world experiments: in a prospective matched deployment, threads assigned to DarkBot accumulated an average of 3.85 more CTI entities than their controls over seven days, and across 104 live forum conversations, the system elicited CTI-relevant disclosures without observed account suspensions, moderator interventions, or explicit accusations of automated participation.

</details>


### [396] [PhiShark2026: A Multi-Layer Active-Web Raw-Evidence Dataset for Phishing Website Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23199)
*Furkan Çolhak,Ferhat Demirkıran,Hasan Dağ,Alexander Iliev*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多层主动网络钓鱼数据集，包含67,502次扫描（33,387个钓鱼观测和34,115个良性参考观测），保留HTML、URL、重定向、HTTP/安全头、TLS证书、DNS、开放端口、地理定位等原始证据，并采用宿主感知的证据模型区分共享平台上的基础设施归属，为钓鱼测量研究提供可检查、可复现的基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有钓鱼数据集通常将观测简化为URL或预计算特征，限制了研究者对原始证据的访问，无法推导替代特征、应用新提取方法、考察跨层关系，也难以随钓鱼技术演化进行重分析。为解决这些局限，需要构建保留多层原始证据的钓鱼数据集。

Method: 构建多层面板网络数据集：包含67,502次扫描（33,387个来自运营封禁源的钓鱼观测及34,115个良性参考），系统性地保存HTML内容、截图、URL和重定向行为、HTTP和安全头、合规文件、TLS证书、DNS和域名注册、开放端口、地理位置和可访问性测量以及网络基础设施等多层原始证据，并显式记录不可用证据而非当作负面观测。同时采用宿主感知证据模型，对免费托管租户页面屏蔽提供者拥有的基础设施信号，保留有意义的页面级和传输级证据。

Result: 特征分析揭示了钓鱼网站与良性网站在Web资源使用、域名成熟度、邮件和策略配置、安全头以及基础设施上下文方面存在系统性差异。数据集保留了原始工件及采集元数据和明确证据可用性，提供了可检查和可复现的钓鱼测量基础。

Conclusion: 该多图层数据集通过保留原始证据和显式证据可用性记录，克服了传统钓鱼数据集仅保留URL或预计算特征的局限，为未来钓鱼测量和数据集研究提供了可检查且可复现的基础，有助于研究者随钓鱼技术演进进行重新分析。

Abstract: Phishing websites are short-lived and rapidly changing, yet many phishing datasets reduce observations to URLs or precomputed features, constraining researchers to predefined representations and discarding the underlying evidence needed to derive alternative features, apply new extraction methods, examine cross-layer relationships, and reanalyze observations as phishing techniques evolve. This study addresses this limitation with a multi-layer active-web dataset comprising 67,502 scans, including 33,387 phishing observations from operational feeds and 34,115 screened benign reference observations. The corpus preserves raw evidence across HTML content and screenshots, URL and redirect behavior, HTTP and security headers, compliance files, TLS certificates, DNS and domain registration, open ports, geolocation and accessibility measurements, and network infrastructure, while explicitly recording unavailable evidence rather than treating it as negative observations. To avoid misleading infrastructure attribution on shared platforms, the study applies a hosting-aware evidence model that masks provider-owned infrastructure signals for free-hosted tenant pages while retaining meaningful page- and transport-level evidence. Characterization reveals systematic differences between phishing and benign websites across web-resource usage, domain maturity, mail and policy configuration, security headers, and infrastructure context. By preserving raw artifacts together with acquisition metadata and explicit evidence availability, the corpus provides an inspectable and reproducible foundation for future phishing measurement and dataset research.

</details>


### [397] [FIDES: A Concordance Protocol for LLM-Generated Trading Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23308)
*Arther Tian,Alex Ding,Simon Wu,Aaron Chan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: FIDES 是一种测量协议，将大语言模型生成交易策略时的三个产物（自然语言理由、可执行代码、回测绩效）视为三个需要互相核对的视图，而非单一可评分的交付物。在 8 个美国 ETF、4 个模型、40 个策略的样本外测试中，发现三个关键问题：一致性不预测盈利（仅 2/40 策略跑赢买入持有）、自我评估严重失真（32/40 声称跑赢但仅 1 个属实）、语言-代码评判不稳定（更换评判模型会使半数以上的 say-to-do 结果翻转）。FIDES 强调其作为测量保真度协议的价值，而非对市场表现的论断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在生成交易策略时会同时产出自然语言解释、可执行代码和运行后的绩效记录，但很少被系统地检查这三者是否互相一致。现有做法往往将三者当作单一交付物笼统评分，忽略了语言表述、代码实现和实际结果之间的潜在严重背离，需要一种严格的测量协议来系统性地量化这些差异。

Method: FIDES 采用双重交付（dual delivery）设计：单次模型调用同时返回含明确声称优势的自然语言策略和自包含的 strategy(df) 函数。随后在沙箱中对滞后一期（lag-one）的样本外数据执行代码回测，并量化三个一致性缺口：(1) say-to-do（语言与代码间的差距）、(2) do-to-real（代码与实际结果间的差距）、(3) say-to-result（语言声称与实际表现间的差距）。实验覆盖 8 个流动美国 ETF、4 个模型及两阶段启发（two-stage elicitation）分支，共 40 个策略，样本期为 2023 至 2024 年。此外还引入未来信息探针（注入 Close.shift(-1)）与更换评判模型两种扰动测试。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 一致性并不能预测盈利能力，仅 2/40 策略跑赢买入持有，且简单 sma(50,200) 规则在平均 Sharpe 上超过所有模型的均值；(2) 自我评估校准严重失准，40 个策略中 32 个声称跑赢买入持有，但实际只有 1 个做到；(3) 将语言-代码评判者换成第二个模型后，超过半数的 say-to-do 一致性判定发生翻转。注入 Close.shift(-1) 平均降低 do-to-real 达 0.33，而运行时未来信息探针不论在干净代码还是注入代码上均未触发。

Conclusion: FIDES 应被视为一种测量保真度（measurement fidelity）协议，而非对市场表现的主张。它揭示了 LLM 生成策略在语言、代码与结果三视图之间的系统性失联，强调了可执行验证、自我评估校准和评判稳定性在评估 LLM 交易能力中的必要性。

Abstract: An LLM asked for a trading strategy returns three artifacts at once: a natural-language rationale, an executable implementation, and once run, a track record. Whether these are the same object is rarely checked. We present FIDES, a measurement protocol that treats them as three views to be reconciled rather than one deliverable to be graded. Through dual delivery, a single model call returns both a natural-language strategy with an explicit claimed edge and a self-contained strategy(df) function. FIDES executes the code in a sandbox against a lag-one out-of-sample backtest and scores three concordance gaps: say to do, do to real, and say to result.
  On 8 liquid US ETFs across four models plus a two-stage elicitation arm, 40 strategies, 2023 to 2024 out-of-sample, three findings stand out. First, concordance does not predict profit: only 2 of 40 strategies beat buy-and-hold, and a plain sma(50,200) rule outperforms every model's mean Sharpe. Second, self-assessment is badly calibrated: 32 of 40 strategies claim to beat buy-and-hold and exactly one does. Third, swapping the language-code judge for a second model flips say to do on more than half of items. Injecting Close.shift(-1) drops do to real by 0.33 on average, while our runtime future-information probe fired on neither clean nor injected code. We frame FIDES as a protocol for measurement fidelity, not a claim about market performance.

</details>


### [398] [SxSSD: A Secure and Extensible Software-defined Solid State Drive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23365)
*Josh Dafoe,Bo Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了SxSSD，一种安全且可扩展的软件定义SSD设计，通过将内部策略定义与底层FTL机制解耦，允许可信应用动态且安全地定义FTL策略和存储接口，同时保留了传统块级SSD的隔离安全性和更高灵活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统块级SSD的FTL固件难以修改，安全设计（如恶意软件攻击下的数据恢复）需要修改FTL代码但缺乏接口；而open-channel SSD和zoned namespace将FTL移入操作系统，虽然提高了可扩展性，但模糊了可信边界，增加了安全风险。作者希望同时获得可扩展性和安全性。

Method: SxSSD将FTL中的策略定义与底层机制解耦，允许可信应用动态定义FTL策略和暴露的存储接口；识别并解决了OS被攻破场景下的关键安全挑战；实现了原型系统并对比不同FTL策略和存储接口进行了性能评估。

Result: 实验评估表明，SxSSD相比原生FTL实现的额外开销很小，证明了该设计在提供灵活性和安全性的同时，性能代价可接受。

Conclusion: SxSSD成功兼顾了软件定义SSD的可扩展性与传统块级FTL的隔离安全性，为安全且可扩展的SSD设计提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Solid-state drives (SSDs) are built on NAND flash memory and expose it to the operating system through a block-based storage interface. As NAND flash has special read/write constraints due to its hardware nature, a translation between OS-level I/Os and raw flash memory I/Os is needed. This results in a flash translation layer (FTL) that creates a ``trusted computing base'' due to its physical isolation from the OS. Building on this trusted computing base, some security designs (e.g., data recovery from malware attacks) can ensure strong data security properties even if the OS is compromised. However, they mostly require modifying the FTL's firmware code, which is hard in practice because the traditional block-based FTL does not provide an interface to modify its internal functions. New flash storage interface designs, such as open-channel SSDs or zoned namespaces, have moved key FTL functions into the OS. These interfaces ease modification of FTL functions, at the cost of blurring the trusted boundary, as the FTL is no longer isolated from the OS.
  In this work, we have introduced SxSSD, a secure yet extensible software-defined SSD design. By decoupling internal policy definitions from primitive FTL mechanisms, we allow trusted applications to dynamically and securely define FTL policies and the exposed storage interface (achieving increased flexibility compared to open-channel and zoned namespaces SSDs). Most significantly, SxSSD retains the isolation of traditional FTL execution (achieving security similar to traditional block-based SSDs). We have identified and addressed key security challenges introduced under a compromised OS. In addition, we have implemented a prototype of SxSSD and evaluated its overhead with different FTL policies and storage interfaces. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the overhead incurred by SxSSD is small compared to native FTL implementations.

</details>


### [399] [Adversarial Entropy Inflation Against Gumbel-Based Inference Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23375)
*Nikita Kezins*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于Gumbel的推断验证机制对LLM权重窃取的防御效果，发现该防御在被动攻击者假设下有效（>200倍减速），但当攻击者控制提示词分布时防御显著退化。通过对六个模型（1B-32B参数）的实验，字符和脚本级别破坏的提示词可使每位令牌泄露的比特数翻倍，将减速因子降至60x-118x，表明静态良性流量校准的阈值不足以防御，应改用基于局部令牌熵的动态阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Gumbel-based推断验证防御假设了被动攻击者，但未考虑攻击者主动控制提示词分布的场景。由于验证器的可接受令牌集大小由模型自身的输出熵决定，攻击者可通过工程化设计的提示词（打破语法和子词结构）来扩大可接受令牌集，从而打开更大的隐蔽信道，使现有防御的基准阈值失效。

Method: 作者设计了多种对抗性提示词策略（包括字符级和脚本级结构破坏），并在六个指令微调模型（参数规模1B至32B）和三个随机种子下进行实验。攻击者策略旨在扩大验证器中可接受令牌集的大小，从而提升每一位令牌的隐蔽信道容量。

Result: 最强的攻击（字符级和脚本级破坏）相比良性提示词，每位令牌泄露的比特数大约翻倍，将权重窃取攻击的减速因子从>200x降至60x-118x。防御效果在攻击者控制提示词分布时急剧退化。

Conclusion: 静态的、基于良性流量校准的容差阈值不足以抵御主动攻击者。jitter-forgiveness阈值应根据局部令牌熵进行动态校准，以提高该防御机制在面对提示词分布可控的攻击者时的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Gumbel-based inference verification bounds LLM weight exfiltration by only forgiving token choices that plausibly arise from honest GPU nondeterminism, reporting a >200x slowdown for a steganographic adversary under benign prompt traffic. This bound assumes a passive attacker; we show it degrades sharply against an adversary who instead controls the prompt distribution. Because the verifier's admissible-token-set size is driven by the model's own output entropy, prompts engineered to break grammatical and sub-word structure -- rather than benign conversational traffic -- widen that set and open a materially larger covert channel. Across six instruction-tuned models spanning 1B to 32B parameters and three random seeds, our strongest attack (character- and script-level disruption) roughly doubles bits leaked per token relative to benign prompts, cutting the slowdown factor to 60x - 118x. These results indicate that static, benign-traffic-calibrated thresholds are insufficient for this defense, and that jitter-forgiveness thresholds should instead be calibrated dynamically against local token entropy.

</details>


### [400] [A Threshold Homomorphic Blockchain Architecture for Secure and Scalable IoT Sensor Data Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23396)
*Narendra Kumar Dewangan,Mounira Msahli*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Phi-PHE-BC，一种拓扑感知的同态加密区块链架构，用于安全且隐私保护的IoT传感器数据聚合。该框架结合阈值Paillier解密与图参数化的安全性和性能分析，将协议行为与验证者图关联起来，支持链上同态聚合，并提供了部分同步和拜占庭容错假设下的活性与吞吐量分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的同态加密区块链框架通常依赖经典密码学困难性假设，很少将网络拓扑纳入活性与性能分析中。本文旨在弥补这一空白，构建一个同时考虑密码学安全性与网络拓扑结构的IoT传感器聚合架构。

Method: 结合阈值Paillier解密与图参数化分析，使用链上Paillier密文实现同态聚合，提供IND-CPA机密性和EUF-CMA交易完整性；通过噪声洪泛包装保护部分解密份额，实现信息论隐私；在部分同步和BFT假设下，要求验证者连通性kappa(Gv)>=f+1保证活性；对树、星型、网格和无标度网络推导拓扑相关的吞吐量界，并构建每区块通信成本模型；采用博弈论分析诚实验证者参与策略。

Result: 在Hyperledger Fabric 2.5上的实验显示，相比传统PHE区块链基线，端到端延迟更低，同时保持可控的阈值解密开销。拓扑扩展、验证者敏感性、阈值解密和拜占庭负载实验均验证了其实际可行性。

Conclusion: Phi-PHE-BC是一种实用、安全、隐私保护且拓扑感知的IoT传感器聚合架构，博弈论分析表明诚实验证者参与是主导策略，形成全诚实纳什均衡，实验验证了其实践可行性。

Abstract: Homomorphic-encryption blockchain frameworks for IoT sensor aggregation generally rely on classical cryptographic hardness assumptions and seldom account for network topology in liveness and performance analysis. This work introduces Phi-PHE-BC, a topology-aware homomorphic blockchain architecture for secure and privacy-preserving IoT sensor data aggregation. The framework combines threshold Paillier decryption with graph-parameterized security and performance analysis, linking protocol behavior to the validator graph. On-chain Paillier ciphertexts support homomorphic aggregation while providing IND-CPA confidentiality under the Decisional Composite Residuosity assumption, and authentication signatures provide EUF-CMA transaction integrity. Threshold partial-decryption shares are protected by a noise-flooding wrapper that provides information-theoretic privacy under the configured statistical-hiding condition. Under partial synchrony and Byzantine fault-tolerance assumptions, liveness requires validator connectivity kappa(Gv) >= f+1. We derive topology-dependent throughput bounds for tree, star, mesh, and scale-free networks, together with a per-block communication-cost model. A game-theoretic analysis shows that honest validator participation is a dominant strategy under the stated utility model, yielding an all-honest Nash equilibrium. Experiments on Hyperledger Fabric 2.5 show lower end-to-end latency than the selected traditional PHE-blockchain baseline while maintaining controllable threshold-decryption overhead. Results across topology scaling, validator sensitivity, threshold decryption, and Byzantine-load experiments indicate that Phi-PHE-BC is a practical architecture for secure, privacy-preserving, and topology-aware IoT sensor aggregation.

</details>


### [401] [InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23471)
*Hanling Tian,Gengyu Zhang,Zeyang Sha,Jingying Wang,Yuhang Liu,Zhehao Huang,Kun Yang,Xiaolin Huang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出InjecMEM——一种仅需单次交互即可注入内存系统的攻击范式，通过设计检索无关的锚点和对抗性指令，在用户后续相关查询中持续操纵模型输出，揭示了LLM智能体内存系统的新安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着内存系统成为LLM智能体的默认子系统以提供持久个性化和连续性，自然引出一个关键问题：内存系统是否会为智能体引入新的安全漏洞？作者旨在系统性探索这一攻击面。

Method: 基于内存系统的检索-再生成机制，作者构造包含两类组件的注入：(1) 高召回率的主题锚点，使下游检索稳定地将记录关联到目标主题；(2) 通过梯度坐标搜索优化的对抗性指令，在不确定的融合上下文、位置变化和长提示下保持有效性。指令通过合成提示模板和插入位置的平均化学习，并扩展到跨骨干模型的联合优化以研究迁移性。

Result: 在多个内存系统和骨干模型上的评估表明，InjecMEM实现了可靠的主题条件检索和目标生成，在内存漂移下依然有效，同时不影响非目标查询。攻击仅需单次交互，无需对内存存储具有读写权限。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调需要加固内存系统，并为研究智能体内存安全提供了可复现的框架。

Abstract: Memory is becoming a default subsystem in deployed LLM agents to provide persistent personalization and continuity. This naturally prompts a question: will memory system introduce new vulnerabilities into agents? Thus we propose InjecMEM, a novel memory injection attack paradigm that requires only a single interaction (no read/edit access to memory store) to steer later responses of related queries toward a pre-specified output. Guided by the retrieval-then-generate mechanism of memory systems, we craft the injection with a retriever-agnostic anchor and an adversarial command. The anchor contains high-recall topical cues so that downstream retrieval consistently associates the record with the target topic. The command is a short sequence optimized to remain effective under uncertain fused contexts, variable placements, and long prompts so that it reliably steers outputs once retrieved. We learn the command via gradient-based coordinate search, averaging over synthetic prompt templates and insertion positions, and extend it to joint optimization across backbones to study transfer. Evaluated across multiple memory systems and backbone models, InjecMEM achieves reliable topic-conditioned retrieval and targeted generation, remains effective under memory drift, and leaves non-target queries unaffected. Our results underscore the need to harden memory systems and provide a reproducible framework for studying agent memory.

</details>


### [402] [Adapter-Based Few-Shot Continual Learning for Malicious Packet Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23536)
*Kyle Stein,Guillermo Francia,III Eman El-Sheikh,Andrew Arash Mahyari*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对恶意软件分类中的Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL)设置，提出了一种混合框架，结合领域预训练的SSL骨干网络、LoRA低秩自适应和原型分类头，在抵御灾难性遗忘的同时高效学习新恶意软件类别，并在多个数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶意软件变体不断演化，检测系统需要在不从头重训的情况下适应新威胁。然而持续更新模型常导致灾难性遗忘。虽然持续学习在恶意软件检测中已被探索，但FSCIL设置（仅凭少量标注样本学习新恶意软件类别）仍相对未被充分研究。

Method: 提出一个混合框架：1) 使用在恶意软件数据包上进行领域特定预训练的自监督学习(SSL)骨干网络作为初始化；2) 在基础会话中采用低秩自适应(LoRA)高效微调模型，同时冻结核心骨干网络以保留已学表示；3) 增量会话中使用基于原型的分类头，从有限样本中建立稳健的决策边界。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法持续优于先前的恶意软件FSCIL基线方法，达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的混合框架有效缓解了FSCIL中的稳定性-可塑性困境，为恶意软件分类领域的小样本类增量学习提供了可行且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: The continual evolution of malware variants necessitates detection systems that can adapt to new threats without retraining from scratch. However, continually updating models on new data often leads to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned knowledge is overwritten. While continual learning has been increasingly explored for malware detection, the specific setting of Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL), where new malware classes must be learned from only a small number of labeled examples, remains comparatively underexplored. Therefore, this work investigates the FSCIL setting for malware classification. To address the stability-plasticity dilemma, we propose a hybrid framework that leverages a Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) backbone initialized through domain-specific pre-training on malware packets. Our method incorporates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to efficiently adapt the model during the base session while freezing the core backbone to preserve previously learned representations, alongside a prototype-based classification head for incremental sessions to establish robust decision boundaries from limited samples. Extensive experiments across several datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior malware FSCIL baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [403] [Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems under Training-Time Data Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23547)
*Mustafa Umut Ozbek,Taiwo Ojo,Pooria Madani,Khalil El-Khatib,Li Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了11种离线异常检测器在SWaT工控基准上对训练时污染的鲁棒性，包括三种污染策略（随机注入、相似性定向注入、特征噪声注入）和1%-10%的污染预算。结果表明鲁棒性与模型强相关，无法从干净数据性能预测；基于局部密度和距离的检测器受注入污染影响最大，而PCA、SVM、HBOS和IForest相对稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工控系统异常检测研究大多假设训练数据可信，但实际中训练数据可能因日志被篡改、标注错误、历史记录被操纵或安全重训练流程不当而受到污染。本文旨在填补这一空白，评估离线ICS异常检测流水线在训练时污染下的鲁棒性。

Method: 在SWaT基准上采用统一离线协议，评估11种异质异常检测器在三种污染策略下的表现：前两种（随机注入、相似性定向注入）将攻击样本注入正常训练池，第三种（特征噪声注入）向选定的正常训练样本添加有界高斯噪声。污染预算为1%-10%，使用干净的验证集和测试集进行评估，属于基于污染的而非梯度驱动的投毒方法。

Result: 鲁棒性高度依赖模型，无法由干净数据上的表现预测。注入型污染造成最大性能退化，尤其对局部密度和距离类检测器影响显著；特征噪声污染影响相对有限。PCA、SVM、HBOS和IForest保持相对稳定，而调优的神经检测器表现出中等鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 训练数据完整性对于ML赋能的工控系统监控至关重要。研究结果凸显了在选择和部署工控异常检测器时需考虑其对训练数据污染的抗性，但结论受限于所评估的数据集、模型和威胁假设。

Abstract: Machine-learning-based anomaly detection is increasingly used in industrial control systems (ICS), yet most studies assume that detector training data is trustworthy. In practice, training data may be corrupted through compromised logs, labeling errors, manipulated historian records, or unsafe retraining processes. This paper evaluates the robustness of offline ICS anomaly-detection pipelines on the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) benchmark under training-time contamination. We assess 11 heterogeneous anomaly detectors under three contamination strategies: random injection, similarity-targeted injection, and feature-noise injection. The first two insert attack samples into the nominal training pool, while the third adds bounded Gaussian noise to selected normal training samples. These attacks are contamination-based rather than gradient-driven poisoning methods. Contamination budgets from 1% to 10% are evaluated using clean validation and test sets under a unified offline protocol. The results show that robustness is strongly model-dependent and cannot be predicted from clean-data performance alone. Injection-based contamination causes the greatest degradation, particularly for local-density and distance-based detectors, whereas feature-noise contamination has a comparatively limited effect. PCA, SVM, HBOS, and IForest remain relatively stable, while the tuned neural detectors demonstrate intermediate robustness. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of training-data integrity in ML-enabled ICS monitoring, subject to the evaluated dataset, models, and threat assumptions.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [404] [Spectral partitioning for $k$-block averaging kernels of finite Markov chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21466)
*Michael C. H. Choi,Youjia Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于选择有限遍历可逆马尔可夫链的状态空间划分的谱算法，通过将P²的底部非平凡特征函数（或P的代数最小特征函数）进行加权k-means取整来构造划分。该方法定义的Gibbs核能在块内按平稳条件分布重采样，与基线核P组合可加速收敛。作者导出了目标函数F的精确迹与归一化割表示，证明了其等于Pearson χ²互信息，并为两块情形给出精确阈值扫描解法，为一般k≥2情形提供了子空间距离形式的谱近似界。该方法与经典归一化谱聚类相反，使用底部模式促进跨块大流量和块标签信息的快速丢失，在多个实验（控制谱图、平均场Ising模型、贝叶斯变量选择）中展示了每次迭代的显著收敛和统计估计改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法在收敛速度上常受限于状态空间的结构。通过选择合适的状态空间划分来定义Gibbs核（在块内按平稳条件分布重采样），并与基线核混合或复合，可以加速收敛。然而，如何自动选取最优的划分（即哪些状态应被聚为一个块以便块内重采样）是一个关键且具有挑战性的问题。作者旨在开发系统性的谱算法来优化这一划分选择，并为其提供理论保证和概率解释。

Method: 作者提出通过加权k-means对P²的底部非平凡特征函数（或对加法混合情形使用P的代数最小特征函数）进行取整来选择划分O。核心目标函数为F(O)=‖G_O P−Π‖²_{F,π}，作者推导出其精确的迹表示和归一化割表示，并证明F等于初始块标签与一步转移后状态之间的Pearson χ²互信息。对两块情形用阈值扫描精确求解一维加权two-means问题；对一般k≥2，先对底部(k−1)维嵌入做加权k-means取整，再用F对候选划分重新打分。作者还证明了取整失真可表示为子空间间的距离，从而导出谱近似界。框架进一步扩展到加法混合、有限时域目标和折扣无限时域目标。

Result: 实验在三个场景中验证了方法：控制谱图（可精确控制特征谱的图结构）、平均场Ising模型和贝叶斯变量选择问题。结果表明，所提出的划分选择方法在每次迭代的收敛速度和统计估计方面都带来了显著改进。与经典归一化谱聚类使用顶部非平凡模态寻找低流量持久簇不同，本方法使用底部模态以促进大的归一化跨块流量和块标签信息的快速丢失。

Conclusion: 本文为MCMC加速中的划分选择提供了一套具有理论保证的谱算法框架。通过使用底部特征模态（而非经典谱聚类的顶部模态），该方法能够构造有利于快速混合和标签信息丢失的划分，从而加速马尔可夫链收敛。理论贡献包括对目标函数的迹/归一化割表示、与χ²互信息的等价性、精确的两块求解方案以及一般的谱近似界。实验证明了该方法在多种应用中的实际有效性。

Abstract: We develop spectral algorithms for selecting state-space partitions that define averaging kernels for finite, ergodic and reversible Markov chains. For a partition $\mathcal O$, the Gibbs kernel $G_{\mathcal O}$ resamples within the current block from the stationary conditional distribution; when this update is tractable, composing or mixing it with a baseline kernel $P$ can accelerate convergence. We select $\mathcal O$ by rounding the bottom nonconstant eigenfunctions of $P^2$, or the algebraically smallest eigenfunctions of $P$ for additive mixtures, using weighted $k$-means. For $F(\mathcal O)=\|G_{\mathcal O}P-Π\|_{F,π}^2$, we derive exact trace and normalized-cut representations and show that $F$ equals the Pearson $χ^2$-mutual information between the initial block label and the state after one transition, giving this matrix objective a natural probabilistic interpretation. In the two-block case, a threshold sweep exactly solves the associated one-dimensional weighted two-means rounding problem. For general $k \geq 2$, weighted $k$-means rounds the bottom $(k-1)$-dimensional embedding, after which candidates are rescored by $F$; the rounding distortion is a distance between subspaces that yields spectral approximation bounds. We extend the framework to additive mixtures, finite-horizon objectives, and discounted infinite-horizon objectives. In contrast to classical normalized spectral clustering, which uses top nonconstant modes to find low-flow persistent clusters, our method uses bottom modes to favor large normalized cross-block flow and rapid loss of block-label information. Experiments on a controlled-spectrum graph, a mean-field Ising model, and Bayesian variable selection show notable per-iteration improvements in convergence and statistical estimation.

</details>


### [405] [Gauss--Hermite Quadrature for Gaussian-Mixture Entropy with an Action-Space Hermite Surrogate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21467)
*Jae Wan Shim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出两种方法：一是利用Gauss-Hermite求积法近似评估高斯混合分布的微分熵，二是提出用于行动空间的Hermite多项式代理模型。在雷达指向基准中，二阶Hermite代理相比二阶Taylor代理在同等计算预算（每次重规划九次直接目标评估）下，实现了显著更低的代理误差和优化遗憾，并改善了指向性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯分布广泛用于信号和状态中的不确定性建模，而高斯混合常用于多模态分布场景。与单一高斯不同，高斯混合的微分熵通常没有闭式表达式，需要数值近似。此外，在连续行动空间的重复优化问题上，需要更高效的代理模型来降低优化遗憾。

Method: 提出一种基于Gauss-Hermite求积法的高斯混合微分熵评估方法，求积阶数控制近似数值分辨率。同时提出在行动空间中使用Hermite多项式构建代理模型（surrogate），用于连续行动上的重复优化。

Result: 在二维高斯混合基准上，该方法与Taylor近似、解析熵界和数值积分参考进行了比较评估。在雷达指向基准中，二阶Hermite代理相比基于名义行动局部导数的二阶Taylor代理，在相同计算量（九次直接目标评估）下实现了显著更低的代理误差和优化遗憾，并改善了指向性能。

Conclusion: Gauss-Hermite求积法为高斯混合微分熵提供了可控分辨率的数值近似方案，而Hermite多项式代理在连续行动重复优化场景中优于基于局部导数的Taylor代理。

Abstract: Gaussian distributions are used to model uncertainty in signals and states, and Gaussian mixtures are often used when the underlying distribution is multimodal. Unlike a single Gaussian, a Gaussian mixture generally has no closed-form expression for differential entropy and therefore requires numerical approximation. We propose a Gauss--Hermite quadrature method for evaluating Gaussian mixture differential entropy. The quadrature order controls the numerical resolution of the approximation. The method is evaluated on one- and two-dimensional Gaussian mixture benchmarks against Taylor approximations, analytic entropy bounds, and numerical integration references.
  For repeated optimization over continuous actions, we also propose a Hermite polynomial surrogate in action space. In a radar pointing benchmark, its second-order form achieves substantially lower surrogate error and optimizer regret than a second-order Taylor surrogate based on local derivatives at the nominal action, while both methods use nine direct objective evaluations per replanning step. The Hermite surrogate also improves pointing performance in the tested benchmark.

</details>


### [406] [A Data-Driven Approach to State Construction in Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21480)
*Linde Van Gestel,Marie-Anne Guerry,Evy Rombaut*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合监督式特征选择与无监督学习的马尔可夫链状态构建方法框架，通过比较密度聚类、谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射三种无监督技术，发现谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射在捕捉数据内在结构方面表现最佳，为马尔可夫建模中的状态定义提供了方法论指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 马尔可夫链模型依赖状态（state）构建，但传统方法中状态的创建常被忽略或基于先验假设，可能违反转移概率的齐性（homogeneity）要求，从而降低模型的有效性与预测能力。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 将监督式特征选择与无监督学习（密度聚类、谱聚类、Kohonen自组织映射）相结合，构建数据驱动的状态划分框架。同时引入分类性能与马尔可夫模型精度两方面的评价指标来评估状态构建效果。

Result: 在真实应用案例上的比较分析表明，谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射在捕捉潜在内在结构方面表现最佳。

Conclusion: 本文为应用马尔可夫建模中的状态定义提供了理论与方法论基础，可作为改进状态划分的基石性指导。

Abstract: A Markov chain is a widely used stochastic process modelling random events over time. These models are built on subsets of the entire dataset, referred to as states, which are considered to be homogeneous regarding transition probabilities. However, the creation of these states is often disregarded or based on prior assumption, potentially violating the homogeneity requirement and thus decreasing the validity and predictive power of the model. In order to fill this gap, this paper combines supervised feature selection with unsupervised learning techniques for data-driven state construction. Density-based clustering, spectral clustering, and Kohonen self-organizing maps are examined for their ability to identify latent groups without prior assumptions. The contribution of this study is twofold. First, the paper presents a methodological framework for state construction incorporating suitable unsupervised learning techniques, with appropriate measures both for classification performance and Markov model accuracy. Secondly, the framework is tested on an application, resulting in a comparative analysis showing that spectral clustering and Kohonen self-organizing maps are best at capturing inherent structure. These results serve as a cornerstone in providing theoretical and methodological guidance for improving state definition in applied Markov modelling.

</details>


### [407] [Sparse Separable Factor Analysis in the Complex Domain with an Application to Local Field Potential Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21551)
*Ian Hultman,Kirtikanth Kalapatapu,Yassine Filali,Rainbo Hultman,Sanvesh Srivastava*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏可分因子分析（SSFA），一种针对复值数组的潜变量因子模型，通过跨模态可分离协方差结构建模复值张量数据，并采用逐元素lasso惩罚和复软阈值更新实现可解释的稀疏估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号处理中广泛存在复值数组数据，其科学解释依赖于保留振幅和相位信息。现有协方差估计方法要么忽略数据的多路组织结构，要么依赖实数域嵌入而无法直接利用复值结构。

Method: SSFA采用跨模态可分离协方差结构，每个模态的协方差矩阵由低秩Hermitian因子结构和对角残差协方差矩阵组成。对复加载矩阵施加逐元素lasso惩罚，并通过逐模态参数扩展的期望最大化（EM）过程进行估计，加载更新具有闭式复软阈值解（缩小模的同时保留相位），另设平衡步骤解决可分离协方差结构的尺度不可识别性。

Result: 模拟研究表明SSFA相比基于向量化的方法（包括复主成分分析）能改进协方差估计性能。在真实数据应用中，对小鼠局部场电位记录的分析揭示脑区、频率和时间不同分组诱导的可分离结构，并实现对电极错位导致缺失记录基于模型的插补。

Conclusion: SSFA为复值数组提供了一种直接利用其复数结构的多路稀疏协方差估计框架，兼顾可解释性与估计精度，在神经科学信号中展现出实际应用价值。

Abstract: Complex-valued arrays arise in signal processing, where scientific interpretation depends on retaining amplitude and phase information. Existing covariance estimation methods either ignore the multiway organization of such data or rely on real-domain embeddings that do not directly exploit their complex structure. We develop sparse separable factor analysis (SSFA), a latent factor model for complex-valued arrays with a separable covariance structure across modes. Each mode-specific covariance matrix is modeled through a low-rank Hermitian factor structure and a diagonal residual covariance matrix. To obtain interpretable estimates, we impose elementwise lasso penalties on the complex loading matrices and estimate the SSFA parameters using a mode-wise parameter-expanded expectation-maximization procedure. The resulting loading updates admit closed-form complex soft-thresholding solutions, which shrink the modulus of each loading while preserving its phase. A separate balancing step resolves the scale nonidentifiability of the separable covariance structure. Simulation studies show that SSFA improves covariance estimation relative to vectorization-based methods, including complex principal component analysis. We apply SSFA to local field potential recordings from mice, where we compare separability structures induced by different groupings of brain region, frequency, and time and perform model-based imputation of recordings missing because of electrode misplacement.

</details>


### [408] [Random Hazard Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21597)
*Hemant Ishwaran,Eileen M. Hsich,Udaya B. Kogalur,Donald K. K. Lee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出随机风险森林（RHF），一种基于生存树的集成方法，用于在连续时间中利用纵向（不规则、异步更新的）协变量学习患者的动态风险变化，无需前瞻性信息即可进行实时更新的个体化风险预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录和可穿戴传感器等临床数据源会在随访过程中以不规则时间、不同测量计划重复记录患者状态，这为连续更新的个体化风险预测创造了机会。然而现有方法往往在建模前简化了时间结构，难以充分利用纵向协变量在连续时间上的动态变化信息。

Method: RHF通过非参数风险似然直接构建估计问题，利用高效的工作模型指导树构建，然后为每个终端节点估计灵活的时间变化风险。给定任意可预测的协变量路径，每棵树沿路径在终端节点间移动并组装相应的节点级风险形成轨迹，对所有树取平均得到路径级风险估计。由于每个时间点的路由仅使用紧邻之前的协变量状态，RHF可容纳内部纵向协变量而不引入前瞻偏差。

Result: 仿真实验和重症监护（ICU）实际应用表明，RHF在不规则和异步协变量更新情况下能够准确估计变化的患病风险。

Conclusion: RHF为处理不规则、异步纵向临床数据提供了有效的非参数生存分析方法，能够在连续时间上动态更新个体化风险预测，具有重要的临床应用价值。

Abstract: Clinical data sources such as electronic health records and wearable sensors record patient status repeatedly over follow-up, often at irregular times and on different schedules for different measurements. These data create opportunities for continuously updated, individualized risk prediction. Existing approaches, however, often simplify the temporal structure before modeling it. We introduce Random Hazard Forests (RHF), a survival tree ensemble that learns how a patient's hazard changes in continuous time as new measurements become available. RHF formulates the estimation problem directly through a nonparametric hazard likelihood for predictable covariate processes. An efficient working model guides tree construction, after which flexible time-varying hazards are estimated for each terminal node. Given any predictable covariate path, each tree follows the path through its terminal nodes over time and assembles the corresponding node-level hazards into a trajectory. Averaging these trajectories across trees yields the RHF pathwise hazard estimate. Because routing at each time uses only the covariate state available immediately beforehand, RHF accommodates internal longitudinal covariates without lookahead. Simulations and an intensive care application show that RHF accurately estimates changing risk under irregular and asynchronous covariate updates.

</details>


### [409] [Guidance for Prior Change via Density Ratio Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21729)
*Yichen Zang,Song Liu,Jiun-Yi Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于密度比估计（DRE）的无偏测试时引导框架，用于模拟器中的参数推断，解决了PriorGuide因高斯近似和高斯混合模型拟合引入的系统偏差，同时避免了先验依赖性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟器推断（SBI）在似然不可解的领域至关重要，但摊销生成模型受限于训练时先验，缺乏随先验知识演化的灵活性。PriorGuide虽提出推断时引导方法，但其不可解公式依赖高斯近似和GMM拟合，引入系统性偏差。

Method: 提出一个无偏的测试时引导框架，利用密度比估计（DRE）学习得分引导项，将推断过程与训练先验解耦；框架对特定密度比估计器保持不可知性，具有通用性和灵活性。

Result: 在多个任务中，该方法在C2ST和MMD指标上匹配或优于PriorGuide，且在训练先验和目标先验重叠有限时仍保持鲁棒性；应用于行星光变曲线的贝叶斯更新参数推断中也表现出强有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DRE-based框架成功消除了PriorGuide的系统偏差，实现了先验无关的无偏推断，并在多个任务及真实科学数据（行星光变曲线）上验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) serves as a vital framework for parameter inference in scientific fields where simulators involve intractable likelihoods, yet while amortized generative models offer rapid posterior estimation, they are often restricted by the specific priors used during training, thereby limiting their flexibility as prior knowledge evolves. To address this prior dependency, PriorGuide was introduced as an inference-time guidance method, but due to its intractable formulation, it relies on Gaussian approximations of the reverse transition kernel and Gaussian mixture model fitting for the prior ratio, both of which introduce systematic bias. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an unbiased test-time guidance framework that leverages Density Ratio Estimation (DRE) to learn a score guidance term, effectively decoupling the inference process from the prior training. Moreover, our framework remains agnostic to the specific density ratio estimators, making it a general and flexible framework for handling prior changes. Experimental results across multiple tasks demonstrate that our method matches or outperforms PriorGuide on C2ST and MMD in most tasks while maintaining robustness even under limited overlap between the training and target priors. Furthermore, we apply our method to Bayesian updating for parameter inference from planetary light-curve data, where it also demonstrates strong effectiveness and robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/a-chenchen/dre-based-prior-guidance .

</details>


### [410] [Structured Learning on Mapper Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22044)
*George Babus,Farzana Nasrin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在Mapper构建的拓扑表示上进行学习的框架，将完整Mapper构造视为表示本身，而非仅作为预处理步骤产出图。该框架研究表示的重标注不变性、距离函数、多尺度分解的结构复杂度以及学习稳定性，并通过时间序列和图分类实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习方法通常将复杂数据压缩为固定维度的嵌入向量，这可能会抑制数据的多尺度结构组织信息。Mapper算法虽能通过神经构造分解数据为重叠局部区域，捕捉几何组织、局部统计行为和关系连通性，但现有工作仅将Mapper作为预处理图生成工具，未将其充分融入表示学习框架中。

Method: 提出了一个在Mapper诱导的结构化表示上进行学习的数学框架，核心思想是将完整的Mapper构造视为表示本身的组成部分。具体包括：1) 研究表示的重标注不变性数学性质；2) 定义Mapper表示空间上的距离函数；3) 分析多尺度分解的结构复杂度；4) 研究表示扰动下的学习方向稳定性。通过时间序列和图分类数据集上的受控实验进行验证，包括表示消融研究、Mapper参数敏感性分析及表示空间几何分析。

Result: 实验通过受控的表示消融、Mapper参数敏感性和表示空间几何分析验证了所提框架的有效性，展示了该框架能够对Mapper表示进行系统性的比较、解释和分析。

Conclusion: 所提出的数学框架为Mapper表示提供了系统比较、解释和分析的工具，为表示几何、结构复杂度和学习稳定性研究提供了实用手段，表明Mapper构造可作为一种有效的可学习表示形式。

Abstract: Modern machine learning (ML) methods are highly effective for prediction tasks, but many commonly used representations reduce complex data to fixed dimensional embeddings that may suppress multiscale structural organization. The Mapper algorithm from topological data analysis (TDA) provides a different perspective by decomposing data into overlapping local regions connected through a nerve construction, producing a structured representation that captures geometric organization, local statistical behavior, and relational connectivity simultaneously. In this work, we develop a framework for learning over Mapper induced structured representations. Rather than treating Mapper as a preprocessing step that produces a graph for downstream learning, we treat the full Mapper construction as part of the representation itself. We study mathematical properties of these representations, including invariance under relabeling, a distance functional on the space of Mapper representations, structural complexity of multiscale decompositions, and learning oriented stability under representation perturbations. Experiments on time series and graph classification datasets validate the proposed framework through controlled studies of representation ablation, Mapper parameter sensitivity, and the geometry of the induced representation space. Together, these results demonstrate how the proposed mathematical framework enables systematic comparison, interpretation, and analysis of Mapper representations, providing practical tools for studying representation geometry, structural complexity, and learning stability in learning tasks.

</details>


### [411] [Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22179)
*Jiajun Sun,Zhanrui Cai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出似然数组回归（LAR）方法，通过嵌套左上下文窗口评估每个目标token的似然特征并组织成结构化数组，显著提升成员推断和AI生成文本检测性能，并建立了匹配的极小极大理论界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于似然的方法通常将token级概率压缩为少数预设分数，且大多仅使用全前文上下文条件下的概率，忽略了不同上下文尺度下的似然信息。作者希望挖掘短上下文似然中蕴含的、超越传统全上下文概率的检测信息。

Method: LAR方法在多个嵌套左上下文窗口下评估每个目标token，将似然特征组织为结构化数组。通过对齐跨不同长度文本的数组，学习检测信息如何随上下文尺度、token位置和似然特征变化。LAR-1聚合单个对齐单元的学得贡献；LAR-2增加由同一目标token在不同上下文长度下评估对形成的二阶特征。对于二次模型，建立了极小极大匹配界，表征了有限维近似和随机平方投影的误差。

Result: 在多个评分语言模型上，LAR在成员推断和AI生成文本检测上均显著优于基于似然的基线。分析表明短上下文似然包含超越全上下文概率的额外信息，二阶特征为成员推断提供额外增益。

Conclusion: LAR通过系统性利用多尺度上下文似然信息，为成员推断和AI生成文本检测提供了更强大的方法，其理论分析为理解似然信息的尺度结构提供了框架，并揭示了短上下文与二阶交互特征的重要价值。

Abstract: Membership inference asks whether a text was used to train a language model, whereas AI-generated text detection asks whether it was generated by a language model rather than written by a human. Existing likelihood-based methods typically compress token-level probabilities into a few prespecified scores, most often using only probabilities conditioned on the full preceding context. We propose likelihood-array regression (LAR), which evaluates each target token under nested left-context windows and organizes the resulting likelihood-derived features into a structured array. After aligning arrays across texts of different lengths, LAR learns how detection information varies with context scale, token position, and likelihood features. LAR-1 aggregates learned contributions from individual aligned cells, while LAR-2 adds second-order features formed from pairs of evaluations of the same target token across context lengths. For within-path quadratic model, we establish matching minimax lower and upper bounds, characterize errors from finite-dimensional approximation and random squared projections, and derive conditions under which an oracle spectral sieve attains the minimax rate. Across multiple scoring language models, LAR substantially improves membership inference and AI-generated text detection over likelihood-based baselines. The analyses further show that shorter-context likelihoods contain information beyond conventional full-context probabilities, while second-order features provide additional gains for membership inference.

</details>


### [412] [Recovering Weighted Tangent Geometry from a Single-Scale Score Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22334)
*Ziqi Zhao,Qingjian Ni*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在分支点（branch point）处，如何仅通过单一噪声水平下的得分场（score field）来恢复加权切向几何（weighted tangent geometry），即各分支的局部份额（归一化角度测度）、分支中心及齐次度 d。作者建立了切向测度模型，证明分数值（不需导数）满足 OU 特征函数方程，可解出中心与齐次度；进而证明在任意环境维度 D≥2 中，单个精确球面可识别归一化角度测度；对至多 K 条正射线，2K-1 阶矩可构造性恢复数量、方向与权重。文中还给出信息论下界（KD-1 个切向标量分量）、平面情形的充分必要性结果、有限噪声下 O(σ^β) 收敛界以及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在流形学习中，光滑数据流形附近可用一个切空间概括局部几何，但在分支点（如流形相交处）一阶对象从单个切空间退化为测度。作者希望回答：在分支中心和齐次度均未知时，单一噪声水平下的得分场能否确定这种加权的切向几何（各分支的局部占比）？这一问题对理解去噪扩散模型的几何恢复能力至关重要。

Method: 作者采用切向测度模型（tangent-measure model），其中 d 为局部测度维数。核心方法包括：(1) 证明齐次切向测度的高斯平滑满足 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 特征函数方程，利用弱形式将分数值（而非分数导数）转化为求解中心和齐次度的线性系统，并给出秩条件与摄动界；(2) 校准后，单个球面上的切向分数等价于标量高斯-锥变换的球面 log 梯度，通过积分恢复该变换（至多差一个尺度），其所有球谐乘子为正，从而单壳层即可识别归一化角度测度；(3) 对 K 条正射线，利用 2K-1 阶矩构造性恢复；在平面中证明 K 阶既充分又必要；(4) 对有限平面 C^{1,β} 分支给出 O(σ^β) 收敛界。

Result: 论文证明单一噪声水平下的得分场足以确定分支点的加权重几何：中心与齐次度可通过线性系统解出；单球面可识别任意维数 D≥2 的归一化角度测度；对 K 条正射线给出矩方法；任何固定观测方案至少需要 KD-1 个切向标量分量，且平面情形下度 K 充分且必要并给出有限查询证书。实验表明 5 万步训练降低了验证归一化分数误差但反而提高了角度矩误差，说明分数拟合与几何恢复可能分离。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上确立了在分支点处，单一噪声水平下的得分场是可识别的充分观测：它不仅能确定中心与齐次度，还能恢复各分支的加权角度分布，且在任意维数下单壳层即足够。平面情形获得了严格的最优性（K 阶充分且必要）。实验揭示训练中普通分数拟合与几何恢复之间存在张力，提示几何恢复可能需要专门的训练目标或更高精度。

Abstract: Near a smooth data manifold, one tangent space summarizes local geometry. At a branch point, the corresponding first-order object is instead a measure over tangent directions, whose normalized masses record the local share of each branch under the chosen data measure. We ask whether a score field at one noise level determines this weighted tangent geometry when the branch center and homogeneity degree $d$ are unknown. In this tangent-measure model, $d$ is the local measure dimension. Gaussian smoothing of a homogeneous tangent measure satisfies an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck eigenfunction equation. Its weak form turns score values---without score derivatives---into a linear system for the center and homogeneity degree, with an explicit rank condition and perturbation bound. After this calibration, the tangential score on one sphere is the spherical log-gradient of a scalar Gaussian--cone transform. Integration recovers that transform up to scale, and all its spherical-harmonic multipliers are positive. Thus one exact shell identifies the normalized angular measure in every ambient dimension $D\geq2$. For at most $K$ positive rays, moments through degree $2K-1$ constructively recover count, directions, and weights in arbitrary dimension. Any fixed observation scheme needs at least $KD-1$ scalar tangential components. In the plane, degree $K$ is both sufficient and necessary, and we give quantitative finite-query certificates. For finite planar $C^{1,β}$ branches with positive $C^{0,β}$ densities, we prove $O(σ^β)$ convergence from the finite-noise score to its tangent model. In controlled experiments, 50k-step training lowers validation normalized-score error across four geometries yet raises angular-moment error, separating ordinary score fit from geometry recovery.

</details>


### [413] [Sparse Additive Off-Policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning with Potentially Limited Number of Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22595)
*Tuoyi Zhao,Chengchun Shi,Zhengling Qi,Lan Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的框架，用于无限时域强化学习中的灵活、非线性且可解释的离线策略评估(OPE)。通过使用稀疏加性结构的非线性函数类来建模Q函数，推导出高概率有限样本误差界，该误差界仅对数依赖环境维度d，从而缓解维数灾难。分析保证了当轨迹数或时间水平足够大时的准确值估计，并提出了基于组稀疏的特征筛选程序，能高概率识别包含所有相关协变量的简化特征集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离线策略评估理论大多假设可以访问大量轨迹，且容易受到维数灾难的影响。然而在实际应用中，获取大量轨迹成本高昂，状态空间也可能很大。因此需要一种既能处理大规模状态空间、又能保持可解释性，并且在轨迹数或时间水平有限时仍能保证准确估计的OPE框架。

Method: 1) 采用稀疏加性结构的非线性函数类建模Q函数，兼顾灵活性与可解释性；2) 推导高概率有限样本误差界，证明误差界仅对数依赖于环境维度d而非多项式依赖，从而缓解维数灾难；3) 提出基于组稀疏性的特征筛选程序，从高维特征中高概率识别出包含所有相关协变量的约简特征集。

Result: 推导的误差界表明：当轨迹数或时间水平足够大时，值函数估计均能保证准确。与现有OPE理论通常要求大量轨迹不同，本文的分析表明即使轨迹数有限，只要时间水平足够长也能实现准确估计。数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文为无限时域RL中的离线策略评估提供了兼具非线性灵活性、可解释性和理论保障的新框架，通过稀疏加性结构和组稀疏特征筛选有效缓解了维数灾难，并在轨迹数或时间水平两个维度上均建立了可靠的误差保证。

Abstract: We develop a new framework for flexible, nonlinear, and interpretable off-policy evaluation for infinite-horizon reinforcement learning. To handle large state spaces and support transparent decision-making, we model the Q-function using a nonlinear function class with a sparse additive structure. We derive high-probability finite-sample error bounds for estimating the value function of a target policy and show that the bounds depend only logarithmically on the ambient dimension $d$, thereby alleviating the curse of dimensionality. In contrast to most existing theory for off-policy evaluation, which typically assumes access to many trajectories, our analysis guarantees accurate value estimation when either the number of trajectories or the time horizon is sufficiently large. In addition, we propose a group-sparsity-based feature screening procedure that identifies, with high probability, a reduced feature set containing all relevant covariates. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [414] [Scale-invariant Optimal Sampling for Rare-events Data with Sparse Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22597)
*Jing Wang,HaiYing Wang,Qiang Zhang,Hao Helen Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种尺度不变的稀有事件大规模数据最优子采样方法，通过最小化预测误差定义最优子采样函数，并利用自适应Lasso（adaptive lasso）和最大采样条件似然（MSCL）提高估计效率，解决了现有最优子采样概率受数据尺度影响、非活动特征可能被任意放大影响子采样的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对于包含稀有事件的大规模数据，子采样是一种有效的计算手段，但过度激进的子采样会损害估计效率，因此需要最优子采样。然而现有最优子采样概率依赖于数据尺度，某些缩放变换可能导致低效的采样结果；尤其在存在非活动特征时，这些特征对子采样概率的影响可能被不恰当的缩放变换任意放大，从而严重损害估计性能。

Method: 本文从预测误差而非参数估计的角度出发，利用自适应Lasso构建估计过程：首先针对稀有事件数据引入自适应Lasso估计器并建立其oracle性质；然后推导出尺度不变的（scale-invariant）最优子采样函数，最小化逆概率加权（IPW）自适应Lasso的预测误差；最后提出基于最大采样条件似然（MSCL）的估计器以进一步提升估计效率。

Result: 通过模拟实验和真实数据集验证了所提方法的性能，表明尺度不变的最优子采样函数能够有效缓解数据尺度变换带来的子采样效率问题，且在稀疏模型（含非活动特征）场景下表现优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 该研究针对稀有事件大规模数据中的子采样问题，提出了一种尺度不变且以预测误差为目标的最优子采样框架，结合自适应Lasso的oracle性质与MSCL估计器，在理论上保证了方法的可行性，在实验上验证了其有效性与稳健性。

Abstract: Subsampling is effective in tackling computational challenges for massive data with rare events. Overly aggressive subsampling may adversely affect estimation efficiency, and optimal subsampling is essential to mitigate the information loss. However, existing optimal subsampling probabilities depend on data scales, and some scaling transformations may result in inefficient subsamples. This problem is more significant when there are inactive features, because their influence on the subsampling probabilities can be arbitrarily magnified by inappropriate scaling transformations. We tackle this challenge and introduce a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function in the context of sparse models, where inactive features are commonly assumed. Instead of focusing on estimating model parameters, we define an optimal subsampling function to minimize the prediction error, using adaptive lasso to outline the estimation procedure and study its theoretical guarantee. We first introduce the adaptive lasso estimator for rare-events data and establish its oracle properties, thereby validating the use of subsampling. Then we derive a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function that minimizes the prediction error of the inverse probability weighted (IPW) adaptive lasso. Finally, we present an estimator based on the maximum sampled conditional likelihood (MSCL) to further improve the estimation efficiency. We conduct numerical experiments using both simulated and real-world data sets to demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [415] [Generative Neural Networks for Sinkhorn Distributionally Robust Hypothesis Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22746)
*Fenglin Zhang,Teyan Liu,Jie Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生成式框架的Sinkhorn分布鲁棒假设检验方法，通过核平滑参考分布的等价条件KL散度表示推导强对偶性，并利用超输入凸神经网络近似凸势函数，从而高效学习最小不利分布，克服了传统大规模锥规划方法不可扩展的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Sinkhorn分布鲁棒假设检验（SDRHT）问题需要通过求解大规模锥规划来解决，这种方法在计算上不可扩展，难以应用于实际大规模场景。因此需要一种更高效的方法来学习最小不利分布并实现端到端的采样。

Method: (1) 推导Sinkhorn散度模糊集与核平滑参考分布的条件KL散度的等价表示；(2) 基于该性质证明约束和非约束minimax SDRHT公式的强对偶性；(3) 利用闭式最优检测器和Brenier定理，将max-min对偶公式重写为关于凸势函数的最大化问题，其梯度刻画核平滑分布与其最小不利对应分布之间的可逆传输映射；(4) 使用超输入凸神经网络（HyCNNs）配合随机梯度估计器近似这些势函数，并证明HyCNNs的表达能力及其诱导传输映射的分布普适性。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的方法在不同样本量和维度下均取得了优异的准确性和鲁棒性，同时避免了经典SDRHT方法的可扩展性限制。

Conclusion: 该生成式框架提供了一种可扩展且高效的SDRHT求解途径，通过凸势函数与HyCNNs的结合，实现了对最小不利分布的高质量学习和高效采样，兼顾了理论保证与实践性能。

Abstract: This paper studies the Sinkhorn distributionally robust hypothesis testing (SDRHT) problem, seeking a robust detector against least-favorable distributions in Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets centered at the empirical distributions. Existing approaches solve this problem by solving large-scale conic programs, which are not scalable. To overcome this, we propose a generative framework that learns least-favorable distributions and supports efficient training and end-to-end sampling. For the Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets, we first derive an equivalent conditional-KL-divergence representation with respect to kernel-smoothed reference distributions. This property allows us to prove strong duality for both constrained and unconstrained minimax SDRHT formulations. Based on the closed-form optimal detector and Brenier's theorem, we reformulate the max-min dual formulation as a maximization problem over convex potentials whose gradients characterize invertible transport maps between kernel-smoothed distributions and their least-favorable counterparts. We efficiently approximate these potentials using Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs) equipped with stochastic gradient estimators and prove the representation power of HyCNNs and the distributional universality of their induced transport maps. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves superior accuracy and robustness across different sample sizes and dimensions, while avoiding the scalability limitations of classical SDRHT methods.

</details>


### [416] [A Commutator Framework for Selective Spectral Alignment in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22910)
*Kaj Nyström*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个有限宽度几何框架，通过三类交换子（门控-协方差、敏感性-协方差、AGOP-NFM）来量化深度神经网络中学习到的特征几何的组织、传输和选择性对齐。建立了敏感性-协方差交换子的四源精确层间恒等式，并证明AGOP-NFM交换子是内部交换子的奇异值加权传输。通过缓冲局部能量、谱间隙与投影演化估计，以及条件Lyapunov原理，揭示了特征几何对齐是层与尺度依赖的相容性现象，而非训练的普适结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习理论大多基于无限宽度极限（如神经正切核NTK框架），难以解释实际有限宽度网络中特征几何的演化规律。作者旨在建立有限宽度下的几何框架，回答特征几何如何组织、传输和选择性对齐的问题，并澄清为何风险下降不一定导致交换子（表征几何相容性）坍缩。

Method: 该工作构建了三类交换子族：门控-协方差交换子、敏感性-协方差交换子、AGOP-NFM交换子。通过精确层间恒等式将敏感性-协方差交换子分解为四个来源：下游传输、相邻层失衡、逐点敏感性波动、非线性门控-协方差交互。利用缓冲局部能量处理分离协方差子空间间的混合问题，建立谱间隙、投影演化和稳定性估计，并基于几何误差界或固有阻尼假设提出条件Lyapunov原理。结合解析示例与数值实验（跨深度、宽度及两个回归基准）验证理论。

Result: 结果表明：①敏感性-协方差交换子可精确分解为四个可解释来源；②AGOP-NFM交换子作为奇异值加权传输，解释了为何仅观测特征侧对齐不足以确定内部几何；③条件Lyapunov原理在明确几何误差界或固有阻尼假设下给出衰减，但仅靠梯度流无法推导这些准则；④数值实验中，负传输-失衡交互主导的消长（cancellation）在多种深度、宽度和回归基准中保持一致，表明谱对齐是层和尺度依赖的相容性现象。

Conclusion: 特征谱对齐并非训练过程中的普适性结果，而是一种由传输、交互、消长和潜在阻尼共同调控的层与尺度依赖的相容性现象。该框架为理解有限宽度DNN中特征几何提供了严格的定量工具，弥补了无限宽度理论在解释实际网络行为上的不足，并为后续研究特征对齐的动态机制奠定了基础。

Abstract: We develop a finite-width geometric framework describing how learned feature geometries are organized, transported, and selectively aligned in deep neural networks. Incompatibility among weight-generated covariance, gates, and backward sensitivities is quantified through three families of commutators: between gates and covariance, between sensitivities and covariance, and between average gradient outer products (AGOPs) and neural feature matrices (NFMs).
  An exact layerwise identity decomposes the sensitivity-covariance commutator into four sources: downstream transport, adjacent-layer imbalance, pointwise sensitivity fluctuations, and nonlinear gate-covariance interactions. The AGOP-NFM commutator is a singular-value-weighted transport of the internal commutator, explaining why observed feature-side alignment alone does not determine the internal geometry from which it emerges.
  Buffered localized energies resolve mixing between separated covariance subspaces. We establish spectral-gap, projector-evolution, and stabilization estimates, and formulate conditional Lyapunov principles that yield decay under explicit geometric error-bound or intrinsic-damping assumptions. These criteria do not follow from gradient flow alone and clarify why risk reduction need not imply commutator collapse.
  Analytic examples and numerical experiments exhibit factorization of spectral and activation geometry, transient growth, and cancellation among nonzero sources. In tested finite-time regimes, cancellation dominated by a negative transport-imbalance interaction persists across depths, widths, and two regression benchmarks. Spectral alignment therefore appears as a layer- and scale-dependent compatibility phenomenon governed by transport, interaction, cancellation, and possible damping, rather than a universal consequence of training.

</details>


### [417] [One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23094)
*Gordei Verbii*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明隐式DDIM反演单步是探测预训练扩散模型是否编码局部流形几何的最廉价手段，其等价于强凸势函数Ψ_t的驻点条件。论文厘清了三个重要推论：贝叶斯极限下解的唯一性及训练分数违背后验协方差界的模型误差判定；Picard迭代作为单位步长梯度下降在不稳定区域（λ_max>2）会振荡并可被阻尼修复；流形几何位于收敛域中，振荡壳和发散壳分别位于尺度无关深度w=1/2和w=1/(1+ρ_g^*)。实验显示精确分数在三个类别上复现壳体误差在0.54%以内，而训练分数均无壳体（这是一个推导性局限而非零结果），且在DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256上无条件上界被违逆1.26-4.66倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者期望无需流形、reach或单峰等强假设，仅借助隐式DDIM反演单步这一极廉操作，从理论上刻画预训练扩散模型编码的局部几何结构，并为模型误差提供假设无关的判定证书。

Method: 将隐式DDIM反演步重新表述为显式势函数Ψ_t(x)的驻点条件x-G(x)=∇Ψ_t(x)，在贝叶斯极限下证明其强凸性（模量恰为e^{-h_t}）。利用该势函数的Hessian谱、后验协方差下界以及Cov(x_0|x_t)⪰0推导收敛半径、振荡与发散壳体位置，并在三类数据集上对精确分数与训练分数进行实证核验。

Result: 在贝叶斯极限下解唯一且收缩常数ρ_g^*=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326；Picard迭代在λ_max>2处不稳定可阻尼修复；振荡壳位于w=1/2，发散壳位于w=1/(1+ρ_g^*)，精确分数复现误差≤0.54%，训练分数均无壳体（因Fermi窗口与训练支持冲突3.6-5.6倍，训练Hessian-Lipschitz常数仅为曲率的2-12%）。无条件上界σ_tλ_max(sym J)≤1对精确分数成立至3×10^{-7}，但在所有DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256设置中被违逆1.26-4.66倍。

Conclusion: 隐式DDIM反演单步从理论上构成了对扩散模型局部几何的严格探针：精确分数满足全部理论预言，而训练分数系统性偏离理论界限，揭示出模型在局部流形几何编码上的根本性局限，且这种局限是可推导的而非实验噪声所致。

Abstract: One implicit DDIM inversion step is the cheapest probe of whether a pretrained diffusion model encodes local manifold geometry. It is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, $x-G(x)=\nablaΨ_t(x)$, strongly convex at the Bayes limit with modulus exactly $e^{-h_t}$ for the step's log-SNR gap $h_t$ $-$ for every data law, schedule and point, with no manifold, reach or unimodality hypothesis. Three consequences must be kept apart. (i) The solution is unique at the Bayes limit; a second one requires the trained score to violate the posterior-covariance bound by $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$, a hypothesis-free certificate of model error; the same bound makes contraction a schedule constant, $ρ_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$ throughout the standard DDPM schedule. (ii) The solver can still fail: Picard iteration is unit-step gradient descent on $Ψ_t$, unstable wherever $λ_{\max}(\nabla^2Ψ_t)>2$, so oscillation certifies nothing; damping below $2/λ_{\max}$ cures it. (iii) The geometry lives in the convergence domain: on the scale-free depth $w=rκ_{\max}$ the oscillation shell sits at $w=\tfrac12$, schedule-free, and the divergence shell at $w=1/(1+ρ_g^{\star})$, with a measured finite-noise correction in $\|\mathrm{II}\|^2$. Exact scores reproduce both to within $0.54\%$ on three classes; no trained score we probe shows a shell $-$ a derived limitation, not a null result: the Fermi window conflicts with the model's own training support by $3.6$-$5.6\times$, and the trained Hessian-Lipschitz constant is $2$-$12\%$ of the curvature the law reads, $0$ on a ReLU net. Finally the unconditional ceiling $σ_tλ_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$, from $\mathrm{Cov}(x_0\mid x_t)\succeq0$ alone, holds for the exact score to $3\times10^{-7}$ but is violated in all DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 settings, by $1.26$-$4.66\times$.

</details>


### [418] [Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23480)
*Jiaming Qiu,Yingye Zheng,Ying-Qi Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于临床监测场景下序贯风险分类的多目标优化方法，同时优化灵敏度、特异性和监测成本三个关键指标。通过价值递归刻画每时刻立即分类与继续监测之间的权衡，并利用循环神经网络（RNN）逼近演化中的价值过程，结合原始-对偶更新方案满足性能约束。在模拟研究和连续血糖监测的低血糖风险预测应用中验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在临床监测中，及时风险分类至关重要，但需要在早期分类干预与观察更多数据之间权衡。然而现有方法多针对完全观测轨迹设计，且无法对灵敏度、特异性和监测成本等关键操作特征提供有效控制，因此需要一种能在部分观测条件下同时优化和约束这三类指标的序贯分类方法。

Method: 首先将序贯分类问题形式化为针对灵敏度、特异性和监测成本三个目标的多目标优化框架；通过价值递归刻画每个时间点上立即分类与继续监测之间的权衡；随后将规则估计转化为在灵敏度与监测成本约束下最大化特异性的约束优化问题；采用循环神经网络（RNN）逼近演化中的价值过程，并利用原始-对偶更新方案确保满足性能约束。

Result: 通过模拟研究以及连续血糖监测中低血糖风险预测的应用，验证了所提方法能够生成准确且及时的序贯决策规则，并严格遵循预设的灵敏度、特异性和监测成本等操作特征要求。

Conclusion: 所提出的多目标序贯分类框架能够在临床监测场景下实现精度与及时性的平衡，同时提供对关键操作特征（灵敏度、特异性、监测成本）的可控性保障，为临床决策提供了兼具理论保证和应用价值的方案。

Abstract: Timely risk classification is essential in many clinical monitoring settings, where decisions must balance the benefit of classifying patients early for subsequent intervention against the value of observing additional data. Yet most existing statistical and machine-learning methods are designed for fully observed trajectories and offer limited control over key operating characteristics such as sensitivity, specificity, and monitoring cost. We cast the sequential classification problem within a multi-objective optimization framework targeting these three criteria. We characterize the optimal decision rule through a value recursion that quantifies, at each time point, the trade-off between immediate classification and continued monitoring. To estimate the rule from data, we formulate a constrained optimization problem that maximizes specificity while enforcing prespecified sensitivity and monitoring-cost constraints. We then develop an estimation procedure that employs a recurrent neural network to approximate the evolving value processes and a primal--dual updating scheme to satisfy the performance constraints. Through simulation studies and an application to continuous glucose monitoring for hypoglycemia risk prediction, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields accurate and timely sequential decision rules that adhere to the desired operating characteristics.

</details>


### [419] [A Deep Causal Inference Approach to Measuring the Effects of Forming Group Loans in Online Non-profit Microfinance Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.02795)
*Thai T. Pham,Yuanyuan Shen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究Kiva众筹微金融平台上团体贷款对融资时间的影响，利用深度学习和NLP技术处理贷款描述文本作为控制变量，发现团体贷款平均缩短融资时间约3.3天。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为团体贷款对投资者风险更小，但这一观点在慈善性在线市场中是否成立尚不明确。作者希望测量在Kiva平台上团体贷款对融资时间（作为贷款风险/成功率的代理指标）的因果效应。

Method: 采用因果推断方法，控制贷款规模及其他因素，同时利用深度学习和自然语言处理技术处理贷款描述文本这一非结构化数据，以发挥其优越的预测能力来辅助回答因果问题。这是首个使用先进深度学习技术处理非结构化数据来回答因果问题的研究。

Result: 研究发现，在Kiva平台上，形成团体贷款平均可以缩短融资时间约3.3天，即团体贷款确实加速了资金的募集。

Conclusion: 在慈善性在线市场中，团体贷款确实能够加快融资速度，支持了团体贷款风险更低的传统观点；同时证明了深度学习技术在处理非结构化文本数据以回答因果问题方面的有效性。

Abstract: Kiva is an online non-profit crowdsouring microfinance platform that raises funds for the poor in the third world. The borrowers on Kiva are small business owners and individuals in urgent need of money. To raise funds as fast as possible, they have the option to form groups and post loan requests in the name of their groups. While it is generally believed that group loans pose less risk for investors than individual loans do, we study whether this is the case in a philanthropic online marketplace. In particular, we measure the effect of group loans on funding time while controlling for the loan sizes and other factors. Because loan descriptions (in the form of texts) play an important role in lenders' decision process on Kiva, we make use of this information through deep learning in natural language processing. In this aspect, this is the first paper that uses one of the most advanced deep learning techniques to deal with unstructured data in a way that can take advantage of its superior prediction power to answer causal questions. We find that on average, forming group loans speeds up the funding time by about 3.3 days.

</details>


<div id='math.ST'></div>
