Conclusion: 全局与局部神经算子并非互斥的替代选择，而是同一频谱误差校正机制的互补两半。通过将它们以多重网格循环的形式交错统一，RWR弥补了两类现有方法的根本缺陷，为工业级大规模网格仿真提供了更精确且数据高效的神经代理方案。

Abstract: Recent mesh-based simulation advances have, in no small part, relied on neural surrogates of two distinct families: global models that route information through a small set of latent tokens, and local models that perform message passing across mesh edges. Consistent with both classes is the inability to perform beyond low-dimensional problems and small-scale or oversimplified meshes, the simulation regimes where industrial problems reside. Our work shows this explicitly and presents a unified formulation. In global approaches, latent-token attention acts as a spatial low-pass filter, while local message passing lacks the global reach necessary to propagate information across large mesh spaces. Viewed through the error, the two operators are the halves of a multigrid cycle: one corrects errors at the lower end of the spectrum, the other at the higher end, and neither can do the other's job. We introduce Read-Write-Relax (RWR), which interleaves latent attention with message-passing relaxation under a unified formulation. The interleaved processor lowers error across the entire spectrum, making RWR the most accurate model in nearly every comparison across our industrial and public benchmarks. It is also markedly data-efficient in the scarce-data regimes, accurate on the engineering quantities of interest, and scales full-field predictions to challenging, large-scale problems.

</details>


### [455] [Benchmarking Composable Compression Techniques in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21693)
*Afsara Benazir,Chen Chen,Rongxiao Qu,Jiabo Huang,Jingtao Li,Lingjuan Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoEXBench 是一个系统性的基准测试框架，用于评估多种 MoE 压缩技术（专家剪枝、权重量化、KV-cache 压缩）在组合使用时的端到端部署效果。它覆盖 10 个 30B-235B 的 MoE 模型、多种架构与压缩组合，并揭示了压缩方法间的非平凡交互——组合压缩效果无法从单独技术预测，专家剪枝是主要质量退化来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE LLM 在实际部署中常需叠加多种压缩技术（专家剪枝、权重量化、KV-cache 压缩）以适应消费级硬件，但这些技术通常被孤立评估，缺乏对它们组合使用时交互效应的系统性研究。

Method: 构建 MoEXBench 基准：覆盖 10 个 MoE 模型（30B-235B 参数），涵盖标准注意力、混合线性注意力和滑动窗口注意力三种架构；评估 20%-50% 专家剪枝率、1-16 bit 权重量化方案和多种 KV-cache 精度设置；引入八个模块的评估套件，联合测量压缩质量、工作负载与架构鲁棒性、各压缩技术敏感性及部署效率。

Result: 揭示了压缩方法间非平凡的交互：组合压缩无法从单独技术中预测；压缩率单独无法可靠预测质量损失或运行时间收益；专家剪枝是主导质量退化来源；平均质量指标可能掩盖特定工作负载和架构的失败。通过发布归一化模块分数、压缩产物和可复现脚本，支持跨 MoE 家族和硬件后端的精度-内存-延迟对比。

Conclusion: MoEXBench 提供了首个系统性评估可组合 MoE 压缩作为端到端部署工作流的基准，揭示了组合压缩中非平凡的交互效应，并倡导采用更细粒度的评估而非仅依赖平均指标，为面向实际硬件部署的 MoE 压缩方案设计提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs scale model capacity efficiently through sparse activation, but their large expert parameter footprint, routing imbalance, and long-context KV-cache growth make deployment difficult on commodity hardware. Practical deployment often requires stacking multiple compression techniques: expert pruning removes redundant experts, weight quantization lowers model memory footprint, and KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory pressure. However, these techniques are typically evaluated in isolation, leaving open how they interact when applied together in realistic deployment pipelines.
  In this work, we present MoEXBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating composable MoE compression as an end-to-end deployment workflow. MoEXBench studies 10 MoE models ranging from 30B to 235B total parameters across standard-attention, hybrid linear-attention, and sliding window attention architectures. It evaluates 20%-50% expert pruning rates, 1 to 16 bit weight-quantization schemes, and multiple KV-cache precision settings, applied both individually and in combination.
  MoEXBench introduces an eight-module evaluation suite that jointly measures composable-compression quality, workload and architecture robustness, pruning/quantization/KV cache sensitivity, and deployment efficiency on commodity hardware. Our results reveal non-trivial interactions among compression methods: composable compression cannot be predicted from standalone techniques, compression rate alone does not reliably predict quality loss or runtime gain, expert pruning is the dominant degradation source, and average quality can hide workload and architecture-specific failures. By releasing normalized module scores, compressed artifacts, and reproducible scripts, MoEXBench enables practical accuracy-memory-latency comparison across MoE families and hardware backends.

</details>


### [456] [Provably adaptive sampling with uniform and remasking discrete diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23554)
*Daniil Dmitriev,Zhihan Huang,Yuting Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散模型的采样效率问题，提出了基于leave-one-out去噪器的一阶采样器（适用于均匀和remasking前向过程），证明了采样所需的离散化步数与目标分布的内在依赖结构（双全相关DTC）相关，而非环境维度d。该保证为自适应采样，采样误差受限于评分估计误差与离散步误差之和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准τ-leaping采样器在均匀前向过程下的采样复杂度下界随环境维度d线性增长，这引发了一个问题：这种维度依赖是否是前向过程本身的固有特性？作者希望回答这一问题，证明可以通过更好的采样器设计摆脱维度依赖。

Method: 提出一种基于leave-one-out去噪器的一阶采样器，支持坐标并行更新。通过引入Bayes最优辅助采样器将离散化误差与评分估计误差分离，推导出离散化误差的精确信息论表示（用前向过程中不同坐标在不同时刻的互信息刻画），并在均匀和remasking前向过程下用DTC(X0)控制该误差。

Result: 主要结果表明：在取对数因子后，N=O(DTC(X0)/ε)个离散化步骤即可达到O(ε_score+ε)的采样误差。该采样复杂度由目标分布的内在依赖结构（DTC）决定，而非环境维度d。数值实验在结构化合成分布上验证了预测的维度自适应行为。

Conclusion: 回答了对环境维度依赖是否固有这一问题的否定答案。离散扩散模型采样复杂度可以由目标分布的依赖结构（而非维度）控制，前提是采用合适的采样器（如leave-one-one去噪器的一阶并行采样器）。采样器在采样过程中能够纠正去噪错误，这在大量坐标同时更新时是必要的。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel updates, but their sampling efficiency can depend strongly on the choice of the forward process and the sampler. For the uniform forward process, existing lower bounds for the standard $τ$-leaping sampler scale linearly with the ambient dimension $d$, raising the question of whether this dependence is intrinsic to the forward process. We answer this question in the negative. We consider a first-order sampler based on the leave-one-out denoiser for uniform and remasking processes whose coordinate updates can be performed in parallel. In both cases, the sampler can correct denoising mistakes during the sampling process, which becomes necessary when many coordinates are updated together. Our main result establishes an adaptive sampling guarantee: up to logarithmic factors, $N = O(\mathrm{DTC}(X_0) / \varepsilon)$ discretization steps suffice to achieve sampling error $O(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}+\varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{score}}$ is the error in score estimation. Thus, the sampling complexity is governed by the intrinsic dependence structure of the target distribution, as measured by its dual total correlation $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$, rather than directly by the ambient dimension $d$. Our analysis proceeds through a Bayes-optimal auxiliary sampler that separates discretization error from score-estimation error. We also derive an exact information-theoretic representation of the discretization error in terms of the mutual information between different coordinates of the forward process at different times. This representation applies to general forward processes and, in the uniform and remasking cases, can be controlled by $\mathrm{DTC}(X_0)$. Numerical experiments on structured synthetic distributions illustrate the predicted dimension-adaptive behavior.

</details>


### [457] [Posterior Information Dynamics of Diffusion Models for Linear Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21709)
*Xiangming Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过定义"平滑似然力"（精确后验与先验分数之差），系统研究了扩散模型在逆问题反演过程中测量信息进入反向去噪的时机与分配方式。作者导出了信息-最小均方误差（I-MMSE）恒等式，并证明在高噪声下力能量呈二次衰减，通过可解模型揭示了条件化去除测量已解释的类分离、熵从log n降至H(I|r)等性质。实验在可解析后验模型及冻结FFHQ模型上验证了理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型广泛用作线性逆问题的先验，但端点生成质量无法揭示测量信息在反向去噪过程中何时进入以及如何在不同信号方向上分配。理解这一内在机制对于改进扩散模型的逆问题求解至关重要。

Method: 提出平滑似然力（精确后验与先验分数之差）作为分析工具，在各噪声水平上刻画测量信息的影响。推导其期望平方范数与相对熵耗散/增长的关系，建立I-MMSE恒等式；在有限二阶矩假设下分析高噪声区域的力能量衰减规律；通过可解模型和实验验证理论预测。

Result: 1) 平滑似然力的期望平方范数同时给出后验-先验相对熵耗散和反向路径相对熵增长；2) 建立信息增益与去噪误差减少之间的I-MMSE恒等式；3) 有限二阶矩下力能量及其与先验分数能量之比在高噪声下随信号系数呈二次衰减；4) 可解模型显示条件化去除测量已解释的类分离、熵从log n降至H(I|r)、信息同化依赖算子-先验对齐；5) FFHQ实验表明相同谱的掩码产生不同先验归一化的零空间轨迹统计。

Conclusion: 测量信息在扩散模型反向去噪中的进入时机与方向分配具有可解析的结构化规律，取决于算子与先验的对齐程度而非仅依赖奇异值谱。平滑似然力为理解和调控扩散先验在逆问题中的信息同化过程提供了理论框架。

Abstract: Diffusion models are widely used as priors for linear inverse problems, yet endpoint quality does not reveal when measurement information enters reverse denoising or how it is allocated across signal directions. We study this process through the smoothed likelihood force, the difference between exact posterior and prior scores at each noise level. For a fixed measurement, its expected squared norm gives both posterior--prior relative-entropy dissipation and reverse-path relative-entropy growth. Averaging over measurements yields an information--minimum mean-square error (I-MMSE) identity linking information gain to denoising-error reduction. Under finite second moments, the force energy and its ratio to prior-score energy decay quadratically in the noising kernel's signal coefficient at high noise. Solvable models show that conditioning removes class separation already explained by the measurement, reduces a uniform index entropy over \(n\) empirical samples from \(\log n\) to \(H(I\mid r)\), and makes assimilation depend on operator--prior alignment even for identical singular values. Experiments in models with tractable posteriors evaluate these predictions. In a separate illustration with a frozen FFHQ model, masks sharing the same spectrum yield different prior-normalized null-space trajectory statistics.

</details>


### [458] [Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21727)
*Renfei Zhang,Niloofar Mireshghallah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现，使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在良性事实数据上训练模型，会显著增加模型提取其已记忆的个人身份信息（PII）的能力，即使训练数据中完全不包含任何PII。在DeepSeek-V3.1上，逐字回忆@k从0.155提升至0.370（2.4倍），且该效应随模型规模增大而增强，同时推理能力和拒绝率保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR被广泛用于提升模型的推理能力，但其对模型信息泄露行为的副作用尚未被充分研究。作者希望探究这一仅接触良性数据的训练过程，是否会影响模型对已记忆的私人信息的可提取性，从而揭示潜在隐私风险。

Method: 首先确认指令模型已记忆PII但通常保持潜伏状态（很少主动暴露）。然后在完全不含PII的良性事实数据上应用强化学习，通过两种探针重新检测：定向探针（name->email配对搜索）和非定向自由回忆提示（要求模型列出所知的地址）。实验覆盖DeepSeek-V3.1以及从8B到671B参数规模的三个模型。

Result: PII提取在两种探针下均显著上升。在DeepSeek-V3.1上，逐字回忆@k从0.155提升至0.370，即2.4倍增益。该效应随模型规模扩大而加剧，最大模型（671B）的绝对泄露量最大。同时模型的推理能力和拒绝率保持不变。

Conclusion: RLVR会选择性地改变模型对已记忆信息的可访问性，而非整体改变模型行为，使得从未被训练触及的私人数据变得更容易被提取。攻击者无需隐私相关的训练信号，也无需访问数据本身，只需在无害数据上进行微调即可获得通往记忆数据的路径，构成严重隐私威胁。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is deployed to make models better at reasoning tasks, but its side effect on what models will divulge is under studied. Here we show that RLVR on facts increases extraction of personally identifiable information (PII) the instruct model had already memorized. We first confirm that instruct models have already memorized PII but leave them latent, rarely surfacing one when asked. We then apply RL on benign factual data that contains no PII of any kind, and re-probe: a targeted probe over name->email pairs, and an untargeted free-recall prompt that simply asks the model to list the addresses it knows. PII extraction rises sharply under both: on DeepSeek-V3.1, verbatim recall@k increases from 0.155 to 0.370, a 2.4x gain. The effect scales with model size: across three models spanning 8B to 671B parameters, absolute leakage is largest in the biggest model. Meanwhile model's reasoning abilities and refusal rates are retained, indicating that RL selectively changes which memorized information is accessible rather than broadly altering the model. In summary, memorized private data can be made markedly more extractable by training that never touches it. This gives an adversary a route to memorized data that requires no privacy-relevant training signal and no access to the data itself -- only the ability to fine-tune on something innocuous.

</details>


### [459] [Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21736)
*Zixuan Liu,Fangzheng Wu,Brian Summa,Zizhan Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应多层Twisted SMC方法，通过学习一系列由易到难逐步变稀有的中间事件来逐步引导twist函数的学习，从而更可靠地估计大语言模型中极低概率罕见不安全行为的发生概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型中的罕见不安全行为即使概率极低，在数十亿次交互的部署规模下仍具有重大实际意义。现有的标准Twisted SMC框架在估计罕见事件概率时需要来自罕见事件目标分布的正样本，但在有效的twist函数被学习之前，这类正样本几乎不存在，导致罕见事件估计不可靠。

Method: 提出Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC方法，通过一系列逐步变稀有的中间事件来学习罕见事件的twist函数。在每一层，已学习的twist提供了更具信息量的正样本用于学习下一层twist，最终得到针对目标罕见事件的更精确的twist函数。

Result: 在多种任务和不同模型规模上进行的实验表明，该方法相比基线产生了更准确的罕见事件概率估计。

Conclusion: 该方法通过更可靠地发现难以观察到的罕见不安全行为，为强化部署语言模型的评估和安全性对齐提供了一个实用工具。

Abstract: Rare unsafe behaviors in large language models can remain practically significant even when their probability is extremely small, particularly at deployment scales involving millions or billions of interactions. Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a principled framework for rare-event probability estimation by learning twist functions that guide generation toward a target event. However, the standard twist learning framework relies on positive samples from the rare-event target distribution, which may be nearly absent before an informative twist has been learned, resulting in unreliable rare-event estimation. We propose Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC, which learns the rare-event twist through a sequence of progressively rarer intermediate events. At each level, the learned twist provides more informative positive examples for learning the next twist, ultimately leading to a more accurate final twist for the target rare event. Experiments across diverse tasks and model scales show that the proposed method produces more accurate rare-event probability estimates. By enabling more reliable discovery of hard-to-observe unsafe behaviors, our method provides a practical tool for strengthening the evaluation and safety alignment of deployed language models.

</details>


### [460] [Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21752)
*Hong-Yi Wang,Mingze Wang,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了一个深度多层感知机的均匀可压缩性定理：对于具有解析激活函数的深宽教师网络，存在一个相同深度但更窄的网络可以近似表示相同的函数，压缩后的宽度与原始宽度无关，仅与误差预算和有效输入维度有关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可被大幅压缩而不影响性能的现象已被长期观察，但其背后的理论机制尚不清晰。本文旨在从理论上解释并证明这一现象。

Method: 提出了一种新颖的导数匹配技术，该技术能够感知低维输入结构；同时引入逐层重新加权（layer-wise reweighting）方法来保持输入-输出映射不变，从而构造出窄网络来近似原始宽网络。

Result: 压缩后的网络宽度与原始宽度无关，大小为 $O((\log(1/\varepsilon))^{d_{in}})$，其中 $\varepsilon$ 为误差预算，$d_{in}$ 为有效输入维度。

Conclusion: 该定理首次从理论上严格证明了深度MLP的可压缩性与原始宽度无关，而仅依赖于误差容忍度和输入的内在维度，为理解神经网络可压缩性的本质提供了理论依据。

Abstract: It has long been known that well-trained neural networks can be compressed very strongly without affecting their performance, an important phenomenon that remains poorly understood. We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations. For a deep, wide fixed teacher network, there exists a narrow (same depth) network that approximately represents the same function as the original. The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the original width, but is $O((\log(1/\varepsilon))^{d_{in}})$, where $\varepsilon$ is the error budget and $d_{in}$ is the effective input dimension. Our construction involves a novel derivative-matching technique which is aware of the low-dimensional input, and a layer-wise reweighting that preserves the input-output mapping.

</details>


### [461] [How Architecture and Training Affect TPC Representations Across Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21756)
*Tyler Wheeler,Michelle P. Kuchera,Raghuram Ramanujan,William Sieland,Ryan Krupp,Daniel Bazin,Connor L. Cross,Hoi Yan Ian Heung,Andrew J. Jones,Ruchi Mahajan,Saiprasad Ravishankar,Pranjal Singh,Benjamin Votaw,Chris Wrede*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了深度学习中基础模型表示在实验物理领域（尤其是时间投影室TPC）跨实验和探测器系统的可复用性。通过在线性/非线性探针和随机权重对照下使用冻结编码器，作者发现架构本身（而非仅靠下游微调）是任务相关结构的重要来源，且这种结构在不同实验和探测器系统间可复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习日益转向基础模型范式，但在实验物理中，模型和学到的表示能否超越其开发所在实验被复用仍不明确。已有评估通常依赖下游微调性能，无法区分架构贡献与编码器训练贡献，也难以从下游任务中反推表示的实际结构。作者希望系统性地评测TPC事件表示跨分类任务、跨实验、跨探测器系统的复用能力。

Method: 使用GADGET II TPC和AT-TPC四个数据集的变长稀疏张量事件，训练Sparse ResNet和PointNet风格两种编码器生成512维嵌入。通过随机初始化编码器隔离架构贡献，再对每个编码器在分类任务上训练后冻结参数，为每个下游任务训练线性或非线性探针，评估其表征可复用性。

Result: 随机初始化的PointNet风格编码器表示在多个任务上具有高度信息性；两种架构在嵌入空间组织方式上存在差异，但均未表现出跨探测器系统的较大系统性信息损失。架构引起的结构在跨实验和探测器系统中保持有用。

Conclusion: 架构是TPC嵌入中任务相关结构的重要来源，在评估表示学习和开发可复用探测器模型时应将其作为显式因素加以考虑。单纯的监督训练带来的表示可复用性有限，而架构内在的归纳偏置贡献了跨系统迁移的大部分价值。

Abstract: Deep-learning efforts have increasingly shifted toward foundation model approaches. In experimental physics, this allows models and learned representations to be reused beyond the experiments in which they were developed. This work evaluates the reusability of representations across experiments and detector systems using probes on frozen encoders. These probes reveal task-relevant structure before downstream adaptation, complementing fine-tuning. Together with random-weight controls, they distinguish contributions from architecture and encoder training that downstream performance alone cannot resolve.
  Time projection chamber (TPC) data provide a useful testbed because events from TPC systems can be represented as variable-length sparse tensors, while detector geometries, event topologies, and scientific tasks can differ substantially. We investigate whether fixed-dimensional TPC event representations can be reused across classification tasks, experiments, and detector systems. Sparse ResNet and PointNet-style encoders produce 512-dimensional embeddings for four datasets from the GADGET II TPC and AT-TPC. Randomly initialized encoders isolate the contribution from architecture before supervised training. We then train each encoder on a classification task, freeze its parameters, and train a linear or nonlinear probe for each downstream task. We find that this architecture-induced structure remains useful across experiments and detector systems. The randomly initialized PointNet-style representation is highly informative on several tasks. The two architectures organize their embedding spaces differently, but neither exhibits a large, systematic loss of utility cross-detector. These results show that architecture is a major source of task-relevant structure in TPC embeddings and should be treated explicitly when assessing representation learning and developing reusable detector models.

</details>


### [462] [A Fixed-Radius Distance-Band Benchmark for Dimensionality-Reduction Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21779)
*Yoshio Takaeda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批评了基于k近邻的降维质量评估指标（如recall@k、trustworthiness）存在偏差——它们对每点使用可变半径和硬包含阈值，天然偏向t-SNE/UMAP等邻域图方法，而惩罚保持绝对距离的方法。作者提出用固定半径的距离带状Shepard rho（Spearman相关系数）来分带评估近程与全局结构保真度，并在合成数据集与真实噪声条件下对八种方法（PCA, Isomap, t-SNE, UMAP, PyMDE, PCC, DREAMS, toorPIA）进行基准测试。结果显示：高全局rho可与~93倍的簇内尺度坍缩共存；recall@k与固定半径带系统性分歧且方向符合偏差预测；成员受限的Shepard rho能解决单点与少数群体问题，而即使DREAMS也会静默失败。所有指标均在全部成对距离上精确计算，与任何方法内部机制无关，并可通过离线工件复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DR方法评估过度依赖k近邻存活率类指标（recall@k, trustworthiness, continuity），这些指标因每点可变半径与硬包含阈值而存在系统性偏差：它们偏爱邻域图方法（t-SNE, UMAP），却无法反映绝对距离保真度，尤其掩盖簇内尺度坍缩等价值层面畸变。因此需要一个无偏、固定尺度、可区分近程与全局结构的评估框架。

Method: 提出固定半径的距离带状Shepard rho指标：在高维与二维成对距离之间计算Spearman相关，按累积距离带分割以分别报告近程和全局结构，保证每个点用相同的绝对半径判定。此外引入价值层面的过压缩度量和成员受限的Shepard rho以解决单点/少数群体问题，并设计了补充的out-of-sample（addplot）异常检测测试。所有指标在全部成对距离上精确计算，独立于方法的内部实现。

Result: 对八种方法在多种合成几何（非均匀密度、密集簇、闭环过渡、离子空间离群点、不平衡两群体）以及现实噪声（SNR=1, D=768, N=1000）下评测发现：(i) 高全局Shepard rho与~93倍簇内尺度坍缩可共存，秩指标无法发现而价值指标可见；(ii) recall@k与固定半径带系统分歧，方向与预测偏差一致；(iii) 成员受限Shepard rho可解决单点与少数群体问题，而DREAMS这类近程-全局混合方法也在该类问题上静默失败。离群点检测测试验证了异常落入正常区域之外的判别力。

Conclusion: Rank-based近邻指标不足以评判DR保真度，固定半径的Shepard rho族提供了一种更公平、可复现、能同时捕获近程尺度与国际结构的评估基准，并能揭示秩统计量无法察觉的尺度畸变与少数群体问题。封闭源码方法toorPIA的输出坐标被提交为工件，保证所有数字可离线复现。

Abstract: Dimensionality-reduction (DR) methods are routinely judged by how well each point's k nearest neighbors survive the 2-D embedding (recall@k, trustworthiness, continuity). We argue this family is a biased measure of distance fidelity: its per-point variable radius and hard inclusion threshold favor neighbor-graph methods (t-SNE, UMAP) and penalize methods that preserve absolute distances. We instead score DR fidelity with a fixed-radius distance-band Shepard rho: the Spearman correlation between high-D and 2-D pairwise distances, restricted to cumulative distance bands so that near and global structure are reported separately, with every point judged on the same absolute radius. On synthetic datasets with known ground-truth geometry (non-uniform density, dense clusters, a closed-loop transition, off-subspace outliers, imbalanced two-population data) at realistic noise (SNR=1, D=768, N=1000), we benchmark eight methods -- PCA, Isomap, t-SNE, UMAP, PyMDE, PCC, DREAMS, and the closed-source toorPIA -- and show that (i) high global Shepard rho can coexist with a ~93x collapse of within-cluster scale, invisible to rank-based scores but obvious in a value-based over-compression metric; (ii) recall@k and the fixed-radius band disagree systematically, in the direction the bias predicts; (iii) a membership-restricted Shepard rho resolves single-point and minority-population questions that many-pair statistics cannot -- questions on which even DREAMS, a recent local-plus-global hybrid, fails silently. A supplementary out-of-sample (addplot) test asks whether a never-seen anomaly lands outside the normal region and whether its direction identifies its source. All metrics are computed exactly on all pairwise distances, independently of any method's internals, and every number is reproducible offline: the closed-source method's output coordinates (not its algorithm) are committed to the artifact.

</details>


### [463] [Variance Driven Exploration: A Provable and Efficient Methodology for Pure Exploration in Highly Stochastic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21995)
*Khang Luong,Nam Nguyen,Hoang Ta,Hung The Tran,Tuan Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出方差驱动探索（VarDE）方法，用于在高随机性环境中进行纯探索，通过将采样分配最小化最终决策的不确定性，应用于最优臂识别、蒙特卡洛树搜索和最优策略识别三个核心问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高随机性环境中，探索过程常被随机方差主导，现有的纯探索方法未能系统性地将采样努力分配到最能减少最终决策不确定性的方向，缺乏一个统一且具有理论保证的探索原则。

Method: VarDE基于"采样应最小化最终决策不确定性"的基本原则，通过平滑决策函数形式化最终决策的不确定性，推导出能够显式捕捉各组件随机噪声对最终输出可靠性影响的分配规则，并将该方法应用于BAI、MCTS和BPI三个纯探索问题。

Result: VarDE在理论层面提供了方差衰减和简单遗憾的保证；在实验层面，相较于现有方法，在高随机性环境中展现出显著且一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: VarDE是一种通用的、有理论支撑的纯探索方法，在高随机性环境中相比现有方法具有一致且显著的性能优势，同时具有方差衰减和简单遗憾的理论保证。

Abstract: We propose Variance Driven Exploration (VarDE), a principled approach for pure exploration in highly stochastic environments, where the exploration process is dominated by stochastic variance. VarDE is built on a fundamental principle: sampling effort should be allocated to minimize the uncertainty of the final decision. We formalize the uncertainty of the final decision through a smooth decision function and derive allocation rules that explicitly capture how stochastic noise in individual components affects the reliability of the final output. We apply this methodology to three core problems of pure exploration -- Best Arm Identification (BAI), Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), and Best-Policy Identification (BPI) -- with theoretical guarantees on variance decay and simple regret. Empirically, we demonstrate consistent and significant improvements of VarDE over existing methods, with especially strong gains in highly stochastic environments.

</details>


### [464] [MSM-Mem: A Universal Medical Structured Multimodal Memory Framework for Medical AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21810)
*Md Asaduzzaman Jabin,Khoa Le,Lin Zhao,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MSM-Mem，一种医疗结构化的多模态记忆框架，使基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的医疗AI智能体能够像临床医生一样通过积累经验而不断进化，将临床经验组织为语义、情景和视觉记忆，并在推理过程中增量更新和检索，从而逐步提升决策可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床决策本质上是经验驱动的，医生通过跨交互的综合分析逐步精炼推理能力。然而，当前基于MLLM的医疗AI智能体大多是"无状态"推理系统，每次交互独立生成决策，无法保留或内化经验知识。这种差异限制了它们通过使用来逐步提升推理可靠性以及在真实临床工作流中适应纵向患者语境的能力。

Method: MSM-Mem是一个智能体记忆框架，其核心方法包括：（1）将异质临床经验组织为三类记忆——语义记忆（semantic）、情景记忆（episodic）和视觉记忆（visual）；（2）在推理过程中对记忆进行增量更新；（3）检索先前经验以辅助当前推理，从而使智能体能够随着时间推移渐进式地精化决策。

Result: 在MoE-LLaVA骨干网络上进行的评估表明，MSM-Mem带来了持续的性能提升，并且随着持续使用还能观察到进一步的性能增益。

Conclusion: MSM-Mem为医疗AI智能体提供了一条可行的进化路径，使其能够以类似于临床医生从实践中学习的方式，逐步提升推理能力，从而弥合当前MLLM智能体与真实临床工作流之间的差距。

Abstract: Clinical decision-making is inherently experience-driven: physicians progressively refine their reasoning by synthesizing patient history, multimodal observations, and prior diagnostic experiences across interactions. In contrast, current multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based medical AI agents largely operate as stateless inference systems, generating decisions independently for each interaction without retaining or internalizing experiential knowledge. This discrepancy limits their ability to progressively improve reasoning reliability through usage and adapt to longitudinal patient contexts in real-world clinical workflows. In this study, we propose Medical Structured Multimodal Memory (MSM-Mem), an agentic memory framework that enables medical AI agents to evolve through accumulated clinical experiences. MSM-Mem organizes heterogeneous clinical experiences into semantic, episodic, and visual memory and incrementally updates them during inference, allowing the agent to retrieve prior experiences to inform current reasoning and progressively refine decision-making over time. Evaluations on MoE-LLaVA backbones demonstrate consistent performance improve- ments with further gains observed through continued usage. In general, MSM-Mem offers a viable pathway toward medical AI agents capable of evolving their reasoning competence in a manner analogous to the way clinicians learn from practice over time.

</details>


### [465] [Symbolic Neural ODEs: Learning interpretable models from time-series data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22112)
*Nibodh Boddupalli,Jeff Moehlis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机器学习框架，直接从时间序列数据中识别稀疏、可解释的动力系统模型，通过神经网络参数化向量场并最小化多步预测损失，结合逐步增加预测视界和稀疏正则化，显著提升模型稳定性与泛化能力，并能准确恢复稳定/不稳定不动点、周期轨道和混沌吸引子等多样行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于单步回归（one-step regression）识别动力系统向量场的方法在模型稳定性上表现不佳，尤其是面对多步动力学复合时容易累积误差并导致不稳定的模型。现有方法缺乏对长期行为的约束，也缺少对混沌系统统计特性的理论保证。因此需要一个能同时兼顾数值可解性、模型可解释性和长期稳定性的识别框架。

Method: 1) 使用神经网络架构参数化底层向量场；2) 在有限视界上最小化多步预测损失（平均绝对误差，MAE）；3) 训练过程中逐步增加预测视界（curriculum/progressive horizon）；4) 施加稀疏性促进正则化以获得精简模型；5) 建立轨迹误差与统计精度之间的理论界，为模型行为提供理论解释。

Result: 该方法能准确恢复包含稳定/不稳定不动点、周期轨道和混沌吸引子在内的多种动力学系统。相比单步向量场回归方法，多步训练显著改善了模型稳定性。对混沌系统，即使在长期轨迹预测受限的情况下，模型仍具有准确短期动力学和一致的长期统计特性（均值、方差、Lyapunov指数），并提供了轨迹误差与统计精度之间的理论界。

Conclusion: 多步预测训练与逐步扩展视界的策略是识别稳定、可泛化动力系统模型的有效途径，结合稀疏正则化可获得精确且可解释的模型；理论界的建立为理解多步训练在混沌系统中的统计准确性提供了原则性依据。

Abstract: We present a machine learning framework for identifying sparse, interpretable models of dynamical systems directly from time-series data. Our approach parameterizes the underlying vector field using a neural architecture and trains it by minimizing a multi-step prediction loss over a finite horizon. To ensure numerical tractability, we optimize a mean absolute error objective averaged across prediction steps, and progressively increase the horizon during training. A key feature of this formulation is that it enforces consistency under repeated composition of the learned dynamics. As a result, the identified models exhibit significantly improved stability compared with approaches based on one-step regression of the vector field. When combined with sparsity-promoting regularization, this leads to parsimonious models that generalize beyond the training data. We demonstrate accurate recovery of systems exhibiting a wide range of behaviors, including stable and unstable fixed points, periodic orbits, and chaotic attractors. For chaotic systems, while long-term trajectory prediction is inherently limited by sensitivity to initial conditions, we show that multi-step training yields models with accurate short-term dynamics and strong agreement in long-time statistical properties, including mean, variance, and Lyapunov exponents. Moreover, we establish theoretical bounds linking trajectory error to statistical accuracy, providing a step toward a principled explanation for this behavior.

</details>


### [466] [Resilient Concurrent Causal Discovery for Topological Event Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21815)
*Jiyu Tian,Junhao Dong,Mingchu Li,Lingling Fang,Liming Chen,Andreas Holzinger,Zheng Yan,Yew Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RCCD方法，用于从拓扑事件序列中学习鲁棒的并发因果图。通过影响力感知的超边因果注意力机制捕获多对一因果交互，并设计基于掩码的交替因果优化框架增强对缺失数据的韧性，在模拟和真实电信网络数据上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法难以处理拓扑事件序列中并发事件带来的复杂因果关系，且对不完整事件序列缺乏鲁棒性，影响网络可靠性保障。

Method: 1) 提出影响力感知的超边因果注意力机制：将事件持续时间融入嵌入表示，通过超边因果卷积聚合并发事件特征，并注入网络先验知识以捕获多对一因果交互；2) 设计基于掩码的交替因果优化框架：通过自监督掩码重构迫使模型根据上下文恢复被掩码的事件类型，增强预测器对缺失数据的韧性。

Result: 在模拟和真实电信网络数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性方面均显著优于现有最先进方法，更适用于真实电信网络环境。

Conclusion: RCCD为拓扑事件序列的并发因果发现提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案，在真实电信网络中具有更好的实用价值。

Abstract: Causal discovery on topological event sequences is crucial for ensuring the reliability of networks. However, existing methods struggle to capture the complex causal relationships arising from concurrent events and lack robustness to incomplete event sequences. To address these issues, we propose a resilient concurrent causal discovery method, termed RCCD, enabling robust learning of causal graphs from topological event sequences. Specifically, we first introduce an influence-aware hyperedge causal attention mechanism, which incorporates event duration into the embedding representation, aggregates concurrent event features via hyperedge causal convolution, and injects network prior knowledge to capture the complex many-to-one causal interactions. Furthermore, we design a masked-based alternating causal optimization framework, which forces the model to recover masked event types based on context through self-supervised mask reconstruction, thereby enhancing the resilience of the predictor to missing data. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world telecommunication network datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and robustness, making it more suitable for real-world telecommunication network environments.

</details>


### [467] [Joint Causal Structure and Cluster Discovery Using Variational Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22212)
*Avni Rajpal,Anubhav Kumar,Rishabh Karnad,Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan,P. K. Srijith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于变分推断的新方法，可同时推断潜在变量簇及其间的因果结构，无需预先知道分组信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法通常假设变量分组（簇）信息是已知的，但在脑成像、气候建模等实际应用中，簇及其间的因果关系往往是潜在未知的，需要同时推断。

Method: 基于变分推断框架，分别使用分类分布和伯努利分布构建关于簇和图结构的近似后验，推导变分下界并设计相应的估计技术以学习变分参数和模型参数。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上验证了所提方法在簇发现和因果发现方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在不依赖先验分组信息的前提下，同时实现潜在簇与其间因果结构的联合推断。

Abstract: Causal discovery aims to understand the relationships between individual random variables. In many applications, such as brain imaging and climate modeling, it is more meaningful to consider interactions among groups of variables. Existing methods assume that knowledge of such groups or clusters is explicitly available when modeling interactions. However, in practice, these clusters as well as the causal relationships among them, are latent. In this paper, we present a novel approach based on variational inference to simultaneously infer both the latent clusters and causal structures. We learn an approximate posterior over clusters and graph-structure by considering variational distributions based on categorical and Bernoulli models respectively. We derive variational lower bounds and estimation techniques to learn variational and model parameters. The effectiveness of our proposed methods for cluster and causal discovery are demonstrated on both synthetic and real data sets.

</details>


### [468] [A Physics-informed Neural Network Approach for Robust Buckling Load Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Truncated Conical Shells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21818)
*Devasmit Dutta,Budhaditya De,Rohan Majumder,Sudip Kumar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种物理信息神经网络（PiNN）框架，用于预测薄壁截锥壳在轴向压缩下的临界屈曲载荷，并将其集成到基于可靠性的设计（RBD）中，以校准考虑目标可靠性和数据不确定性的安全一致折减因子（KDFs）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统薄壁截锥壳屈曲设计依赖保守的折减因子（如NASA SP-8019），这些因子未明确考虑壳体几何形状、制造质量、数据不确定性或目标可靠度，导致设计过于保守或不够准确。

Method: 构建PiNN框架，将几何与材料描述符结合源于壳体稳定性理论和局部缩减刚度法（LRSM）的力学特征；设计物理信息损失函数以惩罚超过理论弹性屈曲载荷的力学不可行预测；使用133组实验Mylar截锥壳轴向压缩测试进行训练与评估，并集成到RBD公式中计算可靠度指标并校准KDFs。

Result: 与常规深度神经网络（DNN）相比，PiNN提高了预测精度、降低了平均绝对误差并增强了物理一致性；PiNN-RBD框架能够有效评估可靠度指标并为预设目标可靠度水平校准安全一致的折减因子。

Conclusion: PiNN-RBD框架为缺陷敏感壳体结构提供了高效且具有不确定性感知能力的设计方法，弥合了物理模型与数据驱动方法之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Thin-walled truncated conical shells are widely used in aerospace, marine, offshore, and lightweight infrastructure systems due to their high strength-to-weight ratio and geometric efficiency. Their buckling resistance under axial compression, however, is highly sensitive to geometric imperfections, manufacturing tolerances, material variability, and nonlinear instability effects. Conventional design procedures rely on conservative knockdown factors (KDFs), such as those recommended in NASA SP-8019, which do not explicitly account for shell geometry, fabrication quality, data uncertainty, or target reliability. This study develops a physics-informed neural network (PiNN) framework for predicting critical buckling loads of thin truncated conical shells and integrates the trained surrogate within a reliability-based design (RBD) formulation. The model combines geometric and material descriptors with mechanics-informed features derived from shell stability theory and the localized reduced stiffness method (LRSM). A physics-informed loss function penalizes mechanically inadmissible predictions exceeding the theoretical elastic buckling load. The framework is trained and evaluated using 133 experimental Mylar conical shell tests under axial compression. Compared with a conventional deep neural network (DNN), the PiNN improves predictive accuracy, reduces mean absolute error, and enhances physical consistency. The trained PiNN is then used to evaluate reliability indices and calibrate safety-consistent KDFs for prescribed target reliability levels. Results demonstrate that the PiNN-RBD framework provides an efficient approach for uncertainty-aware design of imperfection-sensitive shell structures.

</details>


### [469] [Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22636)
*Shengbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种稳定的无穷维线性函数逼近框架用于Q-learning，在紧致潜在度量空间上通过重建与压缩算子的非扩张性保证潜在Bellman映射的收缩性，并提出了两种随机逼近算法，获得前导项为O(n^(-1/2))的sup范数收敛界，且算法对度量选择不敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Q-learning结合线性函数逼近可能不稳定，因为任意逼近架构不一定保持Bellman收缩性。作者希望构建一种能够保证稳定性的无穷维线性函数逼近框架，并从单一马尔可夫行为策略轨迹中进行学习。

Method: 在紧致潜在度量空间上定义系数场θ，通过重建算子将θ映射为连续Q函数，通过压缩算子将Bellman更新映射回潜在坐标。两个算子的非扩张性导出潜在Bellman映射的收缩性，唯一不动点θ*的重建逼近最优Q函数。提出两种随机逼近算法，利用度量空间的覆盖数而非维度来控制一致估计误差。

Result: 建立了两种SA算法的sup范数收敛界，前导项为O(n^(-1/2))阶。证明了平滑性沿压缩映射传递至不动点和SA迭代，使估计误差可通过覆盖数控制。算法对度量ρ的选择不可知，能自动适应平滑性和几何结构。

Conclusion: 无穷维公式化为识别控制统计难度的结构提供了强大抽象，算法自动适配数据的平滑性与几何特性。框架可进一步应用于Q-measure-learning（线性密度逼近）和冻结预训练网络下的输出层神经权重训练。

Abstract: Q-learning with linear function approximation can be unstable because an arbitrary approximation architecture need not preserve the Bellman contraction. We develop a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory. The learning variable is a coefficient field $θ\in C(\mathbb L)$ on a compact latent metric space $(\mathbb L,ρ)$. The framework uses a reconstruction operator that maps $θ$ to a continuous Q-function and a compression operator that maps Bellman updates back to latent coordinates. Nonexpansiveness of both operators induces a contractive latent Bellman map on $C(\mathbb L)$, with a unique fixed point $θ^*$ whose reconstruction approximates the optimal Q-function up to representation error. We propose two stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms and establish their sup-norm convergence bounds with a leading term of order $\widetilde O(n^{-1/2})$. The infinite-dimensional formulation provides a powerful abstraction for identifying the structures that govern statistical difficulty. Smoothness of the compression map in $ρ$ is inherited by $θ^*$ and the SA iterates, allowing uniform estimation errors to be controlled through covering numbers of $(\mathbb L,ρ)$ rather than the dimension of $C(\mathbb L)$. Remarkably, the SA algorithms we propose are agnostic to the choice of $ρ$, and thus can automatically adapt to both the smoothness and the geometry. We further illustrate the framework through Q-measure-learning with linear density approximation and output-layer neural weight training under a frozen pretrained network.

</details>


### [470] [Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22607)
*Muhammad Waleed Gul,Elaheh Homayounvala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了DP-FedSHAP，一种仅在联邦学习产生的后验TreeSHAP解释向量上应用客户端级差分隐私的架构，以应对共享高保真SHAP解释所引发的成员推断攻击风险，并在高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上权衡了解释保真度、隐私保护与模型AUPRC性能三者之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测依赖集中式机器学习模型存在严重的数据隐私风险；联邦学习虽然实现了数据去中心化处理，但金融监管要求模型透明，因此必须使用TreeSHAP等可解释AI工具。然而近期网络安全研究表明，共享高保真SHAP解释会使联邦网络暴露于成员推断攻击之下，在透明性与隐私安全之间形成了根本性矛盾。

Method: 提出DP-FedSHAP架构，仅在联邦学习框架中对后验TreeSHAP可解释性向量应用客户端级差分隐私扰动，而非对训练后的模型权重直接加噪。将DP-FedSHAP与针对模型权重进行扰动的Weight-Level DP基线方法进行对比实验。

Result: 在使用高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上，定量测量了解释保真度、隐私保护程度以及模型AUPRC三个指标之间的权衡关系，并比较了DP-FedSHAP与Weight-Level DP基线的性能差异。

Conclusion: DP-FedSHAP为联邦金融欺诈检测中"模型透明"与"隐私安全"的冲突提供了一种新颖的解决方案，证明了在解释层面而非模型权重层面施加差分隐私是一种可行的隐私保护策略，但实际应用中需要在解释保真度与隐私强度之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new architecture that applies client-level differential privacy only to post-hoc TreeSHAP vectors. It is compared against a Weight-Level DP baseline, which perturbs the trained model directly instead. Using the highly imbalanced IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset, this study measures the trade-off between explanation fidelity, privacy preservation, and the model's Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC).

</details>


### [471] [More Experts, Worse Dynamics: Inverse Scaling and Spectral Bias in Mixture-of-Experts State-Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21840)
*Chandresh Pandey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在受控合成环境中批判性评估了混合专家（MoE）架构在谱状态空间模型中的动态表达假设。通过三类不同动态机制（混沌、稳定振荡、噪声主导自回归）的序列预测任务，发现算子级混合模型始终不如单专家基线，专家数量增加导致逆缩放，路由崩溃且无法产生有意义的专业化，甚至完美监督也无济于事。进一步揭示MSE改进可能源于时间平滑破坏吸引子几何结构，而非真实建模动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构被广泛认为通过将复杂系统分解为简单局部动态来增强表达力，这一直觉已被扩展到谱状态空间模型，假设混合稳定算子能够适应异构或机制切换的时间序列。作者希望批判性地验证这一假设是否真正成立，特别是在纯粹的动态挑战而非表征挑战的场景下。

Method: 在受控合成环境中设计包含三个机制（Mackey-Glass混沌系统、稳定振荡、噪声主导自回归）的逐步预测任务。通过广泛的消融实验，包括容量缩放、oracle路由、冻结专家变体、以及输出级MoE基线的比较，系统评估算子级混合模型的性能。

Result: 算子级混合模型在所有消融设置下均未能超越单专家基线。增加专家数量导致逆缩放；路由崩溃或无法诱导有意义的专家专业化；即使提供完美机制监督（oracle routing）也无法阻止全局性能下降。此外，混沌轨迹上MSE的"改进"可能是误导性的——相空间分析显示较低误差往往源于时间平滑破坏了吸引子的几何结构，而非对动态的真实建模。

Conclusion: 研究识别了在所研究的参数化和训练协议下算子插值的潜在局限性，强调在评估机制切换动态系统时需要采用几何感知的评估方法，而不应盲目依赖MSE等标量指标。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are commonly motivated as a way to increase expressivity by decomposing complex systems into simpler local dynamics. This intuition has recently been extended to spectral state-space models, where mixing stable operators is assumed to enable adaptation to heterogeneous or regime-switching time series. We critically evaluate this assumption in a controlled synthetic setting designed to isolate dynamical rather than representational challenges. We study a next-step prediction task on sequences composed of three regimes: chaotic dynamics generated by the Mackey-Glass system, a stable oscillatory regime, and a noise-dominated autoregressive regime. Across extensive ablations including capacity scaling, oracle routing, frozen-expert variants, and comparisons to output-level MoE baselines, operator-level mixture models consistently fail to outperform a single-expert baseline. Increasing the number of experts leads to inverse scaling, routing collapses or fails to induce meaningful specialization, and even perfect regime supervision does not prevent degradation in global performance. Furthermore, we show that apparent improvements in mean squared error on chaotic trajectories can be misleading. Phase-space analysis reveals that lower error often arises from temporal smoothing that destroys the geometry of the underlying attractor rather than from faithful modeling of the dynamics. These results identify a likely limitation of operator interpolation under the studied parameterization and training protocol, and underscore the need for geometry-aware evaluation when assessing regime-switching dynamical systems.

</details>


### [472] [Change Detection in Probability Flow ODE: Online Testing in Diffusion Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22807)
*Artem Kraevskiy,Artem Prokhorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的序贯变点检测方法，通过概率流ODE将数据映射到标准高斯潜空间，并利用最大均值差异（MMD）作为检验统计量，结合Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序进行阈值校准，无需对变点前后分布做参数假设即可检测任意分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多时序数据任务（如金融市场趋势反转识别、视频音频自动分割、运动传感器方向变化检测）本质上需要检测时间有序数据中的分布偏移。当变点前后的条件密度未知且无闭合形式时，经典似然比检验不适用，亟需一种不依赖参数假设的变点检测方法。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 利用预变点数据训练一个带有冻结上下文编码器的条件扩散模型，通过概率流ODE定义一个确定性双射，将变点前观测映射到标准高斯潜变量；(2) 通过同一冻结映射处理变点后观测，使其偏离参考分布，采用最大均值差异（MMD）作为检验统计量，推导高斯零假设下各组分的闭合表达式，并建立其作为退化U统计量的渐近分布；(3) 将得到的统计量应用于Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序，实现精确阈值校准。

Result: 该方法能够检测任意分布偏移，包括协方差旋转和高阶结构断裂，且无需对变点前后任一阶段做出参数假设。通过高斯零假设下的闭合形式推导和退化U统计量的渐近分布理论，保证了检测统计量的理论可靠性，并实现了Shiryaev-Roberts程序的精确阈值校准。

Conclusion: 该工作成功将扩散模型与经典序贯变点检测理论结合，克服了似然比统计量在条件密度未知时的局限性，为非参数假设下的任意分布偏移检测提供了统一、可扩展且理论上完备的解决方案。

Abstract: A rapidly growing range of sequential data tasks, such as identifying trend reversals in financial markets, auto-segmenting video and audio recordings, detecting changes in movement direction from motion sensors cannot be fully addressed without detection of distributional shifts in time-ordered data. We consider a sequential change-point detection problem where the conditional density switches at an unknown time, yet neither the pre- nor post-change distribution admits a closed-form. Classical likelihood-ratio statistics are inapplicable in this settings.
  A conditional diffusion model, trained on pre-change-point data with a frozen context encoder, defines a deterministic bijection via the probability flow ODE. Pre-change observations are mapped onto standard Gaussian latent variables. Post-change observations, processed through the same frozen map, deviate from this reference. We employ the Maximum Mean Discrepancy as the test statistic, derive closed-form expressions for its components under the Gaussian null, and establish its asymptotic distribution as a degenerate U-statistic. Afterwards we apply an online detection procedure of Shiryaev--Roberts to the resulting statistic with exact threshold calibration.
  The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.

</details>


### [473] [DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22824)
*Tue Do,Daniel Alabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DIME框架，一种基于理论的、查询高效的扩散模型成员推理攻击方法。通过精确刻画有限训练集上最优扩散去噪器的形式，将成员泄漏分解为重建精度的偏差项和局部拥挤项两项互补信号，仅需两个查询即可实现攻击，在多个数据集上以显著更低的查询成本取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的成员推理攻击大多是启发式的，缺乏理论基础，且需要大量查询预算。作者希望建立一种理论上可解释、查询高效的成员推理攻击方法，以更好地理解并从防御角度应对扩散模型中的隐私泄漏问题。

Method: 1) 从理论上精确刻画有限训练集上最优扩散去噪器的封闭形式，揭示成员泄漏由去噪器的隐式重建误差决定；2) 将该误差分解为偏差项（重建精度）和局部拥挤项（邻近训练样本的几何结构）两个信号；3) 设计仅利用模型查询的高效估计器，构造仅需两个查询的实用攻击；4) 在五个数据集上验证，并评估具体防御措施。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA和ImageNet上，DIME在1% FPR下的TPR比现有攻击提升最多3倍；仅需两个查询的两查询变体即可超越现有30查询的基线方法，在相当或显著更低的查询成本下持续优于先前攻击。

Conclusion: DIME证明了扩散模型成员推理攻击可以具备严格理论支撑且高度查询高效，为理解和防御扩散模型中的隐私泄漏提供了新视角，同时提出的防御措施可用于缓解此类强大成员测试的威胁。

Abstract: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.

</details>


### [474] [ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21860)
*Weihang Pan,Zhengxu Yu,Yuxiang Zhang,Wenzhi Li,Zhongming Jin,Binbin Lin,Xiaofei He,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ChainPrune，一种推理路径语义结构优化方法，通过将自生成的推理路径组织成树形结构并进行多准则优势路径选择来构建偏好数据，结合DPO偏好学习和监督损失，有效解决大型推理模型（LRM）的过度推理（overthinking）问题，在减少推理步数和计算开销的同时保持甚至提升准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型在Chain-of-Thought推理中表现出过度推理行为：推理步骤过长、存在冗余步骤、计算开销高。现有的token-length奖励策略虽能减少token数量，但导致"伪简洁"（pseudo-conciseness）问题——token数减少了但冗余推理依旧存在，推理链反而更长且结构效率更低。因此需要一种既能减少推理长度又能保留关键推理步骤、同时避免伪简洁的语义结构优化方法。

Method: ChainPrune包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将自生成的推理路径整合为树形结构；(2) 采用多准则优势路径选择（multi-criteria dominant path selection）过程构建偏好数据，生成浅层推理轨迹（shallow reasoning trajectories）同时保留必要推理步骤；(3) 结合DPO（Direct Preference Optimization）偏好学习方法与监督损失，有效缓解虚假奖励抑制（false reward suppression）问题，从而合成高质量且可控的训练数据以优化推理框架。

Result: 综合实验结果表明，ChainPrune在推理步骤长度和计算开销方面均实现了显著降低，同时在准确性上保持甚至提升了原有水平。

Conclusion: ChainPrune通过推理路径的语义结构优化与偏好学习相结合，为缓解LRM的过度推理问题提供了一种高效且可控的解决方案，在推理效率与推理质量之间取得了良好的平衡。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the multi-step problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by introducing explicit intermediate reasoning. However, advanced Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking behaviors, including excessively long reasoning steps, redundant steps, and high computational overhead. Existing token-length reward strategies aim to promote concise outputs, but often result in pseudo-conciseness, where token count is reduced, yet redundant reasoning persists, leading to longer and less structurally efficient chains. To address these limitations, we propose ChainPrune, a novel reasoning path semantic structural optimization method to efficiently and controllably synthesize self-generated high-quality training data. We initially consolidate self-generated reasoning paths into a tree-based structure, followed by a multi-criteria dominant path selection process for preference data construction that formulates shallow reasoning trajectories while preserving essential reasoning steps. To further enhance the quality of reasoning, we incorporate a DPO-based preference learning method combined with supervised loss, effectively mitigating false reward suppression. This innovative integration significantly enhances both the efficiency and effectiveness of our reasoning framework. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate significant reductions in step length and computational overhead, while maintaining or even enhancing accuracy.

</details>


### [475] [Stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22953)
*Nabil Kahalé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（SGDIR）变体，针对平方损失推导出期望过量风险的维度无关上界；在无噪声情形下得到了平均与非平均SGDIR的新界（源参数与容量假设下），在特定源参数下达到$O(m^{-2}\log^2 m)$，在另一源参数下可达$O(m^{-3+\epsilon})$；还建立了与上界匹配（至多差对数因子）的下界。在有噪声情形下，证明了在一般假设和正则化参数温和下界下，SGDIR的期望过量风险不超过岭回归（至多差对数因子）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是核方法中重要的优化算法，但现有理论分析往往依赖特定的步长选取或需要额外条件。本文旨在系统分析带初始正则化的SGD变体（SGDIR），在不额外依赖光滑性条件下建立维度无关的风险界，并与岭回归进行严格对比。

Method: 采用SGDIR（初始正则化的SGD）进行分析，在无噪声情形下区分平均与非平均两种聚合方式，在矩、源和容量条件下推导期望过量风险的维度无关上界；在有噪声情形下建立SGDIR与岭回归的逐实例比较，利用正则化参数的温和下界进行界分析。

Result: 无噪声时：特定源参数下界为$O(m^{-2}\log^2 m)$；另一源参数下对任意$\epsilon>0$且容量参数超过$\epsilon^{-1}$时界为$O(m^{-3+\epsilon})$；建立了在特定区域与上界匹配（至多差对数因子）的下界。有噪声时：在一般假设下SGDIR的期望过量风险不超过岭回归（至多差多项式对数因子）。数值实验与理论一致。

Conclusion: SGDIR在无噪声和有噪声两种情形下均具有与岭回归可比甚至更优的理论保证，维度无关界的建立表明该方法在高维场景下具有良好泛化性能，为核方法中SGD类算法提供了坚实的理论支撑。

Abstract: We analyze a variant of stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization (SGDIR) and derive dimension-free upper bounds on its expected excess risk for the squared loss. In the noiseless case, we obtain new bounds for both averaged and non-averaged SGDIR under moment, source, and capacity assumptions. For a particular value of the source parameter, these bounds are of order $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$, where the number of training samples is of order $m$. For another value of the source parameter, we obtain, for any $ε>0$, bounds of order $m^{-3+ε}$, provided that the capacity parameter exceeds $ε^{-1}$. We also establish a lower bound that matches our upper bounds in certain regimes up to a polylogarithmic factor. In the noisy case, we provide an instance-based comparison between SGDIR and ridge regression. Under general assumptions and a mild lower bound on the regularization parameter, we show that the expected excess risk of SGDIR is no larger than that of ridge regression, up to a polylogarithmic factor. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data are consistent with our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [476] [Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22915)
*Akifumi Wachi,Takumi Tanabe,Youhei Akimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文定义了"安全黑客"（safety hacking）现象：推理时流水线先用学习的安全代理过滤输出，再选择代理可行集中奖励最高的输出，但代理不完美会污染可行集，奖励最大化会放大残留违规，导致看似合规实则违规的输出被选中，且随N增大这种失败几乎必然发生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时缩放（inference-time scaling）常使用学习的安全模型过滤输出，再以奖励模型选优。然而这种"过滤+选优"的组合可能产生两阶段失效：安全代理的误差先污染可行集，奖励最大化再放大这种污染。作者希望从理论上刻画这种组合失效的本质与边界条件。

Method: 作者定义安全黑客为通过学习约束但违反真实安全标准的输出。对约束Best-of-N采样，推导有限N界，该界由代理可行集内安全与不安全输出的联合上尾奖励分布决定。进一步证明对与代理可行参考分布有界χ²散度的策略，存在与N无关的安全黑客界，并以约束悲观采样实例化该覆盖控制原则。

Result: 若不可行但代理可接受的输出具有更重的奖励尾部分布，随着N增长安全黑客几乎必然发生，即使假阳性质量、平均安全与奖励代理误差任意小。覆盖控制只能限制放大，无法修复已污染的可行集；正则化选择并不必然比约束Best-of-N对所有奖励代理更安全。玩具与语言模型实验证实了污染及其奖励尾放大效应。

Conclusion: 推理时缩放与学习安全模型的组合存在内生性困难：安全代理的微小误差在奖励最大化下可能被放大为近乎必然的安全失败。仅靠覆盖控制或正则化无法根治这一根本问题，需要重新审视推理时安全流水线的设计。

Abstract: Inference-time pipelines often sample multiple outputs, filter them with a learned safety model, and return the proxy-feasible output with the highest learned reward. We show that this composition creates a two-stage failure: an imperfect safety proxy first contaminates the feasible set with unsafe outputs, and reward maximization can then amplify this residual contamination. We define \emph{safety hacking} as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety criterion. For constrained Best-of-$N$ sampling, we derive finite-$N$ bounds governed by the joint upper reward tails of safe and unsafe outputs within the proxy-feasible set. If unsafe-but-feasible outputs have the heavier tail, safety hacking becomes asymptotically certain as $N$ grows, even when false-positive mass and average safety- and reward-proxy errors are arbitrarily small. We also show that policies within a bounded $χ^2$ divergence from the proxy-feasible reference distribution admit an $N$-independent safety-hacking bound, and instantiate this general coverage-control principle with constrained pessimistic sampling. Coverage control limits amplification but cannot repair a contaminated feasible set: admitted unsafe outputs may still be favored, and regularized selection is not necessarily safer than constrained Best-of-$N$ for every reward proxy. Toy and language-model experiments characterize both contamination and its reward-tail amplification, which exposes an inherent difficulty in inference-time scaling with learned safety models.

</details>


### [477] [BioMed-Agent-RL: A Meta Learning, All You Need for Biomedical Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21864)
*Md Asaduzzaman Jabin,Zihao Wu,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BioMed-Agent-RL，一个统一的医学智能体，集成了自适应编排、策略与基于奖励的强化学习模型，用于生物医学应用中的临床视觉大语言模型推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床视觉大语言模型在复杂临床场景中常遭受病灶噪声、模态错位、幻觉和上下文接地缺失等问题；同时主流智能体系统依赖静态非自适应管线，缺乏复杂医学推理所需的灵活性。

Method: BioMed-Agent-RL采用统一医学智能体架构，结合临床上下文感知偏好优化（CPO）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和动态熵调节的组相对策略优化（GRPO）；通过多模态元学习方法充当领域专家与人类判断合成器，自适应利用临床接地与推理器、病灶分割器、领域特定合成器等模型级专家知识，通过迭代自适应RL处理多种临床模态（如X射线）。

Result: 在多个基准上进行密集消融实验，该智能体显著优于现有SOTA模型，包括GPT-5，达到约73%的准确率（较当代基线增益约5%）。

Conclusion: 该框架为构建事实性强、可靠、稳健且具备专家级表现的独立临床推理智能体系统确立了新标准。

Abstract: The current progress of Clinical Vision Large Language Models (C-VLLMs) has substantially improved digital diagnostics, still these frameworks often endure lesion noises, modality misalignment, hallucination, and missed contextual grounding in complex clinical cases. Moreover, prevailing agent systems usually depend on static and non-adaptable pipelines and lack the versatility necessary for complex medical reasoning. To resolve these difficulties, we present BioMed-Agent-RL, a unified medical agent that incorporates adaptive orchestration, policy, and reward-based reinforcement learning (RL) models for biomedical applications. To ensure reliability, it invokes clinical context-aware preference optimization (CPO), direct preference optimization (DPO), and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with dynamic entropy regulation. This pipeline utilizes a multimodal meta-learning approach that operates as a field-specific expert and human judgment synthesizer. The agent adaptively utilizes a set of model-level expertise, such as clinical grounding and reasoner, lesion segmenter, and field-specific synthesizer, across various clinical modalities (e.g., X-ray) by utilizing an iterative and adaptive RL approach. The agent learns to seriously synthesize misleading, conflicting vision cues and trust in inherent reasoning, while specialist advice is faulty. An intensive ablation study is conducted across multiple benchmarks, and the agent significantly outperforms existing state of the art models, such as GPT-5, attaining up to ~73% accuracy (gain of ~5%) over contemporary baselines. As a result, the framework suggests a new standard for building factual, reliable, robust, and expert-like intelligent agent systems for independent clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [478] [Traceable Spectral Inference via Influence Functions: Efficient Data Attribution and Error Proxies for the Ariel Mission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23458)
*Nikki Grens,Luís F. Simões,Kai Hou Yip,Theresa Lueftinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于影响力函数（influence functions）的训练数据归因方法，专为科学空间任务（如ESA的Ariel）中的光谱分析管线设计。通过将影响力从损失重构为预测、利用极限学习机的闭式岭解高效计算无穷小预测影响力，并推导出基于残差传播的保守误差代理，实现对无标签环境下模型预测可靠性的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在科学空间任务（如ESA的Ariel）部署的机器学习模型中，地面真实值在运行期间不可用，物理合理性必须被人工评估，因此可解释性至关重要。现有可解释AI方法多聚焦于特征归因，而训练数据归因（尤其是影响力函数方法）在操作化光谱管线中未被充分探索。

Method: 三个关键贡献：(1) 将影响力函数从损失视角重新表述为预测视角，实现无标签部署；(2) 借助极限学习机（ELM）的闭式岭解，高效计算无穷小预测影响力；(3) 通过将训练残差沿影响力灵敏度传播，推导出基于影响力的保守误差代理。

Result: 在模拟光谱数据上的评估表明，所提出的误差代理与基于尺度和形状的光谱误差强相关。此外，影响力函数能够识别最具影响力的训练样本，并近似识别最具危害性的样本。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，该影响力-预测重构框架可作为科学机器学习（scientific machine learning）的操作化框架，在无地面真实值的场景下为模型预测提供可靠性评估与数据归因能力。

Abstract: Interpretability is critical for machine learning models deployed in scientific space missions such as ESA's Ariel, where ground truth is unavailable during operations and physical plausibility must be assessed. While most explainable AI methods focus on feature attribution, this work investigates training data attribution through influence functions and introduces three key contributions for operational spectroscopy pipelines. First, influence is reformulated in terms of prediction rather than loss, enabling label-free deployment. Second, by leveraging the closed-form ridge solution of an Extreme Learning Machine, infinitesimal prediction influence is efficiently computed. Third, an influence-based conservative error proxy is derived by propagating training residuals through the influence sensitivities. Evaluated against simulated spectra, the proposed proxy correlates strongly with scale and shape-based spectral errors. Furthermore, influence functions enable the identification of the most influential samples and the approximation of the most harmful ones. Together, these results suggest that this approach can serve as an operational framework for scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [479] [Graph Representation Learning of Lightweight IoT Ciphers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23054)
*Jonathan Cook,Sabih ur Rehman,M. Arif Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图表示学习（GRL）和部分差分分布表（pDDT）特征工程的框架，用于高效识别和可视化SIMON/SIMECK轻量级密码算法的高概率差分簇。三种ML模型（KNN、DT、RF）构建的有向图均达到1.0的精确率（零误报），其中KNN聚类分离效果最佳、F1分数最高、构图时间仅约2.3秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SIMON和SIMECK作为面向IoT设备的Feistel轻量级密码算法，易受差分密码分析攻击。现有技术依赖启发式和采样方法提升效率，但尚未有工作将机器学习引导的图表示学习（GRL）用于高效识别和可视化高概率差分簇，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 从部分差分分布表（pDDT）中提取四种差分属性作为特征工程策略，揭示原始差分数据中隐藏的结构信息。利用增强后的特征，针对SIMON32和SIMECK32分别构建并比较三种ML引导的有向图：K近邻（KNN）、决策树（DT）和随机森林（RF）。

Result: 三种模型在识别高概率差分方面均达到1.0的精确率（零误报）。KNN在聚类分离度、F1分数和构图效率（约2.3秒）方面最优；DT和RF则产生近似完美回归的最优路径。该框架首次实现了差分聚类效应的图可视化——高概率单位比特差分在学习嵌入空间中形成几何上紧密的簇，且结果在两种LCA上一致。

Conclusion: 该框架在SIMON32和SIMECK32上结果一致，证明了其可推广至其他AND-rotation轻量级密码算法家族，为轻量级密码的差分安全性评估提供了一种高效、可可视化的新途径。

Abstract: SIMON and SIMECK belong to a family of Lightweight Cryptographic Algorithms (LCAs) based on the Feistel block cipher, designed for Internet of Things (IoT) devices. As with all Feistel ciphers, they are susceptible to differential cryptanalysis, necessitating rigorous resilience evaluations. While state-of-the-art techniques leverage heuristics and sampling to improve efficiency, little work has applied Machine Learning (ML) guided Graph Representation Learning (GRL) to efficiently identify and visualise high-probability differential clusters. We address this gap by introducing an efficient feature engineering strategy that extracts four differential attributes from a partial Difference Distribution Table (pDDT), revealing structural information concealed in raw differential data. Utilising the enriched features, we construct and compare three ML-guided directed graphs for SIMON$32$ and SIMECK$32$ using K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Trees (DT), and Random Forests (RF). To the best of our knowledge, our framework produces the first graph-based visualisation of the differential clustering effect, in which high-probability single-bit differentials form geometrically close clusters in the learned embedding. All three models achieve a precision of $1.0$ in identifying high-probability differentials, confirming zero false positives. KNN achieves the strongest cluster separation, the highest F1 score and the lowest graph construction time of approximately $2.3$ seconds, while DT and RF produce optimal paths with near-perfect regression. The results are consistent across both LCAs, demonstrating the applicability of the framework to other AND-rotation LCA families.

</details>


### [480] [CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21909)
*Qian Zha,Jinda Liu,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CD-LoRA，一种无路由器的多任务低秩适配方法。作者通过二阶泰勒分析揭示基于路由的LoRA方法存在训练-推理不一致问题，即随机路由决策在分布偏移下损害推理稳定性。CD-LoRA完全去除路由器，采用一致性驱动的对齐机制在共享低秩空间中强化跨任务表征一致性，从而产生鲁棒且任务无关的特征。实验表明CD-LoRA在多项基准上优于现有最新多适配器方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoRA的多任务学习方法依赖复杂的路由机制来划分任务特定知识，但作者发现这种设计存在训练-推理不一致问题：训练时随机路由决策与推理时的分布偏移导致推理不稳定。作者通过二阶泰勒分析证实了路由方差引起的模型不稳定性，因此需要一种更简洁、稳定、无需路由机制的多任务PEFT方案。

Method: CD-LoRA的核心是彻底去除路由器，转而采用一致性驱动的对齐机制，在共享低秩空间中强制跨任务的表征一致性（representation congruence）。该方法不进行显式任务划分，而是通过学习任务无关的鲁棒特征来适配多个任务，降低了额外参数量开销并避免了路由机制带来的不稳定因素。

Result: 大量实验证明CD-LoRA在多个基准上一致超越现有的最先进多适配器方法，且模型结构更简单，训练-推理更稳定，是一种无路由器、更稳定的多任务参数高效微调解决方案。

Conclusion: 作者揭示了路由机制在多任务LoRA中的训练-推理不一致性缺陷，并通过去除路由器、以一致性对齐取代路由划分的思路，验证了更简单、更稳定的多任务PEFT范式是可行且更优的。

Abstract: While Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is essential for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to diverse domains, prevailing LoRA-based methods rely on complex routing mechanisms that partition task-specific knowledge. In this work, we reveal that such routing-based designs are prone to a training-inference discrepancy, where stochastic routing decisions under distribution shifts compromise inference stability. Driven by a second-order Taylor analysis that exposes the instability induced by routing variance, we challenge the training-inference discrepancy and propose Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation (CD-LoRA). By eliminating routers entirely, CD-LoRA employs a consistency-driven alignment mechanism to enforce representation congruence across tasks in a shared low-rank space. This paradigm fosters robust, task-agnostic features without explicit partitioning overhead. Extensive experiments show that CD-LoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-adapter baselines, offering a simpler, router-free, and more stable solution for multi-task PEFT. The code is available at the anonymous link https://github.com/zhaqian21/CD-LoRA.

</details>


### [481] [Spectrum-Aware Bounds on Invertibility for Privacy-Enhancing Instance Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23382)
*Seokjin Hwang,Yuting,Li,Kiwan Maeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一族新的隐私增强编码理论下界，相比现有方法更紧、适用于确定性编码器，并可推广到MSE以外的相似度度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实例编码是常用的隐私增强技术，但大多数工作缺乏理论保证来证明编码过程不可逆。此前的一项工作虽然首次提出了MSE下界来限制对手的重建精度，但该下界存在三个关键局限：过于宽松、仅适用于随机编码器（排除了实践中常用的确定性编码器）、且只限于MSE度量。

Method: 通过合理利用编码器的谱结构，作者引入了一族新的下界。这些下界（1）比现有界更紧，（2）适用于完全确定性的编码器，（3）可扩展到MSE以外的基于范数的相似度度量。

Result: 作者在多种编码器、数据集和攻击方式下评估了新提出的下界，结果显示这些界一致成立，并且优于现有的下界。

Conclusion: 通过正确考虑编码器的谱结构，可以在理论上同时解决现有下界过于宽松、仅限随机编码器、仅限MSE三个局限，为隐私增强编码提供更通用的理论保证。

Abstract: Instance encoding is a popular empirical technique for privacy enhancement when sharing data to an untrusted server. It transforms sensitive data through an encoding process before sharing, with the hope that the encoding process retains utility but makes it hard to reconstruct the original data. However, most work offers no theoretical guarantee that the encoding process is actually irreversible. A recent work derived a mean-squared error (MSE) bound limiting any adversary's reconstruction accuracy, offering one of the first theoretical results in this domain. This bound, however, has three critical limitations: it is often too loose, only works with randomized encoders (excluding many deterministic encoders practitioners use), and only bounds MSE. We introduce a family of new bounds that (1) are tighter, (2) applicable even to fully deterministic encoders, and (3) can extend beyond MSE to other norm-based similarity metrics, by properly accounting for the encoder's spectral structure. We evaluate our bounds across a range of encoders, datasets, and attacks, showing they hold consistently and improve upon the existing bound.

</details>


### [482] [Beyond Fixed Directions: Adaptive Representation Analysis of Reasoning and Memorization in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21919)
*Shaheen Nabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过Qwen3-0.6B模型和400个样本的受控数据集，检验了语言模型中推理与记忆可由单一表示方向刻画的假设。结果表明一维投影可达AUROC=1.00（与全维线性探针相当），但经过GRPO（组相对策略优化）后方向发生显著重组（均方向余弦0.453，探针方向余弦0.445，最终层表示漂移0.511），尽管探针AUROC仍保持1.00。结论支持单方向可解码性，但挑战固定方向稳定性：信息保留而几何实现改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来有工作提出语言模型中的推理和记忆可由单一表示方向刻画，包括在强化学习过程中保持该方向固定的方法。作者旨在检验这一观点背后的两个关键假设：一是推理类与事实回忆类任务组是否近似满足单方向可分离性；二是GRPO训练后该几何结构是否保持稳定。

Method: 使用Qwen3-0.6B模型和一个受控的400示例数据集，通过对比一维投影与全1024维线性探针的性能来评估单方向可分离性；通过测量GRPO训练前后平均方向余弦、探针方向余弦以及最终层直接表示漂移来评估方向稳定性。

Result: 一维投影可与全1024维线性探针匹配，在研究的任务组上AUROC均为1.00；但GRPO后方向发生实质性重组：平均方向余弦为0.453，探针方向余弦为0.445，最终层直接表示漂移达0.511；然而探针AUROC仍保持1.00。

Conclusion: 证据支持所研究任务组具有单方向可解码性，但挑战了固定方向稳定性假设：信息内容得以保留，而其几何实现方式发生变化。

Abstract: Recent work has proposed that reasoning and memorization in language models can be characterized by a single representation direction, including methods that keep this direction fixed during reinforcement learning. We test two assumptions behind this view. First, are reasoning-oriented and factual-recall task groups approximately single-direction separable? Second, does the resulting geometry remain stable after GRPO? Using Qwen3-0.6B and a controlled 400-example dataset, we find that a one-dimensional projection can match a full 1024-dimensional linear probe with AUROC = 1.00 on the studied task groups. However, after GRPO, the corresponding direction is substantially reorganized: mean-direction cosine averages 0.453, probe-direction cosine 0.445, while direct representation drift reaches 0.511 at the final layer. Probe AUROC nevertheless remains 1.00. The evidence therefore supports single-direction decodability for the studied task groups but challenges fixed-direction stability: the information persists while its geometric realization changes.

</details>


### [483] [RAD: Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23468)
*Noah Dahle,Anne Tumlin,Ngoc Tran,Xenofon Koutsoukos,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究关系异常检测问题，提出RAD（规则增强的关系异常检测器），结合异构图表示学习与精炼的符号规则信号，在LANL网络安全事件检测和两个用户流失异常任务上优于平面表格检测器和关系基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法大多要求将多表关系数据库展平为单一特征矩阵，这会模糊实体身份、模式结构和多跳依赖，导致无法检测依赖关系上下文的异常。此外，关系异常检测还面临如何将符号行为证据融入学习到的关系表征这一额外挑战。

Method: RAD方法包含四个步骤：(1) 从随机森林路径中推导候选规则；(2) 将候选规则精炼为紧凑可解释的谓词；(3) 将规则特征注入异构图表示学习模型；(4) 使用基于重构和成对排序的监督信号学习异常分数。同时构建了涵盖三个场景的关系异常检测基准。

Result: 在三个基准场景（LANL网络安全事件、Amazon和H&M用户流失）上，RAD在AUROC和AUPRC上取得了最佳平均排名，优于平面表格检测器和关系基线。消融实验表明直接规则注入和排序监督是关键贡献因素，而边重构并非始终有益。

Conclusion: RAD有效证明了符号规则信号与异构图表示学习的结合能够提升关系异常检测性能，特别是在自然类别不平衡条件下；该工作为关系数据库中的异常检测提供了新的范式，并公开了代码和数据以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Anomaly detection is often applied to data stored in relational databases, yet most existing methods require flattening multiple tables into a single feature matrix. This flattening can obscure entity identity, schema structure, and multi-hop dependencies, limiting the detection of anomalies that depend on relational context rather than isolated feature values. Beyond preserving relational structure, relational anomaly detection raises an additional challenge: how to incorporate symbolic behavioral evidence into learned relational representations. To address these challenges, we study relational anomaly detection, where the goal is to identify anomalous entities or events in a multi-table database. We propose RAD, a rule-augmented relational anomaly detector that combines heterogeneous graph representation learning with refined symbolic rule signals. RAD derives candidate rules from random-forest paths over flattened summaries of the entities or events being scored, refines them into compact interpretable predicates, injects the resulting rule features into the graph model, and learns anomaly scores using reconstruction-based and pairwise-ranking supervision. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a relational anomaly detection benchmark spanning three settings: LANL cybersecurity event detection and two unexpected user-churn anomaly tasks derived from Amazon and H&M relational databases. Experiments show that RAD improves anomaly ranking over flattened tabular detectors and relational baselines under natural class imbalance, achieving the best average rank on AUROC and AUPRC across the benchmark. Ablations show that direct rule injection and ranking-based supervision are key contributors to performance, while edge reconstruction is not uniformly beneficial. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/noahd15/RAD_RelationalAnomalyDetection.

</details>


### [484] [Bi-EZP: LLM-Guided Bilevel Program Evolution for Ensemble Zero-Cost Proxy Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21927)
*Yutao Lai,Kezhao Lai,Hai-Lin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bi-EZP，一个双层次框架来自动构建零成本代理（zero-cost proxies）的集成。上层由大语言模型生成可执行的聚合程序，下层用 CMA-ES 优化程序的连续参数。通过分离结构发现与参数标定，在 NATS-Bench、Network Design Spaces 和 DARTS 上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零成本代理能避免重复训练对候选网络进行排序，但不同代理捕捉不同属性，在跨搜索空间上常产生不一致的排名。现有集成代理的自动发现需要同时优化离散的聚合结构和连续的系数，难以将结构质量与参数标定分离，这增加了搜索难度并影响泛化性能。

Method: 提出 Bi-EZP 双层次框架：上层使用大语言模型生成可执行的聚合程序（整合四种互补的基准代理），并为每个程序指定参数范围；下层使用 CMA-ES 在内部训练集上优化每个固定程序的连续参数。标定后的程序在独立的验证集上通过 Kendall 秩相关系数评估，进化选择倾向于泛化能力强的聚合结构。

Result: 在 NATS-Bench 和 Network Design Spaces 上验证了跨异构搜索空间的排序性能，并通过 DARTS 实验评估下游架构搜索效果。实验表明将程序发现与数值标定分离，能为自动化集成零成本代理构建提供有效途径。

Conclusion: Bi-EZP 通过双层次优化将聚合结构发现与参数标定解耦，有效解决了自动集成零成本代理中离散结构与连续参数混合优化的难题，验证了该方法在跨搜索空间排序和下游架构搜索中的有效性。

Abstract: Zero-cost proxies enable neural architecture search (NAS) to rank candidate networks from statistics computed at initialization, avoiding repeated training. However, different proxies capture different properties and often produce inconsistent rankings across search spaces. Ensemble proxies can combine complementary signals, but automated discovery must optimize both discrete aggregation structures and their continuous coefficients, making structural quality difficult to separate from parameter calibration. We propose Bi-EZP, a bilevel framework that decouples these decisions. At the upper level, a large language model generates executable aggregation programs over four complementary base proxies with program-specific parameter bounds. At the lower level, covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) optimizes the continuous parameters of each fixed program on an inner training split. The calibrated programs are then evaluated using Kendall's rank correlation on a disjoint validation split, enabling evolutionary selection to favor structures that generalize beyond their calibration data. Experiments on NATS-Bench and Network Design Spaces evaluate ranking performance across heterogeneous search spaces, and DARTS experiments assess downstream architecture search. Results show that separating program discovery from numerical calibration provides an effective approach to automated ensemble zero-cost proxy construction. The source code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Bi-EZP-318D

</details>


### [485] [Gated Decoupled Compositional Bandits: A Unified Theory of Contextual Bandits with Supervised-Calibrated Action Scaling and Pre-Execution Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21993)
*Oleg Miroshnichenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出门控解耦组合式Bandit（GDCB），一类包含三种结构创新的上下文Bandit算法家族：(i) 动作由名义臂与上下文相关缩放器的组合构成；(ii) 缩放器参数在独立的监督循环中学习，而非与臂选择联合优化；(iii) 所有动作在执行前经过门控，可修改或否决组合动作。论文形式化该算法类，证明四个结构定理描述其统计行为，并论证六类工业系统（短期租赁动态定价、临床给药、信贷发放、电网需求响应、内容审核、LLM工具使用代理）均为GDCB实例。核心结果是解耦方差缩减定理：良好校准的缩放器可消除臂-奖励映射中由上下文引入的方差，将非平稳Bandit问题转化为近似平稳问题。门控诱导等价定理表明，在平稳门控下，先前任意策略收集的历史数据无需重要性采样修正即可作为有效热启动初始化器。该工作将审批门控、合规规则、安全盾等通常被视为部署摩擦的约束，重新定义为促进快速部署的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文Bandit算法（如LinUCB、LinTS、HierTS、因子Bandit、神经上下文Bandit及RLHF）无法统一解释和建模一类具有实际工业重要性的系统，这些系统共享三个特征：动作由名义臂与上下文缩放器组合而成、缩放器参数单独学习而非与臂选择联合优化、动作执行前经过门控。作者希望通过形式化这一算法类、建立其统计理论基础，为这些高价值工业系统提供统一的理论保证，并重新审视约束在部署中的作用。

Method: 论文定义了GDCB算法类，由三个组件刻画：组合算子（组合名义臂与缩放器）、缩放器家族（决定上下文到缩放参数的映射形式）和门控（执行前修改或否决动作的机制）。基于此形式化框架，作者提出并证明四个结构定理，包括核心的解耦方差缩减定理（说明校准良好的缩放器将非平稳问题变为近似平稳问题）和门控诱导等价定理（说明平稳门控下历史数据可直接作为热启动而不需重要性采样修正）。研究还通过实例映射论证六个工业系统均为GDCB的特定实例。

Result: 论文证明了解耦方差缩减定理和门控诱导等价定理等四个结构定理，刻画了GDCB算法的统计性质。前者表明缩放器能消除上下文导致的方差，使系统近似平稳；后者表明平稳门控下历史数据可免重要性采样直接用于初始化。论文还论证了六个工业系统（短期租赁动态定价、临床药物剂量、信贷发起、电网需求响应、内容审核和LLM工具使用代理）都归入GDCB框架，仅在组合算子、缩放器家族和门控上有所区别。配套论文在真实生产数据上验证了短期租赁动态定价实例。

Conclusion: 作者结论是：在高风险受监管领域，通常被视为部署摩擦的约束（审批门控、合规规则、安全盾）实际上是实现快速部署的机制而非障碍。将缩放器学习与臂选择解耦、引入门控机制，可系统性地利用这些约束来加速部署并保证统计性能，为工业规模上下文Bandit系统提供了统一的理论基础。

Abstract: We introduce Gated Decoupled Compositional Bandits (GDCB), a family of contextual bandit algorithms with three structural innovations that jointly fall outside the taxonomy of LinUCB, LinTS, HierTS, factored bandits, neural contextual bandits, and RLHF. In a GDCB system: (i) the action delivered to the environment is the composition of a nominal arm, drawn by a discrete or hierarchical bandit, with a context-dependent scaler; (ii) the scaler parameter is learned in a separate supervised loop, not jointly with arm selection; and (iii) every action passes through a pre-execution gate that may modify or veto the composed action before it reaches the environment. We formalise this class of algorithms, prove four structural theorems characterising its statistical behaviour, and show that six industrially significant systems -- short-term rental dynamic pricing, clinical drug dosing, credit origination, grid demand response, content moderation, and LLM tool-use agents -- are all instances of GDCB, differing only in the composition operator, scaler family, and gate. The central result is the Decoupling Variance Reduction theorem: a well-calibrated scaler removes context-induced variance from the arm-to-reward mapping, turning a non-stationary bandit problem into an approximately stationary one. The Gate-Induced Equivalence theorem shows that under a stationary gate, historical data collected under any prior policy is a valid warm-up initialiser without importance-sampling correction, generalising the companion P-HITL result (arXiv:2606.02595) from human approval to arbitrary gates. In regulated, high-stakes domains, constraints usually treated as deployment frictions -- approval gates, compliance rules, safety shields -- are the mechanism that makes fast deployment possible, not an obstacle to it. The companion paper validates instance 1 (STR dynamic pricing) on real production data.

</details>


### [486] [DySCo: Dynamically consistent data-driven downscaling of extremes in climate projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21998)
*S. Stamatelopoulos,M. Wang,I. Lopez-Gomez,L. Zepeda-Nunez,Z. Y. Wan,R. Carver,F. Sha,T. P. Sapsis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DySCo（Dynamically and Statistically Consistent downscaling）框架，一种非侵入式降尺度方法，通过数据驱动的nudging重构生成动力学配对的训练轨迹，并训练两阶段算子，在保持与粗尺度GCM动力学一致性的同时实现高分辨率气候降尺度，在LENS2数据集上验证其与最先进无监督模型相当的统计性能且保持优越的动力学一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域气候风险评估（如基础设施设计、灾害预测、保险资源配置）需要高空间分辨率的极端事件统计，但直接使用全球气候模型（GCMs）进行高分辨率长期模拟在计算上不可行。现有降尺度方法虽然能提高分辨率并校正偏差，但关键在于保持动力学一致性——自由演化的GCM轨迹不会追踪训练校正算子所用的观测数据，这对于基于情节（storyline）的因果极端事件分析至关重要。

Method: DySCo框架采用两步策略：(1) 利用数据驱动的nudging（松弛）方法对GCM实现非侵入式校正，生成与粗尺度GCM动力学配对的训练轨迹，避免对GCM进行侵入式修改；(2) 在这些配对轨迹上训练一个两阶段算子，该算子同时满足动力学一致性与统计一致性要求，在时间和空间上将粗分辨率输出映射到高分辨率。

Result: 在Community Earth System Model v2 Large Ensemble (LENS2)上，将粗尺度输出在时间和空间上下采样至历史再分析数据，结果显示DySCo实现了与粗尺度GCM轨迹优越的动力学一致性，本质上对GCM施加了最小化、因果性的校正，同时保持了与最先进无监督模型可比的顶尖统计性能。

Conclusion: DySCo成功解决了降尺度中动力学一致性与统计准确性之间的权衡问题，为高分辨率降尺度提供了一种在极端事件目录生成和情节式风险评估中具有重要应用价值的框架，在不引入侵入式模型修改的前提下实现了两者兼顾。

Abstract: Regional climate risk assessment is critical for applications such as infrastructure design, disaster forecasting, and insurance resource allocation. However, estimating regional (i.e., high-spatial-resolution) risk with global climate models (GCMs) remains computationally prohibitive, which has driven the development of downscaling methods for coarse GCM outputs. Downscaling is vital for rare events, since quantifying their extreme properties requires high spatial resolution and very long GCM simulations. These methods non-intrusively increase GCM resolution while correcting statistical biases from unresolved fine-scale processes, thereby improving the accuracy of extreme event statistics with long return periods. A key challenge is preserving dynamical consistency, as freely evolving GCM trajectories are not expected to track the observational dataset used for training the correction operator. This is critical for causal extreme event analyses, where storyline-based risk assessment, i.e., extreme event catalogs, is necessary for effective planning. We address this challenge by introducing Dynamically and Statistically Consistent downscaling (DySCo), a non-intrusive framework yielding high-resolution climate projections consistent with coarse GCM dynamics. DySCo relies on a data-driven reformulation of nudging to create dynamically paired training trajectories without intrusive GCM modifications. Using these paired trajectories, we train a dynamically and statistically consistent, two-stage operator. We evaluate the method by downscaling the Community Earth System Model v2 Large Ensemble (LENS2) in time and space towards historical reanalysis. Results show DySCo achieves superior dynamical consistency with the coarse GCM trajectories, essentially applying a minimal, causal correction to the GCM, preserving top statistical performance comparable to state-of-the-art unsupervised models.

</details>


### [487] [The Communication Map of a Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22007)
*Richard Zhe Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"通信地图"(communication map)，一种仅从权重出发、统一量化Transformer中所有18类潜在通信通道耦合强度的工具，可在一张图上描绘模型中每个注意力头、神经元等组件之间的信息流连接。该地图计算迅速（GPT-2仅需15秒），揭示了70-89%的头对显著偏离随机，并展示了两项应用：恢复盲发现的归纳电路以及识别一个独特的二维流子空间，其删除会消除六种模型的归纳能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer组件通过共享残差流进行通信，但此前可解释性研究主要依赖人工逐个电路地映射这些连接，效率低下且难以覆盖所有潜在通道。作者希望从权重出发，系统化地绘制模型中所有可能的通信通道，而非仅依赖人工追踪。

Method: 将Elhage等人(2021)的组合分数推广为一个统一的耦合系数，覆盖全部18类连接（从整个注意力头电路到单个神经元），仅根据权重即可计算。作者对GPT-2（6.3×10^8通道）到Pythia-6.9B（1.3×10^11通道）的模型进行了全量普查，并开发了干预套件用于验证。

Result: 发现70-89%的头对朝向远非随机分布，有些强耦合、有些主动回避。完整地图在单张消费级GPU上对GPT-2仅需15秒、对Pythia-6.9B仅需11分钟。最强头-头耦合能盲恢复已知的归纳电路并聚成社区，消融某社区会破坏模型上下文复制能力。将所有头的耦合系数池化可识别出独特的二维流子空间，其删除可在六个模型中消除归纳能力，且该子空间不同于激活PCA或离群维度识别的子空间。

Conclusion: 通信地图提供了一种可扩展、仅基于权重的全量通信通道映射方法，补充并超越了传统的人工电路追踪和激活分析手段，可广泛用于Transformer的可解释性研究。作者公开了地图、统计工具和干预套件。

Abstract: The components of a transformer communicate by writing to and reading from a shared residual stream, and mechanistic interpretability has mapped these connections by hand, one circuit at a time. We present the communication map, which charts every potential communication channel in a language model from weights alone, generalizing the composition score of Elhage et al. (2021) into a single coupling coefficient covering all 18 connection classes, from entire attention head circuits to single neurons. The census of all candidate channels, from $6.3\times10^{8}$ in GPT-2 to $1.3\times10^{11}$ in Pythia-6.9B, finds that 70-89% of head pairs are oriented far from chance, some coupled strongly and others actively avoiding each other.
