Experiments on 18 datasets, 23 state-of-the-art lightweight forecasters, and 14 baselines demonstrate that MetaCaster achieves both data efficiency and computational efficiency while maintaining high-quality TSF performance.

</details>


### [589] [How to Train a Critic Stably and Efficiently](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23566)
*Penghui Qi,Xiangxin Zhou,Wee Sun Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为BPCO（最佳实践批评者优化）的配方，解决了基于批评者（critic）的大语言模型强化学习训练不稳定问题。BPCO通过组合DPPO、受限价值预测、蒙特卡洛价值目标、未归一化策略优势和长度自适应GAE等设计，使基于批评者的训练在数学推理任务中稳定有效，性能匹配或超越基于分组采样（如GRPO）的基线，同时每个提示仅需采样一个响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于分组的强化学习方法（如GRPO）无需训练批评者，通过为每个提示采样多个响应来估计优势，但批评者若能可靠地从单个响应估计token级优势，将更高效。然而标准批评者训练配方往往不稳定，因此需要研究这种不稳定性并设计可靠的批评者训练方案。

Method: BPCO配方包含五个关键设计：DPPO、将价值预测限制在奖励范围内、使用蒙特卡洛价值目标、未归一化的策略优势、以及长度自适应广义优势估计（GAE）。此外，由于批评者仅在训练时使用，可将其条件化到奖励定义相关的信息（如参考答案或评分标准）上，这些信息对策略不可见。通过受控实验隔离每个设计选择的效果。

Result: 在从1.5B参数到30B-A3B混合专家模型的多种模型规模下，BPCO在数学推理任务中一致地提升了强批评者基线性能，并在每个提示仅采样一个响应的情况下匹配或超越基于分组的基线。该配方同样适用于基于评分标准的奖励学习。

Conclusion: 精心设计的批评者能够为分组相对优势估计提供可靠的替代方案，证明批评者路径是可用于大语言模型强化学习的实用且高效的方法。

Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop \textbf{Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)}, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized policy advantages, and length-adaptive generalized advantage estimation. Because the critic is used only during training, BPCO can also condition it on reward-defining information, such as a reference answer or grading rubric, that is hidden from the policy. Controlled experiments isolate the effect of each design choice. Across mathematical reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B parameters to 30B-A3B mixtures of experts, BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline consistently, and matches or exceeds a group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt. The same recipe also improves learning with rubric-based rewards. These results show that a carefully designed critic provides a reliable alternative to group-relative advantage estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic

</details>


### [590] [Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19234)
*Eddy Soria,Aida Valls,Ana Beatriz Hernández-Lara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的三角模糊数距离度量——三角模糊重缩放距离（d_{TR}），该度量将线性重缩放（LRE）直接集成到距离计算中，避免了传统方法需先归一化再计算距离的预处理步骤。作者形式化证明了d_{TR}满足度量空间的全部性质（非负性、同一性、对称性和三角不等式），并验证了其有界性、尺度不变性和原点不变性。该度量结合权重向量可用于异构模糊数据的多准则决策、合成指标构建和基于距离的机器学习任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂系统决策中，模糊三角数（TFNs）常用于表示不精确或不确定信息，而量化TFNs之间的距离是许多模糊方法的核心。然而，现有距离度量假设所有值处于同一尺度，当面对具有不同尺度或单位的异构属性时，需要额外的归一化预处理步骤，这增加了复杂性并可能引入偏差。本文旨在解决这一挑战，提出一种将归一化直接嵌入距离计算的新度量。

Method: 作者提出了d_{TR}（Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance），其关键创新在于将线性重缩放（LRE）直接集成到距离计算过程中，在比较模糊数时同时完成归一化。论文通过数学证明验证了d_{TR}满足度量的四个基本性质（非负性、同一性、对称性和三角不等式），并证明了其具备有界性、尺度不变性和原点不变性。此外，该度量支持权重向量用于维度优先级排序，适用于异构模糊数据场景。

Result: 论文形式化证明了d_{TR}是满足度量公理的指标，包括非负性、同一性、对称性和三角不等式；同时证明其具有有界性、尺度不变性和原点不变性，这些性质表明d_{TR}在异构数据下无需预处理即可直接使用，且不受量纲和坐标原点变化的影响。

Conclusion: d_{TR}为异构模糊数据的距离度量提供了一种无需预归一化的理论优雅且实用的方案，结合权重向量后，适用于合成指标构建、基于距离的机器学习算法以及多准则决策辅助等应用场景。

Abstract: Decision-making in complex systems often involves dealing with imprecise or uncertain information, frequently represented using fuzzy sets, particularly Triangular Fuzzy Numbers (TFNs). A crucial aspect of many fuzzy methods is the quantification of distance between TFNs. Many distance measures assume that all values are in the same scale, requiring a preliminary normalization stage when applied to heterogeneous attributes with different scales or units. This paper proposes the Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance (d_{TR}), a metric designed to address this challenge. The d_{TR} uniquely integrates Linear Rescaling (LRE) directly into the distance calculation, ensuring normalization during the comparison of fuzzy numbers. We formally prove that d_{TR} satisfies the properties of a metric, including non-negativity, identity, symmetry, and the triangle inequality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that d_{TR} is bounded, scale-invariant, and origin-invariant. These properties, combined with a weighting vector for prioritizing dimensions, make d_{TR} suitable for applications involving heterogeneous fuzzy data, such as the construction of synthetic indicators, distance-based machine learning algorithms or multicriteria-decision aiding.

</details>
